title: Relaxing stay
text: We stayed at Almanity for 3 nights in the heat of June. The pool was magical and provided relief from the heat and made our stay wonderful and relaxing. There were plenty of sunlounges and shade. The pool cafe was a highlight, serving delicious drinks and food. I recommend the club sandwich. MOC Garden restaurant also served delicious meals. It is a bit of a walk to get to the ancient town - but once the sun goes down the walk is ok. The breakfast provided lots of options and is a real highlight.

title: What could be the reason for removing the star rating?
text: I understand that it is difficult to maintain the quality that was previously provided, especially during tough economic times. However, everything here, from the employees' attitudes to cleanliness, was satisfactory. I felt there was no reason it shouldn't be rated a 5. During my month-long stay in Da Nang, I stayed at six different hotels, and this place had the cleanest shower filter. Additionally, there were always lifeguards present at the pool, ensuring safety and maintaining the water quality, which allowed me to enjoy swimming comfortably. From the moment I took the taxi and greeted the staff to the cleaning personnel and restaurant employees, everyone was friendly and proactive, making my stay very comfortable. The breakfast might not be extremely diverse, but there was still a decent variety of enjoyable dishes, and fresh vegetables were provided daily, which was a plus!

title: Very good
positives:
Location is great! Beautiful hotel. The rooms are dated and a little dark, but otherwise quite nice. Bathrooms are ok- very basic for a 5 star hotel in this price range. The star attraction of this hotel is the pool as you can see in the stock photos. 
Service is pretty good. Location is wonderful, and the gardens are quite nice and beautifully maintained. 
I requested a change from the superior/Loft room I booked because it had too many stairs and the bedroom upstairs was a bit claustrophobic inducing. Too many step ups and step downs to the bathroom and back which I didn’t appreciate. And the WiFi didn’t work either. 
After requesting the front desk to change my room, initially I was met with resistance and told if I changed, I’d have to pay an additional fee, which was considerable. I requested the staff speak to the manager, who to his credit, he did, and they ended up changing my room to a regular room. This wasn’t as nice or had any special features, but at least it was less stairs and step ups and downs. Probably a room with a lesser rate than I originally paid, but I was pleased they honored my request. 
We used the spa and that was ok. Very expensive for the money we spent, but it was nice to have a facility to unwind right on the premises. 
Breakfast buffet is quite good. Enjoyed the yogurt and the muesli, fresh herbs and vegetables from their garden (which we didn’t see or spot on the premises), a decent selection of local fruits and a range of Korean and Vietnamese options.

negatives:

I left early to another hotel and wasted one night of payment.

We recommend that you Choose the non-loft rooms and choose room away from kitchen and bring earplugs.

title: Thank you to the really kind staff.
text:
I lost my passport.
After finishing a two-day trip in Da Nang, I moved to this accommodation and realized that I left my passport in Da Nang. At that moment, one of the staff members kindly helped me.

That staff member calmed my shocked heart and accurately understood the situation. She clearly guided me on what was needed and how to resolve it quickly. Many people were kind during my trip to Vietnam, but this staff member was the kindest and most capable. She made me personally feel the reason for choosing a good accommodation.

The only way I can repay her is by leaving a good review. I expressed my gratitude in my limited English, but I want to sincerely thank her once again.

Thanks to her, I was able to conclude my trip enjoyably.

The accommodation was very beautiful.
The breakfast had a variety of foods, and everything was delicious.
I chose this accommodation because of the swimming pool, and it was much more satisfactory than the photos.

The reception staff, those who greeted me whenever we met, the people who organized the room, and even those who managed the pool at night all provided excellent service.

If I visit Hanoi again, I will choose this accommodation without hesitation.

그 직원분은 놀란 마음을 진정시켜 주었고, 상황을 정확하게 파악했습니다. 무엇이 필요한지, 어떻게 해야 빠르게 해결할 수 있는지 명확하게 안내해 주셨습니다. 베트남 여행 동안 많은 분들이 친절했지만, 이 직원분은 가장 친절하고 가장 능숙한 분이었습니다. 좋은 숙소를 선택해야 하는 이유를 직접 느끼게 해주었습니다.

제가 그분께 보답할 수 있는 방법은 좋은 리뷰를 남기는 것뿐입니다. 부족한 영어로 감사 인사를 전했지만, 다시 한번 진심으로 감사하다는 말씀을 전하고 싶습니다.

덕분에 여행을 즐겁게 마무리할 수 있었습니다.

숙소는 매우 아름다웠습니다.
조식은 음식 종류가 다양했고 모두 맛있었습니다.
수영장이 좋아서 선택한 숙소였는데, 사진보다 훨씬 만족스러웠습니다.

리셉션 직원, 마주칠 때마다 인사해 주신 분들, 객실을 정리해 주신 분들, 밤에 수영장을 관리해 주신 분들까지 모든 직원분들께서 훌륭한 서비스를 제공해 주셨습니다.

다시 하노이에 방문하게 된다면 고민 없이 이 숙소를 선택할 것입니다.

I lost my passport.
After spending two days in Da Nang, I moved to this hotel and realized that I had left my passport there. At that moment, one of the staff members helped me very kindly.

She not only calmed me down, but also clearly understood the situation. She knew exactly what information was needed and what steps to take for a quick solution. Many people were kind during my trip in Vietnam, but she was the kindest and most capable person I met. She made me realize why staying at a good hotel is important.

The only thing I can do for her is to leave a good review. I tried to thank her in my limited English, but I want to say again that I truly appreciate her help.

Thanks to her, I was able to finish my trip happily.

The hotel itself was beautiful.
The breakfast had a wide variety of food and everything was delicious.
I chose this hotel because of the swimming pool, and it was even better than the photos.

All the staff provided excellent service. The reception staff, the people who greeted me, the housekeeping staff, and even the person taking care of the pool at night were all wonderful.

If I visit Hanoi again, I will definitely stay at this hotel without hesitation.

title: Acceptable
negatives:
Hotel was not accommodating about rescheduling needs. Once we found out there was a mandatory holiday dinner we didn't want to stay as many nights. They still charged us the full amount even though there was no mention of a holiday dinner when originally booking.

The room was not worth the price. We had jacuzzi roof top suite and it took hours to fill up the jacuzzi with hot water. There was also water still in the jacuzzi from the previous guest. It didn't give me a sense of clean. The staff should have done more to explain how to operate the jacuzzi when showing us the room, or offered to set it up for us at a time of our choosing. It is supposed to be one of the main perks of the rooftop room after all. The other disappointing feature of staying on the rooftop is you have almost no view of the pool and it was a 5 minute hike to the lobby from the roof top, if I had known that I would have booked us a much cheaper room on the courtyard level. 

And then when texting the whatsapp for information about the spa menu they asked for our room number, called our room and then told us to scan a QR code in the room but we couldn't find it. There really should be paper spa menus in every room if the hotel is claiming to be a spa resort. When we did eventually book a massage the scheduling was difficult. There were very few times available. It was not a seamless process.

We stayed in nicer hotels in Vietnam for less than half the price. This resort was not good for my wellness even though wellness is in the hotel name.

年末年始をゆっくり過ごすのに最高でした。
お部屋もゆったりで、毎日掃除されていてとても清潔です。
朝ごはんが美味しいので、早起きする気持ちになれます。
ホイアンの街まで徒歩で行けるので、観光もしやすく素敵な滞在が出来ます。

The room had a jacuzzi, which took some time to fill, but we were able to comfortably soak together up to our shoulders, which was enough to relieve our travel fatigue.

Good swimming pool

author: Teresita

title: It was satisfying.
text: I stayed in the loft room and it was better than I expected. The room condition was good, and they accommodated my requests, which was nice! Walking to Old Town is okay to do about once a day, but going twice is tough. I recommend having lunch at the restaurant right in front and going for a walk to Old Town around dusk to enjoy it! It's farther than I thought, and the walking path is not a proper sidewalk, which makes it challenging. I found it a bit strange that food is not allowed in the room. Apparently, there’s a fine for breaking this rule. However, they do have decent room service, haha. I obviously knew about durian and mangosteen, but I didn't quite understand why other foods weren't allowed. The pool is so beautiful that I used it twice! Breakfast is average, and the checkout time is generous, which is great. The shower valve was a bit inconvenient, and the bathroom doesn’t ventilate well, so if you go with your partner, make sure to avoid any big moments, haha!

title: Next time I go to Hoi An, I will definitely plan to go here.
text:
My younger sibling had a room on the second floor, while I was in the first room, and we stayed for one night and two days on the recommendation of my biological sibling.

First of all, every staff member we encountered from the parking lot to the room was friendly. It really lifted my spirits!

The lobby was clean, and although the accommodation was duplex, it wasn't uncomfortable at all. I think it would be better to book a regular floor if you have a child or are bringing your parents!

The room was clean, and it had most essentials. It may not be on par with a luxury hotel, but it was tidy, which I appreciated.

When we entered and unpacked, I was worried because the air conditioning wasn’t working, but when I called the front desk, a staff member promptly came up, explained the situation, and by the time we returned from swimming, it was working normally. The staff member who attended to my discomfort kept asking if there was anything else that was bothering me for over five minutes. That was quite touching.

Breakfast was better than I expected. The made-to-order omelets and pho were nice, there were many drink options, and it was great that they brought a drink of your choice as soon as you sat down.

The swimming pool had good water quality, and both the lifeguard and the female staff members were extremely friendly.

I felt really regretful that I only stayed for one day.

There wasn’t a single staff member who wasn’t friendly, and I want to thank the female staff member, whose name I don’t know, who wore a white shirt and black pants, took pictures for us, and stored our luggage separately before we left!

I will definitely visit again!!!!

P.S. Everyone has their own preferences, but personally, I was very satisfied with this accommodation. This quality for this price, plus breakfast, is a win!! There are cafes nearby, and within about five minutes, there are fee-free ATMs such as Shinhan Sol Travel and Travelogue.

동생은 2방, 저는 첫방이었고 친동생 추천으로 1박2일 지내다 왔습니다.

우선 주차장에서부터 객실에 올라갈때까지 마주치는 모든 직원분들이 친절했습니다. 기분이 좋아지더라구요!

로비도 깔끔하고, 숙소는 복층이었지만 크게 불편한 건 없었습니다. 만약 아이가 있거나 부모님을 모시고 간다면 복층이 아닌 층을 예약하는 게 좋을 것 같지만요!

객실은 청결했고, 웬만한 건 전부 구비되어 있습니다. 특급 호텔만큼은 아니지만 깔끔해서 좋았습니다.

들어가서 짐을 풀다보니 에어컨이 되지 않아서 걱정이었는데 프론트에 전화하니 직원분이 바로 올라오셔서 상황 설명해주시고 수영하고 돌아오니 정상적으로 작동하였고, 제가 겪은 불편에 대해 5분 이상의 직원분이 죄송하다고 추가로 불편한 건 없는지 마주칠때마다 물어봐주시더라구요. 그런 점이 감동이었어요.

조식은 기대했던것보다 괜찮았습니다. 즉석에서 조리해주는 오믈렛과 쌀국수도 좋았고, 음료 종류도 많았고, 자리에 앉자마자 원하는 음료 한 잔을 가져다 주는 것도 좋았습니다.

수영장은 수질 괜찮았고, 상주하시는 가드분도 여성 직원분들도 너무너무 친절했습니다.

여기에 하루를 머물렀는데 너무 아쉽더라구요.

칭찬을 하지 않을 직원이 없을 정도로 모든 분이 친절하셨고, 흰셔츠에 검은 바지 입은 이름은 모르지만 사진도 찍어주시고, 나가기 전 짐도 따로 보관해주신 여직원분 감사해요!

꼭 다시 방문할게요!!!!

ps. 사람마다 개인차가 있겠지만, 개인적으로 저는 정말 만족한 숙소였습니다. 이 가격에 이 정도 퀄리티에 조식까지 더해져서 굳!! 근처에 카페도 있고, 5분정도 거리에 신한sol트래블을 비롯한 트래블로그 등 수수료 안 나오는 atm 기기도 있습니당

The pool is lovely, as are the staff who are regularly taking and delivering poolside drinks and food orders. The spa and gym are great (although you need to book the spa a day in advance). title: Thanks to the front staff.
text:
I would like to express my gratitude to Mr. Dinh Tan Binh, the front staff.

My family of three stayed for two days. My daughter is already a working adult, and she returned separately to Fukuoka and Osaka. On that day, our flight was significantly delayed, causing us to miss our connecting flight. I was using a translation app to inquire via email but received no response, so I consulted the front desk out of frustration. They grasped the situation and kindly called the airline's customer service to change our flight. 

Thanks to their assistance, we were able to attend work the next day without further delay. I am truly grateful to them for listening to our concerns and resolving the situation. Thank you very much.

Regarding the hotel, it was quiet, and all the staff were very kind, allowing us to have a very pleasant holiday. Thank you.
text_original:
フロントスタッフのMR. DINH TAN BINHに御礼申し上げます。

家族3名で二日間宿泊させていただきました。娘は既に社会人、帰りは福岡と大阪へ別々に帰国。当日飛行機がかなり遅延して出発が遅れる事で経由便の乗り継ぎが間に合わず、翻訳ソフトを駆使しメールで問い合わせていましたが返信がなく困ってフロントに相談。事態を把握して航空会社のカスタマーへ電話をして便の変更をして下さいました。
それにより無事翌日遅れる事なく会社に出社できました。不安な私たちに優しく内容を聞いてくださり解決してくださった事、心より感謝します。本当にありがとうございました。

ホテルについても静かでスタッフ皆さん優しい方ばかりで、とても良い休日を過ごせました、ありがとうございました。

title: Value to stay.
text:
This is a lovely hotel with super friendly staff. It can be a bit tricky to get the air conditioning in the room just right, and while the bathtub and shower are separate, it's a little hard to use them without getting the floor wet. The facilities are a bit old, so if you have high expectations, you might notice a few things that aren’t perfect.

That said, it’s a charming resort-style hotel with a touch of old-school luxury, and if you’re a bit flexible, you can really enjoy your stay here. The staff are always eager to help, and apart from the housekeeping team, everyone speaks very good English, which makes everything easier.

Breakfast is fantastic — there’s a great variety and it’s thoughtfully prepared, so even if you’re staying for several days, you won’t get bored of it.

It’s also really close to the main riverside area in Hoi An, with lots of shops and things to see, so there’s always something to do.

If you’re thinking of staying in Hoi An, I’d definitely recommend this place!

positives: I want to tell you that my name is Abdulrahman Almahmoud from Qatar, not Ahmed from Bahrain, many times asking you to change
author: AHMED

title: Clean and peacefull hotel
text:
Vety clean and peacefull hotel just from walkin distance from the Hoi An old quarters.

Personnel was ready to assist in all your matters. They arranged a surprise on a birthday in a short notice.
author: Maarit

title: Exceptional
positives: Absolutamente todo. Es un sitio increíble
negatives: La única cosa mala, por decir algo, es que no tenían Bloody Mary 😅
author: Paula

title: I recommend it because the location is also close to Old Town.
text: The hotel is located within 10-15 minutes of Old Town, and there are also spa shops nearby. It's convenient to use for drop-offs when heading to the airport. The hygiene of the hotel was good, and the color of the swimming pool water was a bit cloudy, but other than that, it was nice. The staff was friendly, and I liked it!
text_original:
호텔기준 올드타운 10-15분 이내 위치하고
호텔근처에 스파샵도 가까이있어서
공항 나갈때에 아용해서 드롭가는것도 편리해요
호탤위생상태 좋았고 수영장은 물 색깔이
조금 탁했는데 그거빼곤 좋아요 직원들도 친절하시구 맘에듭니다!
author: eunji

title: Más oara gente joven
positives: Ubicación, amviente
negatives: Habitación doble con escaleras peligrosas para el baño
author: VILMA

title: Hoi An has a beautiful resort with a swimming pool.
text:
I have visited Hoi An several times, but this is my first time at the Almanity Resort.

I chose Almanity Resort because I wanted to spend a relaxing time by the pool.

The lifeguard, whose name is TAN, is friendly and has a beautiful smile. Because of TAN, who created wonderful memories for me, this is a resort I want to visit again.

It is within walking distance to the old town and has a great location.
text_original:
호이안을 여러번 방문했으나 알마니티 리조트는 처음 방문했습니다.

수영장에서 한가로운 시간을 보내고싶어 선택한 알마니티 리조트..

친절하고 미소가 아름다운 라이프가드의 이름은 TAN 입니다.  좋은 추억을 남기게 해준 TAN 때문에 다시 오고 싶은 리조트 입니다.

올드타운으로 도보 이동 가능하고 위치 좋아요
author: SUJEONG

title: Exceptional
positives:
Personal super amable
Buena ubicación cerca del casco antiguo aunque no lo pudiéramos ver por las instalaciones
author: Noelia

title: Lovely stay
text:
Lovely stay beautiful pool breakfast was amazing so much choice 
Ideal location not far to walk into old town.
author: Janek

title: Para repetir
positives: La habitación era maravillosa, el desayuno estupendo , las cenas , el personal
author: Antonio

title: Solid Hotel
text: Very good hotel. Lots of kids though. Some of them were screaming in the pool at 6:30am. I think the hotel should have a rule about early morning noise. Perhaps it is better not to have a room facing the pool.
author: Charles

title: HOTEL PARA DISFRURAR
positives:
La piscina es espectacular. La ubicación a 10 min andando de la zona antigua y con mil sitios para comprar y comer. La habitación con jacuzzi perfecta. Para dos personas grandes sin problemas. El personal de recepción, como es de esperar, muy profesionales y súper amables.
Los 30 minutos gratis de masaje en las piernas es un detallazo.
negatives:
Como crítica constructiva, en el jacuzzi de la habitación, el botón de llenado debería pararse automáticamente, porque hasta que no metes la pata la primera vez, lo más probable es que inundes la terraza. :-) 
Por el tamaño de la habitación, no me gusto que no hubiera armario y que la ducha fuera tan pequeña.
author: PCamerino

title: The staff members are wonderful.
text: All the staff, including the shuttle drivers, are very kind and friendly. They patiently engaged with my poor English until the end. The breakfast is very delicious, and the freshly made donuts were the best. The breeze by the poolside is very pleasant, making you want to stay there forever. It gets too hot outside during the day, so spending time at the pool is the right choice. I regret not bringing my swimsuit. Next time, I will definitely bring one. The room facilities are standard, and I was able to spend my time without any problems. It comes with air conditioning.
text_original: 送迎ドライバー含め、全てのスタッフさんがとても親切でフレンドリーです。こちらの下手な英語にも最後まで付き合ってくれます。朝食はとても美味しい。揚げたてのドーナツが最高でした。プールサイドは吹き抜ける風がとても心地よく、いつまでもいたくなります。日中は外が暑すぎるので、プールで過ごすのが正解。水着を持ってこなかったことを後悔しています。次回は必ず水着持参します。部屋の設備は普通。問題なく過ごせました。エアコン付きです。
title_original: スタッフさんが素晴らしい
author: RYOKO

title: Muy recomendable, me ha encantado
positives: Todo perfecto, habitación muy grande y cómoda, una piscina muy rica y un desayuno perfecto
negatives:
No está bien insonorizado y se oye mucho el pasillo.
Pero no es un problema.
author: Willian

title: Perfect location
text:
This hotel is perfect for Hoi An- within walking distance to the old town, and about 10min taxi ride to the beach.
The staff were so friendly.
Pool area was amazing, and the breakfast also very good with plenty of choice.
The only room for inprovement was the gym, which felt a bit dated and was SO hot.
I think if I went to the beach again, I’d make my own way rather than use the shuttle to a “private beach”, which is actually a beach club with only 22 beds on the beach.
Otherwise, Almanity was perfect!
author: Stephen

title: Con poco esfuerzo podrían mejorar mucho la satisfacción del cliente.
positives: Y ubicación, atención de gran parte del personal, la atención en el desayuno y piscina
negatives:
Piscina llena de niños y sus juguetes que dificultaban un baño tranquilo y agradable.
Acceso a la habitación incómodo , mantenimiento de la habitación, limpieza mejorable., estado de las toallas, amenities.
author: Pau

title: My favorite hotel
text: Hands down my favorite hotel in all of Vietnam!  Amazing staff and incredible pool. And best hotel breakfast ever!  I would come back to Vietnam just to stay at this place.  Highly recommended!
author: Jay

title: Buen hotel muy bien ubicado
positives:
Ubicación 
Limpieza
Atención
negatives:
Habitación duplex con escalera
Ruido de la piscina
author: Susana

title: 2 Night Stay
text: Lovely hotel although a little dated and in need of some modernisation. Rooms were large with big comfy bed and staff were helpful and friendly. We had a huge wasps nest on our balcony but this was quickly sorted once we alerted staff to it. Breakfast was lovely with plenty of variety. Location was great for centre of Hoi An.
author: Amanda

title: Me encantaría repetir!
positives: Es una pasada de hotel!
negatives: Nada malo que decir.
author: Monica

title: I enjoyed it so much that I want to visit again next time.
text: Due to circumstances, I could only stay for one night, but I'm really disappointed about thatㅠㅠ The staff were very kind, and the room condition was great! To be honest, I booked because of the Anamanity pool, and the pool view was unbelievable.. I had breakfast while looking at the pool, and it was so enjoyable.... When I come back to Hoi An, I will definitely stay here again. It was that good.
text_original: 사정상 1박밖에 못 했는데 그게 너무 아쉬워요ㅠㅠㅠ직원분들 너무 친절하시고 룸 컨디션도 좋아요! 사실 알마니티 수영장 하나 보고 예약했는데 역시나 수영장 뷰 장난 아니에요.. 조식 먹을 때 수영장 보면서 먹었는데 너무 행복했습니다.... 다음에 호이안 오면 전 또 이곳에서 묶을 거예요. 그 정도로 너무 좋았습니다.
title_original: 다음에 또 재방문하고 싶을 정도로 너무 좋았어요.
author: JISUN

title: Exceptional
positives: Todo increíble. Buena atención, rico desayuno, gimnasio completo, piscina perfecta
negatives: Lo único malo es la señal de Wifi.
author: Nicolas

title: Thanks to the resort staff's service, I had a more comfortable and happy time.
text: I booked the Almanty Resort because the pool is beautiful, and thanks to the staff member Ngoc, I felt very comfortable and received VIP treatment. Every breakfast, she personally brought me coffee, asked how I was doing, and always greeted me with a smile, making it a truly unforgettable trip. Thank you^^
text_original: 알마니티 리조트가 수영장이 예뻐서 예약했는데 Ngoc직원덕분에 너무 편안하고 vip대접받았어요. 아침식사때마다 직접 커피도 챙겨주시고 항낭 안부 물어봐주시고 항상 웃는 얼굴로 응대해주셔서 정말 잊지못할 여행이 되었어요. 고마워요^^
title_original: 리조트직원 응대덕분에 더 편안하고 행복한 시간을 보냈어요.
author: Gwon

title: Sin duda volvería y lo recomiendo
positives: El personal y la atención fueron excelentes así como el "afternoon tea" diario para todos los clientes del hotel. Excelente y un detalle que se valora mucho y lo hace más especial al hotel
author: Segismundo

title: Satisfaction, emotional atmosphere, relaxation.
text:
I booked considering the cost-effectiveness among the resorts.

1. The breakfast was very abundant and of good quality, everything was well-kept and hygienic. I ate a lot, haha.

2. The swimming pool is beautiful, and there are deep areas great for playing and soaking. There are plenty of sunbeds, which is great. The fries are delicious, and the price was just right, so I had them twice. The beer is served in a chilled glass, which is very refreshing.

3. The hibiscus tea given during check-in was so delicious, and the staff were friendly. They helped us with any questions, and they were also good at storing our luggage and renting out bicycles during check-out. I forgot a mango in the room fridge, but the staff checked the room as we were checking out, asked us about it, and returned it to us.
text_original:
리조트중에서 좀 가성비 생각하고 예약했음

1. 조식 너무너무 많고 퀄 좋고 하나하나 보관 냉장 위생 다 굿이었음 오래먹음 ㅋㅋㅋ

2. 수영장 존예고 깊은곳도 있어서 놀기도 몸담그기도 좋음
선베드 많은것도 좋고
감튀 존맛이고 가격 딱좋아서 두번먹고
맥주 얼음잔에 주는데 속이 시웡함 아주 청량

3. 체크인시 주는 히비스커스차 너무 맛있고 직원들 친절함 뭐 물어보면 다해주고 체크아웃할때 짐보관도 자전거 대여도 잘해줌
방 냉장고에 잊고 망고 듀고왔는데 체크아웃시 바로 직원이 방 한번 체크하면서 우리한테 물어보고 갖다줌
author: ban

title: una experiencia grandiosa
positives: el desayuno magnifico, la piscina hermosa
negatives: la habitación que me asignaron no era tan linda como la otra de mi familia
author: DISEÑO

title: Gorgeous
text: Just a lovely peaceful and beautiful place.
author: Blanche
reply:
Dear Blanche,

Thank you for your wonderful review. We're delighted to hear that you found Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa to be a peaceful and beautiful place—it truly means a lot to us.

We hope your stay in our Loft Room was comfortable and memorable. The unique split-level design offers a tranquil space to unwind, and we’re so pleased it left a positive impression.

We’d love to welcome you back for a longer stay in the future.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Buen hotel y muy bien situado
positives: Muy buena situation, personal muy amable y desayuno muy bueno con calidad y variedad.
negatives: Nuestra habitación tenía dos niveles ( dos pisos ) estado la cama en el piso de arriba, y las escaleras siempre son un problema y un riesgo
author: Javier

title: Fantastic stay, attentive staff
text: I had a fantastic time staying at Almanity. The staff was incredibly kind and gave a bunch of great recommendations for food, coffee, drinks, activities, and tailors. They went above and beyond to address any minor issues I brought to their attention. The facilities are also very pretty. I stayed in a loft room and it was a wonderfully unique stay. Conveniently located a short walk from all the best Hoi An has to offer. Highly recommend staying here!
author: Clayton
reply:
Dear Clayton,

Thank you for your kind and detailed review. We’re thrilled to hear that your stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa was fantastic and that our team was able to enhance your experience with thoughtful service and local recommendations.

We’re especially glad you enjoyed the unique design of our Loft Room. Its split-level layout offers a special touch for guests seeking something a little different, while still providing comfort and a peaceful retreat.

It’s also wonderful to know you found the location convenient for exploring all that Hoi An has to offer. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Excellent
positives: La piscina y los masajes son estupendos, además del desayuno súper completo y variado
author: Maria

title: Ok hotel
text: We stayed here for 3 nights, the hotel is not far from town. The rooms are a bit old and it’s very hard to control the water temperature. The should do better cleaning, our toilet smelled very bad of pee and it was very dusty and they only provided one toilet roll per night. The staff are welcoming, but we asked the reception to book the coconut tour for us and they charged us almost triple of the price and I told the guy and he just kept lying so be careful booking your tours with them I advise you to book on Klook or somewhere else, they will scam you. Then my husband got poisoning and they didn’t wanted to refund us I had to fight for it, in the end they refund us. The pool is ok but there isn’t much sun, the breakfast is good with a good variety of things. We also had a problem with our door it wouldn’t open but they tried to solve it asap. It’s an ok hotel for 2/3 nights.
author: Claudia

title: Above average
positives:
desayuno muy completo
piscina increible
negatives: gente de servicio intentando vender masajes, ropa, notas de "deberás pagar" si hacer xxx cosas, y el ruido .
author: Pedro

title: very clean and comfortable hotel
text:
We enjoyed this hotel very much. Old town is just a few minutes walk away.
Minh was super helpful when we first checked in. We stayed in the loft rooms-bedroom upstairs with sitting area downstairs. Breakfast had wide variety. Rooms were clean and comfortable.
author: Sally
reply:
Dear Sally,

Thank you for your wonderful review and perfect rating. We're so glad to hear that you and your family had a great experience at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.

It’s lovely to know that Minh made your check-in smooth and welcoming, and that you enjoyed the cleanliness, comfort, and thoughtful layout of our Loft Room. This split-level design offers both privacy and space, making it a great choice for families or those looking for something a little different.

We’re also happy to hear that you found the breakfast selection satisfying and the location convenient for exploring the Old Town.

We hope to welcome you back on your next visit to Hoi An!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Exceptional
positives: Hotel de lujo, precioso, comodísimo y con servicio excelente, una experiencia inolvidable
author: Sofia

title: Very nice hotel
text: Superb customer service from start to finish. Excellent breakfast. Comfortable bed. Room sound proofing was the only issue we encountered and it is completely dependent on your neighbours. First 2 nights were great, second 2 nights we heard their doorbell go off during the night, cell phone alarm going off in the morning, and general noises coming from the room(s) around us. This was the only negative as the rest of the stay and hotel was fantastic. Would consider staying here again.
author: john

title: Un muy buen hotel muy cerca del centro
positives: Era cómodo y con excelentes instalaciones. La habitación era amplia y la piscina muy buen. El personal muy atento y un magnífico desayuno.
negatives: El colchón no era cómodo y tenía uno de los lados vencido.
author: Ana

title: Very clean and conveniently located hotel
text: Enjoyed this hotel very much! We had the loft rooms and were really comfortable. Away from Old Town but still within walking distance. People are friendly and helpful especially Mr Minh.
author: Sally

title: Recomendado
positives: Muy bien ubicado y buen desayuno. Tiene un servicio de transporte gratuito a la playa.
negatives: Las habitaciones con dos pisos no son muy cómodas. Falta un poco de limpieza
author: Claudio

title: Great Staff and location
text: The staff and service were good and the location is convenient to explore Hoi An.  We didn't like the rationing of water to two small bottles per room per day and the extra charges for a refill, especially when they are refilling water. The mattresses and linen were worn out. It was not the 5-star experience that we expected based on the reviews.
author: Swetha
reply:
Dear Swetha,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're glad to hear you appreciated our friendly staff and convenient location for exploring Hoi An—it means a lot to us.

We also value your honest comments regarding the bottled water policy and the condition of the mattresses and linen. Your feedback helps us identify areas where we can improve, and we’ll be reviewing these points carefully with our team to better meet the expectations of our guests.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future and provide a more refined experience.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Excelente relación calidad-precio
positives: La pisicina, el entorno, el gimnasio, el desayuno completísimo y sobre todo las bicis gratis.
negatives:
No nos subieron las maletas a la habitación pese a que las dejamos por la mañana. Hasta que no llegamos muy tarde no las subieron y estaba en recepción.

La habitación en dos niveles algo incómoda y angosta.
author: Enric-Sol

title: Lovely hotel
text: We spent three days in this lovely hotel. The check in with bingh was excellent, the weather was a little overcast so all the recommendations in hoi an were really helpful. The location is perfect for walking into the old town and the spa treatments are wonderful.
author: Jane
reply:
Dear Jane,

Thank you for your wonderful review and perfect scores! We're so pleased to hear that you had a lovely three-day stay with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.

It’s great to know that Binh made your check-in experience smooth and that his local recommendations helped you make the most of your time in Hoi An, despite the overcast weather. We're also delighted that you enjoyed our convenient location and relaxing spa treatments.

We truly appreciate your kind words and hope to welcome you back again for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Esta bien
positives: La picina es muy bonita. El Desayuno es muy Bueno
negatives: Para Pagar la habitacion fue un poco desagradable pues, la page por Booking y ellos tambien querian que la pagara yo alli….
author: Yenny

title: Perfect hotel in Hoi An
text:
This was our second visit to the Almanity. We first visited in 2022 and it was brilliant both times. However a couple of things the resort could improve upon (we didn’t have these issues in 2022)

The soaps in the room used to be amazing, shower gel and hand soap, it was stunning. However this time, the hand soap has been replaced by little bars of soap and it was those lovely touches that made it extra nice last time. And secondly, the WiFi - the WiFi this time was absolutely terrible and our phone signal was 3G at best throughout the whole resort, meaning we were dependent on WiFi. The download speed was 9mb when we did a ping test.. impossible to watch anything online or even browse the internet to be honest. Just an upgrade of their service would make the hotel 10/10 for us
author: Alex

title: Calidad y buen servicio
positives:
El hotel esta posicionado en un lugar muy comodo y facil para recorrer lo mas importante de Hoi An.
El desayuno es formidable, sin dejar espacio a la imaginación. Atencion del personal de primer nivel.
Habitaciones grandes y comodas, piscina fabulosa y restaurant buenisimo.
Fue una estadia muy confortable.
negatives: Estuvo todo perfecto
author: Carolina

title: Okay hotel, thats now a bit run down
text: Hotel is nice but cramped and rooms are already a bit older. There is very little sun in the pool. Breakfast options OK. Go for a smaller cheaper hotel in the area. Value for money will be better.
author: Amir

title: Maravilloso
positives: Todo, es espectacular. Esta a 10 minutos del centro andando pasando por una bocatería riquísima.
author: Sara

title: Great hotel and the best staff!
text: Beautiful staff and fantastic facilities.  Absolutely loved my stay and will definitely be back!
author: Charli
reply:
Dear Charli,

Thank you for your fantastic review! We’re thrilled to hear that you had such a wonderful stay and that our staff and facilities made your experience so enjoyable. Knowing that you felt well taken care of and plan to return means the world to us.

It was truly our pleasure to host you, and we can’t wait to welcome you back for another memorable stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Estupendo
positives: Las instalaciones son geniales, y el personal muy atento. Piscina y buffet muy buenos
negatives: Nada
author: Hector

title: The best hotel
text: As soon as I entered the hotel, a wonderful swimming pool came into view. Thanks to the good weather, it's enjoyable to swim during the day and take pictures with beautiful lights at night. Above all, I was touched by the kind assistance from NO QUYNH during check-in and check-out. This hotel greatly contributed to making our family's trip the best it could be.
text_original:
호텔에 들어서자 마자 멋진 수영장이 보여요.
날씨고 좋은 덕분에 낮에는 즐거운 수영과 밤에는 멋진 조명과 함께 사진을 찍기 좋아요.
그리고 무엇보다 체크인 때와 체크아웃 때 도움을 주신 NO QUYNH 의 친절한 응대에 감동 받았습니다. 저희 가족 최고의 즐거운 여행이 되도록 도움에 많이 된 호텔이었습니다.
author: 김
reply:
Dear 김,

Thank you for your wonderful review! We are delighted to hear that you and your family had such an enjoyable stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. It’s great to know that you loved our beautiful pool, both during the day and at night, and that you were able to capture special moments.

We truly appreciate your kind words about No and Quynh’s hospitality. Providing warm and attentive service is our priority, and we’re so happy that they made  positive impact on your experience.

It was our pleasure to be a part of your family’s memorable trip, and we hope to welcome you back for another fantastic stay in the future!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Oasis muy cerca de Hoi An
positives: El desayuno fue delicioso, la piscina muy agradable, el personal muy servicial y me ayudaron con todo lo que necesitaba y el Spa excelente!
author: Valeria

title: Fantastic hotel
text: An excellent and very well run hotel. The staff were outstanding, particularly Lin and Ngoc.
author: Zachary

title: Muy buena opcion para estar en hoi an
positives: El personal, la limpieza, la ubicacion y las piscinas y jardines
negatives: El area de fumadores muy mal, pocas alternativas para quien fuma
author: Pablo

title: Fantastic Experience!
text: Super staff and beautiful facilities!
author: John

title: Very good
positives: El entorno de la piscina es muy lindo. Hartas reposeras y plantas. Ls piscina grande y linda. El desayuno es muy bueno y completo.
negatives: La pieza. Estaba en el tercer piso en un ático. Las ceramicas del piso y la pieza son antiguas. La cama tiene un borde de madera muy molesto para entrar o salir.
author: Andrés

title: I recommend it.
text: Utilized for a mother-daughter trip in their 20s and 50s. We chose this place because we wanted a room with a bathtub. There were no Japanese guests, quite a few Western guests, and the number of customers was low, which made it quiet and nice. We borrowed the free rental bicycles (which are old) for both days and explored everything. Since it's facing the street, you can hear some motorcycle noise, but it wasn't too loud. The breakfast was very delicious. The pool was visible from the spacious restaurant, making for a graceful breakfast. It may not be a new hotel, but it was clean and comfortable. Currency exchange for Japanese yen was also available at the front desk.
text_original:
20代50代親子女子旅で利用。
バスタブ付きのお部屋が良かったのでここにしました。

title: Fantastic Hotel
text:
Fantastic hotel! I spent quite a lot of time researching Hoi An hotels and this one did not disappoint. The location is great, it’s really close to the Hoi An Old town where everything is (so you don’t really want to be out of town or by the beach as it’s 15min drive to the town).  This hotel has a free shuttle bus 3 times a day so you can still visit their beach area with chairs umbrellas and great restaurant.  However you can also walk to lots of restaurants and the tailor shops with 5minutes and to the river within 10-15mins. 

The breakfast is one of the best hotel breakfasts I’ve ever seen, local food counters, then cooked to order stations for Pho/ omelette. American pancakes and waffle station, continental buffet, pastries, fruits and yoghurts. 

Pool area is great, was never overly busy, rooms were quite clean and modern. 

Highly recommended and would come back here. Thanks!

Quan Nguyen

Since the resort is large, there are many rooms, so depending on which room you are assigned, it may be a bit of a distance from the lobby. The condition of the room was very good, and we stayed in a duplex room, which had a high ceiling and the air conditioning was on the ceiling, so it was cool enough to feel cold while sleeping, but it was slightly warmer on the first floor at times. However, it wasn't unbearably hot, just warm enough that sitting around would make it comfortable! There is a small mart in front of the resort with very cheap prices and a variety of items, making it convenient to grab drinks or beer. I saw on Google reviews that some people ride bikes from afar to shop there! Hoi An is about a 10-minute walk from the resort. If you go along the main road, you will arrive, and if you come at night, you can just follow the main road to find your way! If you search on Google Maps, it will guide you through side streets, but it can be dark and there are local residents living there, so it can be a bit scary.

title: 40th Wedding Anniversary Family Trip
text: For our 40th wedding anniversary family trip, we chose Da Nang and Hoi An, and our first accommodation was the Almanity Hotel in Hoi An. It was about a 30-minute drive from the airport, and since our flight arrived early in the morning, there was no traffic, allowing us to get there smoothly. Even though we arrived at dawn, the front desk staff warmly welcomed us, and we checked into our assigned room without any issues. The room had a loft style, which was a little unfamiliar, but we adapted quickly and made good use of it. The bedroom was on the second floor, and we all had a great night's sleep. The breakfast was also of high quality; everything was delicious. After enjoying breakfast, we spent the morning at the swimming pool adjacent to the hotel, which was also very pleasant. Sipping cold beer by the poolside was fantastic. After spending such a wonderful 2 nights and 3 days at the Almanity Hotel, we moved on to Da Nang, but I found myself wanting to return to the Almanity Hotel in Hoi An with just my wife next time. The memories from Hoi An, filled with wonderful experiences, feel fresh and new.

It was also very convenient - only 10 minutes to Old Town & 5 minutes walk to Madam Khanh :) 

However there were some aspects of our stay that were less than desirable. Unfortunately the hotel had just repainted the stairway & the smell of paint was pretty strong walking up to our room & persisted even until we were at the door to our room.  We also had issues with the mini fridge - it was not cold at all. After informing the staff, we were told that the fridge was not meant to be cold - just room temperature. As an alternative, we were provided ice buckets to keep our water cold, which was a nice gesture on their end. Lastly, we ran out of shower gel in our bathroom on our last day. Unsure if it was because we were checking out & the bottles were not refilled, but it was a bit of a downer to end the trip with an incomplete shower. 

Overall, in spite of these things, we enjoyed our stay at Almanity & would recommend it.

title: What a great hotel!
text:
My partner and I have been to Hoi An a few times, and typically with friends. We've used budget friendly hotels and homestays historically. But this trip we mixed it up. Almanity Hotel made our trip significantly more comfortable. Cool flannels and amazing tea in arrival, and the facilities are amazing. 

The room was huge, and the bed was more comfortable than our new bed at home. Restaurants are lovely, but I found the understanding of gluten free to be hard to convey. They didn't understand that bacon sitting on bread isn't gluten free. However the selection available includes fruit and yogurt as you'd expect.

We took a day trip to My Son Sanctuary and Marble Mountain and organized a driver through the hotel, Vo Thanh Vu. If you've ever driven in Vietnam you'll know that is pretty hectic (organized chaos), but Vu made the whole experience extremely comfortable! He's an excellent driver, and made every effort to make us happy and confortable in the heat with cold water and cold towels. The cold towels were gold on a 40 degree C day with 70% humidity 🤢
The only thing that would have made our trip more perfect is it he had joined us for lunch 😔

We used the pool a lot during our stay and while all staff were excellent, there are always stand outs that go the extra mile to smile and have a conversation.

title: I recommend it.
text: First, I decided on a place close to the Old Town, but when I actually walked there on that hot day, it wasn’t as close as I thought. Taking a taxi to the entrance of the Old Town didn’t cost more than about 2,000 to 3,000 won, so I recommend taking a taxi..! The breakfast was really delicious. Especially the pho and fruits were amazing. The pool was also nice because it was deep, with depths of 1.5 to 1.6 meters, making it more fun. There’s also a shallow area where kids can play. This is definitely a place I want to return to because of the breakfast and the pool. However, housekeeping usually comes around the same time that tourists check out, and I was a bit surprised when they came while I was having breakfast. But there were times when they came while I was eating breakfast and other times they didn’t, so I don’t know... Still, the staff were really friendly. I didn’t catch the name of the person who checked me in during the early morning, but thanks to them, Nhung, Quynh, and Dup, I was able to stay comfortably, so I made sure to remember their names. Especially Nhung, who speaks Korean well, was really helpful when I made requests in Korean, so I am grateful for that! I recommend this place if you visit Hoi An!

title: I really like the swimming pool.
text: First of all, I really like the swimming pool. It's spacious, clean, and not too crowded, which is great. The location was good enough that we walked everywhere while in Hoi An, and we wanted a jacuzzi, so we booked a room with a rooftop. However, to get to the third floor, we had to take the elevator to the second floor and then use the stairs for one more level. This was already known, so it wasn't an issue. The jacuzzi was pre-filled with water, but we could fill it up anew, and hot water was available. The jacuzzi even had a bubbling feature that provided a massage. The balcony with the jacuzzi was spacious, and the jacuzzi itself was quite spacious and deep, shaped perfectly for sitting. The wall was high enough to ensure privacy, so we weren't disturbed. If I ever come to Hoi An again, I plan to stay here.

negatives: Leider war die Klimaanlage in unserem Zimmer (Loft) extrem zugig und direkt auf das Bett eingestellt. Darum haben wir uns entschieden nach 2 Tagen das Hotel zu wechseln.

title: Fantastic property with a great pool!!!
text: Loved staying here because it was a short walk to the old town portion of Hoi An (15-20 mins walk). The resort was spectacularly maintained and the  Deluxe Loft Room was quaint and comfortable and had a tub for which we were very grateful. The breakfast buffet was a great spread which we enjoyed so take that inclusion if you have the option. Only thing I found slightly strange is that they made us pay a hefty deposit on checkin (which we weren't informed about when we booked) but they refunded the whole amount on checkout. Don't know if they do this with every guest but that was literally our only slight hiccup staying here. Highly recommend the place for great comfort and proximity. Didn't have time to use the spa facilities or the pool (because it was cold and rainy when we visited) but I wish I had. There's always next time. Don't hesitate, book your stay cos you won't regret it.
author: Jasmin
reply:

title: Nicht für Raucher
positives: Die Lage
negatives:
Enttäuschendes Erlebnis – leider nicht empfehlenswert

Leider können meine Freundin und ich von keinem positiven Erlebnis berichten. Der Hauptgrund für unsere negative Bewertung ist der Umgang mit Rauchern in diesem Hotel. Das Rauchen ist auf der gesamten Hotelanlage strikt verboten – selbst auf Terrassen, Balkonen oder Außenbereichen wie dem Restaurant und dem Pool. Wer rauchen möchte, muss die komplette Anlage verlassen und sich vor das Hotel begeben, wo lediglich ein kleiner, mit zwei Sonnenschirmen bedeckter Bereich zur Verfügung steht. Das fühlt sich wenig gastfreundlich an.

Ein weiteres negatives Erlebnis hatten wir beim Check-out am frühen Morgen um 5:30 Uhr. Auf unsere Bitte um eine Flasche Wasser vor dem Transfer zum Flughafen wurde uns schlichtweg verweigert, obwohl es keinerlei Aufwand gewesen wäre, kurz eine aus dem Restaurant zu holen. Selbst ein Kauf wäre nicht möglich gewesen – ein absolut unnötiger Mangel an Service.

Das einzig Positive an diesem Hotel war die großartige Lage – wirklich perfekt! Zudem möchten wir die äußerst freundliche Bedienung einer hochschwangeren Mitarbeiterin im Restaurant lobend erwähnen.

Trotz dieser zwei positiven Punkte würden wir dieses Hotel jedoch nicht noch einmal buchen.

title: A nice cozy hotel
text:

We noted that the walls were rather thin and we could hear everything in the adjoining rooms VERY clearly. Unfortunately there was a family with kids running up and down the stairs, and the other room had adults talking loudly and climbing the stairs with shoes on.
However we only have praise for the hotel staff who were really helpful in recommending places to visit and where to find good food in Hoi An. negatives: Einzig Mimi im Restaurantbereich und Minh an der Rezeption geben sich Mühe. Ansonsten arbeitet das Personal ohne Emotionen.
author: Regina

title: I recommend booking a high-class room.
text:
It is located about 10 minutes from the Old Town, which makes it a somewhat awkward location for exploring Hoi An's attractions thoroughly. If you focus on visiting the Old Town, it is well situated. Free bicycle rentals are available, so I recommend using a bicycle when visiting the Old Town. 
The resort's amenities, such as the swimming pool and restaurant, were well decorated and nice, and the staff were also friendly and attentive, providing a good service experience. 
The facilities in the room, like the air conditioner and hairdryer, were in good condition, and the room was clean and tidy. 
However, the soundproofing was the worst. Noise from the hallway outside the door, adjacent rooms, and above were heard without any filtering. If noise is not a big concern, I would recommend this place for solo travelers or friends traveling together.
text_original:
올드타운과 10분 거리에 위치해있으며 호이안 명소들을 두루 둘러보기에는 약간 애매한 위치였다. 올드타운을 중점적으로 둘러본다면 괜찮은 곳에 위치해있다. 자전거 무료대여가 가능하니 올드타운 방문시 자전거를 이용하는 것을 추천한다.

text: Before celebrating our wedding anniversary at the Four Seasons, we decided to spend a night close to the old town where we could enjoy the eateries and night scenery leisurely. title: It was the best stay.
text: I stayed to sightsee in the city of Hoi An. The facilities were meticulously cleaned throughout, and I was able to spend my time comfortably. The spa and pool were as beautiful as those in high-end hotels in Japan. The staff's response was very friendly, and the restaurant recommended by the front desk staff was very delicious for lunch. Of course, the meals at the restaurant within the facility also had a rich menu and were tasty. I stayed for two nights, and it seemed that the menu changed slightly, which left a good impression as I didn’t get tired of breakfast. Lastly, I strongly recommend booking the shuttle service to the hotel. We took a taxi from Da Nang airport, but the hotel's shuttle service is more affordable, and above all, the driver is very kind. I also asked for help to visit attractions like the My Son ruins and Ba Na Hills, and the journey was very enjoyable. I will definitely use it again.

positives: Wir wurden sehr herzlich von Lien empfangen und sie hat uns hilfsreiche Tipps und Empfehlungen für Hoi An gegeben. Vu hat uns nach Hue gefahren und er war freundlich und sehr vorsichtig (fast zu vorsichtig). Das Hotel ist etwas ausserhalb der Altstadt und man ist in einigen Minuten in zentraler Lage. Der Aufenthalt im Almanity Hotel hat uns sehr gut gefallen, wir haben uns wohlgefühlt und würden das Hotel sofort weiterempfehlen.
negatives:

Das W-Lan ist im oberen Stock nicht sehr gut.
author: Nicolas

title: Nostalgic Hoi An and Almania.
text:
I stayed under the name Roh.
- The location is great.
- If you're looking for a slightly quieter place amidst the crowded Hoi An, this is the best location.
- If you're trying to find good restaurants, Grab can be a bit tricky. It's too far to walk, yet too close to take a car, and cars cannot go into the Old Town.
- Koreans, please don't ride bicycles. It's dangerous.
- Some people said the resort is old and dirty, but I thought it was really nice.
- The staff are friendly, and the only downside is that there is some construction going on, so it might be a bit noisy if you stay at the accommodation during the day.
- The breakfast bread is delicious. Korean buffet bread can be a bit hard, but the bread here is moist and delightful. The noodles are also quite acceptable for Koreans, but I personally think the noodles here are the best in Vietnam.
- The cleaning staff and everyone were very kind, and they all looked happy.
- There was one man who seemed a bit gruff, but overall most people were friendly and had good impressions.
- In my personal opinion, it seems like there are two types of Vietnamese people: those who are very nice and those who are not as much.
- Everyone here, including the cleaning staff, was really nice.
- I am now in Da Nang, and I think I should have just stayed there.
- I already miss it. I will definitely come back next time.
- Wishing the staff health and happiness.
text_original:
Roh  라는 이름으로  숙박했어요

title: Hate to gripe
text:
Place is very nice, not 5 stars but upscale for sure.   

Staff swas excellent. Took a real concern in my experience. Offered guidance on a few places that are recommendable.    They are obviously getting a kickback from Morning Glory restaurant and Tuong Tailors.   Both good. Not exceptional.    

Used a bike which was adventurous and suggested as easy to cover far more ground.    Unfortunately it can get a little hairy and got a decent couple of cuts on back of leg.   Thought my legs just sweating (as crazy hot) but in looking I was bleeding.   Even after a shower, it was still apparent and put a small towel under leg to make sure I didn't get blood on sheets.   Tried to rinse out but that's what professional cleaners do.   Surprisingly,  I knew the one hand towel had blood on it and apparently some on a larger towel as well.    To my surprise. When I checked out, they handed me a bill for the 2 towels.  I have worked in hotels for many years and what was left was very nominal.    This is a cost of doing business and again, something I'm sure that hydrogen peroxide and/or bleach could get out.    Sadly, out a bit of a palor on my feel for property and will look elsewhere next time in town, at least for comparison.     Otherwise, a solid value, great breakfast.
author: Geoffrey
reply:

Thank you for your review and high rating! We appreciate your kind words about our property and staff, as well as your understanding of the value we offer and the quality of our breakfast. We're genuinely sorry to hear about your experience with the bicycle and the subsequent issue with the towels.

In the hospitality industry, we understand that accidents happen, and we certainly didn't mean to cause any inconvenience or ill feelings by charging for the towels. It's standard practice to cover damages, but we understand that every situation is unique, and we apologize if this seemed insensitive given the circumstances.

Your feedback is invaluable, and we will review our policies to ensure that we handle similar situations better in the future. We hope this experience won't deter you from considering staying with us again, as we'd love the opportunity to provide you with a stay that meets and exceeds your expectations.

text: I had a great time. The breakfast was clean and nice. My friend praised the coffee as delicious, haha. I really loved that there were various types of eggs. The pool was big, which was great, and the staff were friendly. One of the staff members named Thinh was especially kind! The room had an antique and vintage feel. I stayed in room 2002, but the showerhead was leaking. I think it needs to be replaced. Fortunately, I had brought a showerhead from Korea, so I didn’t encounter any inconvenience, but the Wi-Fi in the room was really poor! It seemed like it was only our room! Because it was so bad, I ended up sleeping upside down in bed! Sleeping like that, I was barely able to connect for about two bars to use my phone. I also liked that the hotel provided a shuttle bus, and they arranged a taxi for us, which was great! The shuttle driver was very kind!

title: I'm taking a very good rest!
text: I took advantage of the 40% discount event and had a great experience. First of all, the pool view was wonderful, and it was spacious enough for swimming. I loved just lying in the shallow area and looking at the sky and the leaves fluttering in the wind. The room had very strong air conditioning and excellent hot water. The breakfast was very diverse, including Vietnamese, Western, and Eastern styles, and it was delicious, so I took several servings. The staff was also very friendly, and I remember that check-in time was at 3 PM, but they allowed us to check in early at 2 PM, which I appreciated. While it may be smaller than other resorts, it was really nice to relax in peace. I was deciding between Citadines Pearl Resort and other places near the old town, and I ended up here, and I had a lot of fun! I definitely want to come back next time!

title: Jacuzzi suite
text:
Went there for one single night with my wife, booked a jacuzzi suite to chill the evening/late afternoon. Unfortunately we complained several times (1 call + 2 request to reception) that we could not properly fill the jacuzzi on the arrival day and asked them to make sure bathtub would be filled when we came back to hotel (late evening). Unfortunately after our evening plans, bathtub was still empty... 
We complained in the morning during breakfast time and they did fix it, but it was our checkout day so could not enjoy fully the jacuzzi option.

Manager did help us on the day to fix the issue but late and also proposed free lunch to compensate it, but we had other plans.

Beside that, the place is nice, windy, not too hot, large pool and wide and comfortable rooms.
Breakfast with a lot of options, not all very tasty but at least you have choices.

Location is very good and no noise from the street.

Just need to make sure that if manager not here or available, staff just fix issues in due time.

Die Pools sind super, weitläufig und auch ein tiefes Becken so wie ein Wassergang mit runden Steinen zur Stimulation der Fuss-Reflexzonen war vorhanden.

title: Exceptional
positives:
L’Almanity Hoi An è un resort incredibile, uno di quelli dove appena entri capisci subito che vale ogni euro speso. Le camere sono spaziali: grandi, curate, luminose e con un livello di comfort che ricorda davvero un 5 stelle. I 100€ a notte (5 volte rispetto al prezzo medio vietnamita) li ho pagati volentieri, perché l’esperienza è nettamente superiore alla media del paese.

La colazione è spettacolare: enorme, varia, con prodotti freschi e una scelta che va dal continentale ai piatti locali cucinati al momento. Il livello è altissimo, sia per qualità che per presentazione. Ogni mattina sembrava di essere in un hotel di categoria superiore. All’interno della struttura si trova anche un ristorante alla carta molto buono dove cucina uno chef di Masterchef.

La piscina centrale è bellissima, grande e tranquilla, ideale per rilassarsi nelle ore calde anche se a volte può essere affollata. Anche il personale è attentissimo, sempre gentile e pronto ad aiutare in modo discreto. Mi fa piacere menzionare Lien, Quyah e Ngoc per la professionalità e la gentilezza.

Nel complesso è uno dei migliori resort del Vietnam per rapporto qualità-prezzo: comfort top, servizi curati e un’atmosfera che ti fa sentire in vacanza dal primo all’ultimo minuto.

title: A nice place to stay.
text:
I spent four nights here. The place is nicely located a few minutes walk from the Old Town. 

The room I was given was a ‘duplex’ a small sitting room downstairs and the bedroom and bathroom upstairs. The room was very clean and the bed comfortable. However, I thought the deco was not really up to 5 star standards, the room to me had a very 70’s, past it’s best feeling, beige tiles, dark wood, no natural light in the bedroom or bathroom.  

There was one small problem when my room wasn’t cleaned one day, but was after I spoke with the front desk. 

The swimming pool is very nice and definitely welcome after a hot and humid day sightseeing.  

The hotel arranged my transfer travel up to Da Nag and provide a nice comfortable air conditioned  car. Thanks to Ba the driver who was very pleasant and point out things of interest on the route. 

Definitely a place worth considering staying at for your stay in Hoi An.

title: Beautiful little hotel, very friendly staff.
text:
My family has two children aged 7 and 9. The hotel is a charming small place, very lovely, with a very convenient location right in the center of Hoi An, so there's no need to travel far to reach the Ancient Town. The hotel is a wonderful combination of the feel of a resort while still being in the city center with all the necessary amenities. The room is very clean and well-arranged. Our family stayed in a pool view room, just a few steps away from the pool, like renting a villa with a private pool but at a much more reasonable cost. The Vietnamese breakfast is very delicious, better than restaurants in town, and the chef is very enthusiastic in welcoming guests and introducing the dishes (one small detail is that the bacon was a bit tough).

The staff from Liên Hiệp Diệp Hứa Hưng are very lovely and eager to assist guests. This time, our family only stayed for 3 nights, but next time we come, we will definitely stay longer because our family really likes Hoi An.

Highly recommended this hotel. It is a small resort located conveniently near the ancient town of Hoi An. We prefer small, boutique, well-equipped, warm-welcome resorts over large ones where you have to walk miles to get to breakfast/entrance/pool and are located in the middle of nowhere. We stayed for 3 nights and will definitely come back and stay longer.

title: Mooi zwembad, relaxte sfeer, centraal gelegen.
positives: Ondanks de latere aankomst op de dag was de ontvangst hartelijk. We hadden de kamers met een vide zodat het bed boven was. Geheel is gemodelleerd naar hoe de Vietnamesen in dit gebied in hun eigen huizen leven, beneden wonen, boven slapen vanwege de vele overstromingen. Kamer was schoon en goed onderhouden, Wifi ontvangst was goed. Zwembad op de binnenplaats is nog mooier dan op de plaatjes en heerlijk om een dagje door te brengen. Full service wat betreft eten en drinken dus wat wil de mens meer. Elke middag is er een Tai Chi sessie om 16.00 uur waar ook het personeel van het hotel aan meedoet. Ontbijtbuffet is mega groot met heel veel keuze en alles vers - zoals eigenlijk in heel Vietnam. Hotel ligt iets buiten het historische centrum, maar een korte rit met Grab (de plaatselijke Uber) en je bent overal snel. Hotel heeft ook een beachclub waar ze je gratis naartoe brengen en gratis bedjes parasols en handdoeken te verkrijgen zijn, maar door tijdgebrek helaas geen bezoek aan gebracht, maar wel het vermelden waard.
negatives: Hoewel de kamer dus historisch is ingericht, zouden wij er niet snel weer voor kiezen. Kamer is smal dus je loopt elkaar snel in de weg en slapen op de vide klinkt leuk maar is uiteindelijk best onhandig als je even iets bent vergeten of in de avond/nacht naar het toilet moet - met een zaklamp een steile trap af met maar 1 leuning is niet praktisch. Restaurant viel ook wat tegen - op papier maakt het veel indruk met een heuse "chef kok", alles vers bla bla bla, maar voor de prijs die je betaald kun je elders in Hoi An veel beter krijgen. Bovendien had onze ober nogal haast, waardoor de snelle eters in ons gezelschap al het toetje aan het uitzoeken waren terwijl anderen de eerste hap van hun hoofdgerecht hadden doorgeslikt - teleurstellende ervaring en dus het bij die ene keer gelaten. Allemaal geen ernstige tekortkomingen - meer keuzes die je maakt.

text: I stayed for two nights in a my spirit room and it was perfect. The bed was soooo comfortable. Love the tranquil pool area, had a great massage and it’s only a 10 min walk to the old town. A peaceful relaxing haven in the middle of a bustling town. I would definitely stay again. 😊
author: Leisa

title: Amazing!!
positives: Adorámos tudo! Desde a piscina ao pequeno-almoço espetacular! O quarto é muito bom e bastante bem equipado! Todo o staff do hotel era simpático e acolhedor, principalmente o nadador salvador que nos serviu o almoço na piscina! O hotel está muito bem localizado a 10 minutos a pé do centro e têm disponíveis bicicletas para os hóspedes sem custos adicionais.
negatives: Nada, estava tudo incrível
author: Inês

title: Be careful of room type
text:
We booked 2 rooms for 4 adults.
Be very careful of room types. They put us in a room with beds upstairs-very small room area. We requested to change and they charge us USd10 more per night.The new room was better .
Our other room had no doors but curtains to toilets and no wardrobe  but rails exposed-not  a proper wardrobe. Toilet was very small, you cant move at all but to get things done without knocking the walls. The platform bed was bad-we keep kicking into it and bloodied ourselves on the leg-very bad.The sofa in 1 room faces away from the TV-whats the point! Not enough hangers for towels in toilet. The location was nt fantastic-if you want to visit the old town-better stay nearer there.
The hotel staff advised us to take taxis instead of Grab and we got riped off. We decided to take Grab every where-very reliable and safe.It allows us to see the price and the driver is traceable. If you want to go to Danang, buy yr stuff there -its much cheaper in Da nang- only get lanterns .
author: Stephen
reply:
Dear Stephen,

Warmest greetings from Almanity Hoi An Wellness Resort!

Thank you so much for taking your precious time in giving us this review, feedback in the area where we did well and and where we had failed to deliver.

We truly apologize for the experience you had. Rest assured this is now addressed with the team. However, we would like to explain about our room concept. The My Spirit room type represents the culture of Hoi An in the old days with duplex nature to avoid floods during rainy seasons. Additionally, because of the open and friendly concept, most of our rooms do not have wardrobes.

We would like to thank you for giving Almanity Family this opportunity to serve you and it has been our privilege to do so during your stay. Thank you so much and we will be anxiously looking forward to your next visit to provide you a much better experience.

Best Regards,
Almanity Team

title: Excelente hotel!
positives: É um excelente hotel, o quarto duplex é excepcional, a piscina é espetacular (com serviço bebidas / comida), staff bastante atencioso e muito bom pequeno almoço. O restaurante do hotel serve refeições a toda a hora. Existe um transfer gratuito para nos levar para a praia. A localização é boa na medida em que fica a meio caminho da praia (10 min de tranfer) e do centro histórico de Hoi An (10 min a pé). Recomendo.
negatives: A insonorização dos quartos não é a melhor e deviam ter avisado que ia haver obras no telhado. De resto, tudo ok.
author: Renato

title: Good

author: Le

author: André

title: The perfect place to relax !
text:
We had a great room with private spa looking out to the stars ! 
We had daily massages included which were very good and just a great way to unwind after a day of hustling for bargains.  
Very clean rooms and fantastic staff, 
They would always go out of the way to accommodate your needs. 
The natural mineral pool is fantastic for cooling off on the hot days. 
The food from the restaurant was very good and the breakfast included in the cost was also plentiful and very fresh. 
But you can eat at many fantastic eateries street food stalls and restaurants nearby. 
Location was only 5 mins walking distance to the old town. 
The general manager Mr Menzies is one of the nicest people on the planet I’m sure ! 
Look overall it’s not the cheapest option but what you get for the money you spend is well worth it. 
If you need to unwind you pretty much don’t have to leave the resort!
author: yoz

title: Very good
positives: O hotel tem um potencial enorme, a zona da piscina é muito bonita e relaxante. O SPA é bastante bom, a Sen foi espectacular a organizar os nossos tratamentos.
negatives: O serviço fica muito aquém do expectável de um hotel de cinco estrelas. Uma parte dos  funcionários demonstra bastante inflexibilidade perante os clientes o que não é normal num hotel que diz ser de cinco estrelas (e.g., não deixar levar as toalhas da piscina para o quarto quando os hóspedes estão molhados), falta atenção aos detalhes (e.g., gel banho vazio quando chegámos e queríamos tomar banho) e a limpeza dos quartos deixa a desejar (e.g., vimos pulgas no quarto)
author: Diogo

title: Great location/nice pool/basic yoga/some massage therapists good/food other than breakfast mediocre
text:
Pros: 
* Nice pool area
* gym and spa quite nice although massages are hit and miss especially if you like deep tissue
* staff is friendly and try to please.
* breakfast spread is quite nice if you are there a short while

Cons
* staff cannot communicate well in English especially in the restaurant
* we were there for 1 week to each healthy and rest and the food for lunch and dinner was very small portions, bland and RIDICULOUSLY EXPENSIVE for Vietnam
* yoga was very basic haha
* in extreme heat the dining room had no zircon :(


For a few days this could be a nice escape if you don't mind tons of Koreans in the pool constantly taking selfies and everything overpriced- programs, food, etc....  

Go for a weekend getaway at best.

title: コスパ最高なホテルです
positives: 旧市街まで歩いて10分ほどで到着できます！ホテルから旧市街へ行く道にはコンビニや小さいスーパー、薬局やスタバがあります。コンビニ横で売っていた柑橘ジュースはとても安く美味しかったのでぜひ飲んでください。フロントで日本円も両替ができます。チェックイン時に頂いたハイビスカスティーは凄くお洒落で美味しかったです。朝食ビュッフェのホットステーションは最高に充実していました。ぜひ朝食付きで泊まってください。

title: 施設の手入れが丁寧
positives:
特にプールがきれいです。年数が経ってくると、池や草木の手入れが後回しになりがちですが、非常に丁寧に手入れされていて感動しました。セクションに関わらず、スタッフ同士でにこやかにお話されていたのも好印象で、ゆったりした雰囲気でした。
五つ星ホテルにありがちな過剰な干渉はなく、距離感もいいです。特にボーイのハイさんにお世話になりました。
通常の部屋は少しコンパクトですが、立地もよいので、長期リゾート滞在‥というより、大人のゆっくり観光・家族でのリゾート体験におすすめです。

The facility's pool is large and clean. The staff always greet you with a smile. Although there is a restaurant, bar, and spa attached, the entire facility is not too big and is the size I like. It's close to the old town but not noisy. I think the double sash rooms are wonderful. 

The staff cares about us while maintaining appropriate distancing. It gives me peace of mind. I would especially like to thank Mr. Hai (I think...probably), the hotel man.
The regular rooms are a little compact and the location is good, so rather than a long-term resort stay, I think it's perfect for leisurely sightseeing and leisure for adults and A resort experience for the whole family.
negatives:
ありません。
目立ったお得さは少ないかもしれませんが、基本的に困ることもありません。皆さん英語も上手で、目に見えない安心代かなーと思います。

Nothing.
If I was to say it, It's been a few years since it opened, so I don't think there are any noticeable advantages compared to newer hotels. 
But considering the quality of the staff and the maintenance of the equipment, it's well worth it. Maybe being here is so natural that we just don't realize the benefits.

特に、メーソン遺跡への車をお願いしたところ、ドライバーのヴィさんにとっても親切にして頂き、家族一同楽しい観光のひとときを過ごすことが出来ました！

title: Could be better
text: We booked via Agoda for a town view room and the room they have given us which you need to use lift and climb the stair up which is a bit far from the lobby. The worst thing we disliked will be the aircon in which 30 degrees still has lots of wind blowing directly on the bed itself and we are not used to being getting the wind blowing directly on our face and the next morning we have gotten the cold immediately.  The breakfast option not good and the beef noodle only come with one piece of beef! What a joke! The so called free massage is just normal nothing to be mentioned as we have much better massage back in Hanoi. The dining option is not good as the main restaurant food is expensive and is the taste is not that good. As we noticed though the hotel running high occupancy but there is only a few guests eating in the coffee house. For the 2 nights stay we didn’t sleep well due to the aircon issue and thus we really think the management should do something to the aircon.
author: ENG

title: Very good
positives: 名前のとおり、リゾートを味わえるホテル。期待とおり朝食も充実、設備も良くプールも楽しめ満足。街なかなのに、ここだけ別世界。フロントのスタッフの対応は素晴らしい。
negatives: 残念なのはスタッフにより差があったこと。朝の太極拳が時間になっても始まらず、プールサイドの係に「今日は休みだ」と言われ、フロントスタッフに確認すると、渋々始まった。また、やはりプーサイドのハッピーアワーで声をかけられ、英語でのやり取りで、全ドリンク対象かと聞き、イエスといったのに、違っていた。それも注文してから結構な時間待ってから持ってきて、ハッピーアワーも終わっているからとの説明。他が良いだけに残念だ。
author: yoko

title: Perfect choice!
text:
This resort is so beautifully designed, peaceful, well appointed and in an excellent location. We stayed first for a few days on the opposite end of Hoi An Ancient Town and this was so much more convenient and easy for getting to and from restaurants, spas etc. The staff were SO great - really helpful, spoke great English and so beautifully presented. The spa was incredible and really well priced. The pools (indoor and outdoor) were stunning and included shaded and sunny areas for swimming and lounging. There is also an indoor pool. There is free daily yoga (it wasnt my style, but nice to have that option). The breakfast buffett was delicious and included a huge variety of western and asian dishes. The rooms we booked were next to each other, and both were spotless, architecturally impressive, cool and had great views over the pool. The beds were huge and so comfortable.  
We were so so happy with our decision to stay at the Almanity and will definitely stay here again next time!

title: 친절하고 예쁜 숙소
positives:
매우 친절한 고객 응대에 먼저 감사드립니다. 
객실과 주변 부대시설 모두 흥미있고 아름다운 경관이었습니다. 
관광지와의 거리는 적당했고 산책하기 좋았습니다.

객실 예약이 잘 못되어 더블 침대가 배정되어 객실 이동을 요청했을 때 빠른 대처로 객실 이동이 아닌 더블 침대를 싱글 침대로 바꿔주어서 감사합니다. 
2일 간의 짧은 여행이었지만 깊은 감사와 애정을 드립니다.

title: Excellent
positives:
위치: 올드타운까지 도보 11분이고, 호텔 근처에도 마사지, 식당, 카페, 미니마트 등이 충분히 있다. 
시설: 시간이 느껴지나 청결하게 잘 관리되어 사용에 불편함이 없다.
서비스: 환경을 위해 어매니티를 자율적으로 필요한만큼 제공하는 것이 좋았다. 또 안방비치에서 해수욕을 할 수 있도록 셔틀을 제공해준다. 

전체적으로 머무르기 편안했다. 수영장에서 느긋하게 휴식을 취하기에 좋고, 직원들이 친절한데, 특히 Diep Ngoc Nhung 씨는 도착하자마자 주변의 볼거리, 먹을거리, 할거리 등을 자세하고 친절하게 알려줘서 호이안을 즐기는 데 너무 유용했다. 게다가 아침에 조식당에서 만나게 되면 커피 같은 것을 세심하게 챙겨주는 등 항상 다정하게 신경을 써줬다. 정말 정말 고마워요. 
이번에 첫 호이안 방문이었는데 아름다운 도시였고 또 올 것 같다. 다음에 올 때도 이곳에 묵을 생각이다.

title: Exceptional
text: WOW. Fantastic resort to get away from the intensity of city life in Vietnam. This place is so peaceful. The resort is great and the staff are so friendly and helpful. Each time we were in the foyer, that would come up to us for a chat and to see if we needed any assistance with what we were planning for the day. They provided good information and locations of what we needed. The massages were a welcomed relief each day. A little more expensive than other hotels but well worth it. The highlight of our stay in Vietnam.
author: Alexander
reply:
Dear Alexander,

Warmest greetings from Almanity Hoi An Wellness Resort!

Thank you for taking your time to write review on us, we are especially grateful to receive such a beautiful comment from our valued guest, with the will to accomplish guest’s satisfaction, we constantly learn from our mistakes, especially from our guest. Therefore, we could improve and bring to you a better service. We hope to see and have the chance to serve you again in the resort.

With best regards,
David, Sales Executive

negatives: 처음에 예약 당시 부킹닷컴을 통해 커넥팅룸 예약문의를 했으나 제대로 답변을 받지 못해 아쉬웠습니다. 하지만 룸 업그레이드를 진행받아 오해가 풀렸고 매우 만족합니다.

title: The most peaceful place in Hoi An!
text: In a bustling city we were so thankful to retreat to our peaceful haven after getting our fill of the busy city each day. We joined the complementary morning yoga classes, afternoon poolside tai chi when we were around and enjoyed the complementary hour-long massages. The breakfast buffet was unbelievable as well. The staff was super friendly and the resort was well-maintained and very relaxing. We felt pampered and refreshed each day, it was quite the contrast from the busy life in the main city so we made a conscious effort to walk into town each day and get as much exposure to the wonderful people and city as possible. The walk into the old town and the night market is pretty quick (20 minutes) and very pleasant when it’s not too hot out, there’s lots to see and do, it’s a spectacular part of Vietnam!

They can coordinate a private tour and when they say “no problem” they really mean it!! We got massages everyday we were there as park of our package deal!! Very happy and hope others can have the same experience we had.

title: Very relaxing stay.
text: Great location, less than a 10 minute walk to the old town. Lots of places to eat within a few minutes from hotel door. You could hear the traffic from the room, but that's because of the constant tooting of the scooters! The room was comfortable enough but the bathroom was tiny! There was also a bit of a damp smell in the room, which I presume is from the air conditioning.  Our deal included a 50 minute massage every day, which was amazing. Beautiful spa. Great pool area. Breakfast choice was extensive which was great if you are staying more than a few days.

title: Classic resort like going back to 1970s
text: The resort is created and built with classic French style. The big swimming pool is great , really great! Our package included full body massage. The room for massage is perfectly set up with dim light and perfume, which I fell asleep immediately after the start of massage. Breakfast buffet is perfect! There was shuttle bus to an bang beach as well which is so convenient!!!!!! Last and the most important, the hotel has the prefect location which is quiet but very close to Hoi an central market and ancient town.

negatives: ikke no
