Big and comfortable rooms, fantastic  breakfast and amazing massages.
Best hotel we’ve to in Vietnam, highly recommended
author: Hilla

title: Exceptional
positives:
Bez wątpienia , jeden z najlepszych hoteli w jakim kiedykolwiek się zatrzymałem. Wspaniała lokalizacja, przepiękny wystrój wnętrz i architektura samego obiektu. Byliśmy zachwyceni! ale przede wszystkim na najwyższe slowa uznania zasługuje personel, przemili chetni do pomocy ludzie. Osobą która powitała nas zaraz po przyjeżdzie była Lien. Urocza osoba która z uśmiechem przedstawiła nam wszystkie informacje dotyczące naszego pobytu, dziękujemy ci Lien! Kolejną osobą (niestety nie pamiętam imienia) był menadżer restauracji. posiadał ogromną wiedzę o daniach z menu oraz filozofii która przyświeca szefowi kuchni. No właśnie , restauracja w hotelu Almanity jest po prostu genialna! Każde danie bylo doskonałe. Używają tylko lokalnych produktów oraz posiadają swój własny zielnik. Jeśli wybieracie się do Hoi An, które samo w sobie jest przepięknym i wartym odwiedzenia miejscem to nie szukajcie innego hotelu.Almanity jest najlepszy!

Without a doubt, one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. A wonderful location, beautiful interior design, and the architecture of the property itself. We were delighted! But above all, the staff deserve the highest praise; they were incredibly kind and eager to help. Lien was the person who greeted us immediately upon arrival. She was a charming person who, with a smile, provided us with all the information regarding our stay. Thank you, Lien! Another person (unfortunately, I don't remember his name) was the restaurant manager. He was extremely knowledgeable about the dishes on the menu and the chef's philosophy. Indeed, the restaurant at the Almanity Hotel is simply brilliant! Every dish was excellent. They use only local produce and have their own herbal garden. If you're going to Hoi An, which is a beautiful place in itself and worth a visit, look no further. Almanity is the best!
author: Marcin

title: Nicest hotel in Hoi An
text:
We've travelled extensively, staying at some of the best and perhaps most expensive hotels during this time. the Almanity is a brilliant hotel, first and foremost because of its outstanding staff. Nothing is too much trouble, and they clearly take great, and justified pride in their very genuine service.

Hoi An is a magical destination and further enhanced by the staff at the Almanity resort. 

Thank you!
author: Clive

title: Bardzo dobry hotel na wypoczynek i zwiedzanie w Hoi An
positives:
Wyśmienite śniadania. Hotel położony poza ścisłym centrum zaledwie kilka minut spacerem do głównych atrakcji. 
Do dyspozycji gości jest bardzo duży basen. Pomocny i niezwykle uprzejmy personel. Pokoje przestronne i czyste.
author: Michal

title: Excellent service and location
text:
We stayed for 3 nights during the November typhoon in Hoi An. Despite local flooding we still managed to have a very enjoyable time here primarily because of the hotel. We went for a luxury double room which was more like an apartment with very comfortable bed and our own bath! The staff all very friendly, rooms and dining areas very clean and stylish décor. The spa looked great but double the prices on the high street for a massage so we went externally. The bar was fun with a reasonable range of drinks, although on the pricey side.

thank you Almanity!
author: Jonathan

title: Szép, igényes, tiszta, kényelmes.
positives:
A hotel nagyon jó helyen van a városban, közel az óvárosi részhez, gyalog mindössze 10 perc. 
Nyugalmas, csendes maga hotel és a környék is, így az alvás zavartalan volt. Tiszták tágasak mind a belső terek mind a szoba. Az ágy rendkívül kényelmes. Reggeli bőséges és széles választékot kínál, mind a helyi szokásoknak mind multikulturális szokásoknak megfelelően. 
A szobába bekészített víz üvegpalackban volt, a fenntarthatóság, környezet kímélés jegyében ami számomra külön pozitívum. A ruhatisztítást gyorsan és kiválóan intézték. Gyors, körültekintő, segítőkész a személyzet.
negatives:
A szobában a vizesblokk/fürdő volt a leggyengébb. A víz nehezen ment le, illetve a felső zuhanyból a víz elzárását követően is sokáig folyt és csöpögött a víz. A zuhanyrészen nincs akasztó, így a köntös és a törölközőt nem lehet hova tenni, mialatt fürdik az ember. Nincsen sminktükör, így aki pl szemüveges nehezen tudja megoldani a szépítkezést (férfiak borotválkozás, nők sminkelés, szemöldök szedés stb.). A hajszárító a legrosszabb volt amivel itt Vietnámban találkoztam. Olyan mintha a 80-as évekből maradt volna ránk. Nincs hozzá formázófej, így hajformázásra, vagy csak normálisabb nem szénakazal szerű hajszárításra alkalmatlan. A vezetéke rövid ahhoz képest, hogy a konnektor milyen alacsonyan van, így aki kicsit magasabb számoljon azzal, hogy ha a feje tetejét szárítja, akkor kiránthatja a vezetékét a konnektorból. 
A személyzet előzékeny, kedves, de egy idő után már túl sok és zavaró volt, (pl.: reggeli közben jött érdeklődni hogy mikor távozunk, hova megyünk, ott milyen tervünk van, ő tud ajánlani 1-2-3 dolgot etc.) A hotel munkatársainak többsége angolul valamelyest beszél, de sokuknál nehezen vagy aligha érthető amit mondanak. Az étkeztetésért (jellemzően reggeli) felelős személyzet jórésze nem ért és nem beszél angolul (szakács, kiszolgáló személyzet), nem tudták elmondani hogy a leves alapleve miből, milyen húsból/másból készül.

Morgenmaden, der var ofte ikke fyldt op, og udvalget ikke kæmpe, og stort set det samme hver dag. Ligger ved en meget trafikeret gade. title: Don't hesitate to book Almanity when in Hoi An
positives:
We had such a wonderful stay at Almanity Hoi An that we actually changed our travel plans and returned for a second stay at the end of our Vietnam trip!

The hotel itself is beautiful, with excellent facilities and a fantastic location. We made great use of the complimentary bike hire, cycling into Hoi An Old Town most days, which was a lovely way to explore the area. The security, concierge and reception teams were always friendly, welcoming and happy to help with anything we needed.

A special mention must go to the breakfast team. The breakfast selection was outstanding — by far the best we experienced during our entire trip around Vietnam. There was a huge variety of options every morning and everything was fresh, high quality and incredibly tasty.

We also enjoyed several treatments in the spa and found the spa team to be professional, welcoming and informative. The complimentary foot massage was a lovely touch and very much appreciated.

The highlight of our stay, however, was the pool area and the exceptional service we received from Thanh and Danh. They worked as lifeguards and at the pool bar during most of our stay and genuinely made our experience special. They were attentive, friendly, professional and always took the time to make us feel looked after. Their customer service was outstanding and they were a big reason why we enjoyed our time at the hotel so much. Thank you both for helping create such wonderful memories for our family.

We would highly recommend Almanity Hoi An to anyone visiting the area and would not hesitate to stay again in the future.

title: booked a city view room but was given a damp, dark underground room with no view at all, which was misleading. I was ve
negatives:
Very disappointing experience. I booked a superior double room with city view, but I was given a room underground, located in a narrow, dark back alley. The room was damp and dark. The door and window faced a corridor with mosquitoes, so we couldn’t even open the window.

How can this be advertised as a city view room? I believe you should clearly state that this room has no view at all when booking. I don’t mind paying more for a better room, but you should not mislead customers like this.

I complained to the hotel staff immediately, and they only said “subject to availability”. This is not about first-come, first-served — this is about false advertising and misleading information.

Please be careful when booking and confirm everything clearly in advance. The bathroom was a bit old. Breakfast selection was just okay.

I had high expectations for this Hoi An trip, but I left feeling very disappointed. I hope you will take this issue seriously.

title: Poor breakfast, services under 4 star standard
text: This is my second time coming to this resort. Previously, it was called Alma Court Yard Hoi An and I was satisfied with its services so that I decided to come back here again. But it welcomed me back with a look unfriendly, almost completely collapse of its services. Breakfast too poor and low quality with fresh juices containing too much extra water, over cooked bacon, etc ... Even I was almost fallen when moving next to the bar by water flowing from their sink system profusely on the floor that nobody knowed, then even no one try to say sorry to me. Booked room for 2 people but everything was set up just for one. Day 2, I would like to go out after breakfast, and it started raining when I stood in front of the lobby, I want to borrow an umbrella from the security men, they was 3 men, did nothing except for pointing me to contact with the reception by myself , no one intended to help customers, I was a bit uncomfortable but still entered the reception to ask for. receptionist just said to me that i should ask the security group before ???? And ... could you believe .. the receptionist said to me that i should ask the security group before ???? And this time, these men concluded : I should return my room and use the umbrella provided in the room. Is this the service of 4 star hotel? Price was amost 200USD. Will never go back here!

title: All service/staff within hotel need to improve
text:
So many staff standing around and not giving good service. With 1&1/2 hours of yoga on offer per day - get a proper yoga teacher - seriously. Spa staff average. Restaurant staff need to be on hand to give service. There are so many of them. Staff need training. If you ask the waiter for water at breakfast he points to the water and tells you to go and get it - while he is not really doing anything. Same with pool staff. Even front desk - hen I asked for a beach towel - they pointed me in the direction of the pool. The poor towel guy was sitting there all day with nothing to do. You never saw the Australian hotel manager anywhere!!!! 
So why is this hotel not full when it is in one of the best locations in Hoian. Because it lacks service. They have the best bar. The interior design is magnificent. Take happy hour. 2 for one - great!! Guest what if you want a white wine - they only have one choice - Sauvignon Blanc. Really - perhaps one dry wine selection would be a smart idea. 
As for the I room amenities - perhaps a tiny cosmetic kit would add flair to the 4 star rating. If the service at this most beautifully laid out hotel would match the design there will be no doubt that this hotel will increase their occupancy and guest satisfaction. Don't make excuses for low season. You must work on customer service. Offer guests a night of authentic Vietnamese street food. Try it!!! 
I hope to return there one day...... Now go and implement these tips. You won't be sorry. By the way most of the front of house staff were really good. They simply need more training. When a guest walk in late at night only one person will look up and say hello ???

I love hotel and and I can just see the potential here. Go for it!!!
positives: The hotel and facilities are tops

title: A brilliant start to our Honeymoon in Vietnam!
positives:
What a magical start to our Honeymoon!  We are collected from airport by Vu after a very long 21hr flight!  He gave us refreshments and made us comfortable,  advising us on many attractions and local foods to try.   Very friendly and polite gentleman. The hotel was amazing,  we stayed in the Jacuzzi roof too suite, the views stunning, very clean and full of all the amenities you desire.  We were welcomed to a beautiful cake with happy honeymoon on!  We started off by having a Couples Bliss Package Spa which was so relaxing and then relaxed by the pool before onto the night markets and lantern boat ride.  The hotel staff arranged our trips to the coconut boats and bamboo circus Teh Der which were both alot of fun and absolutely amazing experiences.   Vu collected us from the hotel on our final day here and took us to our next Villa Resort in Da Nang, such a lovely man. 
We have had the best start to our honeymoon and time in Vietnam, such a stunning country and Hoi An is definitely a place we'd like to visit again with our children.  Absolutely Amazing!  10stars!! X

title: Lovely hotel in Hoi An!
positives:
Lovely hotel in Hoi An! This is my second time staying in Almanity (1st: June 2023 and now: January 2026) and love it even more than the first time! Only a short walk to the river/main strip. The resort also offers bikes as an alternative to walking. Breakfast is also included, offering a range of Asian and western options.

Staff were incredibly friendly and hospitable, and were easily able to arrange a spa package, tickets to events and tourist attractions, private driver to Ba Na Hills, and airport transfer.

A massive thank you to Lien for her hospitality, who greeted us with a smile every day and made sure we had what we needed to make our stay the most enjoyable it could be. And thank you to Ba for driving us to and from Ba Na Hills, waiting for us, and ensuring we had a very smooth ride.

title: GOOD VALUE FOR THE PRICE
text:
Location - Within a 15 minutes walk you can reach the old town so the Location is still good.

Rooms  -  They wanted to put us into a small tiny room but with 2 floors in which the bed is on an upper floor where you have to limb up the stairs. The width of the room was may be only 2.5 mtrs which made us very extrmely uncomfortsble. We then have asked for a more bigger (wider) room which we then have got without Problem. The normal Standard room size is totally OK even though I always don't like if there is no door to the toilet as my wife always Need to listen "to my Music" when I saty on the toilet :-).

Breakfast and Restaurant  - The breakfast is very nice, many choices, all Major kitchen such as western, Vietnamese, China and even Sushi you can get. Enough choice for everybody! The Restaurant I can not value as we always have been eating outside.

Swimming pool and Fitness  -  There are 3 pools and one of the pools is abt 20 Mtr Long, so that I always even could do my swmimming Sport, doing my rounds. The Fitness room os also nice. All amneties are really excellent.

Spa and Sauna  - Since I am living in Thailand, I am very spoiled when it come to SPA offers, but here I can say the SPA is really excellent. May be the best Quality of Aroma therapy I have experienced in Vietnam so far (and I experienced a lot already). There is also a steam Sauna along with shower cabins, all extrmely nice and it really Upgrades the Hotel, since such massages are already included in the room rate.

Final result: A very fair Price for the Money, even though I find the desing of the Hotel not always ideally done (example: when it rains, there is not a single cover Roof in the Hotel so that you can still sit ourside, even though it would be so easy to arrange that)
positives: SPA, BREAKFAST, FRIENDLY SERVICE

title: There are better options closer to the Old Town
positives:
The pool area is relaxing and plenty of both shade and sun depending on what you are looking for.
Overall the grounds are very green lush and well maintained.
The staff were very accomodating with a room change request. We had originally booked a loft style room which we didn’t like because of the steep stairs and fortunately the hotel were able to move us to an alternative room.
negatives:
The staff were very shouty towards each other and once directly to me as a guest. I understand that this shouty way of talking is in the nature of some local people but it can be disconcerting for guests from other cultures.
This hotel might be difficult for older people or those with mobility issues. The beds are on a raised platform that can be especially tricky in the dark at night.
Compared to other hotels the service is not to a 5 star standard. We had an excellent experience with two staff members but most of the staff seemed to think the guests were an inconvenience. 
The walls in the rooms are very thin and you can hear a lot  of the movements of your fellow hotel guests.
The bathroom was very small and hard to be in there without opening the door.
We stayed at the hotel over new years and we did not find out until we checked in that we had paid for a very expensive New Year’s Eve dinner. This was not an optional extra when we booked the hotel and we would have rather made our own plans rather than feeling compelled to attend given we had already paid for the dinner.
The volume control on the TV in the room was strange. It was either muted or very loud.

title: 110% recommended
text:
After a long day of cycling, my friend and I decided to "splurge" on this resort and spa. We tried to clean up outside the hotel as we knew we were dirty from cycling, we were still a little grungy, but the hotel staff still treated us like we were normal customers and never batted an eye. They were helpful from the moment we entered the premises by taking our bags and bikes and helping us get sorted. From there, they made the stay more of an experience than a normal stay. The rooms, spa and whole atmosphere was relaxing, calm, quiet and comfortable. The breakfast was outstanding with options from around the world. The rooms are calming, spacious and have T.V. in English. The whole resort is geared towards Western customers and they hit the nail on the head with making us feel comfortable and relaxed.

The stay is certainly worth the money that we spent. 

110% recommended.

positives: swimming pool, staff, dinning
author: Duy

title: Beautiful grounds, amazing pool, great breakfast, lovely rooms
positives: Beautiful grounds and facilities, friendly staff, good location not far from river, breakfast had lots of options (Buffett style)
negatives: Some mould in shower which was unexpected given 5 star
author: Bianca

title: Highly Recommended!
text:
Recommended!!!
It is a very new, clean, and lovely boutique hotel. The room is very spacious. Staying per night comes with a free massage & sauna and it’s absolutely relaxing. Hotel staffs are very helpful and friendly. Breakfast is delicious. Fresh juice, western-style foods and traditional Vietnam pho are served. Location is good. It’s about 7-8 mins walking distance to the ancient town. We enjoyed our staying with the hotel very much.
positives: the staffs are friendly and willing to help. the whole environment is nice and clean.
author: Fan-Che

title: Exceptional
positives: Everything was perfectfor the our honeymoon! Above all Danh, the lifeguard guy at the pool, was everyday so kind, with a forever smile gifted and had care of us! Absolutely recommended!
author: Carmela

title: Totally recommeded New hotel and spa
text:
We had an excellent experience in the hotel. It's only 3 months old and everything was new. We were upgraded to the higher category room which was a wonderful surprise. Location is a 10 min walk to the Hoi An ancient town. Had a daily sauna/steam bath with a 50 minute massage included in the room rate which thoroughly relaxed us and led us to a peaceful night sleep. Their gym had the state of the art equipment too. 
Service was also excellent and friendly staff. Would definitely stay again.
positives: Good Service, Brand new hotel/spa, Location
author: Rena

title: Ok for one night's stay near to old town
positives:
The room was ok. Some staff front of house mainly good
30 minute foot spa included
negatives:
Breakfast is poor, especially the coffee 

Room tired  food left in halls for over 24 hours
Breakfast staff inattentive 

Water smelt funny like cumin, which made bathing, and the jacuzzi unpleasant 

Generally not of the standard expected, but ok
author: Louise

title: Relaxing journey
text: It was a very pleasant stay for me and my hubby. We enjoyed the daily tai chi, sauna and massage. Alma courtyard even gave us a free wedding anniversary massage in addition to the spa journey offered in the room package. We were upgraded to a bigger room with balcony and courtyard pool view. We were very happy with the stay!!
positives: Spa, ambience and service were excellent!!
author: Pearline

title: Perfect Oasis in the middle of it all
positives: Perfect location, amazing pool. Staff were so friendly and helpful. Would stay here again 100%
negatives: Small issue but would have liked some more local dishes on the restaurant menu.
author: Edward

title: Estupendo
text:
Un gran hotel! A 10 min caminanado de el old city perfecto para poder descansar del bullicio y toda la gente.  Las habitaciones espaciosas y muy comodas.
La piscina y el personal de 10. Probé un masaje con bambu y ha sido uno de los mejores de mi vida,
Totalmente recomendado!
author: Elizabeth
reply:
Dear Elizabeth,

Thank you for your fantastic review and perfect rating! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa, particularly appreciating our tranquil location just a short walk from the Old City, our spacious and comfortable rooms, and our facilities.

Warm regards,

Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Amazing
positives: Everything was amazing, the staff, the breakfast, the rooms, the location, everything is 10/10. Will recommend to everyone
negatives: Nothing 10/10
author: Katrina

title: Decepcionante
text: Para ser un hotel de 5 estrellas, muy mal servicio al cliente. Después de 3 emails para avisarles de que soy alérgica a la lactosa y necesitaba leche sin lactosa para poder desayunar un café en el desayuno, su respuesta es que no han encontrado, cuando en otros hoteles de Vietnam nos la han facilitado sin problema. En la piscina hubo un error con el servicio de la happy hour y nos querían cobrar sin el 2x1. Para hacer el check out no nos facilitaron la opción de recogernos las maletas para bajarlas a la recepción ( en otros hoteles de Vietnam súper pendientes llamándonos a la habitación para cuadrar la hora de recogida). En definitiva, un hotel que está un poco alejado del centro de Hoi An, que no está mal pero que para estar considerado 5 estrellas deja mucho que desear. Sabiéndolo hubiera escogido otra opción.
author: LIDIA
reply:
Dear Lidia,

Thank you for your feedback from your stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. We deeply regret the inconvenience caused regarding the lactose-free milk. Despite our efforts and alternatives offered, we acknowledge our failure to meet your specific needs. We sincerely apologize for this and the confusion during the happy hour at our pool.

We also apologize if our luggage service did not meet your expectations. Your feedback is invaluable for our improvement, and we are committed to enhancing our services.

We hope for another opportunity to provide you with a true 5-star experience.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Just perfect
positives: The location, rooms, spa, restaurant, staf and atmosphere are fantastic! You will not regret visiting this resort.
negatives: Everything is amazing
author: Michel

title: Nos encantó

title: Great hotel and facilities close to Hoi An Old Town
positives: Staff were lovely and so helpful - booked our tickets at reception very efficient. Pool area was lovely and clean. Rooms very very good size and bed very comfortable! Great location, close to beach/ old town. Would definitely recommend and would love to stay again!
author: Aimee

title: très bel hôtel
text: Un hôtzl paisible avec les équipements qu'il faut un super coffee shop attenant qui permet de découvrir le café. Le petit déjeuner est excellent et bien fournis la piscine et le bar très agreable . Il n'est pas loin des commodités et il est sécurisé. Je le conseille vivement un très bon souvenir
author: Orane

title: It's beautiful
positives: This was a very calming place to stay. Location is good. The pool lifeguard was the friendliest man in vietnam.
negatives:
I wasn't mad about the steps up to the
 bed. To turn off the bedside lights you have to get out of bed.  Small complaints for such a beautiful, tranquil place
author: Mairead

title: Magnifique séjour
text:
La chambre spacieuse, le personnel de la réception accueillant même tard ou lorsque nous avions fait livrer des affaires.
Le petit déjeuner est une dinguerie tellement il est bon et complet.  La piscine et les cocktails au top. Équipé d’une salle de sport c’était aussi agréable. L’hôtel est bien situé près de la vieille ville. Super pour une pause de quelques jours
author: Anne-Sophie

title: The perfect place to stay in Hoi An
positives: Very central location within walking distance to old town (but far enough to be out of the chaos). The staff are incredible and bend over backwards to take great care of you. The rooms are immaculately clean and a perfect mix of modern and character. The pool is large and there are plenty of sunny and shady spots for everyone.
negatives: The wifi is a bit patchy at times.
author: Andrina

title: Belle expérience
text: Très bel hôtel bien équipé avec de belle chambre . Le service est au top et la piscine magnifique. La qualité des massages et du spa exceptionnel
author: Sébastien

title: Excellent
positives:
Beautiful pool, Tri was amazing there.
Excellent breakfast.
Very nice staff
negatives: We booked two rooms one for 2 adults and one for 3 kids, they had only 3 beds in the room but they charged for 3 pax occupancy….
author: A

title: Pas Mal
text:
Très Bon accueil, personnel très gentil, très bon emplacement près de la vieille ville, par contre la chambre loft  : le bas est vraiment froid et triste, par contre le haut (chambre) est mignonne comme tout, mais intimité zéro( vitres brouillés séparant la douche de la toilette) .
Très mauvaise insonorisation entre les chambres  et le long de la grand route 
Petit déjeuner très  bien servi, au top.
Magnifique piscine et Jardin
author: Françoise

title: Perfect!
positives: Great Vibes close to downtown - all perfect!
author: Antonio

Nous avons dans un premier temps été placé à l'arriere de l'hotel, proche des travaux et en face d'un mur... bref lvraiement pas terrible... après discussion, le manager Ti nous a gentillement proposé une autre chambre en étant de plus surclassé.. Le personnel est donc au top, l'hotel et ses services (piscines supers chouettes) également, l'emplacement est parfait pour se reposer en étant proche du tumulte de la ville..

title: Exceptional
positives: Great hospitality and staff, especially Tri in the pool
author: Antonino

title: Very good
text: Très bon hôtel, super service et bon rapport qualité/prix
author: Soraya

title: Very good
positives: Amazing swimming pool! Danh from the swimming pool helped us a lot! Great guy!! We asked for an upgrade of our room when we arrived and we they met our expectations with our new accomodation.
negatives: They were really helpful all around, the only problem is that with the laundry service one of my t shirts got ruined. I understand it happens but when i told the reception staff they didn’t even reimbourse the service or give a symbolic discount.
author: Vincent

title: Superbe

Walking distance to old quarter perfect

title: Exceptional
positives: The Almanity Hoi A Resort was one of my favourite places to stay while visiting Vietnam. The location is superb. The staff were extremely attentive, polite and helpful. The breakfast buffet provided an excellent choice of cuisine. They also helped us locate a tailor which I was very impressed with. The pool was beautiful. I also enjoyed two spa treatments during my stay - fantastic. Would recommend to a friend.
author: Fiona

title: À la hauteur de mes attentes
text:
Beau séjour , arrivés en express nous avons bien été accueilli par Binh, toujours souriant et des saluts chaque fois que nous le croisions . Chambre confortable au maximum j’ai dormi comme un ange . L’ endroit est magnifique , les petits déjeuners très savoureux et énormément de choix . Mes seuls bémols vont au gym qui selon moi devrait avoir un air climatisé qui fonctionne , c’était vraiment trop chaud s’entraîner avec cette température. Et l’autre bémol c’est les escaliers glissants lors des jours de pluie , a certains endroits il a des tapis anti dérapant mais les endroits les plus problématiques il en a pas …peut être à revoir sur cet aspect .
Merci à tous pour le merveilleux séjour et merci à VU le chauffeur de taxi qui a prit soin de nous  au maximum et conduisait prudemment.
author: Jean-Philippe
reply:
Dear Jean-Philippe,

Thank you for choosing Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. We're delighted to hear that your stay mostly met your expectations.

We're glad you found our Loft Room comfortable and enjoyed our delicious breakfast options. We greatly appreciate your kind words for Binh, who always strives to provide a warm welcome.

We apologize for any discomfort you experienced in our gym due to the air conditioning. Your feedback is noted, and we will work on improving this aspect. Additionally, your comments regarding slippery stairs during rainy days have been duly noted, and we will address this safety concern promptly.

We also thank you for acknowledging Vu, our taxi driver, for his attentive and safe service.

Your feedback is important to us, and we look forward to the opportunity to host you again in the future, providing you with an even more enjoyable stay.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: We had such a great time here thanku
positives: Everything was so good, pool, room, staff, breakfast...Tihn, Bihn and Minh were also great and attentive very helpful with local knowledge and if we ever needed anything. 10 out of 10
negatives: Nothing
author: Aavan

title: Très bien

title: Great resort in fantastic location
positives: Staff were very friendly, complementary bike hire, buffet breakfast
negatives: Rooms were not soundproof
author: Melinda

title: Top Hotel, nahe der Altstadt

Obwohl das Hotel an einer Hauptverkehrsstraße liegt, sind alle Zimmer sehr ruhig, da es keine zur Straße heraus gibt. Auch das Frühstück ist sehr umfangreich, das Personal sehr freundlich.
author: Ina

title: Excellent
positives: Beautiful pool, nice rooms with good air conditioning. Close distance to beach and Hoi An old town by foot, bike or car.
author: Bec

title: 3 Nächte in Hoi An

author: Melanie

title: Hotel was in a great location with excellent amenities and fabulous pool
positives: Quiet and secluded yet close enough to the hustle and bustle of the old town.
negatives: Pool was excellent

title: Himmlisch!

Freundlichkeit, Service und Perfektion sind hier das Motto!
Dankeschön

Schöne Poolanlage, sehr ruhig, im sehr busy Hoi An.

Restaurant sehr gut.
Personal freundlich.

positives: Stayed in the loft room which felt spacious. Comfortable bed. Nice pool. Easy walk into old town. Helpful and friendly staff. Good breakfast with lots of choice- egg station, pancakes, fresh fruit etc. reception recommended a tailor who was fab (custom tailory Hoi An)
negatives: Shower head needed a descale but worked fine
author: Zoe

title: Great Hotel

author: Bernhard

title: Wonderful family stay in Hoi An
positives: Good location, friendly staff and excellent value.
negatives: NA
author: Thomas

title: Exceptional
text:
eine mögliche Bewertung erstellt:

Perfekte Auszeit in Hoi An

Die Unterkunft bietet ein hervorragendes Preis- Leistungs-Verhältnis und liegt ideal, um die Umgebung zu erkunden. Die Sauberkeit ist tadellos, und das Personal ist äußerst freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die Einrichtungen sind modern und gut ausgestattet, während die WLAN- Verbindung zuverlässig ist. Zudem ist die Erreichbarkeit des Flughafens unkompliziert und die Gegend ist fußgängerfreundlich, was den Aufenthalt noch angenehmer
author: Salvatore

title: Could not have found a better hotel! Everything was perfect
positives: Beautiful pool area, big rooms and just the nicest and most helpfull staff!! Especially Diep, who greeted us and gave us a great introduction to Hoi An and gave info about great restaurants!! Made us feel really welcome!! And Danh who worked by the pool area, and served us a lot of cold beers and everything he did was with a big smile! I have nothing bad to say about staff or hotel
negatives: Nothing negative at all
author: Rebecca

title: Viel zu hoch bewertetes Hotel, wir haben gewechselt ins Nachbarhotel
text: wir haben ein Zimmer bekommen, das eine Zumutung darstellte. Loftzimmer  mit einer Treppe, die keinerlei Bauvorschriftenund Sicherheitsstandards entspricht. Die Toilette befand sich aber in der unteren Etage. Die Betten waren eher Futonbetten und für ältere Menschen,genau wie die Treppe zum Bett eine Katastrophe. Ich war entsetzt. Der Manager kam uns entgegen und wir konnten ins Nachbarhotel Wafaifo Hotel umziehen. Hier war alles bestens.

title: Great place to stay
positives: Lovely resort. Great facilities. Great breakfast. Lovely pool, very good gym and great breakfast. Staff very friendly and helpful
author: Mark

title: Asien Rundreise

negatives: Room service menu was poor

author: Daniel

title: Would recommend this hotel everytime to anyone

author: Dariousch

title: We had an awesome time again and will definitely return for a third time. You feel like you are going on holidays to vis
positives: Atmosphere was warm and friendly. All staff were very friendly & attentive they went out of their way to look after our needs no matter how large or small.  Special mention to staff members MyMy, Binh, Ly & Chau who looked after us so well we didn’t want to leave.
negatives: Nothing really, the pool was a bit busy at times but that was understandable as it was school holidays in Australia as well as summer break in Vietnam and some other countries.. still enough room to cool off after a long hot day though.
author: Christine

title: Fantastic stay !
text: When you arrive you will be greeted in a friendly manner and will be helped with your luggage.  The harmonious interior invites you to linger, especially the atmosphere around the pool is breathtakingly beautiful.  The room was very clean and beautifully decorated.  For me alone, pure luxury.  The spa area is simply beautiful, I recommend the massage with foot bath and the saunas.  The pool area is very well maintained and there are various niches with different qualities of stay, something for everyone.  There are enough loungers available and the service is excellent.  The breakfast buffet is the most lavish and delicious I have ever seen.  It left nothing to be desired.  The cuisine is very good.  I had the summer rolls for lunch, so delicious and beautiful!  The location is great, a 10-minute walk into the middle of the old town.  The restaurant with the koi pond was beautifully designed.  Thank you Almanity for the excellent service and your kindness!
author: Caroline
reply:

Thank you for your glowing review of your stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. We're delighted to hear about your fantastic experience, from the warm welcome and beautiful, harmonious interiors to the breathtaking pool atmosphere and luxurious spa treatments. Thank you for recognizing our excellent service and kindness. We look forward to the pleasure of welcoming you back for another exceptional visit.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Super helpful staff and good location
positives: The pool was lovely, the room was spacious and clean.  The staff were awesome especially Dinh who went way above our expectations for helpfulness and friendliness.
negatives: Our room felt hot initially and when we explained to staff (Dinh) they did everything they could to make it better.  They showed us 2 different rooms to pick from but all had weak aircon.  Instead, Dinhh got us a fan which worked well enough.  The only downside to the property is weak aircon flow but in the end it was adequate and it wouldn’t stop me staying there again.

Executive Assistant Manager

title: A great spot to come back to after a big day. Pool area was very relaxing.
positives: Far enough away from the main area to be peaceful.
author: Margaret

title: Wohlfühlen leicht gemacht
text: Ich habe mich in meinem Loft sehr wohlgefühlt. Eine Oase der Ruhe in der hektischen Stadt. Das  Zimmer sauber und das Frühstück lässt keine Wünsche offen. Es gibt Fahrräder zum leihen und das SPA ist sehr professionell.  Würde ich nochmal nach Hoi An gehen, wäre das Hotel meine erste Wahl.
author: Melanie
reply:
Dear Melanie,

Thank you for your glowing review and for choosing Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa during your visit to Hoi An. We're thrilled to hear that you found your stay in our Loft Room to be a comfortable oasis of calm amidst the city's hustle and bustle. Your satisfaction with the cleanliness of your room and the variety offered at breakfast is greatly appreciated.

We're delighted that you enjoyed the convenience of our bicycle loan service and the professionalism of our SPA. It's wonderful to know that should you return to Hoi An, we would be your first choice.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable stay.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Exceptional
positives: Everything, location, pool everything was great
author: Alicia

title: Rundum Zufrieden
text:
Wir waren bei unserem Aufenthalt rundum zufrieden.
Die Stadt ist natürlich schon sehr schön, aber das tolle Hotel trug dazu bei, dass wir den Aufenthalt uneingeSchränkt genossen konnten. 
Danke an alle vom Empfang, Pool, Frühstück und den Fahrer.

Wenn ich einen Kritikpunkt äußern müsste: 
Wir hatten etwas Pech mit unserer Zimmerkarte, da hätte wir uns noch besseren Service gewünscht, aber die Mitarbeiter waren zumindest sehr bemüht. Als wir um eine Nacht verlängert haben, wurde unsere Karte nicht mitverlängert.  Schlussendlich musste ich 3 mal zur Rezeption vom Zimmer aus laufen, bis es funktionierte. Das hätte man auch direkt beim ersten Mal richtig kodieren können.
author: Leif
reply:
Dear Leif,

Warm greetings from Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa!

Thank you for choosing to stay with us and for your fantastic rating. We are delighted to know that your stay in Hoi An was thoroughly enjoyable and that our hotel contributed significantly to your experience. Your appreciation for our staff, from the reception to the pool, breakfast team, and driver, is greatly valued.

Regarding the issue with your room card, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We understand that such situations can be frustrating, and we regret that it was not resolved more efficiently on the first attempt. Your feedback is crucial in helping us improve our services, and we will take the necessary steps to ensure better handling in the future.

We hope to welcome you back to Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa, where we aim to provide an even more seamless and enjoyable stay.

Warm regards,

Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: A fabulous resort 10 minutes walk to the old town.
positives: Beautifully welcomed on arrival by Lien as she explained the area and the facilities of the resort. The resort is spotlessly clean and well maintained. The rooms are a great size and I'd recommend the rooms on the  second floor overlooking the pool. The pool is a treat to use every day and the breakfast which was included in our booking was magnificent. All the staff were truly terrific and we thank them all for making our stay so lovely.
negatives: Nothing. Stayed longer than originally booked because it is  so good!
author: Wyllie

title: Absolutely beautfitul!
text: One of our favorite hotels in Vietnam! The pool are was amazing! Loved the whole hotel!
author: Viktoria
reply:
Dear Viktoria,

Warm greetings from Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa!

We're incredibly thankful for your perfect rating and thrilled to hear that we're one of your favorite hotels in Vietnam. Your kind words about our pool area and the overall ambiance of the hotel mean a great deal to us.

Looking forward to welcoming you back for another delightful stay.

Best regards,

Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Perfect
positives: The staff - particularly lady on reception who retrieved my phone from taxi driver
negatives: All good
author: Mark

title: Tolle Unterkunft mit schönen Loft Zimmern
text: Die Betten sind sehr gemütlich, die Zimmer dunkel in der Nacht. Schönes Loft Zimmer, der Schlafbereich befindet sich im Zimmer oben. Wirklich gemütliche Anlage, Verkehr hört man hier nicht. Nur ca. 1km bis in die Altstadt
author: Marcel
reply:
Lieber Marcel,

vielen Dank für Ihre Bewertung. Wir freuen uns, dass Sie Ihren Aufenthalt im Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa genossen haben und dass Sie die Betten als sehr gemütlich und die Zimmer als dunkel in der Nacht empfunden haben. Wir sind froh, dass Sie das schöne Loft Zimmer und den Schlafbereich oben im Zimmer als gemütlich empfunden haben. Wir sind auch stolz darauf, dass unsere Anlage ruhig und abseits vom Verkehr ist. Es ist nur etwa 1 km bis in die Altstadt. Wir hoffen, dass Sie uns bald wieder besuchen werden.

Mit herzlichen Grüßen,
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: Lovely
positives: Third time and just loved the ease and facilities and location
author: Jennifer

title: Zimmer ok, Pool top
text: Die Poolanlage ist wunderschön und das Frühstück super.
author: Tanja
reply:
Hello Tanja,

Thank you for taking the time to review your recent stay at Almanity Hoi An. We are pleased to hear that you enjoyed our beautiful pool area and had a great breakfast experience. Your feedback is important to us and we will continue to strive to provide our guests with exceptional service and facilities.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to Almanity Hoi An in the near future.

Best regards,

Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Exceptional
positives: great hotel and great rooms, perfect location very close to the river but quiet. lively swimming pool and breakfast, I have a gluten intolerance and they prepared something gluten free for me, great service.
author: Denise

title: Super!
text: Habe 5 Nächte in diesem Hotel verbracht und alles war toll. Sehr sauber und schön. Das Personal war sehr hilfsbereit und respektvoll.
author: Dilan
reply:
Dear Dilan,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback about your recent stay at our hotel. We are delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us, and that you found our hotel to be very clean and beautiful.

We are also glad to know that our staff provided you with helpful and respectful service during your stay. Our team takes great pride in providing exceptional service to all of our guests.

Thank you for choosing to stay with us, and we look forward to welcoming you back in the future.

Best regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Absolutely loved it. Highly recommend!
positives: Great location, walking distance to Old Town. Beautiful facilities, especially the hotel pool. The staff were so helpful. Will definitely stay again.
negatives: Nothing! Tho if you’re booking the jacuzzi suite like we did (which I recommend) just note that the lift doesn’t go all the way - there’s one flight of stairs.
author: Catherine

title: Sehr gut, auch die Massagen
text: Sehr gut, auch die Massagen. Die Lage ist außerhalb der Altstadt, die Straße etwas laut aber davon bekommt man drinnen nichts mit, oder nur wenig. Manchmal hört man draußen einen Club oder eine Show aber das hört um 11:00 Uhr auf. Das ist in den anderen Hotels auch nicht anderst, aber dieses hier ist von Design her einfach der Hammer. Auch das Restaurant hat eine sehr feine Küche und ich habe die Saft Shakes besonders genossen.
author: Sebastian

title: Very good
positives: Beautiful pool
negatives: Bathroom tiny too small
author: Kylie

title: Coccolati in una vacanza speciale
text: L’ospitalità orientale è già famosa per l’attenzione al cliente. Qui hanno una marcia in più. Grazie a Vy e Huy per il sorriso a colazione e per avermi spiegato come mangiare frutta mai vista prima. Grazie a Vien per avermi accontentato nel mio ultimo capriccio!
author: Patrizia
reply:
Cara Patrizia,

Siamo lieti di sapere che hai trascorso una vacanza speciale presso il nostro hotel e che ti siamo stati di aiuto nell'esplorare nuove esperienze culinarie. Siamo felici che Vy, Huy e Vien ti abbiano fatto sentire accolta e coccolata durante il tuo soggiorno. Siamo lieti che tu abbia apprezzato l'attenzione che dedichiamo ai nostri ospiti e speriamo di avere l'occasione di accoglierti di nuovo in futuro.
Cordiali saluti,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Lovely pool
positives: Pool area and friendly staff
negatives:
I thought the rooms were looking a bit tired 
Not of 5 star rating
author: Carina

title: Amazing hotel, top location
text: Everything was perfect. Anazing staff. Clean hotel. Very beautiful rooms. Perfect breakfast. Beautiful pool. Top locaton.
author: Vangelis

title: Other annoying guests ruin it
positives: The room was nicely furnished and split across two levels which was quirky.
negatives:
Too many ignorant noisy people especially children running out of control and no parenting on display. Noisy guests mean that with the paper thin walls you can hear everything. 

This could be amazing if they banned phone speakers and children. Make it into a civilised adults only resort.
author: MarkBisto

title: Aardig personeel
text: Het personeel is behulpzaam en aardig. Het is niet ver van het centrum van Hoi An, maar 15 minuten lopen. Mijn verblijf in het hotel was comfortabel .
author: Caithlin

title: Exceptional
positives: This was my 3rd stay at this resort and I would definitely come back again. I have taken different friends each time and they have all loved it as well.
negatives: Maybe some poolside music? A beach shuttle to A Bang beach?
author: Christine

title: Genoten van een prachtig hotel
text: Prachtig en de ligging was ook super.
author: Sylvia

title: Fantastic
positives: Everything was really good about the hotel. It was as advertised and staff were amazing and couldn’t do enough for you. Facilities, food options and locations were first class
negatives: No issue at all
author: Pete

title: i definitely recommend this hotel
text: friendly and professional staff. very nice room! pool was very large and there were enough sun loungers for everyone. the breakfast was very extensive and there was something for everyone to enjoy.
author: Tine
reply:
Dear Tine,

Thank you for sharing your feedback about your recent stay at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. We appreciate your comments and are delighted to hear about your positive experience.

It's wonderful to know that you found our staff to be friendly and professional. We take great pride in providing excellent service to our guests. We're also pleased to hear that you enjoyed your room and had a relaxing time by our large pool with ample sun loungers.

Our breakfast team will be thrilled to hear that you found the breakfast extensive with options for everyone to enjoy.

We are grateful for your recommendation, and we look forward to the opportunity of welcoming you back to our resort in the future. If you have any more comments or suggestions, please feel free to share them.

Warm regards,

Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Exceptional
positives: The pool and breakfast were the highlights of this hotel.  Staff were also excellent. About a 10 minute walk to the old town. The only downside for us was that my husband had a knee injury and many grab drivers would not pick up to take to old town as perhaps too close but this has nothing to do with the hotel.
negatives: Nothing, enjoyed our stay and would return
author: Jeanette

title: Genoten
text: Alles aan dit hotel straalt luxe uit! Ook de spa en massages zijn aan te raden. Wij hebben hier een heerlijk luxe verblijf gehad.
author: Evelien

title: Book You Will enjoy it
positives: What we really enjoyed was arriving and the resort was exactly like the pictures. We had a car arranged form airport to take us and when we arrived it was an extra warm welcome, fresh lemongrass face washer and a cool drink. The pool was sensational, by the pool bar very affordable, food brought to our lounge which was lovely also. All staff very accommodating, asking if we needed any tours or extra coffee at breakfast. Breakfast was lovely and the Pho the best thing to start the day. The facility offered more than we required as we wanted to just rest after a hectic travel schedule before our arrival. We only stayed 2 nights as we had other accomodation arranged in Hue and the resort arranged a private car to take us the 3hrs and we did a nice stop off. This was also very affordable and made us feel well cared for. Thi Chi by the pool at 4pm was lovely way to enjoy that little bit more of scenery and the lovely gardens.
negatives: Nothing really. The showers was a little small but the bath tub made up for it. The spa also has a head spa treatment again. That was great.
author: Karla

title: Heerlijk
text: Top zwembad, mooie kamers en goeie service
author: Lisa

title: Exceptional
positives:
Buffet breakfast is the best I have ever experienced. A blend of Vietnamese, Western and Chinese, although we only had the Vietnamese food as it is so delicious.  A shout out to Lien who gave us exceptional and friendly service without being pushy about giving a review. 
The pool area is like a tropical oasis as the end of a hot day exploring Hoi An.
negatives: At the end of our trip many staff came up to us asking us to give a review of the hotel. I have not issues with that. It was insisting that we mention them in the review by name that become a bit pushy.
author: Anouk

title: Exceptional
text: Highly recommend for anyone going to Hoi An! Had the best breakfast and there were alot of activities that were offered at the facility. Even staying at the place was relaxing.
author: Yu-Chau

title: Fantastic
positives: Fantastic hotel, I was sad to leave. The room was very comfortable, breakfast was great with so many options, and the facilities are really good. Also, the staff is lovely!
author: Marena

title: Exceptional
text:
部屋もきれいで食事も美味しいし、スタッフもとても親切でした。
またホイアンに行った際は訪れたいと思えるホテルです。
author: Keiko

title: Pleasant
positives: The staff were lovely and helpful. The breakfast was delicious. And the pool is a great feature of the hotel.
negatives: The water temperature regulation in the shower doesn't work very well. The hotel is advertised as a wellness resort, yet, the gym is very small and there are no classes advertised and held. The pool towels are frayed and threadbare and the room towels not much better. Hallways are very noisy. Staff can be a bit pushy at times.
author: Andrea

title: Very Nice
text: Good place to stay!! Highly recommend but one thing to regret is facility is bit old and the door key was broken. It takes 20 min to fix it.
author: Kota

title: Lovely hotel and amenities set in a convenient location
positives: lovely stay, hotel was very accommodating for us all, as a large group. very well located, only a close walk to the old town. Shame there was a curfew past 10pm for the town though
author: Amie

title: 行き届いたサービス
text:
初めての家族旅行なので色々と調べましたが、そのイメージを上回るサービスでした。
一例ですが
朝からかなり暑くて子供がある小さいので近距離移動でもgrabを使ってましたが朝の時間はなかなかピックアップできずに困っていました。スタッフが話しかけてくれて、何気ない会話から状況を察知してエレクトリックカーを手配してくれ
ました。帰りもホテルまで乗せてくれるように、お願いしてくれました。
気の利いた心配りに感心しました。
author: Masato

title: A small sanctuary in the middle of Hoi An
positives: We had a very relaxed stay in the hustle and bustle of Hoi An. We stayed with our family of 3 in the executive room, where we had a nice sizable room with an excellent bed and a modern design. The staff was very attentive, from the hospitality crew to the lifeguards and the cleaning staff. The breakfast was very good and the pool simply amazing! We will definitely choose Almanity again for our next trip.
negatives: Nothing
author: Merijn

title: ぼちぼちよかった
text: まあまあわるくはなかった
author: 海人

title: Excellent hotel in Hoi An
positives: Lovely resort-style hotel, not far from the Hoi An old town. Amazing pool and very nice breakfast. Staff were very helpful in arranging for any tours we wanted to do and the pool staff were very friendly and helpful.
author: Willmaits

title: 良いホテルでした
text:
天井のライトが接触不良を起こし点いたり消えたりしたのが強いて言えばマイナスだった点。
その対応も早かったし、良いホテルでした。
ホイアンに行くなら、また泊まろうかな。
author: 晃嗣

title: My 4th visit from Hong Kong, I'll be back soon.
positives: My favourite pool. Excellent staff, nice spa, large, well-equipped gym, good breakfast.
negatives: Wifi next to the pool not great.
author: David

title: スタッフの対応がとても良い！
text: スタッフ全員とても親切で、気持ち良く過ごすことができました！楽しみにしていた朝食ビュッフェは、種類がたくさんで、出来立てのオムレツが感動的でした。お世話をしてくれたNgocさんにはとても感謝しています！素敵な時間をありがとうございました！
author: TOMOMI
reply:
Dear Tomomi,

Thank you for your wonderful review! We are delighted to hear that you had such a pleasant stay and that our team’s hospitality made a positive impression. It’s fantastic to know that you enjoyed our breakfast buffet, especially the freshly made omelets!

We will be sure to share your kind words with Ngoc—she will be thrilled to know she helped make your experience special. It was our pleasure to host you, and we truly appreciate your kind feedback.

We look forward to welcoming you back to Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa for another memorable stay in the future!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Amazing experience, plus a very helpful staff and private driver. Thank you Vu!
positives: Amazing stay in Hoi An within this structure. The staff is really supportive and take care of us in every aspect or needs during our stay. Plus, staff organized for us a transport to Da Nang airport with a stop visit at marble mountains. Our driver Vu was amazing, very friendly and supportive! An amazing experience!
author: Luca

title: 喫煙者は。。。
text: 喫煙場所が1箇所で遠い。喫煙者には辛いかも。
author: Yasuhisa
reply:
Dear Yasuhisa,

Thank you for sharing your experience at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa. We’re pleased to hear that you appreciated our cleanliness, location, and overall value.

We understand that having only one designated smoking area may not be the most convenient for some guests. As a wellness-focused resort, we strive to maintain a fresh and relaxing environment for all visitors, but we truly appreciate your feedback and will take it into consideration for future improvements.

We hope to welcome you back for another enjoyable stay in Hoi An!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Very relaxing week in Hoi An
positives: Attentive staff, beautiful pool
negatives: Some problems with air conditioning but all fixed quickly
author: Jessup

title: 素晴らしいホスピタリティ
text: 大晦日のNew Yearパーティに参加しました。食べ物も，催しも，とてもよかったです。部屋も最高ですが，コーヒーを飲めるセットがあったらより良かったと思いました。
author: Haruo

title: Exceptional
positives: We loved our rooftop jacuzzi room, great way to cool down in the jacuzzi at the end of the day The bed and pillows were so comfortable and room was clean and spacious The pool was wonderful.  The staff were so friendly and helpful especially the staff at the pool bar.
author: Katrina

title: エコ
text:
欧米からの観光客が多いからか、無駄な備品を部屋に置かず、必要な人が必要な分だけロビーからピックアップするシステム。
ミネラルウォーターもホタル専用の瓶に詰めておいている。
基本的に大賛成ですが、こらもエコ故なのか、バスタブがないのが日本人としては残念なのだ。
やっぱり浸かりたいよね。
author: NAOMI
reply:
Dear Naomi,

Thank you for sharing your experience with us. We're glad to hear that you appreciated our eco-friendly approach, including the minimalistic room setup and the special firefly bottles for mineral water. We're always happy to offer a sustainable and thoughtful stay for our guests.

We understand your preference for a bathtub, and we truly value your feedback. While we focus on providing eco-friendly solutions, we also strive to meet the diverse needs of our guests. We will consider your suggestion for future improvements.

We hope to welcome you back soon, and thank you for choosing our hotel.

Best regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Relaxing time, lovely hotel
positives: Very relaxing atmosphere - great pool and spa. Breakfast was lovely, lots of choice. Very attentive staff who gave good recommendations of places to go and things to do.
negatives: We got a room upgrade so can’t comment on the loft rooms. It is a 15 minute walk to the old town / river with the lanterns but that didn’t bother us.
author: Harriet

title: very nice trip
text: perfect trip.thank you.
author: SOMEYA
reply:
Dear Someya,

Thank you for your kind words! We are thrilled to hear that you had a perfect trip with us. It was our pleasure to have you stay, and we appreciate your feedback.

We hope to welcome you back soon for another memorable experience.

Best regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager

title: Great hotel, location, kitchen - bad soundproof !
positives: One of the best hotels in Hoi An, excellent European restaurant with renowned chef ! Breakfasts are not quite replenished in time so you often have to wait.
negatives: The absolutely fundamental problem is the zero soundproofing of the rooms and the common corridor, so any noise in the long corridor you hear in the room as if the door were open and often very disturbing until midnight.
author: Petr

title: 素敵なホテル
text:
建物は古いホテルでしたが、スタッフは親切でとても良かったです。

ナイトマーケットまで少し遠いですが歩いて帰れる距離で、街並みを見ながら歩くのも良かったです。
author: 香
reply:
Dear 香,

Thank you for your kind review and for staying with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa! We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our hospitality and found our staff to be helpful and friendly. It’s wonderful that you appreciated the walk to the night market, taking in the charming scenery along the way.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back for another memorable stay in the future.

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: Relaxing and convenient
positives: Great location close to old town, the pool was lovely and staff were great
negatives: Rooms were a little dated but spacious and clean
author: Taryn

title: ホイアン旧市街まで徒歩圏内
text: 贅沢な雰囲気のホテルです。朝食は美味しく、レストランは混雑していないので落ち着いて食べられます。プールが広く暑い昼間は涼むことができます。アンバンビーチまでのシャトルバスが出ていて、ビーチも楽しめます。レンタサイクルがあるので、旧市街を自転車で散策することもできます。今度はもっと長期滞在したいです
author: Daiki
reply:
Dear Daiki,

Thank you very much for choosing to stay with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa, and for taking the time to share such a wonderful review.

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the luxurious atmosphere of our hotel, the delicious breakfast, and the relaxing pool area. It’s also great to know that the shuttle to An Bang Beach and the bike rental for exploring the Ancient Town added to your experience.

We truly hope you will stay with us again in the future for a longer visit. We look forward to welcoming you back!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: Perfect for friends who want a relaxing time but lots of kids running around so not ideal for a romantic getaway
positives: Excellent location, 15 min walk to the old town. Free shuttle bus to their private beach and back!
negatives: Not a 5 star hotel - staff using hands to replenish the food at the breakfast buffet, fraying towels, no plug sockets by the beds
author: Sophie

title: 素晴らしい
text: お部屋もスパも、最高でした。朝食も品数が多く味も良く、満足いく内容でした。次の滞在ホテルまでホテルバスが送ってくれ、大変助かりました。
author: 美加
reply:
Dear 美加,

Thank you very much for your wonderful review and for staying with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.

We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your room, the spa, and our extensive breakfast offerings. We’re also happy that our hotel shuttle service to your next destination was helpful to you.

It was a pleasure having you with us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another fantastic stay in the future!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: Excellent
positives: Great facilities and amazing staff
negatives: On a busy road just out of old town
author: Elizabeth

title: Hotel stay
text:
ホテル滞在が素晴らしい。
部屋も広く、綺麗。水回りも綺麗にメンテナンスされていて使いやすい。

プールは陽当たりも良く、大きさも大きく十分満足できた。

朝食もとても良い。長期滞在しても飽きがこない。

ホテルのスタッフもフレンドリーでフレキシブルにいろいろ対応してもらい、楽しい滞在でした。

またリピートしたいホテルです
author: YUDAI
reply:
Dear YUDAI,

Thank you for your kind review and for staying with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed your long stay with us and found the room spacious and clean, with well-maintained facilities. It’s great to know that you were satisfied with our pool, breakfast, and the friendly, flexible service from our staff.

We’re thrilled that your stay was enjoyable, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another great experience in the future!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: A really lovely resort with a great relaxed pool.
positives: The resort has an amazing pool area. Rooms are comfortable and breakfast was lovely.
negatives: Location is just a little far out. The walk in to old town wasn’t bad but walking in the heat isn’t comfortable
author: Marnie

title: また泊まりたい
text:
色々きを使ってくださり、とても素敵な旅行になりました。
ホイアンに行く際はまた泊まりたいです
author: YUKA
reply:
Dear Yuka,

Thank you for your wonderful review and for staying with us at Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa.

We’re thrilled to hear that our team’s attention to detail helped make your trip so special. It’s great to know that you had a lovely stay and would choose to stay with us again when you visit Hoi An.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another fantastic stay in the future!

Warm regards,
Quan Nguyen
Executive Assistant Manager
Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa

title: Amazing stay in an amazing Hoi An
positives:
The pool was absolutely beautiful and the breakfast buffet was one of the best on our trip yo Vietnam. The staff here were all so friendly and I would definitely come back. 
Their recommendation for silver jewellery was spot on.
negatives: What I didn’t like was in the lift room the fridge is upstairs in the bedroom instead of being downstairs where you would normally make your refreshments. Also lighting around mirror was hard for makeup and there was no full length mirror.
author: Anita

title: 部屋が狭い
text: ドアをあけたらいきなりベッド、部屋のデザインがいまいち
author: Kayoko

title: So good I am going again in 3 weeks
positives: The title says it all :)
negatives: The wifi is a bit patchy.
author: David

title: お宿の感想
text:
価格帯として7000円代のお部屋に泊まりました。

Quan Nguyen

title: Lovely staff, Best hotel breakfast ever, But NEEDS soundproofing.
positives: Good location near great tailors, just across from an alley full of delicious restaurants, and 10-15 minute walk from anywhere you need to go in the old town. Five-star service and a FANTASTIC breakfast! Seriously, that breakfast was unparalleled. They took very good care of us on our honeymoon and made well-informed recommendations. Spa was very nice and reasonable enough when applying the morning discount. Highly recommend the bamboo massage with Ann, outstanding!
negatives:
What really impacted our rest was the lack of soundproofing. All tile everything and no seal on the doors = extreme echo. We pretty much woke up any time another door opened or closed, anytime someone talked, and for those mysterious 6:55am housekeeping calls in the hallway :( We are usually pretty hard sleepers, and even tried earplugs, but no use. This is why we probably wouldn't return.

Cleanliness and facilities were not what we expected from a 5-star resort at this price point. Wish the room had been cleaned more thoroughly, esp. dusting the headboard and bedside lamps, dusting in general, deep cleaning the bathtub and other bathroom fixtures. The loft-style room was well worn and in need of those normal repairs that come with time and use, e.g. filling cracks and grout, repairing gaps in the wall and flooring. 

Seems that it was more a family-oriented resort than a restful and romantic retreat for couples as we thought from the marketing. We didn't mind the shouting and splashing of all the children all morning long so much, but others might.
