author: Michael

title: Good location and facilities
text:
The room/suite we stayed at was spacious (double bed and a single bed) and had a city view. 

The hotel is close to restaurants (such as Michelin-starred Anan, and Michelin recommended, Rice Field and Octo which are a few doors away). It is also walking distance to Takashimaya store and small stores if you want to buy drinks or snacks. It is also easy to book a Grab ride or even a taxicab to sites and attractions.

The staff are welcoming and friendly (from the  entrance, reception,  breakfast area, and afternoon tea area).  Room is also regularly cleaned.  It also has a pool  (not too big but nevertheless a nice addition since not all boutique hotels have a pool) and spa (though we didn’t have time to try the spa). Thank you as well to the staff for bringing out a birthday cake for my son during breakfast. 

My only suggestions are to have more variety in the food for the afternoon tea (it doesn’t change the 3 days we were there) and to have more savory selection in the afternoon tea, as well as more Western selections for breakfast. Though the Vietnamese breakfast fare selection was good.  Also the deposit collected upon check in takes 2 weeks to be returned or reversed in the credit card. It shouldn’t take that long. 

Overall, I would recommend Au Lac Charner and would gladly return.

The location was excellent, and if we go to Ho Chi Minh again, I can't think of staying anywhere else. I strongly recommend it.

title: Quaint Hotel
text:
Plus Points
1. The decoration at the main lobby is quite impressive and welcoming. 
2.  Wide varieties of fruits served at the breakfast buffet. 
3.  Not the usual big brand hotels that looks business like and crowded with guests. It has its charm with only a few floors and limited number of rooms located at the back alley. 
4. The surrounding feels very local with a number of local eateries just outside the hotel and an interesting local market located at the street just behind the hotel. 
3. The spread of food provided at the afternoon tea, included for most guests, is quite substantial and tasty. The cafe is on the 10th floor is very tastefully decorated and offers a good city view.  

Minus Points 
1. The varieties of food, except fruits, at the breakfast buffet are not that comprehensive.  Take note of the egg station and best to order sunny side up that can't go wrong.  And they don't serve other types of coffee except the Vietnamese coffee. You may top up extra to have other types of coffee. 
2.  The bathroom's floor seem to be easily wet after each shower. Possibly due to the gap between the bath tub and the glass panel. We can't prevent it despite stuffing towels between the gap. 
3. Not enough hooks in the bathroom to separately hang dirty and clean clothes. 
4. the map provided by the hotel does not include landmarks around the hotel to enable guests to make sense out of the location of major attractions located near the hotel. Best to use the ones left at the lobby by various tour operators instead. 
5. Do note that there is a flight of stairs (about 8-9 steps) leading to the hotel entrance. Not as user friendly to elderly or those with knee problems although there are porters to help to carry your luggages up and down the stairs. 
 6. Realised that the prices are comparable to other major hotels located around the same area. So, value wise, it may not be great but it's ok if you are looking for a slightly different hotel to stay in.
author: TAN

I hv evidences from the hotel to prove if anyone needs to see that I am still awaiting my refund. The hotel has completely misrepresented and continuing my bookings with other hotels in Vietnam, this is the only hotel that asked for guaranteed deposit and not refunding yet. Collecting VND5M was immediately debited to my credit card but refunding, the hotel or they said their bank, takes their time. Don't trust them..

title: Leider sehr hellhörig, wer ruhig schlafen möchte soll woanders hin
positives: Standort ist super, alles in der Nähe. Mitarbeiter sind sehr freundlich und sehr bemüht. Pool ist schön, teilweise überdacht, so dass man sich von der Sonne auch im Pool verstecken könnte. Weniger Liegen, aber wir haben immer Platz gefunden
negatives:
Seher sehr hellhörige Zimmern. Man hört alles was in dem Nebenzimmer passiert. In dem direkt nebenliegenden Gebäude war eine Baustelle. Lärm vom morgens bis abends mit dem Schlagbohrer u.s.w. Sowas muss bitte im Vorfeld angekündigt werden. Ich würde niemals in ein Hotel mit einer Baustelle nebenan einchecken wollen.
SPA muss auch noch hier erwähnt werden. Nach einer wirklich durchschnittlichen Massage für meiner Frau und mich wurde ausdrücklich nach Trinkgeld gefragt. Nach dem ich 100.000 VND gegeben habe wurde sehr verärgert reagiert und ich müsste auf 200.000VND
 erhöhen. Da die Qualität der Massagen nicht gut war wollten wir ehe nicht mehr rein, nach dem Vorfall mit Trinkgeld umso mehr
author: Roman

title: A lovely boutique hotel
text: I was pleasantly surprised with my stay at Au Lac Charner Hotel.  I knew that the location was great and based on pictures, assumed the rooms were fine.  However, I happened to check in during their daily Afternoon Tea, and learned to my delight that in addition to tea, they also provide a wide variety of complimentary cakes and other snacks.  This and other thoughtful little "features" made me very much appreciate my decision to stay at Au Lac Charner.
author: Philip

title: Top Lage
positives: Das wirklich schöne Hotel in der Mitte des Distrikt 1 hat einen wunderschönen Pool im 10. Stock, mit einer genauso tollen Ausblick über die Stadt. Das ganze Personal war auch stets sehr freundlich. Insbesondere die Dame in der Kundenbetreuung. Die Zimmer waren okay, sie waren Sauber aber nichts Spektakuläres. Für mich waren wirklich die Lage und der Rooftop Pool meine Highlights.
negatives: Zimmer nicht wie erwartet, sehr einfach und nichts besonderes
author: Markus

title: Excellent
text: Really charming place; lovely staff; great location but peaceful
author: Rebecca

title: Tolle Lage, gutes Hotel, nettes Personal
positives: Alles, der ganze Aufenthalt war angenehm, dadurch dass die Zimmer komfortabel waren, das Personal sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit ist, der Nachmittagstee im 10 Stock, der Pool oben... für uns war es einen super Abschluss unserer Vietnam Reise und wir durften im Hotel bleiben und Pool/ Dusche nutzen, obwohl wir längst ausgecheckt waren, denn unser Flug war in der Nacht.
negatives: Nichts....
author: Sofia

title: Nice Boutique French Colonial Hotel
text:
This is a lovely boutique hotel. The rooms were charming though the bathroom had a damp smell about it. They don't use Air conditioning in the hallways but have a door open to allow the natural air to flow, which can be a little warm. The breakfast room is lovely and the choices are ample with many choices as it has to suit many nationalities. I was disappointed that the pastries weren't freshly baked. The afternoon tea room is lovely. Their black tea is jasmine tea and only peach tea in the room so no milk. There is a Circle K a few doors down, but if you're a true tea drinker, maybe being some with you. I wish I had. The pool is small, with five sunlounges by the pool and three on a Mezzanine floor above, so it was rather squeezy trying to have a refreshing swim. 
Overall the staff are polite, respectful and helpful, but don't expect a good chat like you do in Bali.
Definitely a great hotel in a good spot with everything in walkable distance.
author: Gabrielle

title: Der Aufenthalt war Hervorragend
positives: Total sauber, sehr freundliches Personal, nett gestaltet, tolle Massage, gutes Frühstück, perfekte Lage
negatives: Fällt mir nichts ein😀
author: Jörg

title: Nice experience
text: The hotel is near the center, clean, and quiet. The staffs are very friendly, kind, and welcomes .  However,  the hotel door is very difficult to open and   They did not provide the mineral water. There are only two bottled glass water on the desk with open cap that make me can’t drink.
author: Hayeong

title: Eigentlich in Ordnung, aber ich würde selber nicht wieder kommen.
positives: Das Frühstück ist in Ordnung. Die Lager ist gut. Happy Hour ist sympathisch.
negatives: Badezimmer ist in die Jahre gekommen.
author: Quoc

title: Au lac charner. Another word for paradise
text:
Staff, food, amenities,location,room. There is nothing more you could want from a place during your stay.
From the moment you walk in you are at peace.
You will be so happy if you choose this hotel as your home base.
author: Mark

title: Fantastisch!
positives: Alles topp!
negatives: Nichts
author: Friedrich

title: Very good
text: Quirky hotel, shower on balcony is different, reception staff and consierges great
author: christine
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Acceptable
positives: Lage in der Innenstadt
negatives: Das Hotel war fast leer, doch neben unserem Zimmer fand eine Baustelle statt. Erst nach dreimaliger Beschwerde wurden wir auf eine andere Etage verlegt, doch das neue Zimmer roch muffig. Am Ende hatten wir wie andere Kunden Probleme mit der Rückgabe der Kaution, weil angeblich eine Wasserflasche im Kühlschrank fehlte.
author: Adriana

title: Location, value, service
text: Excellent location, helpful and friendly staff,  great full service.
author: Paul

title: Excellent
positives: Gute Lage, schönes Hotel
negatives: Klimaanlage war zu stark und störend
author: Marcus

title: Au Lac Charmer Hotel Ho Chi Minh City
text: Staff were very unfriendly on check in. The walls are thin so you hear your neighboring guests in their rooms. Had a raucous couple next door who kept us awake the whole night.  The location was great though and close to the markets.
author: Dawn
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed
reply:
Dear Mr. Dawn,

Thank you for staying at Au Lac Charner Hotel and taking the time to share your experience with us. 
We sincerely apologize and so sad to learn that we failed to meet your expectations and you had a frustrating experience during your stay, but I really appreciate you bringing this issue to my attention. 
We take guest feedback very seriously and have informed our relevant department directly to ensure this does not happen again. We would love to make things right if you give us another chance.
We hope you and family have a wonderful day and look forward to welcoming you back to us in the near future.

Best regards.
Au Lac Charner Hotel Team

title: Einfach nur perfekt!
positives: Tolle Lage, schöner Pool, sehr gutes Frühstück und super nettes Personal!
author: Peter

title: Nice hotel
text: Nice breakfast, although the hot food- lukewarm.  .  Pool area small- difficult to get a chair.   Free afternoon tea- not available on your check out day.   Wine in room advertised as $25- did not specify it was USD.- which they advised me on checkout- whilst standing over me- and checking via their walkie talkies as they checked our room- very off-putting.  No air conditioning in the upstairs section near the pool.   Overall whilst a nice hotel- would not stay here again..
author: Stefan

title: Exceptional
positives: Sehr aufmerksames und freundliches Personal, gute Lage zum Erkunden der Stadt. Schöne Aussicht von der Dachterasse
negatives: Alles gut
author: simone

title: Lovely property in the middle of Saigon
text: Really nice, spacious, and elegant room.  Delicious breakfast, really enjoyed the rooftop pool.  Great central location, walkable to a lot of the sights.
author: Hermina

title: Tolles Hotel in zentraler Lage mit klasse Roof-top-Pool und leckerem Essen
positives:
Lage sehr zentral - top!
Personal sehr freundlich und informativ - klasse!
Frühstück sehr lecker und umfangreich.
Roof-top-Pool sauber mit toller Aussicht. Die Smoothies sehr lecker!!!!
Tea-Time am Nachmittag ein tolles Angebot.
Da unser Flug erst abends ging, konnten wir noch den Pool nutzen und die Duschen auch. Das ist toll für eine späte Abreise.
Hier würden wir auf jeden Fall wieder einchecken.
negatives: Nichts!
author: Sabine

title: Lovely boutique hotel stay
text:
Nice small hotel close to all the tourist area of district 1 . The rooms were nice and spacious although our shower was quite strange as it had no support for the shower head so you had to always hold it. 
Breakfast was ok but it really needs a different selection every day as it becomes same old every day.
We would like to mention Jessica who  looked after us and was friendly and attentive . She isa great asset to the hotel.
author: Linda
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Very good
positives:
Sehr gutes Frühstück.
Tolle Lage mitten im Zentrum. 
Sehr freundliches Personal. 
Nachmittags Tee.
negatives: Pool sehr klein, zu wenig Liegen und Sessel am Pool

title: Not Good Experience
text:
The photos may look appealing, but it doesn't in real life.

We had to change hotels in our stay. Staff cannot handle concerns effortlessly to resolve conflict. There's bad soundproofing too, which led to much conflicts especially with light sleepers.

Location wise, it's not the most attractive area, you're better off nearer to the malls or the other side of town. 

The only redeeming factor of the hotel is that they had both high tea and breakfast for free.

Au Lac Charner Hotel Team

title: Excellent
positives: Das Hotel ist sehr schön eingerichtet und die Lage ist top! Das Frühstück ist auch gut und das Personal super. Robert hat uns einen super Service geboten.
author: Matthias

title: Overpriced
text:
1 night cost RM 600+, too expensive. 

There are stains on towel, room was quite small, not worth it.
author: Rainnee

title: Very good
positives: Das Personal war extrem hilfsbereit und hat uns in allen Fragen bestens unterstützt.
author: Karin

title: Absolutely Wonderful
text:
From the moment we stepped inside the Lobby we instantly knew we would love it here.  We were warmly greeted by the happy and informative staff.
The Room and bathroom both very clean and comfortable.  We booked the Bonard Suite, and it was big with all the amenities needed for a very comfortable stay.  The shower was outside on the Balcony which I thought was strange at first, but got used to it and didn't find it awkward as it is sheilded with plants. 
Buffet breakfasts were great with lots of choices and the complimentary Afternoon Tea was a bonus and really lovely.
The pool was wonderful and clean.  Although small, it was enough to jump in and swim and cool off.
We just loved our stay here, and most definitely will return here as its also in a great location to a lot of places to see, restaurants, cafes. markets and the Square which is a great place to spend time at night.
Thoroughly recommend staying here.
Thankyou to all the staff as you made our stay here wonderful and a great way start off our Vietnam adventure.
author: Mario
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Just okay…..
positives: Der Lage…..
negatives: Das wir nicht das Zimmer bekommen haben was wir wollten aber dafür ein Late Check-out
author: Astrid

title: Very good
text: Convenient location
author: Nancy

title: Very good
positives: Ein wirklich zentral gelegenes Stadthotel. Von hier aus kann man die Stadt gut zu Fuß erkunden. Die unmittelbare Umgebung des Hotels ist super (viele Restaurants, ausreichend Geldautomaten). Besonders gut hat uns die Skyline bei Dunkelheit am Fluß gefallen. Für max. 2 Übernachtungen würden wir wiederkommen.
negatives: Wir hatten ein Familienzimmer für 4 Personen gebucht. Es gab aber nur 3 Bademäntel und Handtücher. Das 2. Bett für unsere Kinder war zu schmal,die Breite des Bettes war bei der Buchung nicht hinterlegt. Der Pool auf dem Dach war klein. Während der Stoßzeiten war es schon sehr eng im / am Pool.
author: Bach

title: Good location but could find better
text: Pictures are a bit deceptive. It s nit a bad hotel but because they sell it as luxurious you feel a bit disapointed when  you see the room. A bit dated and the bath/shower don t look really clean, no fauly to the cleaner but to how they are set up. Breakfast way too busy and not nicely presented. Pool is nice but doesn t look like regularly cleaned. Overall, I believe you can find better for this price.
author: Marion
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Wunderschönes zentral gelegenes Hotel
positives: Sehr schönes und zentral gelegenes Hotel. Die Details der Ausstattung, der Roof-Top Pool und die vielen kleinen Cafe-Restaurants bieten eine Ruhe-Oase zum Stadtgetümmel. Das Personal ist sehr aufmerksam und freundlich.
author: dany

title: Perfect location
text: Great location to everything. Hotel was nice and clean with friendly staff.
author: Jonty

title: Super Hotel mit toller Lage. Perfekt um in Vietnam anzukommen.
positives:
Sehr gut gelegen da mitten in der Stadt mit kompletter Anbindung an Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten & Fußgängerzone. 
Unser Familienzimmer war sehr sauber, komfortabel und großzügig. 
Der Pool auf dem Dach lädt zum entspannen ein und erfrischt nach einem anstrengenden Stadttag. Das Frühstück ist reichhaltig und bietet für jeden Geschmack etwas. 
Sind frühs angekommen und durften schon den Pool nutzen, bis unser Zimmer fertig war. Auch unser Gepäck konnten wir schon abgeben. Ein toller Service.
negatives: Alles super 👍
author: Daniela

title: Exceptional
text: Staff was helpful and very kind.
author: Georges

title: Very good
positives: Diese Punkte waren ok.
negatives: Beim Check In kann man das Zimmer per Kreditkarte bezahlen. Die Check In - Mitarbeiterin behält jedoch die Kreditkarte und konfrontiert den Gast damit, dass zusätzlich eine Kaution in Höhe von 200 Euro für das Zimmer von der Kreditkarte einbehalten wird (das Ganze für eine Nacht). Wir hatten diese Verfahrensweise der Kautionszahlung abgelehnt und auch über Booking.com wurde darauf vorab nicht hingewiesen. Wir konnten dann den Kautionsbetrag auf umgerechnet 100 Euro "runterhandeln" und haben die Kaution in bar hinterlegt, die wir dann beim Check Out zurück bekommen haben (das war aber unschön....)
author: Michael

title: Great stay
text: A boutique hotel that met all of my expectations.  Clean and quiet room was exactly what I needed. I highly recommend.
author: Mina

title: Schönes Hotel in zentraler Lage
positives: Sehr nettes Personal und sehr guter Service. Sehr gute und zentrale Lage. Pool im Hotel
negatives: Das Hotel ist etwas in die Jahre gekommen.
author: Maxim

title: Superb hotel with superb staff
text:
Had a great stay in the heart of District 1.  Location is close to the walking street and not far to the old market.
The hotel upgraded our room when we arrived which was a nice touch.
Breakfast was plentiful and varied with numerous hot options including freshly cooked omelettes.
The cocktails and beers are cheap in comparison to other hotels of a similar standard.  
One minor niggle is that the rooftop bar does not have enough seating by the pool in the evening.  It was often full. Perhaps in the evening clear the sun beds away and replace with a few tables and chairs.
Overall would highly recommend!!
author: Phil
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Sehr gute Lage, aber auch noch viel Luft nach oben bei den Preisen!
positives: Super Lage, sehr freundliches Personal an der Rezeption
negatives:
Am ersten Tag hatten wir ein Zimmer im ersten Stock, ohne Tageslicht. Erst am zweiten Tag haben wir ein Zimmer der gebuchten Kategorie in einem der überein Stockwerke mit Tageslicht bekommen. 
Das Personal im Service Bereich ist leider eher mit dem eigenen Smartphone beschäftigt, als sich um die eigentlichen Aufgaben und die Gäste zu kümmern. Wenn man beim Frühstück ca. 1h vor Ende kommt, sind viele Dinge bereits „aus“ (Orangensaft, Baguette) - persönliches Pech. Das gleiche gilt leider auch für den Nachmittags-Tee. 
Das Treppenhaus (Notausgang/Fluchtweg) ist leider mit Beistellbetten, Wäschesäcke, etc. versperrt. Viel Erfolg beim „raus kommen“, falls es mal brennen sollte…
author: Tim

title: Great Stay
text: Great place. Staff is very nice. Place is clean. Good location. Walking distance to restaurants.
author: Mariela
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Excellent
positives: Schön eingerichtete Zimmer. Das Personal war so hilfsbereit und freundlich...
negatives: Wenig Auswahl beim Frühstück.
author: Mauro

title: If you are light sleeper, reconsider booking this hotel
text:
The goods:  the location and cleanliness, the lobby is very French, beautiful 

The bads:  the hotel being so old, there’s absolutely no insulation between rooms and between floors. I stayed Bonnard suite, the shower was outside in balcony and bathtub was in the room(room 410). I was woken up from room 409 taking shower at 3:30 am and their shower was right next to my bathtub. And it was so loud. Then other side neighbor had a baby she started crying 1:30am one day and I was woken up( other 2 nights, she only cried in the evenings). And also you hear water running down the pipe all hours a day. If the rooms were better insulated, the noise level would have been better. I only slept well one night out of three. 

The breakfast was so so. Ho Chih Minh city was my last city and I experienced 3 other hotel before coming here. This hotel provided least extensive menu. Not impressed. 

The other problem was Wi-Fi dropping often. Worse 5-7pm than later evening. Probably due to being old building. 

This was the only hotel we slept in double or queen bed. The description said large double bed but I wasn’t sure what size that was. But absolutely not a king size bed. 

The pool area is very nice after a tour but not enough chairs around to enjoy.
author: Eun
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Für den Preis, sollte es Alternativen geben
positives: Die Lage im Zentrum ist genial.
negatives: Die Ausstattung der Zimmer ist in die Jahre gekommen und etwas ungewöhnlich. Unsere Dusche war zum Beispiel auf dem Balkon und die Badewanne neben dem Bett.
author: Kay

title: Exceptional
text: Had a good time visiting Saigon! The hotel is close to everything. Although on a busy street noise was not an issue. The daily breakfast was good with lots of selections daily. I enjoyed the variety of fresh fruits daily. Also enjoyed the Gym and the rooftop pool with the views of the city.
author: Avril

title: Im komplett verrückten Saigon ist das Au Lac Charner ein toller Anlaufpunkt.
positives: Das "Au Lac Charner" besticht vor allem durch sein außergewöhnlich freundliches und hilfsbereites Personal sowie durch seine zentrale Lage. Die Betten sind sehr bequem. Der Rooftop-Pool ist vor allem abends toll, das Frühstück sehr lecker.
negatives: Nichts!
author: Tina

title: Good location
text: Hotel is in good location, within walking distance from all the attraction downtown.  Rooms are clean.  Exercise room is small.  Roof top pool is quite nice
author: Phong

title: Schöner Aufenthalt  und gerne wieder
positives: Die Lage ist mitten in der Altstadt, von dort ist alles gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. Unser Zimmer lag nach hinten hinaus und war sehr ruhig. Das Frühstück war international somit gab es für jeden Gast etwas. Das Personal war immer sehr hilfsbereit und sehr freundlich. Man fühlte sich sehr willkommen in diesem Hotel.
author: Andrea

title: Cracking little Gem
text: Stayed for 2 hours nights as a solo female traveller.  Fantastic location.  Felt very safe walking out and about district 1 on my own as everything is so is nearby and walkable.  Loved the little pool/afternoon tea/my outdoor shower and  my G&T as the sun went down and Saigon comes alive!
author: Leila
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Wunderbar für touristischen Aufenthalt im Herzen Ssigons.
positives: Geschmackvoll eingerichtet, zentral gelegen, fantastischer Service.
negatives: Zimmer etwas hellhörig.
author: Nico

title: A bit disappointed.
text:
First of all, the location is perfect and that was the reason I chose this hotel in the first place.
I was disappointed with a few things. 
The roon was smaller then what was advertised. They said 40m2. At the best 25m2. This is not correct. I was offered another room but it was the same size. The photos as very misleading. 
Some staff was not attentive what so ever. This was the only hotel I did not make a big bar tab and that was because nobody asked if we wanted something to drink. This was experienced by other guests that where there..
Breakfast room was to small for the number of rooms but this is more difficult to change then the service. All in all it was not bad but by far the worst service we experienced in our stay in Vietnam and 10 different hotel.
author: Carlos
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Unser Aufenthalt in Saigon
positives: Das Hotel lag sehr zentral. Wir konnte viele Sachen fußläufig erreichen.das Hotel war modern und gepflegt. Das kleine Schwimmbad auf dem Rooftop war nach jedem anstrengenden Tag unsere Erholungsoase. Das Hotelpersonal war freundlich und hilfsbereit. Für die Gesamtbewertung und -eindruck  zweimal ein klares 1+.
negatives: Nichts

negatives: Lebensgefährlicher Einstieg in den Pool.

text: The staff was great and location was great too
author: Hyejin

negatives: Personal schlechtes Englisch
author: Frank

title: Nice!

author: Kazuko

title: Optimaler Ausgangspunkt zum Sightseeing
positives: Optimale Lage. Zu den meisten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind es nie mehr als 15 min zu Fuß. Gutes Frühstück und sehr freundliches Personal.
author: Andre

title: Best in HCM city
text:
Location is great. Close to Nguyen Hue walk street. Expect a lot of coffee shops and local food places(from $-$$$) and less than 30min walk to featured places in Ho Chi Minh City. Kind of  busy area but not too loud. I can still sleep at night.
As for the hotel itself, Easy check-in and check-out. You get buffet breakfast and afternoon tea everyday. staff are friendly and helpful.  Hotel is very clean and the best part is we have a heated toilet seat with bidet
author: Prince

title: Einfach toll
positives: Lage, Personal, Frühstück, Ausstattung
negatives: Nichts
author: Maximilian

title: Great location!
text:
This little French inspired oasis is conveniently located in the centre of the chaos of Ho Chi Minh!  
The staff are attentive and the amazing Robert went above and beyond to ensure our stay was seamless.  Our room was spacious and the facilities were great.  The only challenge was trying to secure a place by the pool as there are very limited seats available in the small area. 
Overall, a fabulous place and  I would highly recommend staying here!
author: Robyn
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Very good
positives:
Wir hatten die Junior Suite Bonard gebucht.
Der Pool auf dem Dach und die Aussicht von dort waren toll.
Frühstück war gut.
negatives:
Der Balkon (auf dem sich auch die Außendusche befand) war viel zu klein, es gab dort auch keine Sitzgelegenheit. Im Zimmer gab‘s kaum Möglichkeiten, Kleidung abzulegen oder aufzuhängen (auch nicht für Handtücher).
Am Rooftop Pool gab es nur wenige Liegen (etwa 10 Stück), die natürlich schnell belegt waren.

positives:

negatives:
Das Bett war uns ein bisschen klein.
Aber die Matratze war gut….!
author: Alexander

title: Good location and facilities
text: Good price and nice facilities
author: Khac

title: Very good
positives: Das Hotel liegt mitten im lebendigen Teil Saigons und ist von außen schon als ordentliches, schönes Gebäude zu erkennen. Unser Zimmer war groß und Komfortabel.
negatives: Die Rolläden haben das Licht von außen nicht wirklich gedämmt. Blinkende Lichter machen es einem schwer einzuschlafen. Am Pool standen vllt. 6 Liegen - für ein Hotel mit geschätzt 40 Zimmern ein wenig dünn. Entsprechend konnten wir uns da auch nicht hinlegen. Schade!

title: Excellent

author: Jaxson

title: Super Hotel in zentraler Lage
positives: Gute Lage, sehr zuvorkommendes Personal und schöner Rooftoppool.
negatives:
Das Frühstück hätte mehr internationale Auswahl vertragen, aber ist ohnehin Geschmacksache.
Die Klimaanlage in unserem Zimmer kannte nur eiskalt oder aus, Mittelding gab es nicht.
author: Michael

title: Great service
text: Great service from all hotel staff! Very nice and friendly! Hotel is beautiful and clean!
author: jeremy

title: Very good
positives:
Zentral und gut gelegen.
Eingangshalle sehr beeindruckend. 
Gute Frühstücksauswahl.
negatives:
Leider hatten wir ein sehr sehr kleines und abgewohntes Zimmer. 
Das Badezimmer war auch extrem klein.
Es gab eine sehr laute Klimaanlage. 
Für den Preis haben wir etwas anderes erwartet.
author: Hendrik

title: Great location, nice room and good breakfasts
text: The hotel is really well situated and rooms very clean and comfortable.  The downside is that the bar closes at  10pm and room service finishes at 9 pm.  Front desk staff are really helpful but we found the restaurant and bar staff didn’t smile very much.
author: Lynn

title: Zentrale Lage, gerne wieder!
positives: Wir waren zwei Mal in diesem Hotel und alles in allem sehr zufrieden. Sehr freundliches Personal, schöne, saubere Zimmer und vor allem eine super Lage direkt ums Eck des Bitexco Financial Towers.
negatives: In der Badewanne/Dusche war der Boden locker bzw. gab beim draufstehen nach und hat sich verformt. Außerdem lief das Wasser nicht richtig ab. Das Bedienfeld der Klimaanlage ist direkt neben dem Kopfteil des Bettes angebracht und leuchtet nachts sehr hell was störend ist. Eins der beiden Betten im Twin Room hat keine Steckdosen in der Nähe.
author: Nina

title: Mature couple spending the kids inheritance
text:
Location - 15-20 minutes walk to markets malls presidential palace HCM museum and some very good restaurants. Jade emperor pagoda 35 mins walk. 
All in all a great location. 
Cleanliness - good as per expectations
Breakfast - good. 
Staff - friendly helpful
This was our last stop of a 28 day holiday. What a great end to great holiday.
author: raj

title: Stadthotel
positives: Die Lage war gut, Restaurants und Shoppingcenter in der Nähe.
negatives: Das « angebliche » Upgrade, das keines war. Unser gebuchtes Zimmer ( mit Balkon) war nicht mehr verfügbar, obwohl wir es gebucht haben. Das Frühstück für den Standard war mehr als schlecht.
author: Ulrike

title: Great location in the heart of the city
text: Lovely hotel in the centre of the city surrounded by good places to eat. Reception/door staff were exceptionally lovely, helpful and keen to provide useful  advice…they even helped us set up Grab on our phones and  helped us find a sky bar on the 28th floor a bit out of town.
author: Helen

title: Zentrale Lage, gerne wieder!
positives: Sehr zentral gelegenes schönes Hotel. Bitexco Tower gleich um die Ecke. Großzügiges Zimmer. Sehr freundliches Personal.
negatives: Beim Duschen lief das Wasser aus der Badewanne und das ganze Bad war nass. Klimaanlagendisplay direkt neben dem Kopfkissen leuchtet nachts sehr hell. Ansonsten alles super.
author: Nina

title: a beautiful hotel in Sai Gon
text:
I highly recommend this hotel for people who’s comparing which place to stay in Ho Chi Minh. You will be able to experience a really good quality hotel for the price. 

The location was so good, so clean, and everything from breakfast and afternoon tea was perfect.
author: HAN

title: Sehr gute Lage, Zimmer sorgfältig auswählen
positives: Lage in Saigon/HCMC ist ausgezeichnet, besser geht nicht. Zimmergröße in Ordnung, eine Suite oder Komfortzimmer (wie gebucht und entsprechend erwartet) war es nicht. Mini-Balkon ohne Ausblick, da begrünt (ähnlich Efeu in De). Dusche auf dem Balkon, Badewanne mit integriertem Whirlpool im Zimmer. Ausgezeichnetes Frühstücks Buffett. Personal sehr freundlich. Am Tag der Abreise wurden uns 100 USD verrechnet wegen angeblichem Rauch im Zimmer (der aufgrund der Gegebenheiten von überall her ins Zimmer ziehen könnte und auch gleich wieder verflogen wäre). Dies hat den positiven Gesamteindruck leider getrübt.
negatives: Am Tag der Abreise wurden uns 100 USD verrechnet wegen angeblichem Rauch im Zimmer (der aufgrund der Gegebenheiten von überall her ins Zimmer ziehen könnte und auch gleich wieder verflogen wäre). Dies hat den positiven Gesamteindruck leider getrübt.

title: First trip to Vietnam
text: This was our first trip to Vietnam and we really enjoyed it. The staff were so friendly and helpful. The hotel is old style but beautiful. The room and bed were comfortable with good AC. Breakfast was great. Location is good for walking or take the hop on/hop off bus.

title: Acceptable

negatives: Personal kann kaum Englisch, Pool und Fitness ist alt, Frühstück ebenfalls nicht sonderlich ansprechend

title: Good hotel- great location
text: Considering its location this hotel is very good value for money. The rooms  are comfortable and the small roof top swimming pool is a real bonus. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend the Au Lac Charner.

title: Saubere Hotel in centrale Lage  mit alles was mann braucht.
positives:
Zimmer war relativ klein und etwas "in alter gekommen" aber hat uns nicht gestört ... Auf Rückseite des Hotels aber dafür sehr leise :). Viele unterschiedliche Zimmer ... beim Buchung genau fragen was reserviert wird!! 

Pool in Dachgeschoss gross genug für Schwimmen.

Gute Frühstück mit Frisch verbereitete Eier!

title: Needs improvement on breakfast
text: Room is okay, reasonably clean and has sufficient space. Breakfast is well below average as everything is served at room temperature except for the noodle. There are warmers under the food but apparently the staff does not know how to use it or they were not turned on. Food is just  below average. Ignoring the food, the place is okay.

title: Super Lage mit außergewöhnlich guten Personal
positives: Das Personal, die Freundlichkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft ist unglaublich! Ganz großes Kino!
negatives: Andere Gäste haben am Pool geschlafen, es sind eh nur wenig liegen dort und diese dann für einen Power Nap zu blockieren war schade.

title: Excellent staff and great location
text: A very welcoming and relaxing stay. Even though it is in the centre of district one it is quiet oasis. A good buffet breakfast and the added bonus of a complimentary afternoon tea. The pool is on the small size with limed sunloungers.

negatives: Das Hotel war ein wenig verbraucht

title: Great location & Amazing staff
text: The location and staff are fantastic; I recommend coming here just for that. The breakfast and rooms are ok, it is enough if you are spending most of your time outside and need a place to wash up and sleep.

Nettes Personal

title: Au Lac Charner Hotel Vietnam
text: This is a 3.5 star hotel located not far from the river in district 1. The staff are excellent as is the breakfast. The street where the hotel is located is very busy & narrow. Overall for the price the hotel is very good.
author: Robert

title: Stadthotel in guter Lage.
positives: Die Lage ist sehr praktisch, wenn man die wichtigsten Dinge fussläufig erreichen will. Der Pool und Rooftop sind natürlich top. Am letzten Tag konnten wir abends noch duschen und in den Pool hüpfen
negatives: Hotel-Taxi-Preise viel zu hoch. Am Ende war es ein normales Grab. Service am Empfang und Frühstück ist verbesserungsfähig. Die Zimmer sind schon ein bisschen abgewohnt.

title: Vietnam journey
text:
On entering the lobby/reception says everything, staff attentive etc.
Bonard junior Suite 4 nights...room is clean and has enough room for 2 adults plus suitcases, bathroom facilities good, although shower outside on balcony..which was quite nice...the only downside was the breakfast, there should be more options/turnaround it became boring also the banmaries were cold on 2 occasions, for a 4 star establishment this should not happen....young inexperienced staff??...for this reason I would not recommend it...there are other hotels at the same base price.
author: mark
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Tolles Hotel mitten in der Innenstadt.
positives:
Lage mitten in der Innenstadt.
Großer Balkon.
Super Frühstück.
Sehr freundliche Mitarbeiter.
Geschmackvolle Einrichtung.
negatives:
Der Pool ist sehr klein,
nur ein paar Liegen.
author: Peter

title: Excellent stay
text: Wonderful 3 day break in a perfect location
author: James

title: Wunderschönes Boutique Hotel mit französischen Flair in Bestlage von Ho Chi Minh
positives: Wir hatten eine Junior Suite mit Zugang zum Nachmittagstee - das Zimmer war wunderschön, die Dusche auf dem Balkon originell und besonders, das Personal super nett und hilfsbereit - das gilt besonders für Jeenie und ihre Kolleginnen am Empfang, aber auch beim Frühstück oder beim Tee; die Lage ist 1A, sehr zentral und doch relativ ruhig! Der Pool auf dem Dach ist klasse, die Drinks gut gemixt, das Frühstück sehr abwechslungsreich und lecker. Wir können das charmante  Hotel unbedingt empfehlen
negatives: Nichts
author: Oliver

title: Great Central Spot - Fantastic staff
text: The gentleman at the front desk remembered our names and guided us through a bunch of fun stuff to do in the area. Loved the place
author: Chris

title: Krönender Abschluss unserer Reise
positives:
Wir hatten ein Zimmer mit Balkon, was sehr schön war, da man abends auch noch draußen sitzen konnte. Die Betten war sehr bequem und alles war außerordentlich sauber.
Die Poolanlage war total gemütlich, wir haben bevorzugt oben zu liegen, da war es sehr sehr ruhig und man konnte herrlich entspannen. Es gab einen Poolservice und einen Nachmittagstee mit allerlei Leckereien.
Das Frühstück war mehr als ausreichend und sehr lecker.
Abends wurde das Bett gerichtet und jeden Tag lag eine Rose am Bett mit Guter Nacht auf einem Blatt geschrieben.
Unser Zimmerservice war hervorragend, da ich einen Tag krank war, wurde nachgefragt ob man etwas braucht und alles gut ist, sehr fürsorglich. Wir waren rundherum zufrieden.
Allein wenn man das Hotel betritt, es war Weihnachtszeit überkommt einen ein so heimeliges Gefühl, als wenn man zu Hause wäre.
Die Lage war perfekt einfach für alles, zu Fuß oder per Uber App, man konnte alles bestens erreichen.
negatives: es gab nichts
author: Werner

title: Au Lac HCMC
text: We stayed here as a couple on the return home, to break the trip.  The location was difficult for a taxi to park, skinny street with a bit of traffic, it wasn't far to walk to the main strip of HCMC, about 2-3 minutes.  Small mart nearby, but other stuff was a bit further.
author: Tammy

title: Rundum top!
positives:
Sehr tolles vielfältiges Frühstück.
Sehr freundliches Personal.
Swimmingpool ganz oben, und die nachmittägliche Teestunde ‚roof top‘
Sehr zentral zum frz. Viertel.
Sauber, sichere Umgebung auch für Frauen.
author: Verena

title: 4 nights in Saigon
text: Stayed at the hotel for four nights in February. The staff were absolutely brilliant. The breakfast was ample and varied. Our room on the sixth floor was quiet, spacious, clean and had excellent air con which was fantastic. Loved the location being so close to all the main attractions and a great bolt hole to escape the heat and chaos of the city. We didn't have chance to use the rooftop pool but it looked great and the free afternoon tea was a nice gesture if your in the hotel at the time. We were very impressed and would certainly recommend this hotel
author: MICHAEL

title: Gemischte Eindrücke: Tolle Lage, renovierungsbedürftige Zimmer und verbesserungswürdiger Barservice
positives: Beginnen wir mit den positiven Aspekten: Die Lage des Hotels ist wirklich erstklassig. Zentral gelegen, bietet es einen bequemen Zugang zu vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten und Annehmlichkeiten der Stadt. Das Personal an der Rezeption war äußerst freundlich und hilfsbereit. Die persönliche Betreuung und Aufmerksamkeit haben meinen Aufenthalt angenehm gestaltet. Auch das Housekeeping-Team verdient Lob, da die Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Zimmer stets auf einem hohen Niveau waren.
negatives:
Leider gibt es jedoch einige Aspekte, die das positive Bild trüben. Die Zimmer wirken bereits abgewohnt und könnten eine dringende Renovierung vertragen. Abgenutzte Möbel und Spuren von Verschleiß mindern den Gesamteindruck erheblich. Es wäre wünschenswert, wenn das Hotel in die Modernisierung seiner Zimmer investieren würde.

Ein weiterer Punkt, der verbessert werden könnte, betrifft die Mitarbeiter in der Bar. Leider erlebte ich hier eine gewisse Unfreundlichkeit, möglicherweise aufgrund von Unsicherheiten in der englischen Sprache. Eine freundliche und serviceorientierte Atmosphäre ist jedoch entscheidend für das Gesamterlebnis der Gäste, und es wäre ratsam, das Barpersonal in dieser Hinsicht zu schulen.
author: Stefan

title: Location, location, location
text: Perfect location, excellent staff and an alright breakfast. The room was spacious with a very comfy bed. WiFi was a bit slow… but everything else was good.

title: Sehr zu empfehlen!
positives: Super Lage, tolles Frühstück, wunderbar auch für den Aufenthalt mit Kind
author: Marie-Anne

title: Good choice
text:
I almost cancelled our booking upon reading some negative reviews.  But our experience was exceptional.   We stayed for 3 night and arrived early, was allowed to check-in for an additional minimal fee.  Room was good for 3 adults, though 2 will share a big bed.  Afternoon tea was served from 2pm to 4.30pm, though only tried once since we are out most of the time.  Breakfast has a great selection of Vietnamese dishes and a few internal cuisine.  The location is ideal for walking to various tourist spots, the bars at night are ok even if you have children and you can go to another street if you don't want to passby their area.  Going back to the hotel, one downside I see is the water pressure, it's ok but can improve including the drain for the water spilling out the bath area, flooring tends to get too wet if you don't put towels on the floor

Overall, I made the right decision booking here,  since it's almost Chinese New Year there is a street a block from the hotel that is closed during our stay which made walking easier.

title: Es hakt an allen Ecken und Enden, daher sollte man sich lieber ein anderes Hotel suchen.

Jessica, who manages the massage center, and Robert, one of the doorman or concierge, are two of the nicest people I’ve met in my hundreds of hotel visits over the years.

I will not hesitate to go back to this splendid hotel the next time I return to Ho Chi Minh.  

I typically stay at five-star hotels, but this splendid four-star hotel lived up to its reviews, and then some.

title: super Personal und Lage, abgewohnte kleine Zimmer.
positives: die Lage ist gut. Das Personal wirklich nett.
negatives:
Wir hatten eine Suite mit 41qm gebucht. Bei der Ankunft wurden wir informiert, wir bekommen eine der drei Suiten mit einer großen Terrasse. Leider war dieses Schein Upgrade wirklich schlecht. Das Zimmer hatte durch die größere Terrasse nicht mal 20qm. Somit konnte man beim Bett nicht mehr vorbeigehen ohne über die Koffer zu fallen. Die Terrasse war wirklich etwas größer, aber nicht besser als der gebuchte Balkon. Die Aussicht ist auf umliegende alte Dächer und bei einem Stadttrip verbringt man keine Zeit auf einer Terrasse. Wir waren echt verärgert. Dazu kommt, die Fotos im Internet sind schon viele Jahre alt. Die Zimmer sind richtig abgewohnt. Badezimmertür lässt sich nicht schließen usw.
Das Hotel ist liebevoll eingerichtet, das Personal super nett. Aber man bekommt nicht das was man erwartet und das gibt Unmut. Nicht nur bei uns. Es waren auch andere Gäste beim Empfang und wollten wissen warum sie nicht ihr gebuchtes Zimmer bekommen. Antwort: Das ist das gebuchte Zimmer, die Fotos sind nur schon älter.
Auch das Frühstück war nicht okay. Cappuccino ist zu zahlen (wird bei der Bestellung aber nicht dazugesagt) wobei 3€ ich als okay empfinde. Die heisse Schokolade wurde nie serviert. Es gibt Platzmangel weil der Raum so klein ist. Nach einem gegangenen Gast wird das Tischtuch mit der Hand ein wenig abgewischt und die nächsten Gäste kommen zu diesem Tisch.

title: Muffiger Zimmergeruch, Schimmel in Whirlpool-Düsen
positives: Die Lage ist zentral
negatives:
Wir hatten eine Junior Suite gebucht,  die auf den Bildern recht schön dargestellt war mit einer Badewanne auf elnem netten Balkon. Bekommen haben wir ein muffig/schimmlig riechendes Zimmer, das die Whirlpool Badewanne mitten im Zimmer hatte, nur eine winzige Außenflache mit Dusche und Ausblick auf ein Blechdach, 2. Stock. Wir hatten die Wanne benutzt, aus den Düsen kam Schimmel!!! Das sah man allerdings erst dann als das Wasser mit dem Schaum abgelassen war, lauter grau/braune Flusen blieben zurück. Eine eklige Vorstellung, dass man in den Schimmel Flusen gebadet hat. Wir haben es dann nochmal kurz ausprobiert und ja, die Düsen waren total verdreckt, was man von außen nicht sieht.
Zu allem Überfluss hat uns das Hotel dann noch beim Check out bzw als wir schon im Taxi saßen, ein Handtuch vorgehalten, das kleine Blutflecken hatte aufgrund von natürlichen weiblichen Gegebenheiten. Man hat uns rüde darauf hingewiwsen, dass das Hamdtuch nun kaputt sei ("towel is broken") und wir das zu zahlen haben. Ein Handtuch mit Blutflecken ist nicht kaputt, so etwas wasche ich daheim bei 60 Grad, bleiche es ggfalls, und das Ding ist wieder wie neu. Wir haben das dann aber bezahlt, um nur schhnell weg zu kommen. In Europa hätten wir uns das nicht bieten lassen.
Nie wieder, das Hotel ist absolut nicht empfehlenswert. Auch der Poolbereich ist vernachlässigt ind lange nicht so schön wie auf den Bildern dargestellt. Man hat hier auch keinerlei Selbstteflexion oder Kritikfähigkeit.
Alles nur Schein und nicht mehr, dss Personal ist nur pseudofreundlich und das auf eine sehr unangenehme aufdringliche Art.

title: Purtroppo non ci tornerei.
positives: La posizione molto centrale, nel distretto 1. Le vie subito vicine non sono le migliori a dire il vero, con locali notturni di dubbia legalità, ma non si sente nessun rumore particolare da fuori e rimane comunque una posizione strategica.
negatives:
In assoluto la cosa peggiore era la insonorizzazione della stanza. La porta di ingresso rimaneva infatti mezza aperta, lasciando passare anche un po' di luce, quindi ogni singolo rumore sul corridoio era come se fosse dentro la stanza. Per nostra sfortuna, abbiamo anche avuto dei vicini rumorosi e che avevano prenotato due stanze, per cui spesso sostavano nel corridoio a parlare ad alta voce fino a tardi. 
Un'altra nota negativa è la colazione, una delle peggiori fatte in Vietnam. Di dolce non c'era praticamente nulla, e quel poco che c'era era di bassa qualità. Inoltre nella hall (dove si fa anche colazione) c'era un freddo assurdo. Considerate che il secondo e il terzo giorno abbiamo fatto colazione fuori.
La piscina è molto piccola: forse me ne dovevo rendere conto dalle foto, ma ci sono letteralmente 4 sdraio, per cui è molto probabile che non possiate rilassarvi a prendere il sole (e comunque vista la posizione dell'albergo, quella piscina non è il massimo del relax in ogni caso).
La doccia è aperta sulla camera, con una tendina che non riesce a trattenere bene l'acqua. Per cui ad ogni doccia il bagno diventava un lago.
Infine, essendo un hotel 4 stelle e avendo pagato una bella cifra per gli standard del Vietnam, mi aspettavo un servizio migliore da parte dello staff: ci siamo dovuti caricare noi i bagagli dal taxi fino alla camera, lo staff alla reception non salutava quasi mai e spesso lo staff addetto alla porta (gli stessi che non ci hanno portato le valigie) rimangono seduti e non aprono la porta. Queste sono piccolezze, sia chiaro, ma rendono un po' meglio l'idea del fatto che questo hotel non rispecchia il costo delle camere e le stelle che porta secondo me.

title: It was a very good hotel.
text: I really liked how the staff were very hospitable and kind. The location is excellent, and it's easy to walk to places listed in the guidebook for District 1. Grab and other rideshare options can pick up and drop off right in front of the hotel. I participated in a Mekong River tour, and the bus came right in front of the hotel. The room felt very clean, and the toilet had a washlet. Breakfast and afternoon tea were held in a stylish venue, and I was satisfied with both the variety and taste of the food. The pool was also nice. Most of the guests were couples from Europe and America, and I didn't see many Asian guests, including Japanese people. The main street was lively, but you could catch glimpses of everyday life in the back alleys with markets overflowing with life. My room was on the second floor, so I imagine the view would have been better if I had been on a higher floor. This was my first time in Ho Chi Minh City, and if I have the opportunity, I would like to stay again next time.

スタッフのみなさんがとてもホスピタリーに溢れ、親切なところが大変気に入りました。

Whether it was exploring the bustling markets, visiting historical sites, or indulging in shopping sprees, everything seemed within arm's reach. This made my stay incredibly convenient and time-efficient.

Dining:
One of the highlights of this hotel's location was the abundance of exceptional restaurants in the vicinity. Within a five-minute walk, I discovered a plethora of dining options, ranging from traditional Vietnamese cuisine to international delicacies. The staff's recommendations were spot-on, and I had the opportunity to savor some of the most delicious meals during my stay. The gastronomic adventure was truly unforgettable.

Hotel Staff:
The hotel staff was undoubtedly one of the standout features of my stay. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warm smiles and a genuine willingness to assist with any request. The level of professionalism and attentiveness displayed by the staff was remarkable. Facilities and Comfort:

text:
9박10일간 머무르면서 아주 즐겁고 행복한 휴가를 보낼 수 있었습니다.  우리 부부는 쇼핑 및 여가 생활을 하기 위해 한곳에 오래 머무르는 편입니다.
첫째 위치가 너무 좋습니다. 호치민에 처음 오는 사람들은 1군에서 거주하는 분들이 대부분일겁니다. 그이유는 깨끗한 환경과 관광명소 쇼핑센터 등등 한국식당뿐만 아니라 일본인거리의 식당 그리고 베트남 맛집들 마사지샵들.... 여행의 모든것들이 최적화 되어 있기 때문일겁니다. 호치민 시청을 기준으로 명품샵(에루샤뿐만아니라 다 있어요)이 있고 휴식할 수 있는 넓은 광장... 밤이 되면 정말 많은 사람들이 모여들고 거기서 좋은 소소하게 장기자랑하듯 노래와 춤등등 많은 볼거리가 있습니다. 그리고 벤탄시장을 가서 보면 다낭이나 하노이에 여러 시장들과 비교할때 깨끗하고 짝퉁들을 구경하면서 재밌는 시간을 보낼 수 있습니다. 첫날에 벤탄시장을 꼭 가서 구경하고 그옆에 HA TAM에서 환전을 하세요. 환전소에 줄 서 있는 모습을 보고 전 놀랐습니다. 처음 보는 광경이라서요^^ 벤탄시장을 경험해보셨다면 타카시마야백화점과 사이공센터가 연결되어 있는데 지하2층과 지상 4층에 있는 음식점에가서 맛난것도 사드세요. 그리고 백화점 맞은편에 사이공스퀘어에 가시면 벤탄시장보다 더 고급스러운 짝퉁들을 보게 되실거고 여기는 정찰가라고 말하지만 1/3가격으로도 많은 물건들을 살 수 있습니다. 질은 훨씬 더 좋고 중급정도의 짝퉁이라고 보시면 될 듯합니다.  그리고 호텔 바로 옆에 비텍스코전망대가 24만동에 볼 수 있어요. 랜드마크가 바로 옆에 있으며,이런 좋은곳들이 호텔을 기점으로 10분내외에 있기 때문에 최고의 위치라고 할 수 있습니다.
둘째 1층에 조식 너무 맛있습니다. 종류는 많다고 할 수 없지만 정말 맛있는 음식들로만 구성이 되어 있어서 10일동안 먹으면서 살만 찐거 같습니다^^
셋째 10층에서 애프터눈티를 PM 2:30~4:30까지 먹을 수 있는데 다양한 빵종류와 커피 음료 과일등을 맛있게 먹을 수 있습니다.
넷째 10층 수영장입니다. 누구는 작다고 하는데 수영선수 아닌이상 놀기 너무 좋습니다. 아내와 많은 날을 수영하면서 놀았습니다. 물깊이가 1.5M라고 되어 있는데 1.6M정도로 깊으며 10M이상 거리가 되기 때문에 놀기에 아주 좋습니다.
다섯번째로 오래된 건물이지만 4성급으로 객실이 깨끗하게 잘 관리 되고 있습니다. 바로 2달전에 하노이 4성급호텔과 많이 비교가 되더라고요. 하노이는 청소도 대충 그리고 바퀴벌레도 나오고...
하지만 AU LAC HOTEL은 하우스키핑후 편하고 깨끗하게 보낼 수 있었으며 벌레또한 보질 못했습니다.
여섯번째로 직원들이 너무나 친절하고 항상 웃으며 반갑게 맞이해 주었습니다. 일정중에 와이프가 너무 아퍼서 약국을 구글지도로 찾아가려고 했는데 가깝고 금방 찾을 수 있는 약국을 쉽게 알려주어서 너무나 감동을 받았습니다.
한가지 아쉬운점은 오래 호텔에 머무를 경우에는 맛난 음식을 먹고 그러기 때문에 몸 관리를 해야 되는데 사진상에는 휘트니스에 런닝머신이 2개 있는데 실제로 가보면 1개뿐이 없었고 매일 운동을 1시간씩 했는데... 런닝머신이 오래 되어서 뛰기시작하면 몇분후 바로 전원이 나갑니다. 처음에 아무 생각없이 뛰다가 전원이 꺼지는 바람에 다칠뻔했습니다. 4번이나 전원나가서 그 이후에 7.5이하로만 1시간씩 매일 걷기만 했습니다. 참고로 휘트니스는 11층(계단이용)에 있습니다. 새거로 교체되었으면 하는 바람입니다.^^
다음에 호치민에 간다면 또 방문하고 싶은 호텔입니다.

title: Great old colonial style hotel at a central location
text:
We had an amazing experience staying at the Au Lac Charner hotel in Ho Chi Minh City. 
The hotel's French colonial style adds a touch of elegance to the overall ambiance. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with exceptional service. The staff promptly took care of our luggage and ensured a smooth check-in process. We were pleasantly surprised by the little extras provided by the hotel, such as a comprehensive breakfast buffet and a complimentary afternoon tea with a delightful selection of cakes, fruits, and beverages. The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable, offering a relaxing retreat after a day of exploring the city. The cherry on top was the rooftop pool, although small, provided a refreshing escape with stunning views. The hotel's location, close to the Bitexco Tower and Nguyen Hue Boulevard, offered a convenient base for exploring the city's vibrant street food scene and lively atmosphere. We highly recommend the Au Lac Charner hotel for its excellent service, comfortable accommodations, and prime location.

title: Room 201&704
text: The hotel interior is super nice inside and outside. The staffs are ok. The problem with our stay was the hotel rooms. At 1st we stayed at Room 704 since its a family room and theres 3 of us the door of room 704 has a downtime when youll need to open it. It literally means youll need to wait for 5secs before pushing the door open or else youll need to close it again and scan your hotel key. Then when there was only 2 of us we changed room to 201 and oh my the bathtub hahahaha! So for our bathtub the water from the shower head and faucet would simultaneously come out also the water will be stuck inside the bathtub. We did request for our room to be changed, at first they tried to fix it, it was fixed but after my cousin finished  bathing the problem occured again, in the end the hotel reception changed our room. With all honesty I wouldnt recommend this hotel if you would be always up and out exploring ho chi minh city. The 1st hotel we stayed at even though its just a botique hotel we enjoyed our stay so much better.

title: Above average
text:
My husband and I stayed at this hotel as part of our Vietnam tour and our experience was somewhat mixed. 

We rate our stay between 2 and 3 stars out of 5 for the duration of our visit.
The hotel's service is very inconsistent, with some staff providing excellent service while others provided none at all. For example, the hotel's waiters and service staff, some were super attentive and professional, while others were overly inquisitive, asking inappropriate questions, or gossiping with other staff or guests, assuming that tourists wouldn't understand what they were saying.

In addition, the cleanliness of the hotel was also inconsistent, ranging from very good to subpar. We noticed mold on some of the curtains, bedding, and fabrics, as well as smudges and marks on various surfaces.

Perhaps our expectations are different as from previous trips to the US, EU, or other Asian (Japan, Singapur, Thailand) countries but overall, it's a decent hotel with potential for a short stay in Saigon.

However, we would not choose to stay here again in the future or could not recommend.

title: Average stay in a good location
text:
The first room we got had a bathtub in the middle of the room next to the tv instead of in the bathroom. Was not what I thought I booked. They showed us 2 other rooms and we ended up switching. They did explain it's a Boutique hotel so all the rooms are different but what an impractical design. The rooms also don't feel clean with limited toiletries.. Benches were sticky and I saw some bugs on the bedside table. I wiped everything down as best I could. Hallways were always hot. We were in our room at one point and the cleaner barged in. Lucky we were both decent but not something I have ever experienced before at a hotel. They did apologise, so may have been an honest mistake. 

They do have an afternoon tea each day which is a nice touch however juices and fruit weren't kept cool and was in a really small room. Breakfast buffet range is quite small. Biggest plus is hotel is in a really good location close to shoppings so we could walk a lot of places. We picked it for nothing other than the location. I found it a bit eerie and was happy to check out. Staff try to be helpful though.

title: Warning! Some rooms have no window despite being advertised as city view.
text: We booked a family room which was advertised as a city view room. We were given a room on level 1 with no window! Well technically it had a painted window that could be opened a crack for a glimpse of an alley if you craned your neck. We heard other rooms have nothing at all. Very claustrophobic. When we complained we were told sorry they were fully booked and they could move us tomorrow. I observed this exact transaction over the next few days with other groups so it must be a common issue.  I pointed out the false advertising of a city view and they said to take it up with Agoda. I was going to find another hotel but they then magicked up a room on level 2 which had a view but unfortunately smelled like a sewer. We managed to cover up the bathroom drain and the smell improved. The next day we were moved to a room on level 8 and it was much nicer. Oddly his room didn't have double glazed windows like the one on level 2. Also the walls are paper thin in this old building and you can hear everything from your neighbours and the hall. Pros are: the staff are genuinely helpful and working under tough conditions because of the terrible rooms they have to manage and dealing with disappointed travellers. Breakfast was good but the dining room too small so people have to wait for a table.

positives: המיקום מצוין.
negatives: מנהל המשמרת היה לא שירותי ולא נחמד. הזמנו שני חדרים, אחד החדרים מתברר שהיה בלי חלון. חנוק, ריח של טחב ורחוק מלהיות מקום שנעים להיות בו. המחיר היה מאוד גבוה ביחס לשאר המלונות באיזור באותה עת . הזדעזעתי מהחדר וביקשתי להחליפו. התשובה המיידית היתה שזה מה שהזמנתי. ואין מה לעשות . אמרתי שלא אכפת לי להמתין עד שחדר אחר יהיה מוכן וכך היה , כמה שעות לאחר מכן הגעתי לקבל את החדר ולהפתעתי נתנו לי את אותו החדר בלי החלון . התחננתי להחליפו קיבלתי תשובה אטומה שזה החדר שהזמנתי ואם אני רוצה בתוספת של 1.25 מליון מאתיים חמישים דונג ( כמעט כמו עלות של הזמנה חדשה ) ללילה יחליפו לי לחדר עם חלון אבל בקומה שונה מהילדים . לא הגיוני ולא הוגן , התחננתי לחדר אחר ( היה עוד חדר פנוי ליד הילדים ) בלית ברירה בעלי נכנס לידר ההוא ואני העדפתי לישון עם הילדים . ביקשתי לבטל לגמרי את ההזמנה וללכת למקום אחר ענו לי באטימות ובחוסר שרותיות שכבר שילמתי ( החיוב היה דרכם מיד כשהגעתי ) ואצטרך להתנהל מול בוקינג . בלית ברירה אמרתי שאישן עם הילדים ולא עניין אותו, לא לקחנו בכלל את המפתח כמה שעות ועדיין לא עניין אותו. בלית ברירה החלטנו להתפצל, בעלי הלל לחדר  כשנכנס להתקלח האמבטיה היתה שבורה , עדיין העדיפו שבעלי ימתין עד שיתקנו וסרבו להחליף חדר . הגענו למלון אחרי טיסה מוקדמת בבוקר בשעה 10 רק אחרי שש ניתן היה להתקלח בחדר ( התעוררנו בשעה ארבע בבוקר וכתבתי למלון מבעוד מועד שנהיה עייפים, לא רק שלא עזר אפילו את השעות הרגילות לקבלת החדר לא קיבלנו) שני לילות בעלי ישן בחדר מחניק  ולא תברואתי ואני הצטופפתי עם הילדים תמורת 490 דולר !! ביקשתי לדבר עם מנהל בכיר הוא ענה שהוא המנהל ,. אכזבה!! אמרתי לו שאחשב בהתאם זלזל בכל דבר שאמרתי . יחס נוראי מזלזל ולא נעים . מאוד מאוד מאוד לא ממליצה על המקום

text:
I highly recommend this hotel for people who’s comparing which place to stay in Ho Chi Minh. You don’t have to search anymore, this is the hot spot!

when I chose this place, what caught my eye was about the design of this place, cleanness, afternoon tea, breakfast and of course, pool was a must for me. 

And when I arrived, had everything what I was expecting, room was cute, with a window, just perfect for myself to have a little treat day.  

but the BEST PART was the hospitality of people here. Very caring, and gathered by lovely souls which made my stay in Saigon memorable. 

Duyen, she made my first Vietnam coffee experience sweet. 
And Phuc, my Vietnam senpai, he recommended me many places around Saigon, but not only that, he made a special cocktail with passion fruit. 
Mun was very charming, and so were Yen&Lam. There’s more faces that I remember in my head but don’t know their name.. sorry! But all the people here gave me a lovely smile. 

Thank you for making me feel home, I will come visit again hopefully very soon.  Next time when I come back, I’d love to have my welcome back drinks with you all!!

title: Cute little French styled hotel, good amenities, centrally located
text:
My husband and I stayed here for 2 days in December 2022 and had the most wonderful time.
1. Though rooms are not that big, but they are very thoughtfully organized and have everything you can ask for
2. The location is excellent, within walking distance to most of the attractions (although HCMC in general isn't a very walkable city we felt, other cities in Vietnam were easier to walk in)
3. The breakfast spread is good. They also have a complimentary high tea in th3 afternoon, and the quality of that spread really surprised us.
4. The rooftop pool is small but has a nice view of the city skyline so you can chill there in the evening with a beer

title: Tak sobie . Nie wrócę
positives: Lokalizacja , basen  i wystrój hotelu zwłaszcza lobby bardzo ładne i przyjemne :)

Bardzo mały , niewygodny pokój . Łóżko było gigantyczne ( ponad 2 metry szerokości ) ale za to nie było  po jednej stronie jednej szafki nocnej i nie było również gdzie rozłożyć walizek . Rozkładaliśmy na podłodze i było bardzo miejsca na przejście . 
Kolejna sprawa to śniadanie . Zawsze do tej pory podróżując i czytając różne opinie śmiałam się jak ktoś pisał, ze nie miał co jeść na śniadanie . 
Wydawało mi się to niedorzeczne . A jednak … 
Nie sądziłam , ze kiedykolwiek  i ja to napiszę 🥺 ale wybór miałam minimalny , żeby nie powiedzieć żaden 😞
Po pierwsze , jeżeli przyszedłeś w późniejszej godzinie , większość półmisków, bemarów była pusta . Jak zauważyłam przez 3 dni , nie było w zwyczaju uzupełniać braków . Jak się skończyło to się skończyło . 3 rodzaje herbaty tylko do wyboru w azjatyckim stylu ( jaśminowa , zielona , brzoskwiniowa ) . Czarnej nie było ( nic dla Europejczyków ) . To samo dotyczy dań. 95 % były to Dania azjatyckie ) czyli obiadowe . Ja jako Europejka nie potrafię zjesc zupy i makaronu z mięsem na śniadanie :(  
Kolejny temat : klapki w pokoju dla gości . Były to klapki wielokrotnego użytku 😳 Które tez kazano zostawić pod groźną kary finansowej . Klapki o wartości 5 zł . Szok!! W hotelu 4* 
Nieprawdopodobne !
I Jeszcze jedna sprawa . Poprosiłam hotel o przechowanie walizek ( 2 szt.) , ponieważ na 3 dni jechałam na Deltę Mekongu i wracałam z powrotem . Dlatego bez sensu było zabierać wszystkie walizki .
Personel się nie zgodził . Poprosiłam managera o rozmowę i dopiero po negocjacjach ustalono , ze można mi na ten czas przechować ale tylko jedną walizkę . Dobre i to . Ale zdziwienie moje było ogromne .
Na kolejnym etapie wracam do Sajgonu ale muszę poszukać innego hotelu . Ten mnie nie zachęcił

Snakkede med andre gæster der blev tilbudt 30 % i refusion og at de kunne bruge søster hotellets pool. 
Da man tømmer poolen om aftenen (vores 1. Aften) står det op med kloark vand i vores værelse og først næste dag får vi et andet værelse, og der har vi så lagt i en stank hele natten.
author: Bente

title: Very dated rooms!
text:
It’s not like the photos now sadly. The reception area is beautiful but that’s where it ends. The rooms are extremely tired.
We were pleasantly surprised to find out we had been upgraded to a suite (our check in form showed a 5th floor room replaced by a 7th floor room) only to open the door to our suite to find it was pretty much a cubby hole. Confused by the term ‘suite’ and the extreme difference to the room in the photos, we went back to reception and were moved to another room, a room like the one in the photos and on the 5th floor! We assumed from this that the apparent upgrade was in fact a down grade.
Whilst the room was much better we were surprised there was no shower (despite there clearly being one in the photos) but later discovered it on the balcony! Complete with a shower curtain to hide your modesty! Balcony was also covered in leaves.

The pool area is okay and breakfast was pretty good. Staff are pleasant although after waiting for about 20 mins for our drinks from the bar, the barman came over to give us a menu. When we said we’d ordered sometime ago, he laughed and said ‘oh yeah, I forgot’. There were only a couple of people in the bar so not busy!

Overall it’s okay but rooms are very shabby. Felt very inferior to all the other hotels in Vietnam, we have stayed in

title: Hotel is great except for possibly 1 staff trying to profit
text: We booked a family room for 3 but was given a 2-bedroom room with portable bed. We show the pictures of the room we had booked but front desk staff insisted that this was a family room, and it was one of their best. He actually encouraged to take it for our 3-night stay. Only when I threatened to report to Agoda and cancel this booking, he decided to apologize for the wrong room. Claiming that they had overbooked. I can see guests waiting downstairs. I suspect they had given our family room for profit. After many rounds from front desk to manager, they finally admitted their mistake and gave us our family from 2nd night onwards. They offered some miserable compensation, a free drink in their bar. A 2nd front desk started working with us. She was much better. They upgraded compensation to cover our delightful meal from the restaurant and our transport to the airport. Does not really make up for the poor 1st night but we felt that the 2nd front desk should be rewarded for her efforts considering the mess created by her colleague and probably her front desk manager. Just be careful with this hotel. The other staff were wonderful. The 2nd front desk staff was wonderful. She should be the manager as she is aware of the importance customer service and integrity. Hence, if the owner reads this post, please do right by promoting the right people. Your current front desk staff and management do not do justice to the service quality of the rest of the staff. If aligned, your hotel could be at least 4 1/2 star or better. Stanly Fenandez Frequent Family Vacation Traveller

title: Good for one night, I wouldn’t recommend more.
text:
Pros:
-Friendly staff (to customers)
-Pretty rooftop bar with pool
-Good location
-Grand entrance
Cons:
-Dirty Room
-Ant/bug infestation
-New management is banking on old Silverland reviews (it’s not held to the same standard anymore)
-Staff is rude to locals/tour guides


To elaborate on the cons, when we arrived we noticed ants on the floor of the room and bathroom as well as an abundance of hair and dust. We informed the front desk staff immediately and they assured us it would be corrected, it was not. We gave the cleaning service a chance the following day to fix the problem, they did not. There were dead ants all over the floor from them spraying for us, as well as live ones. It was not habitable for another night and therefor we chose to move to another hotel. When we brought this to the attention of the manager upon checkout, and included photos, the only thing we were offered was a 4minute complimentary ride to our new hotel. I would have appreciated a refund for the night we chose to leave as we ensured we checked out before their daily checkout time. I found this to be unacceptable. Additionally, they were doing renovations on our floor and the entire hall including our room smelled of chemicals from fresh paint. We paid for a junior suite and it was not as pictured and at one point our sitting area’s sofa was removed without notice and brought back much later in the evening, thank goodness with new upholstery because previously it was covered in unknown stains. 
Overall, I would definitely recommend extending your hotel search and skipping this place if you want a clean room.

title: Good hotel, great location, good value, but with a few shortcomings.
text:
Overall, this is a really nice hotel and good value given it's location. That said, it did have it's faults.

I stayed at this hotel for a combined 10-15 nights in various rooms. I will say that the rooms on the upper floors (8 & 9) that are on the same side of the elevator are the best in terms of low noise. The rooms on the opposite side of the elevator have more traffic, music, and rooster noise. Rooms 908-910 are the best. The breakfast was decent, but get there before 8:30 am.

The positives of this hotel are very good staff, comfortable beds and pillows, nice pool, and great location. Also, as I said, some of the rooms are quiet enough to get good sleep in a very noisy city.

Where the hotel came up short was a couple of areas. First, some of the electric toilet bidets in some of the rooms do not work. Second, while the breakfast in general is good, it does tend to run out of items after 8:30. There are plenty of staff in the kitchen, and they shuffle around to remove dirty plates. However, what the kitchen seems to lack is leadership. There is no one person directing staff on what to do, in particular to replenish empty items. Because of this, items tend to sit empty for over 30 minutes or more. You would think that when an item is running low, somebody would direct staff to get ready to replenish it. Not so. Several days, for example, something as basic as coffee was gone by 9 am. People had to ask for it then wait 30 minutes for new coffee. This is Vietnam. Coffee should never run out. Anyway, if you get to breakfast before 8:30, it should be OK.

Two other weak points of the hotel are that the fitness center is tiny and only has the most basic equipment. Lastly, the wifi is spotty and tends to cut out several times per day (though only for a minute or 2).

Overall, despite it's shortcomings, I do recommend this hotel and I would stay here again.

text:
Overall, this is a really nice hotel and good value given it's location. That said, it did have it's faults.

I stayed at this hotel for a combined 10-15 nights in various rooms. I will say that the rooms on the upper floors (8 & 9) that are on the same side of the elevator are the best in terms of low noise. The rooms on the opposite side of the elevator have more traffic, music, and rooster noise. Rooms 908-910 are the best. The breakfast was decent, but get there before 8:30 am.

The positives of this hotel are very good staff, comfortable beds and pillows, nice pool, and great location. Also, as I said, some of the rooms are quiet enough to get good sleep in a very noisy city.

Where the hotel came up short was a couple of areas. First, some of the electric toilet bidets in some of the rooms do not work. Second, while the breakfast in general is good, it does tend to run out of items after 8:30. There are plenty of staff in the kitchen, and they shuffle around to remove dirty plates. However, what the kitchen seems to lack is leadership. There is no one person directing staff on what to do, in particular to replenish empty items. Because of this, items tend to sit empty for over 30 minutes or more. You would think that when an item is running low, somebody would direct staff to get ready to replenish it. Not so. Several days, for example, something as basic as coffee was gone by 9 am. People had to ask for it then wait 30 minutes for new coffee. This is Vietnam. Coffee should never run out. Anyway, if you get to breakfast before 8:30, it should be OK.

Two other weak points of the hotel are that the fitness center is tiny and only has the most basic equipment. Lastly, the wifi is spotty and tends to cut out several times per day (though only for a minute or 2).

Overall, despite it's shortcomings, I do recommend this hotel and I would stay here again.

Very disappointing! No customer sense!!! 🤬

    - Given a voucher for the coffee shop next door. One cup between two people. When we queried it we were told that was correct and it was a gift to us. How to lose goodwill - the exact opposite of what they were trying to achieve!

Miraculously, the pool repairs were completed in record time, allowing us to use the pool for the second half of our stay.
The hotel rooms are large and the beds are extremely comfortable.
Breakfast was okay. Some bacon, hashbrowns/potatoes would make a great addition.

The staff here from top to bottom sets a standard in customer service. The smiles and greetings each time i entered or left the hotel. The eagerness to help with anything that i needed to help make my vacation special. Never the slightest hint of attitude from any member of the staff. That is rare. The spa was very nice and the quality of the massages was first rate. Especially helpful after a long trip. I have traveled extensively in many countries and have stayed at too many hotels to even remember. This one, however i will remember and will make this my base each time i visit HCMC in the future.

title: Value for money
text:
Located just a few minutes mins walk from  the Cafe Apartment, Silverland Hotel has a nice lobby.  I stayed in the Premier Vannier Room. Price is very reasonable. You get free breakfast and high tea daily. 

The room is spacious and clean. Toilet is rather spacious. A few issues were observed though. Firstly it is hard to get the toilet paper as it is located in an awkward position.  The water at the bathtub took ages to flow. Hence, you will be standing in a pool of water at the end of your shower. Definitely an area for improvement. 

Breakfast gets boring for me on the second day. I usually just eat some eggs and fried rice. The variety of breakfast remains the same for a few days. Not all Service staff at breakfast are attentive. Hightea is slightly better. I see effort in the items offered at the cooking station. There’s really no reason to complain since it’s included in the room.  

The hotel isn’t the most accessible from Ben Thành but you can easily get to the market with a Grab. Nice neighborhood. A leisurely walk will take about 10 mins or so. You will surrounded by tons of bubble tea shops and the cafe apartment.

title: Stay here, it’s amazing, located next to everything and it’s walkable area
positives: Staff were so lovely and kind! Esp Daisy, she was so welcoming and accommodating. My favourite thing would have to be the free Breakfast buffet ! It was sooooo good!! Little bit of variety for everyone to choose from such as pho, mini banh mi, rice dishes, fresh fruit and yogurts. The pool is amazing esp at night and looks out to a nice view of “cafe hotel” , Saigon sky deck is next to this place. The room was nice and fit 3 plus size people comfortably. They had a little Halloween “party” where they invited us to an afternoon tea for free. There is a small gym but it does the job aswell as sauna. Located next to so many nice food places and places tourists would want to go with a quick walk to tpbank atm. Everywhere here was walkable and had lots of convenience shops around, can control the aircon from the room which was a major plus, nice big windows. This hotel is also really pretty and nicely decorated
negatives: Nothing major but when you walk outside it kinda smells abit but it is what it is and doesn’t affect anything to do with your stay at the  hotel. Also room towels could be abit bigger (but we’re plus sized so it’s expected lol ) but the pool towels were nice and big
author: Erica

title: Exceptional

Rooms can be a bit small if you have loads of luggage but really beautifully done.  Wish the bathroom blind was a bit thicker though as the lack of privacy wasn’t too good. The foyer is very classy and makes you feel special.

Enjoyed my stay. I would happily return to the hotel for my next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.
author: Matthew

title: One of my best experience in travelling
text:
Pros: Good customer service everytime you walk into the lobby, smiles from every staff there, they have this tasty lemongrass lime juice as welcome drink, would love to get the recipe for this drink, decent facilities in the hotel, free Hi-tea everyday, superb view from the facility deck on roof, hotel room is comfy.

Cons: hotel room is expected to be bigger like typical hotel room layout but still within my acceptance.
author: Kah

title: Comfortable and good value
positives: Location was ideal for all sights, shops and restaurants. You could walk everywhere. You might want to take a taxi however if you have to cross a wide road like the one along the river of if it’s too humid to walk!
negatives:
The breakfast was suited more towards Asian tastes than European so there were very few options if you didn’t want Asian food for breakfast ( I love Asian food but just not for breakfast!) the coffee was horrendous! I’m sorry but it was undrinkable and the orange juice was very poor. We went to the running bean coffee shop for breakfast. The room was very small, the shower on the balcony was not a great idea- we thought it would be fun but it’s not! 
Not the hotels fault but please be aware the pavement along the road that the hotel is situated on is very dangerous, huge holes and extremely uneven. If you are less confident about walking do not choose this hotel unless you are taking a cab outside for every journey.
author: Stephen

title: Should be 5 star
text: Great location, amazing staff, excellent facilities. Next time in Saigon we come back for sure! Best value for money

title: Wonderful location, staff were fabulous, breakfast was great and the afternoon tea was great as wel.
positives: It's a beautiful French inspired hotel. The staff were amazing and any little issue their straight on to fixing it. We all really enjoyed our stay. Some of our group had balcony showers which they loved. Fantastic location for walking around it's quite compared to most locations.
negatives: The pool was great but could do without some upgrades.
author: Suzanne

title: Splendid!
text: Above all great roof top pool, great location, great afternoon tea and breakfast etc, the genuine attentiveness and hospitality of staff made my stay in Ho-Chi-Minh very special. I will stay with them next time as well. This hotel gives Hochiminh a good name☆

title: Fantastic from the time your step in
text:
Silverland Charner was perfect in almost every way.  We were invited for the afternoon tea while waiting to be checked in, something you rarely experience in other hotels.   Staff were fantastic and the hotel centrally located amidst plenty of shops and cafes.  The best part of it all was the pool which I was lucky to have all to myself.  The landscape,  greenery against the backdrop of skyscrapers made my swim memorable. 
I wish that the standard rooms were bigger though,  but not something which still prevent me from returning.

Breakfast were good, the complementary afternoon tea with live music is a gem, it really made my stay much more enjoyable. Very good location in the heart of District 1 while being a quiet night to relax. There is an abundant restaurant, tea/coffee house and Circle K nearby. Very near to Takashimaya too.

There was a complimentary afternoon tea offered every day which we thoroughly enjoyed.
negatives: Our room had a bath, so we had to climb in to have a shower.  There was no shower curtain so water tended to spray even though we tried to contain it.  However, I don't know if this is the norm for all the rooms.

negatives: Noisy guests returning late at night

The hotel provided wheelchair for my mum during our stay and was definitely helpful to us. Staff are helpful and friendly as usual . Only con was the twin sharing room (without window) I booked for my parents, the ventilation was not good and smell a bit. The family room for 3 pax was okay. I will still stay with Silverland again.

title: Very good
