Sauna, steam room
Afternoon tea
Buffet breakfast was really good 
Close walking distance to Saigon plaza for shopping. 
Our room cleaner was very helpful when I couldn't get the bath water to run hot, he came and fixed straight away.
The staff overall where friendly
negatives:
There was no milk in our bar fridge for us to use in our tea when we got in at night time.The coffee satchet was a 3 in 1 variety which my partner doesn't have sugar in his coffee. If the kitchen has closed for the night then you can't get any milk or further tea etc until they reopen in the morning. Was only given 2 coffee satchet per day. Stock up at breakfast!!
Afternoon tea could do with the small Bahn mi that they have at breakfast but was still lovely.

Great location as it’s only a few steps away from Bitexco tower!

It was a great experience in Ho Chi Minh City.

title: Excellent
text: The hotel is beautifully furnished and ideally located. We also enjoyed the afternoon tea and breakfasts. Our room however was very small and the AC wasn't working properly which really affected our sleep each night. The blinds also let in a lot of light and the walls are rather thin.  The gym is negligible and the pool area very small, albeit stunning. We made use of it after checking out and found it to be uncomfortably cramped. The shower facility at the gym was also poorly designed. We would likely not return at that price but enjoyed the stay nonetheless.

negatives: The pictures are not how the property is especially around the pool area and I wouldn’t recommend the spa!

negatives: The first room that I was offered had no window and smelt terribly of damp, really musty and unpleasant. I was moved to a room which was much better although this was plagued by a colony of ants. The staff were great and promptly provided insecticide.
author: Nicholas

title: Great small hotel

Felt a little spoilt and interested to explore the surrounding bars and restraunts but we didn’t have the time. Will stay here next time
author: Lee
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Awesome location!!! Walking distance to everything you need in HCMC!
positives: Amazing location in District 1, walking distance to River, Markets, Nightlife and Restaurants! Great staff and very accommodating. Nice pool and the complimentary afternoon tea each day was a lovely touch!! Kent, who was Operations Manager was very kind and organised a lovely Birthday Cake and candles for my Partner's Birthday during the afternoon tea upstairs, which was lovely touch, thank you! We also got upgraded to a higher room category with a balcony, which looked out right onto the street on the second floor! Great shower and big bathroom.
negatives: Pillows! They were too soft and flat, but the bed was comfortable. The bathtub took up a lot of room, so the wardrobe storage doors could not open properly, to access easily.
author: Justin

title: Exceptional

title: Superb
text: Wonderful hotel with wonderful staff in a fantastic location just minutes' walk from Takashimaya and Nguyen Hue Walking Street. For Muslims, there are several halal restaurants within a 5 minute walk. Turn right from the hotel and walk to Nguyen Hue Walking Street and cross over to the Sheraton Saigon - the Indian Muslim Jamia mosque is next to it (green building) and there are three halal restaurants there - Halal Saigon for Vietnamese food (good pho), Pasha for Turkish (good kebabs) and D'Nyonya for Malaysian. Shout-out also to Dosh at the Nguyen Hue Cafe apartments for fabulous doughnuts and cheesecake. And of course the scintillating Maison Marou (just a Grab ride away) for single origin chocolate and chocolat chaud - the best I've had outside Paris. The historic sights are also just a Grab away - War Remnants, Reunification Palace, the post office, cathedral and book street. Architecture is lovely but you can skip going inside the PO (typical tourist tat) and the Palace (dull).

title: Awesome Hotel!
text:

Staff there were very friendly and attentive. Special thanks to Ms. Trang for welcoming us and even got us upgraded to executive room. Quite a spread for the breakfast and awesome for the free afternoon tea daily. Yummy food! As for the hotel location - for bubble tea lovers, Gong Cha is just next to the hotel! Some other brands like Kol, ShareTea are nearby too. The local attractions such as Opera house, Saigon Square, Notre Dame Cathedral (currently under renovation) are about 5 to 15mins walk. War museum is a bit further, about 30mins walk. 
Overall, a good stay at this hotel and would definitely recommend to all!

title: Enjoyable stay at this hotel
positives:
Like many other reviews noted, the location is a real advantage. 
The staff was very helpful and friendly and yet not too over-friendly as we have sometimes encountered in Vietnam. We appreciated this professional attitude. 
We were given a choice of rooms when we checked in. The initial suite with a shower on the balcony wouldn't have been nice due to the damp smell, so we were very happy to have taken the other suite on the 8th floor without a balcony, but with a shower inside the room. Much better. Thank you! 
We liked the refillable water bottles, however, it would be better if we could refill them ourselves and not having to ask each time.
Nice choice of teas at breakfast. We were given a voucher for the coffee shop belonging to the hotel and had great coffees there (egg coffee and salt coffee). 
The cocktails we had at the rooftop bar were very good.
negatives:
Expensive laundry. We had to use an external company which charged per kilo.
The breakfast could have more choice of sweet pastries (like croissants, pain au chocolat, ...). The little cakes were not really tasty. Also, some extra nuts (cashews, almonds,...) would have been great. 
Room cleaning service: some items were not refilled automatically (soap, tea, toilet paper). We had to ask.
The nail polishing done at the hotel spa was just okay. I had much better ones done in other cities in Vietnam with more attentive service and better equipment.

It soon got very humid, to an extent that all my clothes and things as well as the bed felt and smelled damp... They tried to fix it with a new air dryer after me complaining, but not until they tried explaining it with the humid weather. This was my last hotel after 3 weeks of travelling Vietnam from and HCMC was not the most humid place I visited, even so all other accommodations (even pretty basic homestays) I stayed at had crisp, dry air inside. 

I got a free taxi to the airport as compensation which was nice.

title: Excellent location with great rooftop pool and drinks area for reasonable a price
positives:
Au Lac Charner Hotel is in a prime location right in the heart of District 1 — perfect for exploring all that Ho Chi Minh City has to offer. The position couldn’t be better, and the staff were overall fantastic. A special shoutout to Tommy, whose helpfulness and friendly attitude really stood out.

The rooftop pool offers great city views and is a brilliant spot to cool off or enjoy a sunset drink. The rooftop bar is also a lovely space to unwind after a busy day in the city.

Although we didn’t make use of the spa services during our stay, the woman managing the massage area was warm and welcoming, and the prices were very reasonable — a great option for those looking to relax without leaving the hotel.

The breakfast buffet was excellent, with a wide variety of options to suit all tastes. A particular highlight was the cheerful pho chef — his smile and energy were the perfect way to start the morning.

Overall, a charming and well-run hotel with great amenities, top service, and unbeatable location. Highly recommended.
negatives: One small observation — on a couple of occasions, a few of the younger female staff appeared to be giggling in a way that some guests seemed to notice. While it may have been completely harmless, it did come across as a little unprofessional and made some guests appear self-conscious. Additionally, the morning manager walked around with a noticeably authoritative presence that bordered on overbearing. It gave off a slightly uncomfortable “boss ego” vibe that felt out of step with the otherwise warm and welcoming atmosphere created by the rest of the team. Minor details, but worth noting as part of the overall guest experience.
author: Shaun

title: Fabuleux
text: Bien situe, proche de tout, personnel accueillant, chambre et lits confortables. Petit dejeuner tres bon. Belle piscine.
author: Vu

title: Excellent place to stay
positives: The location was superb. The rooftop pool was perfect for cooling off. The rooms were great.
author: Alison

title: Excellent séjour
text: Ayant séjourné 12j dans cet établissement, le personnel a toujours été aux petits soins. Un petit bémol pour le foot massage en duo pour ma fille et moi, séance douloureuse et les masseuses ont sollicité plus de bourboires car ont estimé que ce que j avais donné, était insuffisant.
author: Sikhiu

title: Like the hotel will stay here again when I revisit Ho Chi Minh
positives: Location , beautifully decorated, clean, service, bathroom, towels , bed , just about everything there ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
negatives: Swimming pool not enough rooms to relax , unwind, etc
author: Yosi

title: Excellent !
text: Très bien situé.  Personnel très serviable. Service du thé  dans l'après midi très agréable pour faire une pause dans la journée !
author: GUILLET

title: Fantastic location and fabulous, attentive staff
positives: The location of this hotel is fantastic, walking distance to many attractions and great restaurants.  And even though we were right in the heart of the city, our room was quiet.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  The afternoon tea was delightful.
negatives: I'm personally not a fan of a shower over bath combo and the room needed darker curtains and felt a little dated.
author: Natasha

title: Super hôtel
text: Tout est parfait à un prix hyper raisonnable compte tenu de la qualité et du service absolument parfait
author: CLAUDE

title: Staff were very friendly and helpful.Hotel is in a great location. The pool and high tea are wonderful additions
positives: Location
author: melinda

title: Suite senior
text:
Jolie chambre 
Douche sur le balcon : étonnant mais rigolo 
Staff aux petits soins
author: Michel
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Lovely, great location
positives: Great location, could walk to the Remnants museum, and lots of nice cafes, shops etc. Staff very helpful and friendly. Breakfast was good, loved the mango sticky rice and peanuts ! Had a nice massage. Pool very nice too
author: Frances

title: Bel hôtel en centre ville
text: Hôtel de belle facture, très bien placé et où tout le personnel est à l’écoute
author: Michel

title: Terrific place in a good location with a great pool.
positives: Very nice hotel in a terrific location.
negatives: We were on level 3 but could still hear a rooster crowing in the early hours of the morning. We think the rooster lived at the motor bike parking shed next door.
author: Timothy

title: Accueil et services parfaits
text: Très grande gentillesse de tout le personnel, très disponible. Upgradés à notre arrivée avec facilité d'early check in. Tout était très confortable. La piscine est grande et extraordinaire avec ses vraies plantes tout autour et une grande amplitude horaire (6:00-22:00). Très bon petit déjeuner en buffet très copieux (6:00-10:00). Nous reviendrons forcément dans cet hôtel si nous revenons à Ho Chi Minh Ville
author: Patrice

title: Great location in the city centre, modern clean facilities & lovely roof top pool
positives: Great location in the city centre, modern clean facilities & lovely roof top pool
negatives: Our only comment is that we booked for 4 people (2 adults & 2 children aged 9&12), but were booked into a room for 3 people. The staff arranged an extra bed for us (at extra cost) so the problem was solved. But Im not sure why you’d expect a 9 year old to sleep in a normal double bed with the parents…?!
author: Chris

title: Trés chouette
text: Trés bel hôtel au centre ville. Confortable, calme, trés propre. La piscine au rooftop est un vrai bonheur aprés la visite de la ville. Le petit déj est copieux et bon. Excellent accueil de l'équipe.
author: Val

title: Exceptional
positives: Location, facilities, pool, staff.
author: Meaghan

title: Excellent séjour à l'hôtel Au lac Charner
text: L'emplacement est idéal, le personnel charmant, la décoration très réussie, ke buffet du pdj super mais surtout on a adoré le truc en plus : le service du thé l'après midi...très gourmand ! Merci pour avoir fait de notre séjour a Saigon un excellent moment !
author: GUILLET

title: Amazing
positives: Beautiful decorated and super clean hotel located centrally to everything. Staff are super friendly. Great breakfast and complimentary afternoon tea. Pool excellent after a hot day out and about. We highly recommend.
author: Renee

title: Excellent séjour
text: Un emplacement parfait, propreté irréprochable, personnel acceuillant.
author: Ann
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Great location.very helpful staff
positives: Location
author: lewis

title: Excellentes prestations
text:
Personnel très acceuillant et serviable.
Très bien situé, en plein hyper centre
Superbe piscine et piscine en rooftop ouvert 6h-22h.
14h30-16h30 thé/café et pâtisseries offerts au bar de la piscine.
author: Stéphane

title: A great base for exploring Saigon
positives: The hotel was well located within walking distance of the major sights of Saigon. It is attractively decorated and a welcome retreat from the bustling heat of the city. The roof top pool was also very much appreciated at the end of the day.
author: Gordon

title: Very good
text: Je suis contente de choisir cet hôtel . Tout est parfait , la propreté, les lits , le petit déjeuner , le personnel mais je trouve seulement dommage que vous mettez des chaussons à usage multiples, je préfère des chaussons qu’on utilise seulement pour le séjour, c’est plus hygiéniques. Voilà si non j’ai passé un agréable séjour dans votre établissement , j’y reviendrai….
author: MI-

title: Excellent, would highly recommend.
positives: Location of the hotel was ideal, walking distance to Ben Thanh Markets, Saigon Centre, Cafe Apartments.
negatives: The buffet breakfast was okay. There was variety but they would be better have less items and doing them better. The hot food looked like it had sat there a while. We ended up eating out most days.
author: Georgina

title: 2ème visite
text: Maison très agréable „with friendly staff“. La piscine sur le toit et le High Tea lui donnent un certain charme. J‘y retournerai sans lors de mon prochain séjour à Saigon.
author: Andreas

title: An oasis within a very busy city
positives: The location is great. This is an attractive hotel and the rooms are both spacious and comfortable. The rooftop pool is very welcome after a day walking around the city.
negatives: Afternoon tea could have more savoury snacks
author: Gordon

title: Top emplacement et top personnel
text: Emplacement au top et le personnel est vraiment au petit soin
author: Mohamed
reply:

title: A great hotel to start our Vietnam holiday
positives: Quiet, clean and very comfortable. Good location in district 1. Staff so friendly and helpful. Pool was fantastic. Afternoon tea a bonus enjoyed by us all.
author: Fiona

title: Trop cher
text:
Hôtel bien place et personnel aimable. 
Nous avons payé 350€ pour 2 nuits dans 2 chambres sans fenêtre. 
Hôtel bien entretenu mais 
Piscine très petite et photos qui induisent en erreur. Pas de place pour s’installer sur un transat (il y en a 6 au total). 
Décevant
author: CELINE
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Good value for money, would recommend!
positives: Great location, staff super friendly, big room with 3 comfy beds, spa inside the hotel, lovely pool, nice afternoon tea included.
negatives: Needed more shaded areas at pool as very hot in the sun! Breakfast was average.
author: Sally

title: Séjour très agréable
text:
Rien à redire durant notre séjour de 5 jours. Chambre calme, service impeccable, personnel aux petits soins. 
Nous avons pu profiter de la piscine, des goûters et testé un massage, et tout s’est très bien passé.
Nous avons apprécié également les petits déjeuners avec un choix varié.
author: David

title: Exceptional
positives: They staff were soo great and the facilities were excellent and well maintained
author: Kelly

title: Tout est parfait
text: Tout est parfait, l'hôtel et sa localisation, le personnel très professionnel et sympathique ! Le meilleur rapport qualité prix de Saïgon ! Nous reviendrons !
author: Maxime

title: Lovely little rooftop pool
positives: Lovely decore. Pleasant staff. Homely feel. Central.  Nice all round
negatives: Small decent gym ...but Aircon not working
author: Thomas

title: Exceptional
text: c'est un hôtel à  dimension humaine, bien placé et le personnel est au top
author: RABIA

title: Lovely last minute saviour
positives: Very nice hotel with very attentive staff.  They were able to accommodate a last minute booking after a disaster at a different hotel.  Very friendly and helpful stuff.  Lovely room and all facilities to a high standard.  Breakfast and Afternoon tea very nice and easy to access
negatives: Nothing
author: Benjamin

title: Parfait
text: Nous avons passé un très beau séjour. Nous conseillons vraiment cet hôtel rien à redire.
author: Laetitia

title: Overall was good stay
positives: Location was good service was great
negatives: Not enough vegetarian options for buffet breakfast, was limited spread
author: Mehek

title: Magnifique hôtel
text: Magnifique hôtel, très bien situé, avec beaucoup de charme. Personnel très accueillant et attentionné. Petit déjeuner
author: Christian
reply:
Au Lac Charner Hotel, Xin chào!

Dear Mr/Ms. Christian ,

We highly appreciated your feedback regarding your stay at Au Lac Charner Hotel. It is always a pleasure to receive feedback from our beloved customer
We are delighted to learn that we had provided an excellent stay and particularly value of our hotel. Your feedback regarding your recent stay with us is greatly appreciated and will help ensure the services provided at Au Lac Charner Hotel are of the highest quality. We are so pleased that you're enjoying your holiday!
We are happy to have hosted you and hope you will stay with us again on your next visit to Ho Chi Minh city.

With warm regards,
Hotel Management.

title: Wonderful place
positives: Great vibe, awesome location in the center of HCMC. Pool on the roof was very relaxing (you can see the Cafe Apartments in the corner). We could stay all day (evening flight) and have a shower before going to the airport. Staff was very kind.
author: Frits_86

title: Un hôtel très agréable avec un personnel adorable
text:
L'hôtel est beau, propice au repos.
Service impeccable.
author: Michel

title: Ample accomodation for a short 2 night stay ,room used sparingly as we where sight seeing both days
positives: Good location
negatives: No window in room
author: Helen

title: Excellent hôtel au centre de Ho Chi Minh Ville
text: Excellent rapport qualité-prix! Un personnel très professionnel et sympathique, toujours prêt à aider. Des chambres très confortables, tranquilles, spacieuses et très bien équipées. Un petit-déjeuner agréable. La décoration est recherchée et élégante. La piscine est bien, mais il n'y a pas assez de places pour s'installer au bord d'elle.
author: Dominique
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Exceptional
positives: Room 902 nice spacious street facing room.
author: PHILIP

title: Propreté et personnels excellents
text:
Au cœur d'honneur Chi Minh, à proximité des sites touristiques et de toutes les commodités. Personnel très serviable. Bon petit déjeuner. Chambres propres et bien tenues.
Décoration agréable.
author: Evelyne
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Definitely would Return here
positives: Fantastic location & Staff very Professional & Friendly
negatives:
We had the afternoon Tea included in our rate as well.
Very limited choice & Coffee always warm.
Same type of food every day never changed 
 But in saying that super friendly Staff.
author: Paul

title: Charmant hôtel plein centre
text: Idéal pour se promener ..centres commerciaux à proximité.  Bonne literie et personnel très à l écoute et professionnel. Mériterait cependant quelques travaux de rénovation.  Petit déjeuner correct mais café moyen.  Je recommande
author: JACQUES
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Very good
positives: Food, tea time
negatives: Toilet withou washlet
author: Trung

title: Excellent
text: Tout est parfait mais j'y vais quand les prix sont attracifs
author: Brazy

title: Very god staff, great and helpful staff
positives: We like that it was very central to everything
negatives: That the shower was outside in the balcony, and did not realise that it was until we arrived
author: Jocelyn

title: Super hôtel!!!
text:
Tout à été parfait!!! L’accueil, le personnel, la chambre très grande et les 4 plus:
- la douche sur le balcon en plus de la belle salle de bain!
- la piscine sur le toit!
- le Tea-time
- le super buffet du petit dej!
Nous recommandons vivement cet hôtel!
author: Sophie
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Excellent location Hotel
positives:
Shower on balcony, comfortable beds,  rose and good night leaf delivered with turn down service .
location perfect,  attentive professional staff
author: Linda

title: Hôtel agréable, bien situé , propre et à la nourriture bonne .
text:
Seul bémols , location de chambre , jamais vu dans l histoire de l Hotelerie .
Il faut lire la réservation avant d accepter ! Car nous regardant le prix bas sans lire la suite alors qu il est precis plus bas  et en petit, que la chambre est sans fenêtre , chose sue l on ne pense que ça existe ????
author: Saad
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Exceptional
positives: Best hotel i have stayed in within reasonable price, great service, great staff. Exceptional rooms.
negatives: Everything is good.
author: Joel

title: Superbe hôtel bien situé
text: Nous sommes restés Au Lac Charner hotel pour 3 jours. Le personnel est hors pair toujours disponible pour répondre à nos demandes. La chambre était spacieuse. Les déjeuners sont superbes et le bar sur le toit vaut le déplacement. Le seul bémol est la piscine qui manque de chaises cil faudrait limiter l’accès au chaises à 2 heures. Nous reviendrons
author: Daniel

title: Amazing staff, lovely hotel & great location
positives: Lovely hotel with character and great facilities
author: Jarrod

title: Très bon emplacement
text: L'hôtel se situe en plein centre ville de Saigon, tout près de "phố đi bộ Nguyễn Huệ", quartier très animé le soir. L'équipe est jeune, dynamique et très serviable.
author: Tay

title: This hotel made a great end of our holiday and really made us enjoy Vietnam even more!!
positives:
The location, being close walking distance to a lot of great places including the markets!
The staff here are outstanding! It was my husband’s birthday and I messaged them last minute to make his birthday special with a surprise cake for breakfast. They came through with an amazing cake and made my husband’s day! The cake was delicious and such a great French tasting cake. Which he loves! 
This hotel will def be our go to when we go Saigon again. Loved their afternoon tea which they put on upstairs. Real old French vibes and the tea cakes and sandwiches are amazing! I can not fault this hotel at all from the staff or the hotel. Only bad thing we had guests next door who had friends from other rooms come and drink and be loud on the balcony from 12am till 5am. Which is when I think they passed out from too much drinking. I even turned our balcony light on and off to tell them I’m awake. But no care! Happened 2 nights in a row and last night/morning we had to be up at 5am to fly home.
negatives: Nothing
author: nazaria

title: Excellent hitel
text: Nous sommes ravis de notre séjour au  lac Charner, personnel, très compétent, tres bien placé, très bons  massages, nous reviendrons. Seul petit bémol, la clim est orienté sur le lit.
author: Dov
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Fabulous
positives:
The people 
The food
The facilities !
Everything
author: Vilma

title: Parfait
text: Superbe petit hôtel dans district1 proche de tout les centres d intérêts 800m environ.piscine superbe .petit bémol les jus de fruits du pdj.je recommande fortement cet établissement
author: FABIEN

title: A great stay in HCMC
positives: The hotel and rooms are so so stunning. The staff are so friendly and helpful and it’s in a great area for exploring main sights!! The breakfast was also lovely. Thanks
negatives: It wouldn’t put me off staying again but behind the hotel are some clubs (can’t hear them).
author: Ellen

title: Très bon hôtel
text:
Hôtel très bien situé. La chambre est bien équipée et propre. La piscine en haut de l'immeuble est un plus pour la vue et pour se rafraîchir. Le personnel est super agréable. Un merci particulier à Robert😉.
Notre vol étant tard le soir, nous avons pu rester dans l'hôtel et profiter de la piscine et de la douche avant notre départ le soir. 
Je recommande aussi les massages, très pro et très relaxant. 
Merci à toute l'équipe.
author: Olivier

title: The place was amazing the staff were amazing as was the breakfast and high tea in the afternoon.
positives: The staff were very friendly the pool was nice the little gym the room was a good size the shower pressure was great. Also the breakfast and the afternoon high  tea they provided everyday for free
negatives: I can’t say there was anything I did not like about the property.
author: Jason

title: irrégulier
text: J'avais fait un premier séjour au terme duquel j'avais rédigé un avis élogieux pour Au Lac Charner. Mais en période plus chargée, ça a été différent. J'avais réservé une suite Hamelin et, arrivant à 22 h, l'hôtel était plein et le réceptionniste nous a annoncé un "upgrade" avec une chambre plus grande... Mais pas plus grand que la suite réservée, et surtout une configuration absurde : une baignoire en face du lit, et la douche sur le balcon  Pour couronner le tout, on a depuis le lit une vue sur les WC, à travers la vitre mal occultée qui sépare la chambre de la salle d'eau. Donc toutes les chambres ne se valent pas dans cet hôtel et il faut faire attention aux "upgrades" (et éviter d'arriver tard le soir). Pour le reste, c'est calme et propre, le petit déjeuner très correct et varié (cependant pris d'assaut par les groupes), le personnel dans l'ensemble aidant et sympa.
author: dominique

title: Acceptable
positives:
The room was nice. 
Breakfast was exceptional.
negatives:
On my last day they tried to con me into paying to have my sheets washed and made an embarrassing scene at reception. This was caused by a tiny drop of blood from a big bite or something. They had hurried up to the room and tried to find fault so they could fine me. 

I refused to pay and left as the manager tried to apologise for his rude and incompetent staff. It would have been a much higher rating if not for this. 

The pool is barely bigger than a bathtub - misleading photos.
author: MarkBisto

title: Excellent hotel
text: Vraiment il faut chercher longtemps pour trouver des défauts à cet hôtel: il est bien situé, les chambres sont Propres et calmes, agréablement meublées, le personnel charmant et aidant et le petit déjeuner très bon. Il faut aussi essayer le spa qui est très bien. Bref, sans faute. Pas si fréquent dans la ville…
author: dominique

title: Acceptable
negatives: Great location but rooms were run down and walls were paper thin. Our shower was also outside on the balcony which was very unexpected.
author: Elena

title: Très bon établissement
text: C'est la troisième fois que je réserve une chambre dans cet établissement. Je suis toujours autant satisfait. J'apprécie particulièrement la suite Bonard Junior qui propose un balcon. Le petit déjeuner est bon, dommage qu'il ne propose pas une soupe pho tous les matins.
author: James
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Above average
positives: Location
negatives: Showers on verandah; pool area far to small
author: Karen

title: On s attendait à mieux
text:
Très bien situé l hôtel est joli et propre.les chambres sont de bonne taille et décoration stylée.
Le personnel est un peu pédant.le portier ne vous dit spontanément bonjour bonne journée bonsoir.Si vous rentrez dans la nuit ,on vous contrôle malgré que vous ayez la carte de la chambre dans les mains. Le terminal de paiement ne fonctionnait pas. Hazard....
author: alberic
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Outstanding service by all staff.
positives: This is a lovely property in a great location for walking around the city. The hotel has a lot of plants everywhere which made it very beautiful. The room was comfortable with a really nice terrace. We enjoyed the pool, the breakfast and the afternoon tea. The service by all staff was outstanding. The attached coffee shop makes a great iced egg coffee. We would certainly stay here again if we came back to HCMC.
author: Janet

title: 2 nuit à ho chi minh
text:
Un hôtel magnifique, piscine sur le toit avec la vue sur la ville. 
Petit déjeuner avec beaucoup de choix et très bon. 
Personnel très serviable 
Je recommande vivement
author: Eddy
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Enjoyed my holiday. Hotel was clean, nice n very central. Staff helpfil
positives: Breakfast was good. Free afternoonbtea was a bonus. Staff knowledgeable n speaks english n friendly.
negatives: Noise fr tv next room was disturbing
author: Seng

title: Excellent rapport qualité prix.
text: Une entrée discrète bien que très jolie et très soignée, dans une rue paisible qui contraste avec le tumulte qu’il peut y avoir quelques dizaines de mètres plus loin au cœur du district 1. Des chambres à la décoration soignés, très calmes, un petit déjeuner de très bonne qualité et surtout un personnel aux petits soins,  adorable à tous égards.
author: Boris

title: Excellent
positives: Location and staff ere awesome
negatives: The lady serving eggs is very deppressing. Breakfast while it looks great it doesn’t have flavoror good flavor. Bit disappointed that the doorman waited to help treat seat😀
author: Tim

title: Séjour à ho chi minh
text:
Hôtel très bien situé , proche de nombreuses animations et de petite taille 
Chambres propres bien insonorisées climatisation efficace 
Piscine propre avec une vue incroyable 
Petit déjeuner exceptionnel avec une grande variété de produits 
Accueil agréable et efficace 
Cependant attention au nombre de clés données à l’arrivée : si vous êtes seul , il vous donne une clé puis au départ vous réclame 2 clés : risque de facturation de la clé manquante . 
On vous recommande cet hôtel pour un séjour à ho chi minh
author: Cecile
reply:
Dear Valued Guest,
Warmest greetings from Au Lac Charner hotel.
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.
We are glad to know that you got satisfied with our services and enjoyed a very relaxing time at Au Lac Charner. We hope to serve you again if you come back to Vietnam one day.
We wish you happiness and health in life!
Thank you & Best regards,
Au Lac Charner Management team

title: Very good
positives: Great location near Cafe Apartments which we could see from our room.  Very easy to walk to most of main locations. Lovely rooftop pool right next to Sky Tower but unfortunately randomly closed at times which was annoying.  Rooms were nice and staff helpful.
negatives: They decided to relay carpets in our corridor which was noisy and smelly.  They offered for us to change rooms but only that morning and we did not have time.
author: Caroline

title: Toujours un plaisir
text: Bien qu'un peu cher pour sa catégorie,  cet hôtel, de part la qualité de son personnel, l'emplacement, et les petits plus tels que la piscine superbe et la collation offerte l'après midi, est un must que j'apprécie lors de mes séjours à HCMC
author: Daniel

title: We are very satisfied with our stay overall since we get a good deal from booking.com .
positives: It’s located near most of the attractions. The breakfast and afternoon tea at the hotel is superb. Lots of nice cafe and restaurants are around . The pool view is very pleasant both day and night . Hotel staffs are very friendly and helpful especially Ah Phuong : who always give full attention to the guests .
negatives: The smell from the toilet and bathtub after shower is awful . Can be better by putting air fresheners or good ventilation system.
author: Kyaw

title: Bel hotel
text: Bel hotel bien situé, très proche de toutes commodités. Les chambres sont bien décorées dans un style colonial. Le personnel de réception est sympathique. En revanche, le petit déjeuner pourrait être plus complet. il y a un tea time tous les jours au 10e etage qui est très sympathique. En revanche, les prix sont beaucoup trop élevés pour la qualité réelle de l'hotel ; et la connexion wifi est très très mauvaise.
author: Tran

title: Wonderful place to stay in HCM, great base to explore from
positives:
Rooms were spacious, solely clean, comfy beds, good bathroom facilities.
Breakfast unbelievably good, such choice, lovely afternoon tea. 
Pool is great, the lobby area very welcoming.
The location was great for restaurants and bars in our area, there’s a great coffee/cocktail place along the street. 
The staff are second to none so charming and helpful. We had returned after two weeks travelling around Vietnam and were greeted like old friends.
negatives: Nothing, it was perfect for us.
author: Deborah

title: Excellent choix d hôtel
text: Excellent choix d hôtel.  Super rapport qualite prix. L hotel est tres bien placé au centre du district 1 où l on peut visiter à pied la cathédrale,  la poste,  le musée de la guerre.......il est juste en face de la tour bitexco. Le personnel est parfait surtout Mr Hoang qui a été plus que parfait !! Nous le remercions vivement ! Il nous a ete bcp aidé pour nos réservations d'avion et sans lui nous aurions été ennuyes. La piscine sur le toit offre une pause rafraîchissante et la vue y est superbe ! Les massages sont divins à des prix corrects 1h massage dds pieds 17 euros. Bref nous y reviendront sans aucune hésitation et nous vous le recommandons !
author: Agnes

title: Exceptional
positives:
Everything was amazing!! Really nice and kind staff. Delicious breakfast and very comfy rooms.
Thanks so much.
author: Laura

title: Excellent
text: Hotel super personnel très aimable rapport qualité prix super
author: Franziska

title: Very good
positives: Great property in the heart of HCMC. Access to all key sights. Lovely rooms and rooftop swimming pool. Staff were simply amazing.
negatives: Extra bed not very comfy for the children despite the additional price.
author: James

title: Good
text:
Hôtel très correct avec des chambres spacieuses, très propres et bien équipées. 
Le petit déjeuner aussi est très bien avec beaucoup de choix. 
Nous avons été déçu par la taille de la piscine et le manque de place sur la terrasse autour de la piscine (4 transats seulement disponibles). 
Le personnel était accueillant et disponible mais nous n’avons pas apprécié l’attitude lors du check out car nous souhaitions commander un taxi par nous même avec une application. Le réceptionniste nous a proposé un taxi spécifique de l’hôtel. Il s’agissait finalement d’un taxi de l’application que nous avons payé 50% plus cher (certainement la commission de l’hôtel). Pas très sympa…
author: Pauline

title: Great spot for exploring the city
positives: Great location in HCM. Rooftop pool was fantastic for chilling in the hot afternoons, underneath the Bitexco Tower & cool lights of nearby buildings all around after dark.
negatives: There is a noisy late night bar nearby that you can hear at night so ear plugs come in handy
author: Kerry

title: Exceptional
text: parfaite situation et à un prix tres acceptable
author: Brazy

title: Lovely, French-feel hotel.
positives: The friendly staff made everything very pleasant, especially Andy at reception. The complimentary afternoon tea was a nice touch
negatives: Nothing, it was perfect.
author: Bennet

title: Belle adresse au centre de Saigon
text: J'ai eu la chance de bénéficier d'un surclassement de chambre suite à la non disponibilité de la catégorie de chambre que j'avais réservée. Je remercie le personnel de réception pour sa réactivité à gérer la situation (j'ai même pu choisir entre différentes chambres) - alors que j'arrivais assez tard, et donc fatiguée. Pour autant, je n'ai pas été émerveillée par la chambre, et me demande quelle aurait été ma réaction si j'avais obtenu la chambre initialement réservée.  Les photos vues sur le site m'avait laissée à penser que les chambres seraient plus spacieuses. Néanmoins, après qu
author: Anne-Marie

title: Lovely hotel just miscommunication language barrier
negatives: We were told by the hotel that because we had an early flight on the 20th May before breakfast and the day we arrived we were promised a packed breakfast and when we told them they were unsure.
author: Lauren

title: Magnifique
text: Une nuit au 7ème étage dans une suite avec jacuzzi sur belle terrasse privative arborée, sans vis à vis ni bruit alors que Saïgon est une ville très animée - Et belle terrasse avec piscine au 10ème étage avec quelques transats pour s’y reposer, face à la Financial Tower… surtout qu’un goûter (Tea Time) y est proposé dans une salle attenante de 14h30 à 16h30. Personnel attentionné qui a même proposé de réserver taxi pour aéroport à un prix raisonnable (250 000 dôngs) - Vraiment top.
author: Jerome
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Perfect
positives: The breakfast was amazing, the staff were extremely helpful.  I would highly recommend Au Lac Charner
negatives: Everything was perfect
author: Annette

title: Good
text:
Assez grande chambre . 
Faite attention , car plusieurs chambres sont équipées d'une douche sur le balcon.
author: Roxane
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Ho Chin Tin
positives: Location is Great
negatives:
We were chased away from d resto one morning due to long wait and plenty people waiting. We could have been aske if we are done eating yet at least

Shower design is not that good. Water getting out of the tub and spilling on the toilet floors due to improper sealing on glass panel/divider
author: Ronaldo

title: Hôtel extraordinaire super bien situé
text:
2 nuits dans ce magnifique hôtel trèsbien situé près de tout en plein centre ville
Personnel gentil et affable
Piscine sur le toit
Petit dej copieux
Probablement le meilleur choix à Saigon et meilleur rapport qualité/ prix
author: Marc
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: A wonderful stay in this lovely hotel, the staff are wonderful, rooms very clean, beds really comfortable.  The pool is
positives: Everything
negatives: It was all great
author: Deborah

title: Toutes les commodités à un prix raisonnable
text: Nous avons choisi une chambre sans fenêtre: nous restons 2 nuits et pour  dormir et se laver. literie confortable. chambre propre avec bouilloire et mini bar.  joliment décoré dans un style colonial avec des photos souvenir d'indochine. Tea time (dont viennoiseries et fruits) offerts au restaurant du 10ème étage, agréable après une journée à déambuler dans la ville agitée d'Ho chi minh. Petit Hamman, Sauna et douche. Petit déjeuner buffet varié et de qualité. Personnel très agréable. Pour 80 euros/nuit c'est un excellent rapport qualité prix avec une localisation en plein centre quartier 1. La nuit à proximité quelques bars à filles. Mais l'hôtel veille strictement à votre tranquilité
author: Noria
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Stylish and centrally located
positives:
Location is very central.  Staff are excellent 
Rooms are interesting and different in a French colonial style 
Afternoon tea (included) is a wonderful institution
negatives: Nothing we didn’t like but you need to dodge the girls in neighbouring streets if walking home late
author: Duncan

title: hotel a eviter
text:
petit déjeuner uniquement pour les clients vietnamiens, aucune demande n'est satisfaite 
l'avis des clients compte peu
author: JACQUES

title: Not the best
positives: Clean room and swimming pool
negatives:
Breakfast was not great, and every day was the same.
Lots of rubbish in front of the hotel
author: Mehrdad

title: Pas bon rapport qualité prix
text: On paie l'emplacement. A ce prix +100€ par nuit, nous avons eu largement mieux au vietnam.
author: mustapha
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Would return
positives: Great location. Great staff
author: adam

title: Excellent
text:
Cet hôtel serait parfait si les rideaux des chambres étaient bien plus opaques car sinon réveil dès le lever du soleil avant 6 am : pas très reposant
Mention spéciale à tout le personnel : accueil, petit déjeuner , salon de thé et bar ( miss My, miss Ngan, MrVu )
author: Ghislaine

title: A charming hotel with excellent staff breakfast was very good
positives: Staff where excellent,location was great
negatives: You have to specify if you want a shower inside the room, the internet was terrible and bed very hard room 312
author: Phillip

title: Très bon hôtel
text:
Service charmant et impeccable, chambre parfaite ( juste la décoration qui peut en effrayé certains ( cadre photo de personne ), petit dejeuner magnifique ( première fois que je me regale autant ), piscine magnifique, lounge très sympa. Petit hic, l'insonorisation mais on s'y fait vite.

Je recommande.
author: jérôme
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed
reply:
Warmest greeting from Au Lac Charner Hotel to Mr./Ms. Jerome,

Thank you so much for choosing our Hotel to stay during your planned trip and your wonderful feedback on Agoda. We are delighted to read your wonderful feedback about our Hotel. It encourage us a lot to improve the quality for serving our customers better.

Hope that we will have a chance to welcoming you to stay again in the near future.

Best regards.

title: Perfect location for us and really great hotel for the price
positives: Really central location, comfortable room and decent breakfast
author: Jack

title: jean louis
text: Excellent hôtel tres bien situé avec des prix très abordables pendant cette période difficile
author: Jean-Louis

title: Short but enjoyable stay.
positives: Beautiful decor , very clean , staff helpful and friendly.
negatives: Was all good.
author: Neil

title: Splendide havre de paix dans HCMC
text:
Magnifique hôtel, avec un accueil plus que chaleureux vous vous sentez bien à peine le pied posé à l’intérieur, c’est un havre de paix dans Ho Chi Min city. Une superbe piscine en terrasse sur le toit, un tea Time l’après midi est compris dans le prix. 
Le personnel est d’une attention et gentillesse exceptionnelles. 
Sans hésitation une qualité supérieure pour le prix.
author: Lucie

title: Wonderful holiday
positives: Amazing staff , great location, lovely room
author: Kulvinder

title: Very good
text: Manque de variétés au pdj sur la semaine
author: BERNARD
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Excellent stay with good services
positives: The check in and out was fuss free, allow guest to drop off luggage first and collect room key card once ready after 2pm. The facilities was as per listed, with steam room, sauna room, rooftop swimming pool. The Afternoon tea was pretty good and breakfast was also included daily, and has a decent spread. The room was spacious and clean. The location was superb and walking distance to major tourist sites. The service by the staff members were superb and they offered help to bring luggages to our rooms, and help with our heavy bags when we came back from shopping.
negatives: Excellent, keep up the good work.
author: Lee

title: Excellent
text:
Alles super außer das Frühstück 
Das war nicht gut !!
author: Thomas

title: Stunning pool
positives: Rooftop pool was perfect.
negatives: Breakfast was a little underwhelming.
author: Robert

title: Aircondition hat nicht funktioniert
text:
Das Hotel und das Zimmer waren sehr schön, allerdings hat während unseres  gesamten Aufenthalt die Aircondition nicht funktioniert. Nach mindesten 4 Beschwerden und Versuchen die zum laufen zu bringen wurde uns einfach ein Ventilator hingestellt. Der war sehr laut und natürlich nicht kühl genug. Die Art und Weise wie mit dieser Beschwerde umgegangen wurde war äußerst unprofessionell und das Ganze sehr ärgerlich bei sehr heißer und schwüler Aussenluft in Saigon. 
Haben auch versucht uns bei Agoda , über die wir gebucht hatten, zu beschweren, aber der blöde KI Assistent hat nichts verstanden und auf eine Nachricht von einem Mitarbeiter haben wir vergeblich gewartet. 
Also beides nicht zu empfehlen - Agoda und das Hotel - leider
author: Astrid

title: Good alternative to big hotels with great facilities, staff and location.
positives: Great small hotel with beautiful pool deck and breakfast room. Really good breakfast. Staff were all really friendly and helpful. Location was great - can walk to district 1 attractions and the new mrt stop at the opera house.
negatives: One point not so great - the junior suite with the bath on the balcony is very small with only one upright chair. The balcony is a good size with a couple of chairs but often too hot to be out there. The other type of junior suite has a bathtub in the room and the shower outside on the balcony. That said, even though small, the room was very nice.
author: Derek

title: District 1 mit kleinem Dachpool
text:
Französischer Stil, eleganter Eingangsbereich. Suite sehr groß mit 2 Betten. Dusche auf dem Balkon, im Bad Wannne und WC. Aufzug nur bis 10. Etage. Pool sehr schön, Liegefläche sehr klein! Poolbar nur bis 22.00 Uhr geöffnet- geht gar nicht! 
Zum Frühstück im EG kein Aussenbereich. Das mitgebrachte Abendessen war mäßig, zu wenig und der Nachtisch unserer Freude, das Eis mit flambierten Bananen schlecht. 
Gesamtfazit: pompöser Eingangsbereich, im Poolbereich sehr verwinkelt. Das Spa nimmt Zuviel Platz ein. Insgesamt bröckelt nach der Eingangshalle der Putz etwas.
Kostenloser Nachmittagstee/Kaffee  im 10.Stock
Keine Möglichkeit eines späten Getränkes auf der eigentlich sehr schönen Poolterasse. 

Insgesamt aber sehr empfehlenswert.
author: Bühner
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Great hotel , great service and good value for money
positives: Location was perfect for walking to many places of interest. Breakfast was great , something for everyone and was held in a beautiful part of the hotel.   Kent was very attentive and courteous and went above and beyond to make sure our stay was a comfortable one . Thank you Kent and staff.
negatives: Nothing at all
author: Shane

title: Gute alte Zeit vorbei
text: Vorab - eines der unglücklichsten Schlafzimmer - riesiges Bett - eher Massenlager oder Doubleking - aber dann war das Zimmer voll. Unmöglich sich zu bewegen oder gar Koffer zu öffnen. Wir machten den Fehler, das super special included dinner zu buchen - am ersten Abend Durchfall bis zum nächsten Mittag (und das nach 4 Wochen Asien) - selbst der Kellner sagte hinterher, nicht das Western Menu buchen- zudem nichts für hungrige- die Gerichte müssen immer geteilt werden… - positiv - netter 15 Uhr Tee und schöne Gemälde im Haus
author: Olav

title: Fabulous stay - will definitely book again
positives: Great location  - staff amazing
author: Louisa

title: Highly recommended for a comfortable stay
text: We got an upgrade to a family room with ample space, a rather small, quiet balcony lined with plants. Big bathroom with bathtub ans extra shower. Relatively big rooftop swimmingpool with a few deck chairs that are quickly occupied by the hotel guests. Definitely a highlight in the warm climate here! Free high noon tea between 14:30-16:30. Very friendly and helpful staff.
author: Jörg

title: Good medium priced hotel, well positioned and walking distance to most of the cultural attractions.
positives: We had a small issue with the room at the start of our stay.  They had allocated a different room than what we had booked through Booking.com but this was quickly remedied on the first day.  The correct room was lovely and spacious (we booked the Junior Suite with Balcony) and it was found to be very clean and similar to that advertised on line.   The afternoon tea area and breakfast areas were nice and very clean.  Although the breakfast was not as good as some of the other hotels we had stayed at, there was still enough choice that you could find something nice to eat.  Staff were really friendly and helpful and provided great service throughout our four night stay.
negatives: The pool was good but the relaxing area around it was very small, so often there was no availability to hang around if you wanted more than just a quick dip.
author: Kerry

title: Eher 3 sterne
text:
Das Hotel hat eine super Lage.
Zimmer alt aber ok , betten wirklich furchtbar . Wir waren mit 2 kleinen kindern dort. Die reinigung von einem Bettzeug wurde uns in Rechnung gestellt ( unsere kleine hat sich leider übergeben) , kann man machen ist aber mit 20 euro einfach übertrieben ( hier ist man uns noch nach Diskussionen noch 10 euro entgegengekommen )  Meine neue Badehose wurde durch Farbe von den poolliegen zerstört, hat das Personal herzlich wenig interessiert. Das Frühstück ist auch nach asiatischem Maßstab nicht gut ( wir sind oft in südostasien unterwegs) , die auswahl sehr reduziert , aber was wirklich schlimm ist das das wenige was es gibt auch nicht schmeckt , qualität auf hostel niveau.Das personal ist mit den wenigen gästen überfordert , wir haben abends mal 40 minuten auf pommes gewartet.Offensichtlich sind hier nicht alle bewertungen echt . Wir würden nicht mehr kommen.
author: Justin

title: Unique, happy and well maintained hotel, very clean and beautifully designed.
positives: Loved the shower on the balcony, pool on the roof, afternoon tea, and gardens and walls of gardens everywhere.
author: Karen

title: Bestes Hotel unserer Reise!
text:
Kostenloses Zimmerupgrade, Top Lage, nicht direkt in der Partymeile von HCMC, trotzdem alles fussläufig erreichbar, tolle Zimmer, tolles Frühstück, wunderschöner Pool und Wellnessbereich, und das beste: Die Mitarbeiter! Immer nett, zuvorkommend und sehr professionell! 
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen.
author: Philipp
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Great location, staff friendly and helpful
positives: Breakfast was good but thought there could be a little more choice
author: Wendy

title: Great location
text:
A nice hotel right in the city center, easily accessible on foot. Our room on the 9th floor had a lovely view of the city. The rooftop pool was also great – very cool! 

Breakfast was okay, though the selection was a bit limited by Western tastes and not really good. Asian food though was good.

The staff was friendly and helpful. As we booked last minute not worth the price though.
author: Martina

title: Very good
positives: location is excellent but it could be disadvantage(noisiness)
negatives: need to improve bathroom/shower booths and variety of breakfast
author: DADOO

title: Schönes Hotel
text: Wir waren zufrieden mit unserem Aufenthalt. Unser Zimmer war schön, jedoch täuschen die Fotos auf Agoda. Die Zimmer sind kleiner als es wirkt und bei dem Zimmer mit Dusche auf der Terrasse gibt es keine im Zimmer. Das sieht auf den Fotos anders. Das Frühstück ist leider nicht gut. Aber alles in allem gibtan sich viel Mühe.
author: Tobias
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Excellent
positives: Location is great
negatives: Afternoon tea was not the best
author: Chris

title: Schönes Hotel im Zentrum von Ho-Chi-Minh-Stadt
text:
Das Au Lac Charner ist ein gutes und solides Hotel im Zentrum von Ho-Chi-Minh-Stadt. Die Lage ist wirklich praktisch – viele Sehenswürdigkeiten, Restaurants und Cafés sind bequem zu Fuß erreichbar. Perfekt, wenn man die Stadt unkompliziert erkunden möchte.
Die Zimmer sind sauber und ordentlich, mit allem ausgestattet, was man für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt braucht. Der Stil ist schlicht, aber ansprechend, und trotz der zentralen Lage war es erstaunlich ruhig.
Das Personal war freundlich und hilfsbereit, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Auch das Frühstück war absolut in Ordnung: eine gute Auswahl, lecker und ausreichend für einen guten Start in den Tag.
Der Rooftop-Bereich mit Pool ist ein nettes Extra – nicht luxuriös, aber ideal, um kurz zu entspannen und den Trubel der Stadt hinter sich zu lassen.
Insgesamt ein zuverlässiges, gut geführtes Hotel, das genau das bietet, was man für ein paar Nächte in Ho-Chi-Minh-Stadt braucht. Solide Wahl – wir würden wiederkommen.
author: Annekathrein

title: Excellent
positives: Very well situated to explore
author: paula

title: Wunderbar
text: Insgesamt sehr freundliches Personal. Besonders der Manager Hoang kümmert sich persönlich um die Wünsche der Gästen. Stilvolles Design der Zimmer. Location auch sehr gut. Frühstück Auswahl und  Qualität haben noch viel potenzial zu verbessern
author: van
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Great stay in Ho Chi Min City
positives: Great position, great style, great rooms, great service!
negatives: It would be helpful to have an international restaurant
author: Alessandro

title: Fein !
text:
Super Massage im 10. Stock, Pool, Gym, alles da. 

Staff sehr nett. Kent sticht da heraus und Bibi, die das Soa vertritt. Aber Alle bis zum Koch / zur Köchin sind sehr bemüht und freundlich.
author: Christian

title: Lovely stay. Wish we could come back!
positives: We had a lovely stay at the Au Lac Charner! The location was amazing right under the Bitexco Financial Tower. The hotel was beautiful and clean. The personnel were professional and friendly. The swimming pool is quite amazing, and a nice touch is the afternoon tea!! 😊 Wish we could go back!
negatives: Everything was perfect
author: Fernández-Andreu

title: Overall nice hotel in HCMC
text:
We were warmly welcomed, and the staff were very friendly throughout our stay. We would especially like to mention the manager, Le Hoang (Kent), who made sure that we felt comfortable at the hotel. My friend and I stayed for two nights while visiting Ho Chi Minh City. On the second day, it was my friend's birthday, and the staff were very kind — they even brought a small cake for breakfast, which was also delicious.

We also booked the Mekong Delta day tour through the hotel, which we can recommend.

The room was very clean and tidy. However, it would have been nice to have a convenient place to hang or store towels. The bathroom was a bit small, and the bathtub made it a little difficult to get in and out, which could be inconvenient for guests with limited mobility.

We also had a drink at the rooftop bar; while my drink was good, my girlfriend’s gin was a bit too mild in taste.

Overall, we can recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a pleasant and comfortable stay in Ho Chi Minh City, despite a few small details that could be improved.
author: Maida

title: Very good
positives: The location was amazing. It was right in the centre of town with many things within walking distance.
negatives: The pool was nice but there was very limited space to sit around the pool which detracted from the experience. The breakfast was also not great. The options were limited and felt like more lunch foods than breakfast foods.
author: Emily

title: Perfekter Aufenthalt – wir kommen wieder!
text:
Die Lage ist einfach perfekt. Viele Restaurants, Cafés und Sehenswürdigkeiten sind zu Fuß erreichbar – ideal, um die Stadt zu erkunden oder Ausflüge zu machen.
Das Hotel im Boutique-Stil hat uns sehr gefallen. Besonders der Pool im 10. Stock mit der tollen Aussicht ist ein Highlight.
Das Frühstücksbuffet und der Nachmittagstee waren liebevoll angerichtet und sehr lecker.
Ein großes Dankeschön an das gesamte Team – besonders für die Freundlichkeit, Hilfsbereitschaft und Professionalität.
Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und kommen sehr gern wieder!
author: Waldemar
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: very enjoyable -  friendly staff - great location - clean hotel
positives: Excellent location room adequate pool itself ok not much to sit around
negatives: Apart from the seating area around the pool everything else ok
author: Daniel

title: Sehr empfehlenswert!
text: Sehr schönes und gut gepflegtes Hotel in guter Lage. Besonders erwähnenswert ist der erstklassige Service des Rezeptionspersonals. Die versuchen wirklich alles, um dem Gast seine Wünsche zu erfüllen!
author: Siegfried
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Exceptional
positives: Great location with wonderful staff
author: timothy

title: Top Lage und super Service – absolut empfehlenswert
text:
Ich habe ein paar Tage in diesem Hotel verbracht und war rundum zufrieden. Die Lage ist wirklich perfekt – direkt an der Fußgängerzone und nur ein paar Minuten zu Fuß zum Saigon Center. Man ist mitten im Geschehen, hat aber trotzdem seine Ruhe.

Was mir besonders positiv aufgefallen ist: das Personal. Alle waren extrem freundlich und aufmerksam, man hat sich sofort willkommen gefühlt. Ein großes Lob geht an Ken, der wirklich herausgestochen ist – super hilfsbereit, immer gut gelaunt und hat bei jeder Frage direkt weitergeholfen. Man merkt, dass ihm der Job Spaß macht.

Insgesamt eine sehr angenehme Atmosphäre, tolles Team und ideal gelegen – ich würde jederzeit wiederkommen.
author: Quoc

title: A wonderful experience in a beautiful city rich in contrast made easier by very professional staff.
positives: Kent and his team were hospitable and went out of their way to make our experience the best possible. We had a late flight and without hesitation they supported our request to store our luggage on a later than usual check out. Kent also allowed us to use the hotels facilities to "freshen up" before catching a Grab to the airport, which we were most appreciative of. Being friendly and accomodating certainly made thing easier for us. Au Lac Charner is located in a brilliant area, beautifully positioned in a street between old and new Saigon, and within easy walking distance of every must see and do in District 1. Staff also delivered flowers to the room one evening to wish us a good night. How nice is that !!
negatives: There was nothing that I didnt really like.
author: David

title: Hotel für Preis Leistung gut
text: Das Hotel kann empfohlen werden,   wenn wir uns auch gefreut hatten dass das Personal am Empfang ab und zu mal lächelt.
author: Vera
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Great stay in Ho Chi Minh!
positives: The staff were very helpful and professional. Also they helped us find our way around. The breakfast is really a great mix between Asian and western tastes. Afternoon tea was also great.
negatives: Our room seemed appropriate for a single traveller. Would have been good to have larger
author: Lucas

title: Hotel ist gut für einen kurzen Aufenthalt
text: Hotel ist für einen kurzen Aufenthalt.
author: Dennis

title: Very good
positives: Good location
negatives: A bit dated. It appeared as some of the rooms had been refurbished and maybe they were being done on a rolling programme.
author: Sam

title: Trotz Top Lage im Zentrum eine Oase der Ruhe
text: Hotel ist sehr zu empfehlen. Wir waren 3 Nächte im Hotel. Die Lage ist top und man ist mitten im Geschehen. Sobald man wieder im Hotel ist kann man sich vom Trouble erholen. Zimmer waren sehr geräumig und sauber. Service top und die tea time auf dem Dach können wir wärmstens empfehlen. Auch der Flughafentransfer war super organisiert, wir konnten uns für wenig Geld die Grab Warteschlange am Flughafen sparen. Für unser empfinden könnte nur der Pool etwas wärmer sein.
author: Anna-Marie
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Nice, comfortable and quiet hotel
positives: Great location for District 1. Relatively quiet considering the location.
author: Imala

title: Empfehlenswert
text:
Einziger "Mangel" war das fehlende Müsli beim Frühstück. Das Obstangebot wechselte, leider gab es nur an einem von fünf Tagen Bananen.  
Die Lage des Hotels ist hervorragend.
author: Renate
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Great stay, will book with them again when we return next year,
positives: Hotel staff transferred us to and from the airport in a very clean and comfortable car for a reasonable price. All staff were very friendly and willing to help with any questions we had.
author: lyn

title: Fantastisches kleines Hotel
text:
Dieses Hotel hat eine fantastische Lage und unglaublich nette Menschen die Sichtung die Belange der Göstw kümmern. Wenn mal etwas nicht wie erwartet ist, nehmen sich die Mitarbeiter der Sache an und finden eine Lösung. Jeder in diesem Hotel ist freundlich und hat immer ein Lächeln. 
Das Frühstück ist herausragend. Gerne wieder.
author: Oliver
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Mystified with the current rating and reviews? Really in contrast with my experience.
positives: Ideal location in district 1.
negatives: I stayed at multiple hotels throughout vietnam and in particular Saigon on our family holiday and this was the most inferior and most expensive of them all. I was guided and made my choice though reviews and ratings on Bookings.com. My stay was quite disappointing as i was paying above average rates for at best, an average hotel. It holds quite a high rating online.  The hotel photographer did an amazing job, because the images really dont reflect the state or true appearance of the property. Bathroom was really small with fibreglass cracking bathtub. The rooms are run down and look average at best, upon entering the rooms i had to ask staff to change linen because they were still dirty. We paid for an upgraded family room and this was still half the size of another Saigon hotel room we stayed. Coming to a country where bottled water is needed, having filled up bottles of tap water in your room for free is a confusing. The pool was very small and will only allow a maximum 4 or 5 couples up on deck. Swimming in the afternoon meant standing room only and not being able to truly enjoy time around the pool. The images made it look so much more bigger and stylish. We had excessive noise from other rooms to all hours of the morning from multiple rooms which meant sleep was limited. Brought this to the attention to staff and they wont overly interested. I Asked front door staff for directions for some simple things (i.e attractions, nearest convenience store for water ) and they had no idea. The problem is even though the front and main staff appeared pleasant they were so young and inexperienced. Its no reflection on the personnel but more directed at the management their staffing/training.  I am not being overly picky or pedantic, i just believe if you are going to charge expensive rates (for vietnam standards) for rooms then this should be reflected in the hotels amenities, service and staff.

title: Charming Hotel with Great Service & Amenities - but Spa Could Be Better!
positives:
My daughter and I had a lovely stay at this charming hotel!
The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the area. 
The staff was incredibly sweet and welcoming, always ready to help with a smile.

The hotel itself had a nice ambiance, and the pool was a great size, complete with pool towels.
Our room was spacious and comfortable, making our stay very enjoyable. One unusual feature was the shower on the balcony—definitely a unique experience, though a bit odd.

Breakfast was fantastic, with plenty of choices, including a made-to-order omelet/egg station, which is always a plus. 

However, as is common in many hotels in Asia, the sound isolation was quite poor. When the guests in the next room were watching TV, it felt like it was in our room.

A really heartwarming moment was when the staff surprised me with a birthday cake. They weren’t able to catch me on the actual day, but two days later, while I was in the afternoon tea area, they brought out a cake. It was such a sweet and thoughtful gesture, and I truly appreciated the effort.
negatives:
Unfortunately, the biggest disappointment was the spa. I had a oil-massage. The therapist seemed completely uninterested, not delivering the high-quality care you usually find in Asia. At the end, instead of a proper hot towel wipe-down, one was just thrown on my back. To make things worse, the therapist didn’t leave the room to give me privacy but stayed behind a very see-through curtain. The moment I was dressed, she immediately pointed out how much I could tip, which felt quite pushy.

Overall, the hotel itself is charming, with great service and amenities, but I wouldn’t recommend the spa.
author: Kristina&Sophia

title: Super schönes Hotel

We reported this and it was "fixed" the next day. Although it was a bit more stable it was still somewhat of an adventure to sit on it. Au Lac Charner
Pro e contro
Posizione molto buona, vicina a tutto ciò che di interessante c’è da vedere. 
Personale molto gentile e disponibile. 
Stanza ampia e curata. 
Colazione si potrebbe fare di meglio, soprattutto per chi non mangia uova e cose salate. 
Bella piscina ma con pochissime sdraio e sedie, non bastano per più di 6/7 persone. Ottima la sala the e l’offerta a merenda! 
Purtroppo va detto che abbiamo alloggiato al piano 7, in piena fase di ristrutturazione, causando non poco rumore e disagi nel passare, soprattutto durante le ore centrali in cui sarebbe carino potersi riposare. Cosa che noi non siamo riusciti a fare ne’ dopo 20 ore di volo il primo giorno ne’ il secondo giorno di permanenza. Si sono scusati molto ma ci saremmo aspettati una diversa risoluzione della cosa o anche piccola forma di risarcimento per il disagio causato. Se pago un hotel mi aspetto di poter riposare senza il rumore dietro la porta di martelli e trapano

At breakfast time they also don’t have any labels to understand if the foods contain allergens such as dairy, eggs or gluten. So had to keep asking the waitress. In addition if you book a family room in the photos it looks like there are 2 good sized beds but actually what we got was one good sized bed and the other was a rollaway bed. The first night was fairly uncomfortable but after speaking to the hotel they were able to put a topper on so was ok. Our room had a shower on the balcony which is great but you could see the person showering from the inside which I’m not sure would be appropriate if travelling with family.

Hotel Management

title: Excellent hotel right in the centre of District 1

title: Muito bom mesmo
text:

Ótima localização, bem perto do mercado, ótimo quarto e excelente café da manhã. Ainda tem gym, saunas quente e a vapor e SPA.
Recomendo com empenho
author: JOAO

title: Welcoming and friendly staff who speak good English.
positives:
Beautiful and clean, stylish interior.
Welcoming and friendly staff who speak good English.
I would especially like to highlight the Managers who made our stay especially pleasant and were helpful at every step.
The breakfast was delicious and had a wide selection.
The rooms were spacious, with really soft beds and linens.
negatives: I would like to point out that unfortunately the pool area is very small. Only six sun loungers and six chairs with tables. Of course there are places to sit upstairs, but even our group of ten couldn't fit there at once. The pool itself is large.

title: Exceptional
positives: Friendly and helpful staff, they will try their best to meet all your requests. Spacy room and affordable rates. Good selection of food for breakfast. ps, the banh mi here is tastier than some banh mi shops on the streets. Location is superb too.

This really spoiled our stay terribly.. and for the money not great!

negatives: The breakfast was adequate but not a 'wow'.

息子が鼻血を出してしまい、枕を汚してしまいましたが、フロントに連絡したらすぐに駆けつけて対応してくださいました。ありがとうございます。

アフタヌーンティーサービスもビュッフェ形式で最高でした。

negatives: The lighting in the bedroom was horrible. Let the property down. Our window small, view was not very pleasant. It was a bit loud in our room with the traffic from the street.

Staff is amazing: welcoming, friendly and professional

negatives: Gym is a bit tiny

title: プールが混雑
text:
立地やお部屋などとても良かった。
アフタヌーンティーもフルーツやミニケーキなど色々あって楽しい。
プールは小さめだが雰囲気は良い。ただ、他のホテルに比べて常にプールが混雑していた。

title: Hotel was in walking distance to all the main attractions.
negatives: The Afternoon  tea was poor unless you arrived early, as it was not replenished very quickly.

title: 便利な立地
text:
ショッピングのアクセス良好、プールは泳げる広さ、お湯も快適でしたが、立地周辺道路環境は少し暗さを感じます。ですがホテル正面にあるレストランで食べた牛肉ホーの味は最高でした。内装デザインはシックな絵画調で、木製ドアの重厚さとマッチし、いい味を出していました。
夜9時過ぎの少し遅い時間でのチェックインだったためか、若い女性のつっけんどんな態度は残念だったが、きっと疲れていたのかもしれません。遅い時間のチェックインは避けるべきかと思いました。
author: Shuji

title: Disappointing and dishonest
negatives:
I am extremely disappointed with my stay at this hotel. I paid a premium price for a suite, expecting a peaceful and luxurious experience, but instead, I encountered constant disruption and discomfort.

There was loud construction directly outside my window from 7 AM to 5 PM every day, which made it impossible to relax or even stay in my room for half the day. To make matters worse, the shower was on the balcony, and the construction workers had a direct view, leaving me feeling completely exposed and unable to shower in peace.

The hotel was well aware of the construction, as it has been ongoing for months, yet they failed to inform me at booking or check-in. This lack of transparency felt manipulative and dishonest, especially considering the high cost of the room. When I informed them of the situation, they did not make any efforts to remedy the situation.

On top of that, the facilities were very average and did not justify the price tag. I feel like I was misled about the quality and experience I would receive.

I would not recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a relaxing experience. I expected much better, and I left feeling frustrated and disappointed.

negatives: Nothing!

あと屋上のプールは夜景が最高。

title: 動きやすい立地
text:

スパはあまり売りにしてないようですが、最上階のプライベートルームで丁寧な施術をしていただけたのでこちらも個人的にはオススメです。何と言っても施術してから部屋まですぐなのは最高です。
朝食のバリエーションも豊富で数種類は毎日メニューが変わり、作りたてのフォーもいただけます。
ホーチミンに行く機会があればまた利用したいです。

title: Luxury and comfort and class near the market.
positives: The hotel is located in trendy neighborhood, where you can see young professionals gathering and enjoying the good life. The room was huge, but it's what you pay for. The steam room was functional and the pool gives you a view of the skyline, far above the busyness below. You can find some things in walking distance of the hotel, but the larger HCMC attractions are a little far to do one foot. The feel of the linen was the best I've had anywhere. Very luxurious. The breakfast is an absolute feast.
negatives: The room was very large , which gave us lots of room. I might take issue with the outdoor shower. The room is configured such that the shower is outside (which is what we used mostly. Inside, is a full-on bath, so if having a soak is your thing, you can have in the room, jets and all. The toilet is in a separate room, but it's covered by a glass window of sorts that is covered by a blind. Even with the window and the blind, you don't have 100% privacy.

title: おすすめしない
text:
まずチェックインの際に対応してくれたレセプションの女性は早口で愛想がなく、あまり歓迎されていない気持ちになった。
アサインされた部屋はエレベーターの前で、常にスタッフがカートのような物を置いて作業していたり、隣の非常階段ではスタッフが集まって休憩しているような環境で、いつ帰ってきても誰かがいて落ち着かない部屋だった。
人を見ていい対応をしたり、冷遇したりしているのではという疑念がある。
帰る際にロビーでタクシーを待っていたら、男性スタッフに今口コミを投稿して欲しいというような事を言われ、なるほど口コミが高い評価なのはなるほどそういう事かと納得した。
ドアマンは常に顧客の役に立とうと懸命に働いていて親切だった。

We look forward to having the opportunity to serve you again and to bring you a clearer view of Au Lac Charner Hotel.

Sincerely,
The Management Team of Au Lac Charner Hotel.

room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed
reply:
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for choosing Au Lac Charner Hotel and taking the time to share your feedback.

We apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced during your stay. We ask for your understanding as sweets, cakes and soft drinks attract ants into the room. It is important to keep your room clean which is why we advise you not to leave food in the room. When you reported the problem, we offered to change the bed sheets, but you wanted to move to another room. We promptly arranged for you to change your room as requested in the middle of the night.

Regarding the hot water issue, we have worked with the maintenance team and the problem has been resolved.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced and are committed to improving our services. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a better experience in the future.

Thank you for your understanding.
Au Lac Charner management team.

title: Cute hotel in the heart of District 1
positives: Great location to see everything in Ho Chi Minh,  we loved our stay here, concierge staff were super helpful in places to go. The shower outside was a fun addition. Great way to finish our trip.
author: Stacey

title: Exceptional
text: スタッフの女性の方がすごく親切でした
author: SAYAKA

title: Exceptional
positives: Friendly and very helpful staff. We'll presented and serviced rooms.
author: Colin

title: アフタヌーンティーが嬉しい
text: チェックイン後に、アフタヌーンティーに参加できて、美味しいプリンを食べることができたので、満足です。朝食も満足できるものでした。値段を考えると、とてもお得で、オススメしたいです。
author: Yoshiko
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Very nice hotel
positives: Hotel was very nice, almost fancy
author: Adriana

title: ロケーションは最高
text:
1区の観光スポットのほとんどが徒歩10分以内で行けるのはよかった。
古い設備だが綺麗でオシャレなテイストにリノベーションされていると思う。
ただ、バスルームはいまいち。
シャワーしただけでバスルームが水浸しになる。
シャワーカーテンを使おうと、シャワーの向きを変えようとどうにもならなかった。
(お湯の温度と水圧はよかった。)

あと、アフタヌーンティーが含まれているので期待したが、置いてあるメニューが朝食と同じなのが少々残念で、滞在中1回しかいかなかった。

あとこれは絶対とは言いきれないが、エレベーターでどの客が何階で降りるか見ていたところ、欧米人は高層階、日本人を含めたアジア系は低層階だった。
低層階は外の道路を走るバイクの騒音も聞こえるし、窓から見える景色も周囲の民家のバラック屋根。友人の部屋に関しては、外が見えない曇りガラス加工してあった。
author: Noriko

title: Perfect choice
positives: Everything was perfect for us. The room was big with an outdoor shower which we enjoyed. The bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was very good. We were able to take some breakfast with us when leaving early for a trip. The staff was fantastic.  I can highly recommend this hotel.
author: Isabelle

title: 笑顔が、金メダル
text:
娘と友人で　初ベトナムでした。
DoorBoyのの　ユイさんをはじめ　スタッフの皆さんが、笑顔でフレンドリーな対応をして下さり　楽しさ倍増しました。
ベトナムは、食べ物も　全て美味しくて　最高の旅になりました。
又、行きたい国の一つです。その際は、
宜しくお願いします。
author: 眞喜惠

title: Good value in a good location
positives: The hotel is in a good location not far from the river, walking distance to major buildings like the town hall and post office and with lots of restaurants nearby. The room was a bit small but well-appointed and the wifi worked well. The complimentary afternoon tea was a nice touch. The rooftop pool was also welcome, although at times the pool deck area was a little small for the number of guests wanting to use it. The buffet breakfast was comprehensive and good quality. The efficient staff organised a tour of the Cu Chi tunnels and a transfer to the bus station for us.
negatives: No major complaints.
author: Clive

title: evrything is best in saigon
text:
I stay in the hotel for 2 nights.
Food, Service etc.everythig is awesome.
especially, Ms. Queen is very nice.
Her hospitality is fantastic!!
author: Hiroshi

title: First stay in Ho Chi Minh
positives:
Tammy at the front desk was so lovely, as was ALL the staff actually, but she stood out and had a little cheek about her and it was fabulous. 
Pool was great. The massage I had was fantastic. Our room was nice too, albeit only a queen but no fault of the hotel. Loved our stay. Brekky was nice too.
negatives: Bed too small for us, but that's my fault.
author: Tegan

title: スタッフの対応が優しく最高でした
text:
何度か起きたトラブルにも優しく対応してくださり安心して過ごせました。
また行く際には利用したいです！
author: Kammuri

title: Loved it so much and can’t wait to come back
positives: The staff were so friendly and fun, the food was incredibly good at breakfast and the pool was amazing early as the sun came up, was such a surprise. Will stay here again
negatives: Nothing at all, loved it
author: Chris

text:
立地が良く　高島屋やマッサージ店飲食店も近くにあり　便利。
日本人にとって　高島屋があるのは　心強い。
ホテル全体が　白で統一されていて　フランスのプチホテルにいる様。
屋上のプールも　サイゴンタワーを望めて　気分がよい。アフターヌーンティも　嬉しい。

title: Lovely place - will stay again
positives: Great location and friendly staff
negatives: Nothing

title: Exceeded my expectations on every level. A wonderful hotel to stay in. Big thank you to the incredible staff.
positives: The staff are so welcoming and helpful- all of them. Location of hotel is very good ; close to shopping mall, museum, etc. The roof top pool is wonderful; I swam before breakfast and in the evening everyday. They have great cocktails at happy hour- try the mojitos. Breakfast and afternoon tea are such a gracious next level touch.
negatives: Nothing. It is an exceptional hotel experience

title: Excellent

リフォームしてあり綺麗ですが、水回りは年季を感じる所もあります。

positives:

Very comfortable

title: 日本人にもオススメ
text:
1区にあり、徒歩で観光するのに立地はとてもよいと思う。
部屋はきれいで広くかった。バスタブもあり、ありがたかった。
朝食はどれも美味しく、ジュースもデザートも種類が豊富で美味しかった。
3月だったのもあるが、外気温の割に屋上のプールは水冷ためで、昼間はよいが夜は少し肌寒い。屋上からの夜景は抜群だった。

negatives: No bathroom fan

author: Melissa

title: Exceptional

At lunchtime there is a treat of coffee, tea and cookies... the receptionist (Phuc) was really, really nice.

room needs attention.accessories in bathroom hanging loose on wall.bathroom tub not draining.aircon not efficient.breakfast very boring.

title: 日本から
text: 日本からホーチミン旅行に2泊させていただきました。スタッフの方も優しく、とても綺麗で、アフタヌーンティーも最高でした。しかし日本の充電器が対応しない形だったので充電するのにとても困りました。変換プラグを持っていくことをお勧めします。また、プールの水は汚かったので入れませんでした。それ以外を除くと、とても良いホテルで、また利用したいと思います
author: masako
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Very good
positives: The hotel was pretty good. Probably one of the best thing was the breakfast! The swimming pool is very nice because you have a very nice view. The staff in general are very kind. Also the hotel is very well located
negatives: In general everything was ok. If I have to write something that could be improve is that sometimes  I felt the respond of the staff is a little bit "pilot mode", in terms of not "reading" or "understanding" the customer needs. For example, when we arrived (around 7pm) the receptionist knew that we arrived by bus after a 6 hours trip. So instead of thinking that after such a trip the person is probably tired, maybe hungry, etc. She automatically take a map and wanted to start an explanation about tours, activities and things to do around the city. I had to interrupt her and explain that we were tired. Another example: we went for the tea service. The staff person said, I am sorry it is 4.31pm and the service is now closed (the service closes at 4.30pm). I am completely agree that she wouldnt let us to enter because that is the rule ...but what about to offer a glass of water? Maybe a cookie (if you have the posibility) instead of that "closed answer". I dont think is too complicated to implement this and, on the contary, this could create a difference with your competition.
author: Adriana

title: 良いホテルでした

author: RIRIKO

title: Highly recommended
