negatives: Nothing
author: GAVIN

title: Comfortable Stay
text:
It's not a big hotel and the view from my room wasn't great, but it was a very comfortable stay. The room was clean and well maintained. Every staff member I saw was very polite, well trained and hard working. I enjoyed the buffet breakfast and free afternoon tea. Although not large, the pool on the top floor was also nice. The only problem was that there was a gap between the bathtub and the glass screen, and even when I put the shower curtain inside the bathtub, water leaked through the gap and onto the floor.
Overall in the center of Ho Chi Myn city, I believe it was very worthy and good choice.
It is not a luxury hotel but I believe it was worth more than the price.

title: disappointing but staff were lovely

room had no shower
smelt musty
wanted to walk out straight away
the staff were lovely though and have us a room with a shower 

the room was much smaller but they didn’t refund any money

text:

ticktackで紹介されていたのを友人が見つけて選びました。だいたいの観光スポットが徒歩圏内で便利な立地です。

positives: Location is close to most attractions, the room was small but adequate for our stay, room service food was absolutely delicious and the staff are friendly and accommodating. The foyer is beautiful.
negatives:

The room advertises a balcony shower (which we originally thought was a novelty) but we didn’t realise that there was no other shower in the bathroom, if we didn’t feel like showering outside.

author: Marijana

title: Recommended hotel
text: Overall it's pretty good and the waiters are very nice. We stayed for almost a week in total, but it was inconvenient that there was no washing machine in the hotel.
reply:
Dear Valued Guest,
Warmest greetings from Au Lac Charner hotel.
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.
We are glad to know that you got satisfied with our services and enjoyed a very relaxing time at Au Lac Charner. We hope to serve you again if you come back to Vietnam one day.
We wish you happiness and health in life!
Thank you & Best regards,
Au Lac Charner Management team

title: Exceptional
positives: A small charming, well located hotel. The rooftop pool was lovely with lots of shade. It is a perfect place for an evening swim and cocktail. The afternoon tea was a very welcome addition. The teens loved it. Robert at the front desk was very helpful in sorting out a transfer issue that arose. Highly recommend this boutique hotel.
negatives: We didn't stay long enough!
author: Gail

title: 初めてのベトナムでのホテル
text: プール、アフターヌーンティー、朝食を楽しみました。治安も悪くない地域で観光にも便利なのではと思います。一晩だけ、凄い人通りに驚きましたが、私には眠りの妨げにはなりませんでしたが、何だったのでしょうか。
author: Hisako

title: Very good
positives:
This property is a little run down and old. Air-con and internet didn’t work very well. 
I was put in a room just outside many air-con compressors and water was pouring like rain at night. 
Beside the above, the room is generally clean.
negatives: The location is good. All the hotel staffs are very helpful and nice!
author: Aisin

title: 綺麗で可愛いホテル
text:
1人で宿泊しました
第一区にあり、徒歩でもカフェや雑貨屋、マッサージなど色々行けて場所が便利です。
それにとても綺麗で写真通りの部屋でした。電化製品も日本製でした。
残念なのは窓のある部屋を選んだのですが、窓を開けると隣の建物の壁がすぐにあり窓無しでも変わらなかったかもと思いました。
author: MISAE
reply:
Dear Valued Guest,
Warmest greetings from Au Lac Charner hotel.
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.
We are glad to know that you got satisfied with our services and enjoyed a very relaxing time at Au Lac Charner. We hope to serve you again if you come back to Vietnam one day.
We wish you happiness and health in life!
Thank you & Best regards,
Au Lac Charner Management team

title: Exceptional
positives:
Thanks to Robert and his Concierge Team - you were amazing; Jessica was always charming and helpful!
We will be back :)
author: Prieler

title: ちょっと惜しい
text: Wi-Fiが繋がりにくい、浴槽からたまに下水の臭いがする等がなければ完璧。立地は良いし、スタッフは素晴らしく、ホテル自体に清潔感がある。オシュレットが全室完備なのがポイントが高い。次回ホーチミン滞在でも利用させて頂きます。
author: 聰

title: Great stay in a strategic location. Would recommend!
positives: Great location with excellent service from the staffs
negatives: We were unfortunate to change rooms twice due to faulty water heater and air conditioner
author: Shaun

title: Exceptional
text: ホテルは清潔で各方面に歩いていけるロケーションが良かった。
author: Yoshiki

title: Great hotel with super lovely staff
positives:
Lovely hotel. Very clean. Bed linen was super crisp. 

Afternoon tea was great value. Often didn’t need lunch after eating breakfast.
negatives: Small deck area by swimming pool.
author: wendy

title: いいね
text: とにかくスタッフがフレンドリーで親切なのが良い。ホテルは古い感じはするが、お湯もちゃんと熱いし、エアコンも寒いくらいきく。ただWifiが夜になると全然繋がらなくなる。個別にwifiルーターを部屋につけてもらったがダメだった。
author: Kaoru
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Rooms probably better suited to couples.  All in all we had a pleasant stay.
positives: Location is excellent.  The pool is gorgeous and heated, view at night stunning.  The Foyer of the Hotel is stunning. Mostly everything about the hotel is lovely.
negatives: I don't think the rooms are practical for a family of 4, especially the bathroom - it is small and the lighting is very dull.  There is also no ventilation in the bathroom.  Gets hot, steamy and unpleasant.  Nowhere to hang wet bathers.  Also the bathroom door kept sticking, difficult to get out.
author: Debbie

title: 中心地の便利なホテル
text:
チェックイン、チェックアウト時のスタッフの対応が大変良かったです。
ドアマンも素早い動きで良い仕事をしていました。
何より場所は中心地なのでとても便利です。
お食事も美味しかったです。
author: HIROKO
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: A beautiful boutique hotel set in the best location. So close to everything.
positives: The staff were fabulous!!!
negatives: All good
author: pearce

title: 大変便利な場所
text:
ホテルのチェックインとチェックアウト時のスタッフの対応が大変良かったです。
食事も品揃えは少ないですが、充分美味しく頂けました。
場所は中心地でどこへ行くにも便利です。
author: HIROKO
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Alright for a night
positives: location was good for us, 30 mins to airport. few shops/bars cafes nearby suited us for last night in Vietnam.
negatives: staff inconsistent in service and greetings.Some lovely some clearly  not interested.  Food  very average.
author: Melanie

title: Cost/ performance is good.
text: Every hotel staff members are supportive.
author: SHIGEHIRO

title: First time in Ho Chi Minh.
positives: Ideal location for walking to the river or to the main square, which comes alive at night. The staff were so helpful and answered all our questions. The temperature was extremely high while we were in Ho Chi minh, and so the roof top pool was a welcome relief.
negatives: Nothing.
author: Trevor

title: 素晴らしい！
text: アフタヌーンティーもあって、プールは朝6:00から使えるのでグット！昼間は暑いのでプールは朝と夜がオススメです
author: Ken
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Nice location, the pool was a great facility for the kids.
positives: Convenient location.
negatives: The food variety and quality was not as good as some of the other hotels we stayed at in Vietnam.
author: Nellie

title: ロケーションと雰囲気よし
text:
ビテクスコ・ファイナンシャルタワーのすぐ近く、おいしいバインミーで有名なニューランもすぐ。

間口が広い立派なホテルのため、窓が付いている部屋も多い。夜のプールの雰囲気は格別。スタッフもフレンドリーで申し分ない。

レタントン通りの日本人街からは10分ほど歩くことになるが、それで良いという人にはおすすめ。
author: Hirokazu

title: Excellent
positives: Excellent location in the middle of district one near to restaurants and walking distance to famous market. The hotel is very classy with a beautiful main entrance and reception area. Lovely pool area on rooftop with nice views to have a predinner drink. We found food to be disappointing in the restaurant but because of so many restaurants in walking distance this wasn't a problem.  Staff were friendly and attentive especially Robert who could not have done more to help with any questions we had regards places to go or good restaurants to visit. Thank you to all the staff for making our stay in Saigon so enjoyable.
negatives: Better cereal selection ie muesli could be added to breakfast choice.
author: Barbara

title: 良いホテル
text: スタッフの方も優しく多少なら日本語でも会話ができ安心してステイできました。朝食もアフタヌーンティーもとても美味しかったです。
author: KANNA

title: Very nice hotel with all the amenities at a central location with a fantastic staff. Rooms could be better to offer bett
positives:
Pros:
Location
Staff
Facilities
Breakfast buffet included 
Rooftop Afternoon high tea is a classy touch

For context, We stayed in another hotel in district one, slightly further away but still walkable which was 25% more affordable with bigger room size.
negatives:
Hotel is bit on the pricey side
Room size was slightly smaller than other comparable hotels
Due to its central location and facilities, the room charges are on the higher end which in my opinion reduce its rating on the value for money criteria.
author: Sumit

title: 総合的に素晴らしいと思います
text: 今回2泊3日で宿泊しました。2回目の宿泊です。先ずロケーションは、高島屋、ベンタイン市場、サイゴン大教会など、何処に行くにも徒歩圏内で最高です。また、AFTERNOON　TEAが付いているもの珍しいしお洒落です。また、超高級ホテルには無いサービスとしてTVでYOUTUBEが見れます。大体他の超高級ホテルは日本語番組はBSのNHKワールドしか見れないので非常に助かります。また、トイレがWASHLETです。これも、他のホテルではあり得ません。残念な点は、ジャグジー付バスタブがあるのにジャグジーがいつも使えません。また蛇口も温度調節がどっちで水量調節がどっちか分からず、いつも迷います。でもあの価格で、これだけのサービスが享受できるのでジャグジーの不具合を差っ引いても絶対にお勧めです。
author: Hitoshi

title: Excellent
positives: The staff are so friendly and welcoming
negatives: Breakfast could be a bit better
author: Rania

title: 快適なホテル
text:
スタッフは皆、親切です。ロケーションも良く、何をするにも便利でした。料理もそこそこの種類がありました。
少し残念だったのが、冷蔵庫が小さい事と部屋の匂いが気になりました。
author: NOBUO

title: Wonderful
positives: Beautiful architecture and interior design. Very clean and the staff are wonderful. Nice to come back to after a busy day in the hot packed streets. Great location.
author: Natalie

title: また利用したい
text:
スタッフの皆さんがとても親切で
子どもを連れての宿泊でしたがとても快適に過ごせました。
author: n

title: I highly recommend this hotel for families.
positives: Au Lac Charner was a perfect experience for us. The location could not have been better, with easy walking distance to all the major sights and shopping locations. The room size to fit all 4 of use was great: with enough room to move and store luggage. The facilites we amazing and everyone highly approved of the roof top pool. Breakfasts had great variety to meet adventious and not-so adventious tastes. We were arriving a very early morning arrival, so we booked a day in advance. The hotel understood and our room was waiting for us to collapse in after checkin at 6am! I highly recommend this hotel for familes. 5 Stars!
negatives: Couple of roosters around the neighbourhood to wake you up in the mornings, but nothing really bad to note from this stay.
author: Tanya

title: 良かった。
text:
立地も最高で、何よりスタッフの対応が凄く良かった。
ウォシュレットだったのも良かった。
author: Fumiko

title: Great location & wonderful staff
positives: Reception, restaurant & rooftop area.
negatives: I’ve recently stayed twice - bathrooms are ‘tired’ and need upgrading to match reception area.
author: Stephen

title: リクエストが…
text:
全く通らなかったです。
ハイフロアがまさかの一階！
シャワーの水圧はよかったが、排水が…
でも、スタッフはすごく親切で良かった！
author: HISATOSHI

title: If in the future I’m going back to Saigon I would stay here
positives: Very good location, big room, very comfy bed, outdoor shower. Lovely breakfast. The staff is amazing. We were leaving very early one morning with very little time for breakfast and they gave me boxes, bag & cutlery to take something to eat with me.
negatives: The rooftop pool is small and therefore hasn’t got much seating. Both time we tried to go we couldn’t find seating.
author: Isabelle

title: Very good
text:
観光や買物にも便利な立地、コンビニも近くに複数あり、飲食店もあり　朝食はビュッフェスタイルでベトナムグルメも豊富、美味しく充実したメニュー、朝食付きがお得、アフタヌーンティーも付いてたので利用、スイーツの種類もあり満足できる
３泊してシャワーのお湯が出ないことがあったが連絡すると直ぐに対応してくれ、翌日、部屋にフルーツに花を添えて置かれていた
おそらく、シャワー故障のお詫びのようでした
author: Yo

title: I would say the staff and location make this hotel one that I would absolutely recommend.
positives: Amazing location, beautiful staff, very attentive and friendly.
negatives: There was a little bit of noise transfer from other rooms and a few occasions but still much better than other hotels we stayed in.
author: Garrett

title: 良かったけど。。。
text: 立地も良く、値段も手ごろで良かった、、が少し施設が古いかなと思った。かび臭いというか。。。ただ、スタッフの対応も良く、まぁ値段や、今回雨季に訪れたこともあり、ある程度仕方ないのかなともも思っています、が全体的にはよい滞在でした。
author: YUZURU

title: Would defiantly recommend
positives: Pool area was amazing.  Staff were extremely helpful and friendly.  Location was perfect.  Breakfast had a good choice.  The afternoon tea was delicious.
negatives: Cannot think of anything it was spot on.
author: colin

title: Excellent
text:
立地とても良かった！！
朝ご飯も美味しかった！！
スタッフもとても良かった！！！
建物は古そうだが、リカバーされており綺麗！湯船が少し掃除されていなくて、小さいゴミが出てきて入らなかったのが、少し残念くらいです！！
author: oyakawa

title: Directly in the center and close to shopping centers
positives: Location is great. Pool is also very nice.
negatives: Family rooms on 1st floor are very dark and have no view.
author: Antje

title: Very Good
text:
Our room plan included many service like Breakfast buffet, afternoon tea buffet and swimming pool.
we were really satisfied.
author: hamamoto

title: Acceptable
positives:
Location 
Pool 
Rooms clean 
Bedding fresh
negatives:
Breakfast very average. No fresh orange juice even when asked   V little fruit on offer for breakfast.  
No decent cappuccino coffee which was a bit disappointing.  And when asked said I had to pay.  Wld not return.
author: Maria

title: 大人も子供も
text: プールとジムがあってロケーションが良いので決めたところ、新しい建物で清潔だし、アフタヌーンティーも楽しめて最高でした。欧米のお客さんが多いのも納得でした。プールは朝から夜まで楽しめて、ホーチミンの夜景も一望できます。
author: Yuko

title: Exceptional
positives: Great location, friendly staff, lovey free afternoon tea and beautiful pool.
author: Nicolette

title: 窓がない部屋は湿っぽい
text: スタッフはみんな優しくて、朝ごはんもアフターヌーンティーも最高でした！だけど窓なしの部屋を選ぶと湿気がすごくて、ベットが濡れているみたいでした。
author: Harumi
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Nice hotel with a rooftop pool
positives: Good location in district 1. Many sights are within 30 minute walking distance from the hotel. Great selection at breakfast and during the complimentary afternoon tea. Lovely staff allround.
author: A.J.

title: ちょっと期待はずれ
text: 予約サイトの写真は綺麗に撮ってあり、期待してしまうが、おそらく古い建物をリノベーションしたのだろう。プールや客室もそこまで良くない。アフタヌーンティーも種類こそ豊富だがどれもあまりおいしくない。朝食も同様。私はリピートはないな。
author: TSUKASA

title: Excellent
positives: We lost a mobile phone in HCM and the motel staff did a brilliant job of forwarding the phone onto Hanoi for us
author: Vicki

title: Very good
text: 周りの景色はイマイチだけど立地は良かった。こじんまりとしているが、清潔で可愛らしいお部屋。居心地も良い。アフタヌーンティー付だったのに時間的に間に合わず利用できなかったのが残念だった。スタッフもみんな優しくて親切。いいホテルです。
author: 徳子

title: Beautiful hotel with fabulous staff, the receptionists were all delightful and so helpful.
positives:
The location is good, the Bitexco (sky viewing tower) is literally a one minute walk away, while the main market is a 15 minute walk. 
I shared a twin bed room with a friend, it was very clean and very comfortable. The shower was superb.
The pool is excellent, much needed after the heat of Ho Chi Minh city.
negatives: The pool is on the roof of the hotel, and as such space is limited. There are 8 sunbeds and 8 comfortable chairs meaning at peak time in the afternoon it could be tricky getting a seat. There is nothing the hotel staff can do to change this. I was fortunate as always found a seat, but others came for a swim and then couldn't sit and relax.
author: Fiona

title: Exceptional
text:
ロビーがとても綺麗でびっくりです。
朝ごはんが種類豊富でおいしく大満足です。
author: kaori
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Nice place to stay. Would come again.
positives:
Great breakfast - kudos to the chef - it was a fine way to start our days in the pretty dining room. They offer fresh fruit, Vietnamese and Western options, with made-to-order omelettes and pho. 

All the staff were excellent. Special mention to the concierge/receptionist and the bellhop who checked us in at 2:00 am in the morning. (March 26th, sorry I didn't write their names down.) We'd been travelling for 30 hours straight and we were just getting our bearings. They were exceptionally helpful with everything, including activating our Vietnamese SIM cards.

Hi to Joe (pronounced Cho-ee) our lovely breakfast hostess. You do a great job and we wish you well in your career.
negatives:
The bedroom is pretty, and looks just like the pictures. The wood finish is a lower grade than what shows in photos though. 
The bathroom is large and well appointed.
The balcony is wide but not very deep, so we didn't find it a relaxing place to sit in and say, catch up at the end of the day.
author: Dorothy

title: Exceptional
text: とても清潔でスタッフも優しい心温まるホテルです。
author: kaori

title: The staff were super friendly and helpful, the hotel has lots of add ons - a great swimming pool, brand new treadmills i
positives: Well located in District one however just one street away from the red light district….
negatives: The twin room without window we had smelled of mildew.
author: Danielle

title: 立地のみ
text: チェックイン時の男性スタッフが感じ悪い。アゴダで予約した部屋とは別の部屋にされたので、すぐにフロントに戻り当初予約した部屋に変えてもらったが、彼はアップグレードした部屋にしたんだよと言ってたが疑問が残るばかり。次は泊まらない
author: yoshimitsu
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Charming hotel in District one. Great location, nice breakfast and lovely staff.
positives: Great location, lovely staff and nice pool/bar area.
negatives: Nil
author: Morgan

title: ホテルは良かったのですが‥
text: アゴダの特典として、遅い時間のチェックアウト等あったはずなのに、ホテル側には何も連絡無いとの事で、通常通りになってしまいましたが、ホテル側が30分だけ伸ばしてくれました。深夜便での帰国だったので、わざわざこの特典があったから選んだのに、大変残念でした。アゴダからこの件について回答が有れば良いのですが、きっとないでしょうね‥泣き寝入りですね。
author: MAMI

title: Lovely stay with accommodating staff. They were all very polite and helpful. The rooms were incredibly clean and the hot
positives: Clean, location, staff, swimming pool, accommodating
negatives:
2,500,000 deposit for mini bar which was unexpected. 
Went to afternoon tea at 4pm and there wasn’t anything left apart from fruit. A few plates of sandwiches were brought out but they were gone within seconds due to the demand of people at the time.
author: Faye

title: 定宿にします
text: 少し老朽化してますが、部屋の広さ、清潔度、スタッフの対応、施設の充実度、客層、立地すべて、満足しています
author: KAZUYOSHI
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Above average
positives: Good service and nice pool area.
negatives:
Top small breakfast area. 
Cold water in shower
Bad AC in gym
author: Øyvind

title: 立地が良い
text:
空港から車で30分、ベンタイン市場まで10分程度と立地が良かった。
シャワーの水圧は弱く隣の部屋からは喋り声が聞こえたりしましたが、総合的には満足しています。
ベッドも寝心地良かったです。
スタッフの方も親切でした。
ありがとうございました。
author: EMI

title: Great hotel and location with super helpful staff
positives:
Location was great 
Staff were friendly and very helpful going over and above
negatives:
Pillows were not firm enough and not enough offered
Breakfast was average
author: Stuart

title: 立地条件は想像とかなり違った
text:
朝食は毎日美味しく頂きました。
アフタヌーンティーは少し残念でした。
プールは非常に狭くカクテルを頂きたかったのですが椅子が少なくて座る事が出来なかった。
スタッフの方の配慮はフレンドリーで良かったです。
楽しく過ごせました。
author: MAYUMI

title: Perfect hotel for Ho Chi Minh City, would stay again!
positives: Excellent location, beautiful pool area. Inexpensive spa and great breakfast. fabulous staff who couldn’t do enough for you. Highly recommended for any stay in Ho Chi Minh City.
author: Lisa

title: 3泊しました。
text:
2月末に夫と初ホーチミンで宿泊。

良い点
スタッフの笑顔とサービスが良い。
エントランス、ロビーがオシャレで綺麗。
アオザイを着用した女性スタッフがいる。
アフターヌーンティーが楽しめる。
ホテル横にセブンイレブンあり。

悪い点

シャワーを使うと洗面所が水浸し。
コロナで長い間使用してなかったのか
ジャグジー風呂の穴から臭い水が出てきた。
セーフティボックスが故障して使用できず。
2日目部屋カードキーが反応せずドアが
開かずオロオロした。
このトラブルは、カードを読み取る
カードリーダーの電池切れが原因でした。

これもコロナで長い間稼働してなかったせいなのか？わかりませんが、

その都度スタッフがすぐに対応してくれ
良かったです。
またホーチミンに宿泊する時はお世話になりたいと思います。
author: MIDORI

title: Au Lac Charming
positives: Beautifully appointed hotel. Roof top bar city views and lovely small but perfectly formed pool..  The foyer was bright and airy with booke plants and  birds. Perfect staff,friendly helpful and elegantly dresses. Breakfast buffet extremyly comorehensive to suit all tast with some regional specialties. .
negatives: Room window looked out on to the wall. Not a fan of shower curtains dragging in the bath.
author: Sheila

title: 快適に過ごせます。
text:
ホテルは市街地にありどこに行くにも便利です。
白を基調としたお部屋は清潔で快適にすごせました。
帰国が夜便だったためチェックアウト後に荷物を預けて外出、戻った際にはプールのあるフロアのシャワールームを使わせてもらえました。（プール用のタオルも無料で貸していただけます）
スタッフの皆さん、笑顔が素敵で素晴らしかったです。
author: YUKIKO

title: Very good
positives: Ideally located in the city and very nice rooms.
negatives: Breakfast wasn't very good and the restaurant option for lunch or dinner are very limited. The staff is very slow and not pro active.
author: Jovancé

title: 狭い古い
text:
繁華街の街中にあるホテル
夜は出るのが怖い
写真と違って古く狭い
飛行機が遅れ到着が大幅に遅れたのにも関わらず、アフターヌーンティーの提供は無理、ライトチェックアウトも無理。
一体なんのサービスができるんですか。
author: Yuna

title: Families Stay away - only interested in positive reviews
positives: Hard to tell as we didn’t get to see much given we were kicked out on the basis that we might give a bad review.
negatives:
The staff were horrendous and has no interest in solving our issue which was to accept that the family room which was sold on the basis of 2 adults and 2 pre-teens wouldn’t be suitable without an extra bed. Given we had already paid for 4 people, to then pay again for an extra bed which is normally free is pretty harsh. To only find out as you arrive is worse as you are left with no other options but to pay the extortionate fees. We had requested an extra bed as part of the booking 6 months prior but nothing was mentioned about these additional charges. If we had known up front - we could have booked elsewhere. 

While debating this with the staff I suggested that I would leave a bad review given this poor experience and then the staff completely changed focus and just wanted us out. They cancelled our booking and left us in the lurch in Ho Chi Minh. The managers view was that he didn’t want customers who might leave bad reviews or have bad opinions in his hotel. I did make the point that kicking us out wasn’t going to make our view any more positive but that didn’t seem to sway him. 

Everything is wrong about this place and I advise all families to stay away!
author: Jayesh

title: 星5つじゃ足りない！
text:
最高のスタッフ、最高の空間、最高の香り…全てが美しく優しさの溢れる空間でした。必ずまた来ます。
素敵な時間を本当にありがとうございました。
author: rumi

title: Nice hotel
positives: Location
negatives: wifi
author: Anatoli

title: Above average
text: 日中の工事の音が恐ろしくうるさかった。ドライサウナもスチームサウナも使えなかった。欧米人には愛想が良いがアジア人を馬鹿にした様な態度のスタッフいた。朝食は6時からだが6時に行ったら未だ準備中で20分後に来いと言われた。
author: （海外事業部）

title: Exceptional
positives: This is a lovely boutique hotel in the 1st district of HCMC. I cannot speak highly enough about the staff. They are all so held and friendly. They go above and beyond.
negatives: Awesome Staff and lovely hotel
author: Christine

title: Exceptional
text:
以前は、シルバーランド チャーナー ホテルという名前だったと思います。
ロケーションはとてもよく、徒歩圏内でいろいろなところに行くことが出来ます。
屋上のプールの夜景は最高です。22時で使えます。
残念な点は、シャワーを浴びるタイミングが悪いとお湯が出ないことがあります（宿泊者が一斉にシャワーを使うとお湯が出ないこともあります）。
復活してほしいサービスとしては、冷蔵庫のジュースを飲み放題にして欲しいです。
author: TAKESHI

title: Fantastic hotel
positives:
Great location. Lovely room. Fantastic service. Unbelievable bar prices!
We had a great time and have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to others.
negatives: NONE
author: Jörg

title: 特に問題なし
text:
スタイリッシュでコンパクトなホテル
清潔感ありですが全体的にリノベーション必要かも。ティータイムは味は良くなかった。朝食はgood
author: yojiro

title: Comfortable place near city center
positives: The staff was very friendly and helpful
author: CARLA

title: 短期滞在なら
text:
一人旅で8泊しました。
フロントのスタッフのみなさんは、気が利いていて、フレンドリーで良い方ばかりでした。
私は、日本語以外話せないので、わからない所は、翻訳機を使って丁寧に説明してくれました。
ホテルの周りは、コンビニ、カフェ、レストランと全く不便さはありません。
高島屋も歩いて数分ですし。
朝食は、料金並の内容でした。
短期滞在で、着替えをあまり持っていかないなら良いのですが、ハンガーの本数分以外洋服の収納スペースがない為、泊数が多い方はどうかなって思います。
泊数が多く旅行中の衣類のシワを気にされて、キャリーから出す方には向いてません。私は出す派なので。
私は、8泊したので着替えを置くスペースに困りました。
でも、5泊以上の滞在の場合は、ワインのボトルが無料サービスでした。
毎日部屋の掃除はありましたが、2日間以外は、掃除が不完全でした。
使用したバスタオルを片してない、バスタブを洗ってない、初日はバスタブに長い髪の毛が付いていた。
トイレの便器周辺と、洗面の排水口が臭った。
ほぼ使うたびにシャワーの温度が低い。
部屋の見た目は可愛らしく映える感じなので、掃除が行き届いていたら良かったのですが。
アフタヌーンティーは、まあまあでした。
評価としては、スタッフのみなさんの感じの良さが入る事で、可もなく不可もなくでした。
改善されればまた利用しても良いと思います。
author: TOMOHIRO
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Exceptional
positives: Would absolutely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Saigon! Great location, amenities, and some of the most attentive/friendly staff I have encountered throughout Southeast Asia.
author: Jean-françois

title: 良い宿でした。
text:
部屋は清潔で設備もとても整っていました。
スタッフもいろいろなことに気を配っていて、素晴らしいサービスでした。
荷物の運搬やタクシーの手配など、細かなところまで紳士的に対応してもらいました。

ただ、一つだけ朝食が貧相だったように感じてしまいました。
Phoもオムレツもその場で作ってくれるスタイルでよかったですが、レパートリーが少ないなと感じてしまいました。
前日のアフタヌーンティーとデザートは同じメニューだったのも少し残念でした。

ただ、ホテルのロケーションは観光地に近いし、まわりにはたくさんの有名レストランもあるのでとてもよかったです。
author: S
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Very good
positives: Excellent location, super friendly staff and large, comfortable room with a large shower and free-standing jacuzzi bath.
negatives: The lighting in the room is too dark in the evening, making it difficult to put on make-up etc.
author: Clarissa

title: 最上級のおもてなしを感じられる
text:
朝食も部屋もスタッフもアフタヌーンティーも立地も最高でした！
限られたスペースでも工夫を凝らしてもてなそうという心意気を感じられたし、チェックインでもお待たせしてるゲストにきちんと声掛けして気遣う姿勢はベトナムではあまりなかったので新鮮でした。全体的にフランス植民地時代を感じさせる、フランスベースにベトナムの魅力も随所に取り入れたかんじで雰囲気最高！ホテルの規模的に団体客もおらず、客層も落ち着いたかんじで良かったです。プールとジムは小さいから利用しませんでしたが、清潔そうでした。次回のホーチミン滞在時も絶対ここにします！
author: MITSUOKA

title: Exceptional
positives: The property is awesome - from the rooms to the roof top bar. Best of all is the service.
author: Gerard

title: クラシック感とモダンの両立
text: ホテルの「基礎」は年季が入っているのだと思いますが、リノベーション済なので、設備の不都合はほとんどありません。部屋も広めなので、ぜいたくな気分を味わえました。
author: Hirokazu
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Very good hotel
positives: the hotel was centrally located to all the big attractions & within walking distance to plenty of stores and restaurants
negatives: Nothing
author: Damoun

title: おすすめホテルです
text:
ホーチミンの雑多な中で異空間のステキなホテルです。
スタッフの笑顔や対応も良く、とても満足です。
朝食やアフタヌーンティは美味しくて優雅なひと時を過ごせました。
シャワーの圧が低いこと以外はパーフェクトでした。
author: yasuko

title: French Charm
positives: This Hotel oozes charm and character French 🇫🇷 Style with elegance The staff are amazing gorgeous and super friendly and attentive
author: Caroline

title: スタッフがとても親切
text:
南部解放記念日に宿泊しましたが、市内で打ち上げられた花火を屋上階のプールから眺める事が出来て最高でした！
日本へ深夜帰国日には、チェックアウト後でも荷物預り、また市内観光後に夜にシャワーを使わせて頂いたのでとてもスッキリした帰国する事が出来ました！
author: HIDEKI
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: WILL COME BACK SOON
positives: The hotel facilities are new and beautiful. The welcome drink and the cocktail is very nice. Every hotel staff is very friendly.
negatives: NOTHING
author: Jean-françois

title: バスルーム以外は最高
text:
浴槽があるのは素晴らしいが、シャワーに切り替えても蛇口から水が出てしまい、浴槽に水がたまってしまう事がとても残念だった。
朝食のビュッフェも及第点。
立地とスタッフの対応は素晴らしい。
さらに狭いながらもジムやプールもあり、またホーチミン に行く時はぜひ利用したいと思います。
author: KAICHI
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Right by the sky tower
positives:
Lovely, huge room with big bath in the big bathroom. 
Nice pool on roof with great views of the sky tower.
Good choice at breakfast.
negatives:
A lot of bars with 'ladies' outside in street close by.
City view from our 2nd & 3rd floor balconies not great.
author: marian

title: また行きたいホテルです
text: 観光名所の中心部にあり　抜群の立地条件です。　朝食・アフタヌーンティーなどサービスが充実しています。　隣にコンビニ7-11があり何かと便利でした。
author: Masao

title: Very good
positives: Beautiful pool, great breakfast
negatives: Our a/c and fridge were not very cold. Also on 5th floor with long-term residents
author: Devin

title: 素晴らしいホテル
text: 朝食、プール、部屋全て素晴らしいホテルでした。
author: souma

title: Good location
positives: Lovely place to stay, comfortable room and good sized bathroom
author: Stephen

title: 良かった🥰
text:
立地も良く、スタッフもフレンドリーで、朝食も大満足でした。
プールは小さめでしたが、清潔でした(*^^*)
author: RUMI

title: Great stay + good location
positives: Breakfast was included and had sufficient options but the space was not that big
author: SIMON

title: 高級感が溢れるホテル
text: 宿泊料に比して十分な高級感を感じた。アフタヌーンティー付きのプランを選択してよかった。朝食では、オムレツをその場で注文通り焼いてくれるサービスもあり、満足だった。立地が繁華街の近くのためか、夜通しバンドの演奏が聞こえてきたのが残念。
author: Takao

title: Welcoming stay
positives: The rooms are very spacious and clean. The linens are great! No washcloths :) The air conditioning kept the room at the temp you select.
negatives: Nothing
author: Deborah

title: Exceptional
text:
スタッフが皆さん親切で優しかった❗️
安心して泊まれるホテルです。
また8月に泊まります。
author: SUMIE

title: Great location and staff but overpriced
positives: I appreciated the excellent central location of the hotel, making it convenient to explore the city. The staff were friendly and readily available to assist with any inquiries, which added to the overall pleasant experience. The rooftop pool was a highlight, offering stunning views and a relaxing atmosphere. Additionally, the beds were comfortable but the bed in the double room was quite small.
negatives: I found that the high price of the hotel was not justified by the experience. The breakfast offered was very average, with a limited selection of fruits, and if you arrived after 9 am, there were minimal options available as they didn't top up. The rooms were small and incredibly noisy, lacking soundproofing, which affected the quality of rest. Furthermore, the bathrooms were outdated, with non-existent water pressure at times, making it challenging to even shower comfortably. Upon voicing these concerns, the response from staff was dismissive, indicating that such issues were common. Overall, given the high price, I would not recommend this hotel to others.
author: Stylianos

title: 綺麗なホテルです
text:
コンシェルジュの対応もよく、ドアマンの対応も気持ちよかった。
部屋も綺麗です。水量や、お湯の熱さもしっかりして日本人でも満足度高いです。屋上のプールも綺麗です。
author: JUNYA

title: Good hotel in great location
positives: The hotel itself, areas including the rooftop pool & bar were lovely. Breakfast was good with enough choice. Staff very friendly and helpful. Location was great in district 1 where a lot of tourist sights are within walking distance. Afternoon tea was v good, served between 2.30 & 4.30pm.
negatives: The room was ok but had a terrible view of a roof with aircon units. We weren't in it much so we didn't ask for a change. Definitely need better window coverage as a roman blind does not keep out the early morning light.
author: Sarah

title: 最高の滞在でした
text:
コスパがかなりいいホテルでした！
朝食、簡単なアフタヌーンティーつき。こじんまりして可愛いプールもあります。特に立地が非常にいいため、ホーチミンでどこにいくにも困りません。
author: Hinako

title: A lovely place to stay
positives: The staff were very welcoming and helpful, the hotel is in a good location to everything.
author: Jody

title: スタッフの方々がとても優秀で素晴らしい！
text:
日本人youtuberが紹介していたので、他のホテルをやめてこちらを予約しました。

ホテルスタッフの方々がとても素晴らしく、英語があまりできない私たちにも親切にしてくださいました。
また、簡単な日本語がわかるようで、少し日本語を交えて会話してくださりました！

Grabアプリで配車予約する際も、ドライバーとやり取りをしてくださり、スムーズに空港に行くことができました。ありがとうございます！

次にホーチミンに訪れる時も、ここを予約したいです。
その時はムイネーという海の綺麗な場所にも行ってみたいです！

しかし、マッサージサービスだけはホテルではなく専門店を予約した方がいいです。
マッサージスタッフだけはマッサージ中にベトナム語でずっと会話をしており、リラックスがあまりできませんでした。

それ以外は朝食もアフタヌーンティーも、屋上のプールも、素晴らしいスタッフの皆様も、とても快適に過ごせました。
ありがとうございました！
author: HARUKA

title: Not worth the price
positives: The pool was nice
negatives: We could not shower when we arrived as the hot water pipe was turned off. Breakfast was poor with little choices and finished prior to allocated time of 10am. Staff turned off toasters, kettles while some guests still using same. The bedrooms had no windows and had a muggy smell. The staff did not assist with luggage and had very poor English. The pool was smaller than photos online and was quite dirty.
author: Claudia

title: こじんまりとした綺麗なホテル
text: 立地も申し分ない。清潔感のあるホテル。アフタヌーンティーも良かった。ホーチミンに来る時はまた利用したいです。
author: Hiromichi

title: We would choose the same hotel again.
positives: The staff were friendly and helpful. The location was excellent for walking distance to many sites. The afternoon tea was an enjoyable inclusion.
negatives: There are no blackout curtains on the windows. There wasn't a lot of space to open 2 suitcases at the same time.
author: Karen

title: コスパ
text: コスパがなんと言っても良いホテルです。
author: Mari

title: Great Central Hotel
positives: Great location, close to everything and walking distance from supermarkets, restaurants and other eateries. Sightseeing was also very easily accessible. The hotel was very nice too, very clean and very friendly staff.
negatives: Breakfast was not all that great. We only ate there twice. Not a huge variety and did not really cater for vegetarians.
author: Parit

title: ホテルについて
text:
スタッフの対応が明るくて親切でとても満足でした　日本語は通じませんがスタッフは皆んな英語が出来る方ばかりなので特に困った事はありませんでした　朝食もアフタヌーンティーは最高でした　施設は新しい感じはしませんが綺麗にお掃除されてました　シャワーの水圧が悪く高温が出ない感じでした、、、シャワーの場所がバスタブとは違う場所で床がビチャビチャになります
どこに行くにも便利な場所で私は気に入りました
author: MIHO

title: Excellent
positives: Jessica was brilliant and looked after our group of 11 exceptionally well
author: Nicholas

title: 良かったです
text: 部屋は清潔でしたが、設備がやや古かったです。初日はジャグジーが壊れてましたが、翌日には直してくれました。スタッフの対応はよかったです。立地は繁華街に近いです。
author: Y
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Nice hotel but dissapointed by the staff behavior.
positives: The balcony garden and jacuzzi are a nice festure of the Bonard suites.
negatives: Pool looks bigger in photos than it is in reality and there are just a few sunbeds. They asked us to pay on arrival but we wanted to catch the afternoon tea time so we asked to pay later and they said no… so we had to go to the bank and by the time we returned they tried telling us there’s no more time for tea (where anyway there was almost nothing left :) Poor english at the front desk too.
author: Luciana

title: とても良いホテルでした。
text:
８日間の滞在でしたが、ホーチミンの繁華街に近い場所にありながらホテル内はリゾートホテルのような感じの雰囲気でとても居心地がよかったです。一階のロビーやエレベーター内は音楽が流れいてリラックス感がありました。
セキュリティもしっかりしているので安心です。レセプションは24時間対応でとても親切でした。

朝食のビュッフェはとても美味しく、フォーは上品な味わいで毎朝食べていました。
フランス資本のホテルだけあって、アメニティのシャンプーやボディーソープの香りも良かったのが好印象でした。
一点だけ残念な点を挙げるとすれば、東南アジアあるあるで、初日は部屋内に蟻が列をなしていたことです。
ホテルに隣接するコンビニで害虫駆除用のスプレーですぐに解決できました。
上記の点を差し引いてもとても良いホテルでした。ホーチミンを訪れる時は是非また利用したいです。
author: YUKI

title: Little French Hotel with character
positives: Very friendly & comfortable! Our friends recommended this hotel and we can recommend this as well! We will definitely come back. Everything is nearby - nightlife bars and everything you need. Thank you to the whole team and we are glad to stay here with u!
author: Maximilian

title: スタッフもロケーションも良いけど
text: リノベーションしてあるが、古さがあり、何と言ってもネズミが出たのが残念でならない。毎晩ネズミに悩まされた。
author: yuko

title: Disappointing
positives: Staff lovely and very helpful.
negatives: Breakfast ordinary. Rooms not supplied as advertised/booked. Photos of property misleading particularly pool area which was small and poorly shaded.
author: Chris

title: 5っ星？
text:
チェンマイにはもう30回も来ているが4~5年の間にミマンヘミンも随分と変わった
このホテルが出来る前の古いホテルも、泊まったので 新しいこのホテルに期待していたが  裏切られた

場所は最高だが まず車止め狭い
受付から部屋まで一回出て隣のビルみたいで 面倒
部屋は7Fだったが 決して悪くはないのだが  このクラスでバスタブがない
いつも通り ウォシュレットなし

騒音も道路の横なのでうるさいね

この問題は いつもつきまとうのです
新築だったら 5っ星をうたうのであれば
ペアガラスとか防音壁とかするでしょう

雰囲気だけ作って高くとる 見え見え 
ソウルから直行便ある為 Korea多い

雑貨や可愛い服 の昔は宝庫だったが
やはりコロナで店がどーん減った
隣のセンター 普通
今は郊外のマーケットが主流
もう ミマンへミンには 食事はあっても
来る事はない
author: Hideaki

title: Great location and good value for money
positives: Location - comfortable bed. Helpful staff and very friendly.
negatives:
Noisy rooms as old and limited sound proofing. Plus construction nearby. 
Limited supply and fruit options  at breakfast.
Coffee is average but good coffee places nearby.
Pool area is small so space is premium. They also allow smoking which given the area is not nice for non smokers.
author: Michael

title: Very good
text: 街からも近く、ホテル内にはプール、ジム、サウナもあり快適に過ごせました。
author: MAMI

title: Excellent
positives: Good location. The staff in the hotel were lovely and super helpful. The rooms wery very clean. We had a lovely time.
negatives: There were only a few sunbeds around the swimming pool. The breakfast room was small and we had to share the table with other couples most days as there was no space. But it was ok and it didn't bother us.
author: Renato

title: 使い勝手のよいホテル
text:
エントランス、ロビーはとてもキレイであまり古さを感じませんが、部屋はやや古さを感じます。宿泊して不便は感じませんでした。
ロケーションは良いので、食事や買い物にいくのにも便利です。ホテルの隣りにセブンイレブンもあり、ちょっとしたものを買うのに便利でした。
author: ITO

title: Very dissatisfied.
positives: The bedrooms were  clean .
negatives:
Mostly the food. 
We stayed for 3 nights.
The breakfast was not nice. The bread was stale and had a very poor selection of fresh fruit.
We ordered a meal for the room.
When it arrived it was cold and inedible.
Complained at reception but fell on deaf ears.
author: James

title: 全てがてがっかり
text: シャワーは壊れていて、部屋もあまりきれいと言えず、対応も良くなく残念でした。
author: TAMAKI

title: Cozy centrally located hotel perfect for a family
positives: The stay at the hotel exceeded our expectations. It is very centrally located, beautifully decorated with very kind and helpful staff. The breakfast buffet had plenty of choices to offer as well as the afternoon tea. We enjoyed the pool in the evening with the view above the city.
author: Kalina

title: 部屋はレトロ調
text: 価格相応だと思います。立地的は、どちらかというと外れにありますが、許容範囲だと思います。品数は少ないですが、朝食もよかったです。
author: Eiji

title: Luxury stopover before heading home.
positives: Attention to detail everywhere we went with the staff extremely attentive and keen to please. We had a beautiful room and enjoyed the wonderful view from the rooftop bar before dinner. Presentation and service at dinner was outstanding. After a really comfortable night’s sleep we enjoyed a wonderful breakfast with lots to choose from.
author: Vanessa

title: 耳栓が必要
text:
時間によってアフタヌーンティーを自由に楽しめる。場所が繁華街のすぐ近くで便利。

ドアが薄いので、朝から掃除のスタッフ？の声がうるさくて起きた。バスタブにお湯をはろうとしたが、水の出る量が少なくて諦めた。
author: Naho

title: Exceptional
positives: Before coming back home, we chose to stay in this hotel for 3 nights what the great decision of us. Room modern, cleaned and they refilled the complimentary things daily. Staffs was friendly with a happy face always.
author: Dan

title: Very good
positives: The rooftop was great!
negatives: Room was out dated and bathroom dirty
author: McFall

title: 笑顔が素敵なスタッフ
text:
滞在中、スタッフのかたのサービスが心地よかったです。

レセプションもベッドメイク、レストランの方、皆様の笑顔が素敵で、快適な滞在となりました。
また宿泊したいと思います。

唯一、シャワーがぬるいことだけが、
マイナスポイントです。
author: NORIKO
reply:
Dear NORIKO,

Thank you so much for choosing Au Lac Charner Hotel for your stay in Ho Chi Minh city and giving us a good comment.
We are very delighted that you had a memorable stay at the hotel.
Your satisfaction on service is the motivation for us to work even harder. 
We hope you and family have a wonderful day and look forward to welcoming you back to us in the near future.

Best regards,
Au Lac Charner Hotel Team

title: GOOD HOTEL
positives: Good choice in Sai Gon, great stay
author: Daniela

title: また戻って来ました！オーラックへ
text: 今回の10日間のベトナム滞在中、到着後すぐに２泊、途中地方等に行き、またホーチミンに戻り、またリピートしたくなった、私のオススメホテルです
author: MITSUE
reply:
オーラックチャーナーホテルからミズへの温かいご挨拶。 ミツエ、

ベトナム旅行の際に当ホテルにご滞在いただき、誠にありがとうございました。 あなたの礼儀のフィードバックは、私たちの施設とサービスの質を改善するための大きな動機を与えてくれたとても貴重なものです。 フィードバックを関連チームに渡して、作業品質の向上を促します。

繰り返しになりますが、皆様からの素敵なご意見をお待ちしております。近い将来、当ホテルに再びご宿泊いただけるよう、皆様をお迎えできることを願っております。

よろしくお願いします、
オーラックチャーナーホテルチーム。

title: Exceptional Hotel and Staff
positives: Great location, and the hotel and staff were exceptional. Our room was clean, comfortable, and quiet. We ate breakfast and one dinner at the hotel, and both were very good and fairly priced. Check out the rooftop restaurant and bar. Best in the city!
author: Ramsey

title: ホーチミンでの常宿にしたいホテル
text:
朝食とアフタヌーンティ付きで、この宿泊費ならコスパ高すぎ！なオススメホテルです

デザートのバインフランが美味しい

ホテル自体は新しくはありませんが、清潔ですし、スタッフ達もホスピタリティがあり、また帰って来たいホテルとなりました
author: MITSUE
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed
reply:
Warmest greeting from Au Lac Charner Hotel to Ms. Mitsue,

We would like to say thank you very much for your stay at our Hotel during your planned trip in Vietnam. Your courtesy feedback is such a valuable things that gave us huge motivation to improve our facilities and services quality. We would kindly pass your feedback to relevant team to encourage them improve the working quality.

Once again, we are very appreciate for your lovely feedback and hope that we will have chance to welcoming you to stay again at our Hotel in the near future.

Best regards,
Au Lac Charner Hotel team.

title: good stay
positives: nice room, nice staffs, well done all team
negatives: none
author: Subir

title: 次はにないかな
text:
スタッフは親切心はあるのだが、本当に仕事ができない。欧米からのゲストが半分以上なのに、英語が英語のコミュニケーションが下手。声が小さく要望に応えられない。
場所もいいし、部屋も綺麗なのにもったいない。大きな問題はなかったけれど、他にも沢山ホテルはあるので次回はないかな。
ベルボーイさんの働きは素晴らしかっただけに残念です。
アゴダのVIP特典はホテルに伝わっていないので、自分で予約時の画面など見せ、説明が必要。
author: YUKA
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window
reply:
Warmest greeting from Au Lac Charner Hotel to Ms. Yuka,

We would like to say thank you so much for your stay at our Hotel and a sincere apology should be said from our heart for unwanted frustrations you have been through. We would strive to retrain our staff and improve our service quality to serve our clients better as we are willing to stand in our customer's shoes. We also noted that benefits from OTA sites, especially benefits of VIP guests will be more clarified. We would exhaust our heart to assist all the benefits and requests from our Guests subject to our availability.

Once again, we very appreciate your courtesy feedback about our Hotel and hope that we will have a chance to welcoming you to stay again at Au Lac Charner Hotel in the near future.

Best regards.
Au Lac Charner Hotel team.

title: Excellent and friendly
positives: A wonderful location in Saigon, most of the sights are within walking distance, wonderful sky bar, the rooms were excellent, spacious and clean, the staff very accommodating and helpful. The spa area was also wonderful and relaxing
author: Jens

title: ロケーション
text: 最高でした、どこに行くに便利な立地でした。
author: nobuhiko
reply:
Dear Mr/Ms.Nobuhiko ,

We would like to say thank you very much for choosing Au Lac Charner Hotel to stay during your planned trip.

We are delighted to read your wonderful feedback about our Hotel. It encourage us a lot to improve the quality for serving our customers better.

We are looking foward to welcoming you to stay at our Hotel in the near future.

Best regards,

Au Lac Charner Hotel team.

title: Disapointed.
positives: Location was great,
negatives:
Booked Bonnard suite. It was very small with no lounge....nothing like there photos..
Hotel rooms are very tired...breakfast and restaurant food very average....so many better hotel options close by.
author: Steve

title: 清潔
text: 室内に浴槽のあるスイートルームに宿泊しました。ベッドからトイレの中が透けて見えるのが気になりますが全体的NI清潔感のあるホテルです。
author: Ryo
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Excellent
positives: Location , services
author: Quynh

title: お値段以上！
text:
出来たばかりのスタイリッシュで綺麗なホテルです。
12:30くらいに到着したので荷物だけ預け市内観光しようと思っていましたが、お部屋が用意できているとのことで、アーリーチェックインが出来ました。
小さな子連れでしたので助かりました。
次の日は飛行機が7:50だったのでホテルを5:00出発でした。
朝食を持たせてくれるとの事でしたが、空港ラウンジに寄るのでお断りしました。
とても親切に対応していただき、気持ちよく快適に過ごせました。      
前日に宿泊していたホテルはここよりも料金が高かったのですが、全てこちらのホテルの方が格上でした。
絶対また来たいです。
author: KANAKO
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Excellent
positives: Staff were extremely friendly, the rooftop pool is amazing, location is very convenient too
negatives: Rooms could be a little cleaner and bathroom was a bit stuffy because there wasn't a window or other ventilation
author: Andre

title: Worst hotel in life
text: 毎年年末年始は海外都市部とビーチにでかけてます。今回はその中でも最悪でした。空港からの送迎車に乗りチェックインしようとしたが1時間待たされカードキーを受け取ったところ違うホテルでした。この時点でダブルブッキングで違うホテルに案内された事に気が付きました。ホテルの名前が書かれた車の為気が付くのが遅れたのです。翌日ワンランクアップグレードされたと言う部屋に通されましたがサーチャージ込みで1泊32000の価値はまったくありません。また毎晩蚊に悩まされた上シャワーの水圧、温度も不安定、水しか出ない事もありました。過去の4星ホテルの中でも最低ランクです。特に蚊に関しては2日で16箇所刺されてドラックストアーに駆け込みました。評判は全てダブルブッキング無し、アップグレードされたものとさせていただきました。二度と訪れる事はないでしょう。
author: taro

title: Really happy to find a gem in the center at a great price quality.
positives:
Well located hotel in District 1 ... walking distance to major sites in centre.

Colonial themed property, its a little dated but very well cleaned and staff exceptional .... always a smile.
negatives: Pool area small but great for a dip after a long day siteseeing.
author: PTHLUX

title: 利便性は高い
text:
周りは飲食店やマッサージ等何でもあり便利
施設は新しいのだが、ドアの建付けが悪かったりシャワー使用すると周りに飛び散ったり湯量温度も安定しない
author: kazuya

title: Exceptional
positives: Very good service at reception and restaurant. Swimming pool on the terrace is appreciated. Free tea on the terrace with very complete self service. Laundry works very well. Good air conditioning and silence. Shower in terrace sink.
author: Georgios

title: よいロケーションと良いサービス
text: どこに行くのも便利なところ。フリーのドリンクやスナックのサービスもよかった。何より驚いたのは、日本製のシャワートイレが付いていたこと。外国ではじめての経験でした。
author: koji
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Excellent base to get to know Ho Chi Minh city
positives: On the roof, the pool and bar are nice and there is also a sauna, gym and spa. But, the best thing about this hotel is the service, attentive and very friendly
author: MAY

title: おすすめします
text:
全体的にきれいです。
屋上のプールやサウナも最高です。
スタッフの方々もとても親切、丁寧です。
泊まる価値あり
サイゴンスカイデッキ、ドンコイ通りへも近い。
author: YASUHITO

title: Perfect
positives: We stayed here for 2 nights before flying back home. Great spot close to the Opera house where  we had booked evening tickets to Lune. Breakfast was amazing. High tea was a welcome treat as well as a lovely swim in the gorgeous pool.  This was a lovely hotel.  My favourite was how lovely the staff were. Thank you for being so helpful and giving us some lovely  ideas for walking around the city in our limited time. This was the perfect relax before we flew home.
author: Kylie

title: スタッフが親切☆
text:
噂通りスタッフの皆さんが親切で、小腹が空いた時間帯のアフタヌーンティーはお腹も心も充たされました。
ドンコイ通りも近く、初めてのベトナムもおかげさまで快適でした☆
author: SAEKO

title: perfect
positives: lovely staffs, good location
negatives: nothing
author: Nhan

title: コスパが高い
text:
1．ホテル
　・お湯の出がいい
　・備え付けの飲料が無料…僅かな金額だが持ち込みを考えると便利
　・アフタヌーンティーが無料
　・部屋が清潔だし清掃が行き届いている
　・朝食が美味しい＆種類も多く数日泊でも飽きない
2．周辺事情
　・繁華街・観光地が至近
　・徒歩圏内（1-10分）に食事処やコンビニ、屋台、ショッピングセンターが多数あり
author: HIROKAZU

title: Excellent
positives: We stayed here twice during our latest trip. It had a nice foyer and the staff were extremely pleasant. Location was good. By using Grab, it was cheap and easy to get around in the heat. Breakfast was varied but please serve up mango, which was abundant in the markets.
negatives: Unfortunately, we had trouble opening the door to our balcony on the last night. We had been looking forward to our outside spa. The staff tried very hard but I expect a locksmith was needed.
author: Lech

title: 素敵なホテルでした
text: 日本語対応のスタッフの方もいて安心でした。スタッフの対応も丁寧で完璧でした！お部屋はとても可愛く、朝食ビュッフェも美味しかった。街中にあり、アクセスもよかった。
author: Manami

title: Excellent hotel & value for money
positives: Charming hotel in an excellent location with gorgeous staff. This hotel was great value and the rooms were clean and spacious.
negatives: The breakfast and pool food was not good. The pool area has limited chairs so was quite crowded at times and the gym is small but functional for 2 people max.
author: Sarah

title: 最高のホテル
text: ホーチミンを歩くには最高の立地です。日本人街やベンタン市場とは少し離れている為に少し落ち着いた雰囲気も味わえます。ホーチミンへ行くときは是非、利用したいホテルです。
author: KOSUKE
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: Great experience in a central location
positives: Very good experience in this hotel. Friendly and helpful. Rooms a little old but sufficient for the price. Located next to the skyline. It allows you to get to all places on foot without problems. Good breakfast, something new changes every day.
author: DELPHINE

title: 残念
text: 以前宿泊した際に大変気に入り、ここに泊まりたくてホーチミンへ来た。チェックインしたら予約していたバスタブ付きのお部屋ではなかった。再度チェックインし直すと、今度はバスタブの中が汚れていた。信じられない。以前は本当に良かっただけに、どうしてしまったのか心配してる。また、帰りはドアマンに結婚してるのかとか女性に向けてプライバシーに関わる質問をされて大変不愉快でした。レベルが下がってしまったようです。
author: Hiroko

title: Exceptional
positives: Hotel very well located in district 1, spacious rooms and varied and complete breakfast. everything very clean. Maybe we could say that we were missing plugs in the room and there was little lighting in the bathroom. The staff is very friendly and always willing to help. The pool area is very nice and pleasant to take a bath after the excursions.
author: Oygo

title: 親切なホテルでした。
text:
ホテルの立地はショッピングにも観光にも徒歩で行けるところにあり非常に便利でした。
チェックイン時、予約とは違うベットになっていましたが、変更を申し出たところ嫌な顔ひとつせず対応してくれました。
お店の予約やタクシーを呼ぶのもお願いしましたが、どなたも感じの良い対応でした。
ひとつだけ気になったのは、部屋のシャワーの扉がきちんと閉まらなくなってしまっているので、水がトイレのところまで漏れてしまったことです。
てすが、プールも綺麗に掃除されていましたし価格ともに満足のいくホテルでした。
部屋のコンセントは2種類ありました。
author: HIROMI

title: Great hotel and location
positives: Spotless throughout and staff could not be more helpful. Food was excellent, never knew you could have such a variety for breakfast.Location was great for exploring district one and although street outside was busy, hotel is set back a little so noise was never an issue even with street facing room.
negatives: Only downside was not enough poolside seating.
author: Paul

title: オススメのホテル
text:
リニューアルされたばかりでとても清潔。トイレもウォシュレットでした。
アフタヌーンティーもあり、音楽の生演奏付きでとても優雅なひと時を過ごせました。コスパの良いホテル、また使います、

title: Our second stay, and we will be back for a third
positives: The hotel was the poshest place we stayed at while in Vietnam. The rooms were clean, our beds made everyday and bathroom cleaned. The beds were very comfy, the pillows were amazing. Breakfast was nice, plenty to choose from. The omelettes were yummy. The view from the pool was unbelievable! The Bitexco Tower was quite honestly across the road! So we had a fabulous view, and enjoyed watching the window cleaners of the Tower! Location was perfect, the Walking Boulevard was a block away.
negatives: The pool really needs to be cleaned. During the day you cannot see how dirty the water is, so if you decide to go for a swim in the evening I suggest to not look at the lights in the pool revealing all the floaties in the water...
author: julesz

title: 全てに満足です‼︎
text:
エントランスから、お部屋、屋上のプールに至るまで全て素敵な空間でした。
お部屋にバスタブ、バルコニーにシャワーがあり、お部屋も清潔でとても快適に過ごせました。お部屋のアメニティもいい香りでした。
モーニングも、アフターヌーンティーも種類が多く、3泊しても飽きることはなく、むしろ大満足でした。
ベッドがクイーンだったら、もっとよかったかな。
またホーチミンに行くときには、是非利用したいです。
author: Yukiko
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Ok hotel but wouldn’t stay here again.
positives: Location was good
negatives: Room were old needs updating
author: Caroline

title: 綺麗でよかった。
text:
綺麗で、スタッフのホスピタティにも満足した。
市街地の真ん中に位置しているので、治安の悪さも特に感じなかった。
author: KENSUKE

title: Wonderful hotel and location
positives: Lovely hotel in a great location. Roof top pool is amazing with great views. Breakfast was great and lots of options. Staff so helpful and friendly, even getting my money back from the airport taxi who overcharged us (they had taken a picture of the taxi when arrived, asked how much we paid and said too much, so called the company and the driver returned to refund the money!) Highly recommend!
author: Tim

title: スタッフのホスピタリティが素晴らしい！！
text: ウェルカムドリンクとスイーツ、おしぼりが付きました。部屋は少し小さめと思いました。ウェルカムフルーツが部屋に置いてあります。残念なのが外にシャワーがあったことと部屋の中に浴槽があったこと。バルコニーに出るのが面倒だしびちゃびちゃになる。その他は、清潔感もあったしとても良かったです。アフタヌーンティーも朝食も美味しかったです。何よりもスタッフのサポートが素晴らしかった！良いホテルだと思うしサービスは5つ星以上でも良いんじゃないかなぁって思います。
author: Eri
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Acceptable
positives: Nothing - AVOID THIS HOTEL
negatives:
BLACKMAIL, HORRIFIC Food and DISRESPECTFUL MANAGEMENT. AVOID At All Cost. Staff have ruined our holiday. Very very expensive hotel, and really poor service. SUGGEST ORDERING GOOGLE OR BOOKING. COM REVIEWS FROM LOWEST TO HIGHEST TO SEE TRUE HORRIFYING CONDITIONS AT THIS HOTEL. POSITIVE REVIEWS ARE A RESULT OF BLACKMAIL AND BRIBERY. Do not stay here - worst hotel we have stayed at in VIETNAM, and indeed in the world, and we've done alot of travelling!
Really unaccomodating staff - we asked for a breakfast to be packed for us as we've paid for it and have to leave at 445am for an early flight. Every other hotel in Vietnam, and every other hotel I have ever stayed at in the world, has accommodated for this. The manager claimed that their policy says they can't pack a breakfast for us. They use their policy and 'health and saftey' as an excuse for everything. Rude and disrespectful staff have ruined our holiday.
We booked one twin and one double. On arrival, there was apparently a problem with the twin so they have moved us to two doubles and added a fold away bed. Obviously not as comfortable as the twin bed we have booked and take us space in the room
Rooms are very very hot, AC is weak and does not go down below 21 degrees - again, they claim this is for health and safety reasons. It's so hot that we have had to request fans
Do not stay here. There are many hotels at half this price where the service is much better.
Update - the gym stank so much we couldn't use it, the lock on the bathroom door didn't work, and to cap it all off, the manager blackmailed us out at checkout saying that if we delete this review and he can take a photo of the deleted review, they would give us a packed breakfast! The cheek of it! Suddenly health and safety policy was no longer! AVOID At All COSTS
author: Nicole

title: 利用したいホテル
text:
スタッフの対応は非常に良かったです
到着時に一人だけ日本語を使うスタッフがいたのですが、基本すべて英語対応です。
ホーチミン市内観光するには、非常に便利な位置にあります。

部屋に関してもお洒落で非常に良かったです。温水シャワートイレもついているので日本人的にとってはGOOD！
マイナス点は、バスタブ用のカーテンがないので、床が結構濡れますので注意です。
プールは広くはないですが、夜景を見ながら入るのも非常に気持ちよかったです。

深夜便での帰国でしたが、チェックアウト後荷物を預かってもらい、観光や夕食を終えたあと、（プール専用のレストルーム）シャワーを使わせてもらいました。

また利用したいホテルです。
author: TAKESHI

title: Perfekt
positives:
Thanks for All!! Perfekt Stay. Super Pool, nice Breakfast. Frindly Welcome and Service at the Rezeption. We enjoyed it very much. Cheap Cocktails and the Hot Stone Massage was fantastic
.Clean and big family Room. Think we come back again for Sure.
author: Doris

title: ロケーション抜群
text:
スタッフは非常に親切で、イベント日の渋滞でつかまらないタクシーを必死に探してくれたのがとても印象に残ってます。チェックイン時に教えて貰った道案内は間違えてたが、どのスタッフもお客の要望に応えようとする姿勢は立派でした。
ロケーションは最高で、ドンコイ通りで買い物して大きな荷物を一旦ホテルに置けに行けたので、便利だった。
また、デュオ演奏の中のアフタヌーンティーは、贅沢に過ごせた。
すこし、部屋が狭かったのが残念。
author: TORU

title: Excellent hotel in Saigon
positives: Perfect reception service! They seated us by serving us a welcome drink while we checked in. All the staff are very friendly and helpful. They met our needs. I highly recommend this hotel.
author: Fulford

title: お洒落なブティックホテル
text:
ローカルな雰囲気の中に小洒落たホテルって感じのロケーション
1本大きい道路に行くと、カフェもレストランも、有名な観光スポットもとても近いです。スタッフもとても優しく、日本語が話せる方もおられます。
エステも良い。プール利用しませんでしたが、素敵でした。アフタヌーンティーもふりーですが、生演奏が聴けて最高のホテルです。わたしは、必ずまた利用すると思います。お世話になりました。
author: ayu

title: Exceptional
positives: The rooms are large, spacious with a huge bed, which has a fantastic mattress. The bathroom offers every comfort. The hotel facilities are great, towels are changed every day. The laundry service works great. The continental breakfast offers any delicacy. But the most incredible sight is found on the tenth floor, where there is the swimming pool with a direct view of the Bitexco Tower. A dip in this pool is an experience of luxury and true relaxation! The only thing you can not use is the transfer service to the airport, given that the taxi costs much less.
author: Jochen

title: ロケーション良い！新しいHOTEL
text:
年末年始に、利用しました。
HOTEL自体が新しく、スタッフも、とても良く教育されています。
部屋も、綺麗でした。
BITXCO TOWERの近くで、今回は、朝食を付けませんでしたが、すぐ近くに、
ニューランもあり、困りません。
アフタヌーンティーは、あまり口に合わなかったです。
ベトナムっぽい感じで・・・。
プールは、少し小さいです。
全体的には、良いホテルだと思います。
author: Hiroshi

title: GOOD HOTEL
positives: Excellent hotel from all points of view. Location, 2 minutes from the pedestrian street, new, very clean, very kind staff. Spacious and clean room. The bathroom a little small. Desk equipped with everything necessary for business travellers. Roof area with swimming pool which is quite small but very well designed and therefore really pleasant. I highly recommend it.
author: Chris

title: 便利です。
text:
立地条件はいいです。
お洒落なデザイナーホテルといったとこでしょうか。
アフタヌーンティ(軽食)を楽しむことが出来ました。
ただ、バスタブがベッドと同じ部屋にあるので、二人で宿泊では入りずらいこともあるかと。

title: Outstanding experience
text:
I recently stayed at Au Lac Charner Hotel for four nights and had an excellent experience. Overall, the feeling and accommodation were very good. The staff were highly professional, always displaying a sincere attitude with friendly smiles. Additionally, the cleanliness of the hotel rooms was exceptional, and the pool and gym were well-managed.

The location is also very convenient. Although this is a small hotel, it gave me a sense of home. 

Due to work commitments, I spent six nights in Ho Chi Minh City, four of which were at this hotel and the other two at Amanaki Saigon Boutique Hotel. Even though both hotels are on the same street and are priced similarly, I highly recommend staying at Au Lac Charner Hotel.

title: Disappointing Experience Due to Noise and Old Facilities
text:
Unfortunately, my stay at this hotel wasn't as pleasant as I had hoped

Upon settling into my room, I discovered 3-4 bugs on the bed. Naturally, I informed the hotel staff, who were prompt in addressing the issue and tried their best to handle the situation. However, despite their efforts, the outcome was far from satisfactory. The bugs were removed, but the underlying problem seemed to persist, and I couldn't shake the worry that they might return in the coming nights.

As a result, my sleep quality was severely impacted. I was constantly anxious about the possibility of more bugs appearing, which made it difficult to relax and enjoy the stay. The staff mentioned that this issue is apparently common in Vietnam, which I found to be an unsatisfactory excuse for a hotel of this standard.

The main door of the room offered almost no insulation against noise from the hallway. Every time someone walked past, I could hear their footsteps, which became a constant source of disturbance. It was especially bothersome during the night, making it difficult to sleep peacefully.

Despite the hotel offering a nice pool and a great location, these issues with the room's condition and the lack of soundproofing really overshadowed the experience. While the location is great, I would recommend considering other hotels in the area that may offer better value, comfort, and quieter accommodations.

title: 최악의 수질상태
text:
5월 3일 저녁 6시에 체크인했습니다. 하지만 프론트 직원은 수질 문제에 대해 아무런 안내나 양해를 구하지 않았고, 관광을 마친 후 밤 12시에 호텔로 돌아와서야 엘리베이터에 붙은 종이를 통해 공지를 확인할 수 있었습니다.

공지에는 호치민시 내 수질 관련 청소 또는 공사로 인해 특정 시간대(07:00~17:00)에 수질 문제가 있을 수 있으며, 이에 따라 각 객실에 20L의 물이 제공된다고 안내되어 있었습니다. 그러나 공지된 시간대가 아닌 밤 12시에도 수질 상태는 심각했고, 여행용 정수 필터가 단 1분 만에 갈색으로 변색될 정도였습니다.

호텔에서 제공한 20L의 물은 수도꼭지 형태였지만, 샤워에 사용하기에는 매우 불편하고 비위생적으로 느껴졌습니다. 실제로는 세수와 양치 정도에만 사용할 수 있는 수준이었습니다.
밤늦은 시각이라 다른 호텔로 이동하기에도 피곤한 상황이었고, 이로 인해 불편한 숙박을 감수해야 했습니다.

다음 날 체크아웃하면서 이에 대해 프론트에 이야기하자, 직원은 정부 지침에 따른 것이라며, 인근 지역도 동일한 상황이었다고 설명했습니다. 그러나 실제로 호치민시를 관광하면서 이용한 식당이나 공공시설, 그리고 다른 여행객들이 묵었던 숙소들에서는 이와 같은 갈색 물을 본 적이 없었습니다. 호텔 측이 수도탱크나 정수 시스템 등 별도의 대비책을 마련했다면 충분히 완화할 수 있는 문제였다고 생각합니다.

직원들은 친절했지만, 체크인 시점에서 수질 문제에 대해 정확하고 사전적인 안내가 있었어야 하며, 단순한 종이 공지만으로는 충분하지 않았다고 느꼈습니다. 전체적으로 사전에 안내 부족, 부적절한 대처 방식, 다른 숙소 대비 미흡한 준비가 아쉬운 숙박이었습니다. 추천하지 않습니다.

title: 내 생애 최악의 호텔입니다.
text:
해외여행을 수십번 경험한 사람으로 지금 적는 글은 절대 과장이 아닙니다. 호치민
3성급 호텔 기준으로도 한참 낮은 수준의
호텔입니다. 단점들을 다 나열하기 힘들 정도입니다.
(문제점)
1.시티뷰 나오는 방으로 예약했지만 1층 뷰
없는 방으로 일방적 배정.
호텔측은 큰 방으로 배정했다고 했지만
사과 한 마디하고 끝남
서양인이 많은 호텔인데 한국인을 차별하는 느낌이었음.
2.바닥에 개미 출몰.
3.화장실 환풍기 안됨.
4.수시로 전원 꺼짐
5.욕실 샤워실 아래 돌 물이끼로
청결 문제.
6.금고 고장 및 기계에서 나오는 소음으로
고통 받음.
7.바닥청소 상태 나쁨. 맨발로 다닐 경우
검해짐.
8.1층 밖 실외기 작동 소리로 추정되는
소음 때문에 고통받음.
9.샤워실 가림막 악취.
10. 조식 3성급 보다 못한 노퀄러티
(특히 쌀국수)
11.화장실 물빠짐 심각
12.인터넷 속도 매우 느림.
13.휴지걸이 위치 불편
14.주변 유흥가로 자녀 동반 투숙 비추천
15.휴지 질 낮음.
결론:총체적 난국. 그나마 수영장 뷰는 좋네요.  그 외 3성급 호텔만도 못하고
현재의 평점에 대해 의구심이 듭니다.

So kind and friendly!
negatives: We stayed at Au Lac Charner for 3 nights at the beginning of our holiday and 3 nights at the end. We had a standard twin room with no windows the first time and upgraded to a Bonard Junior Suite for the last 3 nights. It definitely wasn’t worth the extra as the balcony was small with no view, and no furniture just an outdoor shower. The “sofa” in the room was actually a bench, similar to those in the Breakfast Room so it wasn’t suitable for relaxing on. Definitely not worth the extra €120 so I’d stick with the standard room next time.

text: 위치와 시설, 서비스는 훌륭합니다. 럭셔리풍의 호텔이라고 에약한 베란다가 있는 스위트룸은  기대달리 룸은 좁고 방내부에 욕조가 있고 욕실에는 변기와 세면대만 있고 정작 샤워기는 실외 베란다 구석편에 샤워기가 설치되어 있어  샤워이용 시에 많이 황당됩니다. 조식은 다양한 과일과 쌀국수,  종류는 많지 않지만 퀄러티가 괜찮았습니다.  추천사항은  무료 티서비시로  오후시간 한정된 시간동안이지만 간단한 다과와 음료, 과일들을  전망좋은 라운지바에서 즐기실 수 있습니다.  전체적으로 별4개이상은 줄 수 있었는데 직원태도만은  평점을 최하를 주고 싶지만  별3개를 드렸습니다.  저의 경우, 직원의 실수로 호텔로비에 맡겨 둔 짐이 분실했다는 사실,  임박한 탑승시간으로 공항가는 길에 다행히 먼저 출발한 손님으로부터 우여곡절 끝에 짐을 전달받아 공항에 도착하였던 순간은 짧지만 난감하고 황당한 경험이었습니다.

title: Fine, if a bit over priced and lacking on details.
positives: The location was great and breakfast very good. The bed was comfortable and the room broadly clean.
negatives:
The hotel control the air con. They set it to 21 degrees which whilst cool enough was still warm in the rooms for me. I have a heat sensitive condition so cooling down in a hot place is really important, j feel like as an adult I should be trusted to control my own aircon. 

Also, it was a honey moon trip and they offered to decorate the room, very kind, but they wanted a million dong to do it. I don’t expect decorations or anything, but I would say maybe just don’t offer to do it if you’re going to charge such a lot of money (for reference, almost all other hotels have put some flowers or something small, complimentary.) it wasn’t that I expected something special or free, it was that I felt they used the fact it was a honeymoon to get some more money. There was also a 10 dollar charge if you lose a key, we didn’t, but again, feels a bit money grabbing. 

Finally. On arrival they showed us a load of rooms and made us pick one which was a bit weird, we did it though and then after a short break they told us we couldn’t have that room after all and gave us another one, which begs the question why bother showing us them in the first place. Also, checkin is listed as being at 2, we arrived at 2:15 and couldn’t check in until 3.

text:

フロントほうで先に電話を切ってしまったり。

翌日朝、フロントに念のため話しにいったら
バスタブの修理について引き継ぎもされておらず！
昼間にも一度部屋に戻ることがあり確認しましたが直されておらず再度フロントの職員にお声かけしましたが、この時にも修理の話は初めて聞くとの反応、直しておくとの返答でしたが、夜帰ってチェックした際にはもちろん！直されていませんでした！

翌日、チェックアウト時にこのホテルに滞在してどうでしたか？よかったですか？って質問されて結構あきれました。

良いコメントを求める前に
業務上の必要対応と引き継ぎを
きちんとやってほしいです。



욕조를 사용하고 싶어서 이 호텔과 방 타입을 골랐는데
욕조는 고장난데다 체류 기간 동안 고쳐주지도 않았습니다.

같은 방을 이틀 예약했던지라
지금 못 고칠 것 같으면 방을 바꿔달라고 했는데
만실이라 안된다고 했고
내일 낮에 제대로 고쳐준다고 미안하다고 하더니
전화를 먼저 끊어버리질 않나..

다음날 아침 프론트에 혹시나 해서 확인했더니
욕조 수리에 대해서 인수인계가 제대로 되어있지 않았습니다.

낮에도 한 번 방으로 돌아갈 일이 있어 체크했지만
물론! 전날 밤 고장난 그대로 방치중이었고  다시 프론트에서 직원에게 말했는데 이때도 욕조 고장난 얘기는 처음 듣는다는 반응, 고쳐놓겠다는 답변이었지만 밤에 돌아와서 봤을 때도 물론! 고쳐놓지 않았습니다!

다음날 체크아웃할 때 이 호텔에 머무른 소감은 어떤가요?좋았어요? 라는 질문을 받아서 솔직히 너무 어이가 없었습니다.

좋은 후기을 바라기 전에 
업무상의 필요한 대응과 인수인계부터
제대로 했으면 좋겠네요
author: Ahn

title: Excellent value hotel on the centre of Ho Chi Minh City
positives:
Wonderful hotel, just minutes walk away from the Central Post office, Opera House, Ben Thanh Market etc. 

We opted for a standard room and it was excellent. Good size twin beds, good A/C a bath & shower, safe, iron etc. 

The breakfast is excellent! Great variety and everything very tasty. 

Staff in Reception and indeed throughout the hotel were friendly, courteous and very helpful. 

We have booked to return to Au Lac Charner at the end of our travels in Vietnam & Cambodia and I look forward to it very much.

title: Excellent
text:
여동생이랑 함께 묶었는데 처음에 업그레이드 해준다고 준 방이 청결상태 최악... 그렇게 먼지 많은 호텔룸 바닥 처음이였어요. 밖에있는 욕조상태도 너무 더러웠고. 방도 제가 원래 골랐던 방보다 너무 작은거 같아서 방 바꿔달라했습니다. 제가 진짜 여행오면 호텔은 잠만자는 곳이라 생각해서 방 상태가 별로더라도 걍 그러려니하고 쓰는데 제 생에 처음으로 방 바꿔달라 컴플레인 해보네요;;; 그래도 방 바꿔달라 하니 응대는 아주 빨랐구요. 원래 선택했던 방도 넓고 깔끔하고 쾌적했습니다.
수건에 빨간 잉크?? 같은게 좀 있던데 순간 생리인줄 알고 식겁했구요. 그래도 묻어나지는 않아서 그냥 그려러니 하고 썻습니다.
첫 단추가 맞지않아서 뒤에 불편한 부분이 틈틈 보였지만 그래도 만약에 처음부터 방에 일만 없었음 그냥 넘어갈수 있는 가벼운 것들 플러스 직원들의 친절한 미소가 너무 아름다워서 다 용서가 되는 부분들이였습니다.
방 청결과 수건 요 두 가지 일만 아니면 아주 만족스러운 스테이였다고 자신합니다.

Spotted some red marks on the towel which that made me think of menses? Maybe housekeeping should pay more attention on the cleaness the first room given to me was very dusty.
On the second day, i didnt ask for the housekeeping but the room was cleaned. Was not really comfortable with it but since it was already done so i just accept it. Thanks. Staffs are always freindly with warm welcoming smile. All of them speaks fluent english. I really love the atmosphere, design and even the music that plays at the lobby.
Overall, i will still would come back for the second time.

title: A good place for a staycation in HCMC
positives:
My wife and I stayed in the 'Executive Double Room'.
Room - Clean, modern, spacious and well-decorated. There were large windows with a decent view and lots of natural light. The bed was very comfortable and we got a very good night's rest. Last but not least, the jacuzzi bathtub was amazing and worth spending a good amount of time in!
Breakfast - A buffet with a good selection of options, both Vietnamese and Western. Very importantly, the coffee available was strong, black and satisfying.
Pool - Not quite a swimming pool, but instead a 'rooftop jacuzzi pool'. Nice to spend some time relaxing in with a drink, but quite small (it can realistically accommodate max. 10 people at a time).
Service - Polite and courteous.

title: Good experience
positives:
Spent just the NYE so of course it was a quite busy day and overall the experience was quite good. Our room was just like in the pictures when we booked it. 

Staff tried their best to help and provide a good service.
The swimming pool has a nice view and I also used the gym (enough equipment for a quick workout but the yoga mats were not cleaned).
negatives:
Of course there is room for improvements. As you might have read before, the hotel has too many rules. 

I understand their point on trying to reduce some damages that guests can cause (and by the way this has nothing to do with the employees or their services) but the hotel management could maybe be a bit less strict with those rules in order to avoid scaring people off.

One down point for me was that the sauna wasn't working well (tried to warm it up a few times but it didn't work)
At the end there was a bit of a push to leave a review while we were waiting to check-out. I also understand their side but I would go ease on that.

To sum up, the experience was positive and I believe the improvements pointed out could make the stay for future guests even better if taken into account.

text:

응웬후에거리 바로 앞이라 12시 넘어서 간식사먹고 산책하고 귀가도 가능.
작은 호텔답게 프랜들리해요. 그만큼 전문적인 태도는 기대하기 어렵습니다.

아고다 예약조건으로 10시 체크인~14시체크아웃, 룸 업그레이드 였는데요.
체크인할때 “너네 기념일이라 내가 특별히 업그레이드 해줄게.”라고 생색냈지만 알면서 귀여워서 넘어갔어요.
혹시몰라 체크아웃 시간 확인하니 12시반이라고 하길래, 예약조건 보여주고 마사지 예약이 있다고 부탁했지만 주말이라 안된다고 12시45분까지 오라고 하더군요..

위 체크아웃 시간과 수영장 청결상태 때문에 재방문은 고려해보겠으나 전반적으로 만족합니다.

Breakfast selection was okay for the level of hotel.
Enjoyed lobby's (christmas) decorations and size.
negatives:

There was occasional construction on the staircases, and mess/noise/open doors ensued.
Gym was too small and badly equipped to be inviting.

title: 베트남 가성비 최악은 역시 호치민인건가...
text:
부푼 마음으로 떠난 베트남 여행의 첫 번째 숙소였는데... 처음에는 이미지가 나쁘지 않았어요... 오래된 빈티지 느낌 나는 숙소? 정도의 이미지였는데 구경하고 와서 씻으려고 보니까 샤워실이 좁아서 욕조에 들어가서 씻어야 되는데 욕조는 뽀싸질 것 처럼 빈약하지(욕조 아래가 텅 비어서 무너질 것 같은 느낌), 샤워기 수리를 안해놔서 핸드샤워기로 돌아가지도 않지... 그래서 그날은 이미 아무생각 없이 들어갔더니 다 젖어서 욕조 물나오는 쪽에서 앉아서 샤워하고 난리도 아니었어요... 밤이라 사람을 부르지도 못하고... 그래서 다음날 리셉션에 얘기했는데 저는 당연히 마스터키도 있고 청소하러도 오니까 외출했다 오면 고쳐줄 줄 알았거든요? 근데 그때까지도 안고쳐 주고 심지어 밖에 외출하고 와서 한참을 기다려서야 사람이 왔어요 ㅎ... 정말 놀라운 처리 속도다... 한국이었으면 난리 났을거야... 하... 아무튼 수리공분도 친절하셨고 직원들도 전체적으로 친절했는데 저는 막 체크 아웃할때 애프터눈티 먹고 가라고 챙겨주고 막 좋다고 해서 기대했는데... 체크아웃 시간 딱 맞춰 나와서 그런지 카운터도 정신 없어보이고 막상 체크아웃하니까 저희한테는 관심도 없더라구요... 숙소를 고른 플러스 요인이 깍이면서 '별로 좋은 숙소는 아니구나.' 라는 결론을 내렸어요. 저는 호찌민-무이네-나짱 가는 코스를 일주일 짜서 간거였는데 호찌민에서는 여기에서만 묵었는데 일단 호찌민은 수도라고 가격도 쓸데 없이 비싼편이고벤탄 시장도 비슷해요... 나짱 가서 망고 샀는데 거의 절반 가격 받아서 충격먹었다는... 여기서 챙겨온 돈의 절반을 썼어요... 심지어 무이네랑 나짱 갔다 귀국할 때 보니까 돈이 남더라구요...? ㅎ...ㅎㅎㅎㅎ....? 유일한 장점은 베트남에 있는 유일한 세븐일레븐... 숙소 바로 옆에 있슴니다...  물가 미쳤어요... 베트남 사람들도 많이 가고 가격 걸어 놓고 파는거라 그런지 신뢰도 가고 저렴했습니다... 어쩌다 호찌민 얘기를 해버렸는데 여기 호텔 조식 종류는 많지 않은데 개인적으로 맛있는 곳이라고 생각했어요. 메뉴가 조금씩 바뀌더라구요. 종류가 많은 편은 아니구요. 사실 식당 자체가 좋은 편은 아니에요 ㅋㅋㅋ... 엄마가 생리 양이 많은 편인데 베트남 가서 갑자기 터져가지고 생리대 하고 잤는데도 샜더라구요. 세탁비 정도 청구할 줄 알았는데 그냥 구매 비용 자체를 청구해서 놀랐다는... 여기서 조금 빡쳤던건 청구 비용이 적힌 종이는 외출한 사이에 두고 가고 아침 먹을때 얘기했던 수리 해달라는 거는 외출한 사이에 해놓지도 않고 돌아와서 한참을 기다리게 했다는 거...? ^^... 이 호텔은 저에게 밥맛 호텔이 되었습니다...
좀 많이 새서 시트랑 아래 까는 패드랑 한화로 8-9만원 정도 내고 왔던 것 같네요... 아 수영장은 안들어가보고 구경만 하러 갔는데 작습니다... 애기들만 놀고 있더라구요. 그다지 깊어보이지도 않았어요. 저렴하게 간다고 하면 나쁘지 않지만 그렇게 추천은 안해요... 화장실이 정말 별로였어요...

 개미  많음.욕조에 물받으니  물에서 이물질이 나와 둥둥떠다님 ㅜㅜ  조식 먹을것 없음 .아고다에서 예약하고 비싸게 얻었는데  현지에서  재오픈 행사로  객실요금 40%  세일중이였음 . 아마도  covid19 으로  영업 중단했었던것 같음. 에프터눈 타임 없었음  그시간에 식당에 불 다꺼놓고  우리가 가니  불켜진 좌석으로 앉으라며  커피 가져다먹으라함.조식뷔페 식당에서  아침에 먹다 남은 커피였음 (보온병에 들어있음)  
청소제대로 안하고 수건이랑 일회용품만 채워줌  하... 진짜 
말해도  듣는둥 마는둥  .
들어오지 말라고 해도 남자청소직원  두명이서  두번이나 문따고  들어옴. 여자분들끼리  절대  가지마셈

title: 가성비 좋은 시내 중심 호텔
text:
호텔가격비교했을 때 가성비 좋음.
3인이라 single, double 침대 있는 방 사용.
조식부페 괜챦았음- 5성급 호텔정도는 아니지만, 쌀국수, 중국식 조식, 빵과 샐러드 좋았음.
애프터눈 티 4시쯤 있는데 홍차와 간단한 디저트, 빵, 케잌 먹을수 있음. 조식 늦게 푸짐하게 먹고, 점심겸 저녁으로 애프터눈티 세트 먹고 6시쯤 저녁외식해서 식대가 거의 들지 않았음.
시내 중심에 있어서, 마사지 샵, sky deck 전망대, 전통 로컬시장 가까와서 걸어다님.
공항세어 택시타고 30분쯤 걸렸고 택시비는 1만원정도 나옴.
한국인 없고, 투숙중 중국인, 일본인, 호주인, 인도인 등 봄.
단점- 수영장 작고, 화장실 시설이 깨끗하긴 하나 좀 올드함..

title: Lovely stay but disappointing breakfast.
positives: beautiful staff, nice pool on the 10th floor, great location, books to borrow in the lobby
negatives: Our room (408) smelt very damp every time you walked in.  We paid for a balcony and what we got was a narrow unattractive ledge with railing looking over rusted buildings which they tried to block out with a creeper.  The breakfast was very disappointing, tiny pieces of cheese that didn't even look like cheese, unappetising Asian-style dishes, deep fried dishes warmed by a heat lamp until they were dried out.  I know this is a first world problem, but I couldn't even get a cup of black tea even when I requested it.

author: Yvette

title: 가성비 최고 호텔
text: 한마디로 가성비 최고의 호텔. 호치민 1군지역 중심에 위치하여 어디든 가기가 편해서 좋았으며, 조식도 매우 좋았음. 특히 애프터눈티 서비스는 압권이었음. 직원들의 친절함 최고 수준이었음. 다만, 룸 내부가 좀 오래된 느낌이고 욕실 청소 상태가 옥에 티라면 티. 다시 호치민에 가면 다시 묶고 싶은 호텔.
author: YUN

title: Excellent
positives: Charming hotel middle of everything. Afternoon tea on the rooftop restaurant was really nice surprise
author: Jani

title: 추천합니다
text:
2박 숙박동안 불편한 없이 잘 묵었습니다. 
직원들 친절하고, 방 깔끔하고 넓었어요 (패밀리룸). 2층이라서 다소 아쉬었지만
크진 않지만 인피니트풀이 있어서 즐기려고 했는데, 시간이 부족해서 잠깐만 구경했네요. 낮시간보다는 밤 시간이 더 좋은 듯 합니다.
다음에 기회가 있다면 재방문 의사 있습니다.
author: Lee

title: Very good
positives: The location was good, easy to get to all the places we wanted to visit.
negatives: The staff forcing me to complete the review in front of them. Have now updated with my actual impressions.
author: Tim

title: 사진보다는 별로
text:
- 4성 이상에 평점 좋은걸로 필터걸어서 고심해서 정한 호텔인데 와보니 부띠끄 호텔이었음... 더 잘 안알아본 내 잘못이지만 ㅠㅠ 그래도 좀 실망. 우리나라 예쁜 모텔수준.... 그래도 조식포함 거의 9만원이었는데, 이정도는 우리나라에서도 충분히 갈정도임 그래서 실망..
- 수영장 진짜 짱짱작음 방도 진짜 작음.....
- 대신 위치 하나는 진짜 끝내줌. 나가서 2분만 걸으면 바로 인민청사 앞 여행자거리고, 주변에 음식점이나 디저트가게도 많음. 관광하는거/ 걸어서 돌아다니는거 좋아하는 사람한테는 진짜 최고의 위치임
- 직원들은 굉장히 친절하고 세심하게 잘 챙겨주고 진짜 쉐라톤 못지않게 서비스는 좋음.
- 조식은 별로였음 6-10시인데 9시 20분쯤 갔을 때 먹을거 거의 안남아있어서 진짜 와 먹을거 없다만 하다가 옴
- 웰컴드링크랑 과일 줌, 애프터눈 티는 조식뷔페랑 비슷했음 이거때문에 여기 선택할 필요는 없음

걍 의식의 흐름대로 썼는데 결론을 내리자면, 
* 우리나라 홍대, 이태원같은 느낌으로 노는 젊은 친구들끼리 왔을땐 위치가 너무 좋아서 만족할듯
* 가족이나 연인끼리 휴가온거라면 그닥 추천하진 않음
author: Bitna

title: Disappointed
positives: Complimentary afternoon tea was lovely. Hot tub at the private terrace was great. Romantic room but extremely uncomfortable.
negatives:
The coffee was awful. The bed frame unnecessarily sharp and high so I bruised my legs several times. It was not possible to close the bathroom door noiselessly, the process demanded a lot of muscular strength. The toilet bidet was not functioning during our arrival. 
   For the first time in my life I saw such a threatening letter in a hotel room- A compensation fee will be applied for stains on the linen. And USD 10 charge for lost keys. A bit too much I think.
author: Ene

title: 위치도 좋고 가격도 좋고!
text:
위치 좋았어요 직원들도 친절하구요
한가지 아쉬웠던건 제가 묵었던방은 샤워부스가 발코니 쪽에 있어서 불편했어요.
그리고 샤워커튼이 조금 지저분... 
그거외엔 만족스러웠습니다. 
덕분에 편안히 여행했습니다. 감사합니다.
author: LEE
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Value for money stay in HCM
positives: Excellent location. Nice boutique hotel. We almost cancelled our booking having read Google reviews … happy that we went ahead. The hotel is absolutely fine; it seems some guests, feeling very overly entitled, rush to placing 1 star reviews when their fairy godmother fails to make their every last wish come true.
author: Beverley

title: 호치민에서 제일 좋았던 장소
text:
처음 방문한 호치민에서 수많은 고민끝에 결정한 숙소인데 탁월한 선택이었어요! 
위치 또한 중심지에 있어 벤탄시장 기준으로 걸어서 10분정도였고, 아파트먼트 카페랑도 걸어서 너무 가까워요. 
직원분들이 무지하게 친절하셔요!!! 
4일 동안 지내면서 오며 가며 미소 없는 직원을 본적이 없을 정도였어요~ 
조식도 종류도 나름다양하고 맛있습니다. 여기에 이 호텔만의 또 다른 장점은 오후에 애프터눈서비스를 진행하는데 다양한 차 종류와 피스케익들을 먹을 수 있답니다:) 
다 만족스럽지만 별을 몇개 뺀 이유는 방음이 다소안된다는 부분과 마지막날 밤에 수영하는데 거기서 바퀴...형님을 보았어요 ㅠ 
제 방으로 기어 내려올까봐 완전 무서웠어요. 
그런 부분을 제외하곤 너무나 만족스러워요:)
재방문 의사 있습니다
author: SUMI

title: Nice hotel with perfect location
positives: Good location
negatives: The breakfast was quite limited for a European.

negatives: It’s a bit dated and perhaps has tried to squeeze too much into the top floor pool and afternoon tea room.

title: 정말 가성비 갑이에요!
text:
무이네 가기전 호치민 1박이라 별 기대없이 예약했던 곳인데 정말 최고였어요. 

직원들 모두 하나같이 친절하고, 지리적으로도 모든곳이 가까워요. 샤워벨브가 망가져서 프론트에 이야기하니 바로 오셔서 수리해줬어요. 

월컴푸드도 맛있고, 루프탑 뷰 맛집이니 다른 곳 안가셔도 됩니다:)

애프터눈티는 시간이없어 이용못한 부분이 제일 아쉬워요! 수영장 및 룸 컨디션 모두 최고였어요. 다음에도 방문할 의사 100%입니다.

title: 감동적인 호텔
text: 여긴 진짜 별 10개 주고 싶어요! 체크인 후에 모든 시설과 애프터눈티 이용가능하다 해서 밤비행기 타기 전에 루프탑에서 수영하고 샤워하고 차마시고 별 거 다 했네요. 짐은 무제한 맡아주고요. 떠날 때 짐 들어 주고 그랩 타는 것까지 도와주더라구요. 넘 고마움 ㅋㅋ 현금이 빠듯해서 팁 많이 못 준 게 못내 맘에 걸립니다. 객실이며 조식이며 모자란 게 하나도 없네요. 비슷한 가격에 로비 웅장한 곳 찾으시면 프린스 가시구요. 아담하면서 예쁘고 편안하고 기분좋은 곳 찾으시면 딱입니다. 비텍스코 코앞이라 택시 타기도 편하구요. 위치도 좋아요. 시청에서 걸어서 10분 정도니 날이 아주 뜨겁지만 않으면 걸을만해요. 많이들 이용하세요~

The swimming pool photos looks beautiful, however, the pool is tired and worn out and the steps are not marked. This is a serious hazard if someone is not paying attention. Wouldn’t stay again

The breakfast was disappointing, the food was very average and there was not much choice. There was very little fruit and when I asked staff to cut up a mango they told me I can do it myself.

negatives: We were given a room, not one we booked. We ordered a room with the bath inside. We were given one with the bath outside and the room was much smaller, I would not have booked this room for various reasons, privacy and weather, both not good! title: Excellent choice
positives:
Breakfast was exceptional.... enjoyed different kinds of soups and Vietnamese bread.
Located very close to all the shopping centres , harbour and Saigon square where people have lots of fun in the evening.
All the staff are very friendly and helpful.
negatives:
Swimming pool not as expected. Quite small and no Steel bars to get in and get out of the pool for senior citizens. My uncle found it very difficult..
Otherwise the hotel is very good.
Breakfast and tea we used to look forward to.
Rooms were always kept clean.
author: Mahanthi

title: 위치빼고 다 별로였어요...
text:
위치는 좋으나, 호텔 들어가면서 나는 향이 좋지 않았어요... 가족객실을 예약했는데 1층 해가 들지 않은 곳에 배정해줬는데 이불에 곰팡이가 피어 있어서 방을 바꿔 달라고 요청했더니 그제서야 7층으로 배정해줬다는... 빛 잘들어오는 같은 객실이 있었음에도 왜 지하같은 깜깜한 방을 배정해줬는지 이해가 가질 않았어요...
새로 지은 호텔이 아니라 리모델링한 호텔이라 객실컨디션이 우리나라 모텔수준도 안된다는... 왜 평점이 높은 건지 이해가 안돼요... 수영장도 작고 사진빨이라는... 퇴실할때도 받지도 않은 마사지 영수증을 내밀고 확인할때까지 기다리라고 해서 그랩 택시기사 기다리게 하고... 호텔때문에 호치민에 대한 기억이 안좋게 남았네요...

title: Excellent

text:

author: JIMIN
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Amazing staff, wonderful location with plenty of shops/restaurants very close by.
positives:
* The staff were amazing and they absolutely made the stay here!  We were welcomed so warmly whenever we came into the hotel. They helped patiently with our many questions :) We needed some advice regarding local trips/tours as well as where to eat, they gave brilliant suggestions and were just the loveliest people! They are a credit to the company! 
* The location is great! We had stayed at another hotel for a few days prior, and this one was much easier to get around - everything you need on the doorstep, including little convenience stores. 
* The afternoon tea is a really super touch. A nice mix of options and beautiful location to sit and have a snack and a drink!
negatives:
* The bathroom was a little tired, all worked/functioned as it should, but there were some areas that needed to be looked at, especially to be at a 4 star rating.  
* The bar closes quite early, we went to see if we could get a drink just before 10, and it was already closing, and no room service option at this time either, not so great if you check in later. 
The staff more than made up for any little niggles we experienced though!! :)
author: Amy

title: 호치민 최고의 호텔
text:
덥고 시끄럽고 정신없는 호치민에서 유일하게 호텔이 좋았습니다.. 
우선 입구부터 세련되고 모던한 시설에 모든 질문에 친절하게 답해주는 리셉션 직원, 객실 내부도 깨끗했으나 다른 방 소음이 조금 들립니다.
체크아웃 후에도 시간 관계 없이 짐을 보관해주었고, 3시부터 5시까지 무료 에프터눈 티에 서비스되는 케이터링도 훌륭했습니다.
스카이덱 바로 근처로 접근성도 우수합니다. 호치민에 또 방문할진 모르겠으나, 방문하게 되면 다시 묶고 싶네요.

title: Exceptional
positives: We love all the staff, they are so friendly and smiling all the time. My kids still talk about how good and friendly they are.
negatives: One observation I've made is that Level 9 has a staff room. However, upon seeing the staff room, it doesn't seem to blend with the overall beauty and tranquility of the hotel's interior. While the hotel boasts a stunning and peaceful design, the staff room lacks color and appears gloomy. I have a strong belief that the hotel staff exhibit excellent attitudes and take pride in their work. I hope the hotel owner can consider improving the staff room to align with the high standards set by the rest of the establishment. Additionally, I am hesitant about expressing my concerns for fear that my comments might lead to the removal of the staff room. However, I have confidence that the hotel owner can invest in the future of the hotel alongside all staff members.

title: Old world charm
positives:
This hotel location was in District 1 just near the Ho Chi Minh City Skydeck and that made it easy to visit the river area, most of Ho Chi Minh City sightseeing sites and for tour pickups. The hotel helped us arrange a small group tour to Cu Chi tunnels which went quite well. Reception had a money exchange and could handle Australian dollars and were very helpful.

I liked the room. The bed was comfortable and there was a desk, chair, fridge and adequate charging spots. The luggage storage was well thought out. The bathroom was roomy and had one of the fancy electronic toilets. We were on the 9th floor by the end of the passage and could look out from there across the city. I liked the mostly white décor and old-time photos.

The 10th floor had an outside L-shaped pool which was pleasantly cool with views over Ho Chi Minh City with tables and deck chairs. The included breakfast buffet on the ground floor was excellent and changed a little bit every day. It had cook-on-request omelettes or fried eggs as well. A complimentary afternoon tea was available between 2:30 and 4:00pm on the 10th floor which we also quite enjoyed with some savory options and a lot of "high tea desert options" again with slightly different options daily. This was also where you could order pool-side drinks and food. Both areas were light and airy with that old world charm and never felt crowded.  All staff were cheerful and helpful.

Since we had a late flight I tried to arrange a late checkout for the day we were leaving but they were fully booked out. However, they said it wasn't a problem. They would store the bags, we could still access the pool area and the associated showers (useful in Ho Chi Minh City's humidity) until we were were ready to leave for the airport. They booked a taxi for us and when we left Au Lac Charner Hotel in very heavy rain the staff were very solicitous, helped us with the bags and covered us with umbrellas so we wouldn't get wet.

title: 难忘的一场旅行
text:
这次是和同事来越南出差。我们撒都是第一次来越南，自然也是第一次来胡志明。
摩托车大军在街道上浩浩荡荡，好吓人。让我想到小时候的场景。
       言归正传，酒店在闹市区，具体说就是最繁华的第一区，隔壁就是最高的大楼。出行非常方便，吃住玩都非常便利。
     酒店其实不大，倒也非常温馨，刚来的时候，服务员就很热情主动给我们提行李，才刚刚登记入住，一楼的大堂往里走是酒店的餐厅，那时候好像有什么活动，服务员说现在是下午茶时间，是免费的，诚挚邀请我们一行加入，酒店还特意请了钢琴师和小提琴手在餐厅给客户演出。
     讲真，是我第一次入住有免费下午茶的酒店，洋溢热情真诚笑脸的服务员，曼妙的音乐声，装修温馨舒适的大堂，第一印象，这个酒店让我觉得非常好。
     事实上，我们住了一个礼拜，酒店也的确让我们非常满意。不管是房间的床和被单，空调的温度，浴室的装修和洗漱用品和毛巾，小到地毯的材料，独具越南特色的草拖鞋，我们都非常满意。
    平日里出门打车，服务员都会用自己手机上的grab给我们叫车，因为真的好便宜啊。后来我自己下载了一个。
    回国前一天，酒店还给我们写了感谢信，两小块巧克力很用心。

  总之，强烈推荐啦。
all in all, we love this hotel. we would book silverland hotel again if we visit Vietnam in future. 
thanks.

negatives: Because of the elegant surroundings it felt a little tasteless to have signs threatening certain behaviours with fines ($10) - this included a charge for uneaten food left on your plate at the buffet(!) breakfast or losing a room key card. These types of signs really didn't suit the ambiance so well curated by the staff and left a bad taste.
