Staff experience was different from other hotels we stayed in Vietnam, some were very helpful others I would say aloof.
negatives: We booked a suite and first room we were given was very odd. It felt like a wide corridor or a big bathroom with a basin out in and two glass doors one leading to a shower and one to a toilet. My kids were in the excec Hamelin rooms which had much better layout.

text:
Хороший милый отель за свои деньги с хорошим расположением  в центре города. Останавливались в нем 2 раза. Были в разных номерах.  Номера чистые и аккуратненькие в постельных тонах.  Отличаются номера тем, что в одном душ находится на балконе, а ванна в комнате. В другом  номере ванна на открытой террассе с прикрытыми кустиками с душем как положено в отдельной комнате(№709 ). 
От аэропорта на такси ехать максимум 15-20 минут, стоит около 200-250 т. донг, из отеля в аэропорт 160 т. донг.  Завтраки в основном азиатские, но сосиски и куриное рагу так же есть в ассортименте. Очень вкусные супчики Фо Га и Фо Бо.  
Отель находится в шаговой доступности от торговых центров.  
Для себя решили, что этот отель подходит если есть время на шопинг и прогулок по центру.

title: Fantastiskt läge och tyst rum.
text: Det bästa med Au Lac Charner hotel är läget, det kan knappast bli bättre. Gångavstånd till mycket och många bra restauranger runt hörnet. Vi fick först ett rum som luktade starkt av avlopp, vet inte om det är ett allmänt problem på hotellet men vi fick snabbt byta till ett luktfritt. Hotellrummet var bland de mindre under vår resa i Vietnam och lite gammaldags inrett. Även badrummet var litet och jag tyckte att det var ganska bökigt att duscha i badkaret och dessutom väldigt halt. Vi hade ett rum med utsikt mot gatan men det var förvånansvärt tyst och vi sov väldigt gott. Mycket trevligt, men pyttelitet, poolområde som var en räddning i ett hett Saigon.  Svårt att få plats att sitta/ligga där dock, många verkade tillbringa hela dagarna vid poolen. Ok frukost. Hade önskat vanligt svart te, men det fanns endast jasminte.  Så även på hotellets afternoon tea,  ett annars väldigt trevligt initiativ som på flera hotell vi bodde på i Vietnam.  På Au Lac Charner  var det kanske inte högsta klass på kakorna men helt ok.

title: awesome!
text: 飯店設計非常有氣質，每一位員工都用心在服務客人，而且非常親切有禮，重點是飯店真的很美，在外面晃了一天，每次回到飯店都有回到天堂的感覺
author: CHIA

title: 地理位置超優 超方便
text: 工作人員非常熱心 房間大又乾淨 美中不足游泳池超小 地理位置離景點都很近 值得再度入住的一家飯店
author: CHEN

title: Excellent!
text: 這次跟朋友三人來旅行，在Agoda預訂了這間評價很好的飯店，果然名不虛傳，飯店地點位置非常好，交通方便！早餐及下午茶buffet很好吃，人員也很貼心，預訂當天是我生日，還準備了蛋糕及卡片，覺得很開心！下次來越南旅遊還是會預訂這間！
author: Illy

title: 咖啡公寓、阮惠步行街廣場、金融塔 近在咫尺
text: 飯店位於熱鬧地帶，距離必去的幾個景點步行都只要幾分鐘，附近有很多餐廳、便利商店。飯店內設施完善，頂樓有游泳池、蒸氣房、還有按摩spa。訂房附贈早餐與免費下午茶，皆在一樓採自助式，餐點種類不算多，但還算精緻，每天會替換部分餐點，但連續住三晚，還是會有點吃膩的感覺，下午茶跟早餐部分吃到的東西差不多有水果、麵包、茶等等。床軟硬適中，冷氣空調的溫度OK，整體推推。
author: Tien-yu

title: CP值高的飯店
text: 交通方便且鬧中取靜,早餐.下午茶都很豐盛,飯店工作人員服務態度非常好,是一間CP值很高的飯店,很值得去住!
author: Chien
room_type: Ruffier Deluxe Twin Room without Window

title: 超級貼心的飯店~非常值得推薦。
text:
房間大，位置好，走出來不用3分鐘斜對面轉角就可以到Miu Miu SPA 按摩囉~5分鐘可以到EON SKY BAR~
進出飯店門口都會有服務員很熱心幫開門及提東西，還會親自送水果到房門口，入住當天是本人生日，很貼心地準備卡片跟小蛋糕，真的是很大的驚喜令人感動，下次有機會再來越南還是會來住這。
author: JingYu

title: Excellent
text: 地理位置非常棒，附近步行就可以到很多餐廳、景點、酒吧，價格相對也非常便宜，CP值很高。員工非常友善親切，特別要感謝一位先生幫我們搬大型游泳圈，可惜大家穿泳衣身上沒帶小費。不過整潔度還可以再進步，浴室跟地板有些灰塵跟小紙屑，但整體來說在這裡度過一段很開心的時間~~
author: Siao

title: 值得一再回訪的飯店
text: 服務人員非常熱情、親切，細心注意我們的需求，地理位置也很棒，下次會再回訪。
author: CHUN

title: 服務佳，地點好，很乾淨
text: 飯店經理人超好，第一天的房間本來在低樓層，反應給他們想住在高樓層，隔天馬上幫我們升等。且飯店的地理位置也很好，就在金融塔旁邊，離miumiu SPA 按摩也很近，早餐也很好吃還有免費的下午茶，之後去一定還會在選這間。
author: CHIH

title: 很棒
text: 越南不是一個到處都有冷氣的地方，飯店也不例外，還好的是房間冷氣溫度夠，整體上來說，算是一個精緻美的飯店。
author: ShihShiao
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: 客服人員都很友善，願意幫忙
text: 用心，值得推薦的好飯店
author: SHEN

title: 服務好!
text:
飯店位置好,樓下有換錢所,便利商店,吃吃喝喝店家很多,旁邊就是金融塔,MIUMIU按摩,高島屋和咖啡公寓也很近.
飯店人員服務好,隨時都是笑臉迎人,不小心遺失房卡,也是馬上補發,且沒有額外費用,服務100分.
飯店早餐的河粉跟春捲,比外面的一堆店家好吃太多,下午茶部分也不錯.
飯店房間部分.我的房型浴缸在房間內,淋浴在陽台,淋浴部分還滿喜歡的,天氣熱出門回來就去淋浴,一天洗了3-4次,
床也滿舒服,飲料水果免費.
頂樓設施,泳池健身房SPA之類的,有上去看了一下,乾乾淨淨的,沒使用不評論.
個人覺得缺點部分,走道及電梯沒有冷氣,在房間內有時會聽到別間房關門聲(建議飯店在房間門貼上防撞隔音泡棉)

總結.這次住宿2晚,整體來說90分,推薦入住喔!
author: MEI-HSIEN
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: 棒
text:
飯店設計非常美，且check in時會提供小茶點，很加分，另外每天下午都有供應下午茶(buffet)，若早上有需要早起參加local tour，可以請飯店協助外帶早餐。服務人員態度良好、時常掛著笑容，讓人感覺非常舒服~~
除此之外，飯店位置優良，步行可到金融塔、咖啡公寓、濱城市場等著名景點，一切非常便利:)
author: Yahui

title: 超棒的飯店

title: Above average

title: 飯店位置附近很熱鬧，很多餐廳、飲料店跟蛋糕店，不會餓到！
text:
飯店服務人員都很親切，入住期間因為手機遺留在Grab上，飯店人員很積極的幫忙與司機說明聯繫！
早餐選擇多，入住三晚，除了固定菜色外，每天都有不同的東西～
飯店環境跟設施也都蠻好拍的，網美必去～
author: YI

title: 入住這間飯店是來到胡志明市最正確的選擇
text: 飯店的建築風格與香氛都很有品味，服務人員很稱職有禮貌。住在古典合併現代的法式飯店裡，裡面還有戶外漂亮泳池、有落地窗的健身房、按摩預約，一切都很滿意！

title: 高級的旅遊住宿

房務人員們非常細心且貼心，還幫我們把載走我們行李和朋友的Grab司機叫回來，真的幫了大忙！（差點要跟朋友分開去機場了）

飯店位置距離金融塔和miumiu2x2很近，到咖啡公寓只要5-8分鐘，可惜只有住一晚，下次來還想住這裡！

title: Food not labeled, allergy concerns.
text:
Had the afternoon tea and was told by staff that it was a pork pastry but it turns out to be pineapple pastry. Husband has a severe allergy to pineapple. Informed staff but they do not seem to understand the severity.

Asked for breakfast box for early check out at 5:45 am but was told it's not available until 6:00am because staff starts at 5:30 am. Even 3 star places have breakfast boxes available as early as 4:00 am. Staff can make the box in the evening and put in the fridge for tomorrow as done by other hotels. Pretty easy to pack a few pastries and add a water and juice box.

Also I informed them that we were celebrating a birthday and was told that they would do something special. However nothing was done yet they celebrated the birthday of the group seated next to us during breakfast?

Very disappointed.
author: R

Au Lac Charner Management team

title: Perfect boutique hotel, amazing service, great location.
text:
Excellent service from all staff. Friendly and personable, they go the extra mile to provide support like keeping our luggage after check out and keeping our dry cleaned laundry until we came back. The staff speak very good English.

Breakfast was a buffet style: assortment of seasonal fruits, salad bar, cheese, ham, omelette station, noodle station, porridge station, toast, assortments of cooked items: vegetables, fried rice, pork, dumplings, etc; juices, tea, coffee. 6 am start.

Afternoon tea was an assortment of fruits and small pastries, desserts.

Pool area has a view of the city. Lots of lounge area.

Foot massage was amazing, lie down, included arms, hands, great, face, neck.

Room size is small, but considering the location is understandable. Needs were comfortable. Bathroom comes with a bathtub, toilet worked. Beautiful stone tiles.

Other guests were respectful and pleasant. Serves a more mature crowd.

Walking distance from many popular areas.

title: Au Lac Charner
text:
Au Lac Charner is a very nice small hotel very well-situated in District 1. It is a short walk to all the iconic sights like the Opera House, Independence Palace, Central Post office, Notre Dame Cathedral, and the Bitexco Tower.

The staff were all very friendly and helpful, and happy to offer sensible tourist advice.

Breakfast was a delicious buffet affair with a lot of choice. Afternoon tea was a delight. The presentation was immaculate, with delicate cakes and fruit portions beautifully presented. This was the highlight of the day for us!

The (Vannier) room we booked was perfectly adequate and was cleaned daily.

The only negative was the sun deck. The pool itself is fine, but there are only 5 sunbeds which tend to get taken quickly. 

For the price, we would rate this hotel highly, and if we ever return to HCMC, we would definitely stay there again.
author: Nicholas

title: Family & Friends Bonding in Saigon
text:
We spent my hubby's birthday in Saigon and Au Lac Charner Hotel was such a charming hotel. Upon arrival, they collected our passport for the room assignments and directed us to go to rhe 10th floor for the afternoon tea. It was delightful with the yummy pastries and fruits and tea 
The ambience was also nice.
Our room was also nice with an outdoor jacuzzi ( rm 710).
The bed and pillows were very comfy.
What was a little bit of a let down was the breakfast buffet because most of the choices were pork and our family was non pork eater.
But generally we enjoyed our stay. The staff were all accommodating and friendly.
Shopping and restaurants are all walkable. Bitexco Skydeck was just around the corner. We will surely be back to this hotel

title: Fine for a 2N stay - but read fine print on the VIP package!
text:
Au Lac Charner is a good hotel in the centre of District 1. Walking distance to all the popular sights in Saigon.  Clean sheets and sound buffet breakfast with most staples for both Asian and Western pallets offered. 
Don’t be fooled with the VIP package as advertised on Agoda. Early checkin is subject to availability - advertised a 10am but didn’t settle in to the room until 1pm.  We were initially given a room with no shower inside the room - it was on the balcony with little privacy from surrounding high rises. After an assertive talk with the checkin staff they changed the room type to the one actually pictured on Agoda.  After these initial discrepancies it was a pleasant stay. Only other comment is the deck around the pool is very cosy/often no spare seats, you just have pick the right time to use this facility.

title: Exceptional service, great location and beautiful room.
text: What more could you ask for - a beautiful paradise to retreat to after a day in Ho Chi Minh. The service is next level - run by a beautiful hotel manager, the staff are all incredibly attentive. I had afternoon tea which was really yummy, jumped in the rooftop pool with a view of the city late at night which was magic. I didn’t realise that the location is great until after I booked it - walking street is the next street over - heaps to explore in the local area. The guest reservation staff are really passionate about being tour guides so can steer you in the direction of great locations to explore. Thank you so much for my lovely stay!
author: Louise
room_type: Bonard Junior Suite with Double Bed

title: Brilliance all round!
text: Perfect location, such comfortable beds, amazing buffet breakfast. Attentive staff and gorgeous rooftop pool. This will be the only place I stay at in Saigon from now on, and I visit often.
author: Nathan

title: Overrated
text:
The free upgrade was not given on check in. The next best room was offered. There were 3 alternate room types for the upgrade and after extensive requests we managed to get the room. The room was large and decorated in dated furniture. 
The breakfast quality was average at best. Choices but quality was sub standard. Times when they ran out of items. 
The pool needed attention as did other facilities. The afternoon tea was welcomed but seldom used. 
The Hotel is on a side street backing onto a market stall. The front street is busy and the footpaths are deteriorated and filled with litter. 
The hotel is close to some nice restaurants but is surrounded by a very seedy environment. 
I would personally stay elsewhere.
author: James

title: Best boutique hotel I’ve ever stayed in
text: Can not fault a single thing. Comfortable beds, lovely rooms, an incredible buffet breakfast, location and the staff such lovely attentive people. Will only stay here every time I visit HCM. 10/10!!!

title: BRILLIANT!!!!!!!
text:
Into day 3 of my stay at the Au Lac Charner.
The most exceptional hotel I have ever stayed in.
Not only is the hotel first class but the staff are what makes a hotel and I can honestly say the team here are just fantastic.
From the fun guys at the Conceirge to the customer service team to the house keeping and food and beverage team a big THANK YOU.
The room is cleaned meticulously daily, the breakfast is top class and delicious and the room WOW!!! with a outdoor balcony spa bath.
The other feature that sets this hotel apart is the complementary afternoon tea service.
The pool is also a very welcome sight after a day in the hot Saigon weather.
I can’t wait to stay here in my next trip to HCMC.

Worst service ever. My friend came and parked his motorbike at the carpark. Receptionist called me right away and demanded that I bring my friend down for registration, which we complied since it was after 10pm. He looked at my friend's ID and continued talking to him in Vietnamese without explaining it to me, until I asked him what in the world was going on. He demanded that I pay for an extra occupant but I insisted that my friend just came for a visit and wasn't staying for the night as he had assumed. And then the receptionist said my friend would not be allowed to go up again and insisted we chat at the bar. His attitude sucked in spite of my trying to explain to him how my friend merely came to pass me something. This is the worst reception i ever had staying in a hotel in Vietnam. Two thumbs down!

title: Exceptional
text: I checked in the night before, and getting the room was quick and smooth as always. I went up to the room to freshen up and take a little rest before working. The next morning, since I had the room key, I went straight to my room early. The breakfast was delicious: today there was tasty meat porridge. The sticky rice was good, and the sausages here are particularly delicious; I always love to enjoy the sausages with coffee. The Vietnamese bread is always good. The sweet tangerines are nice. Especially since it’s the season for rambutan and lychee, the hotel has offered seasonal desserts, which is very nice. The TV has a wide range of channels and the internet is very strong. I am working very effectively. It continues to be my first choice for travel, a luxurious resort stay, and where I can enjoy good food while working.
text_original: Mình nhận phòng từ đêm trước lấy phòng vẫn nhanh gọn như mọi khi. Lên phòng tắm rửa nghỉ ngời làm việc tí. Sáng hôm sau có thẻ phòng nên lên thẳng phòng sớm. Ăn sáng ngon: hôm nay có cháo thịt ngon. Xôi ngon, lạp xưởng ở đây đặc biệt ngon mình lần nào cũng thích nhâm nhi lạp xưởng với cafe. Món bánh mì Việt Nam ngon luôn. Quýt ngọt thích. Vẫn luôn là lựa chọn đầu tiên cho du lịch tại chỗ nghỉ dưỡng sang chảnh và làm việc ăn ngon.

title: A perfect place for a short 2–3 day stay in Ho Chi Minh City
positives:
What I really liked about my stay at Win Hayat in Ho Chi Minh City was how smooth and flexible everything felt from the start. The biggest highlight for me was the 24-hour check-in system no stress about early arrivals or waiting around, which is honestly a game changer after a long journey.

I also appreciated the contactless check-in process, which was super convenient and quick. The property offers a great city view, especially with its proximity to the Saigon River, making the overall experience even more relaxing.

On top of that, the location is quite good close enough to key areas while still feeling calm and comfortable. Overall, it made the stay hassle free and very enjoyable.
negatives:
What I didn’t particularly like about my stay was the lack of on site staff. While the self-service and contactless system is convenient, it can feel a bit impersonal at times. There’s limited human interaction, which makes it harder if you need immediate assistance or have specific requests.

I think having at least some staff presence or quicker support options would really improve the overall guest experience.

title: Industrial, Minimalist, and Clean – but Pricey
text:
This hotel follows a very industrial and minimalist concept—no drama, no unnecessary frills, just the essentials. The full-glass window is a nice touch, the bed is comfortably soft with fresh pillows, and the towels are crisp white and spotless. The bathroom is basic, but hygiene is clearly a priority.
Downside;
• Location: Although in District 1, it’s at the far end. Walking to the center can take 30 minutes or more. Very few shops nearby—only a 7-Eleven and Mini Stop.
• Ambience: The décor and furniture are solid, but the vibe leans heavily industrial—functional rather than glamorous.
• Room: Clean, new-looking, and minimal. Space is tight, just enough for the bed, with little room to move around.
• Price: Feels too high for what the hotel offers.
Overall: If you value cleanliness, a comfortable bed, and friendly staff over extra amenities or décor, this is a solid choice. Just be aware of the location and the price point.
Rating: Comfortable and safe, but overpriced for its status.

title: Für 1 Person und für 1-2 Nächte völlig ok, aber kein 4-Sterne Standard.
positives: Ausgefallen gestaltetes Hotel. Sehr gute Matratzen und Bettwäsche. Gute Auswahl an Kissen. Grosses Fenster für Aussicht aus dem Zimmer, gebucht war mit Cityview und das haben wir auch bekommen. Zimmer und Bad war sauber. Verkehrslärm von draußen war annehmbar. Kostenlose Wasserflaschen aus Glas verfügbar, ansonsten bekommt man meisten Plastikflaschen in den Hotels. Frühstücksauswahl war gut, auch wenn etwas zu chaotisch aufgebaut ist und die Sitzplätze begrenzt waren.
negatives: Moderne Gestaltung der Zimmer muss man mögen. Zimmer sehr sein klein, ok für eine Person, aber zu wenig Platz für ein Pärchen mit zwei Koffern. Bad ist winzig, man muss hintereinander ins Bad, denn für zwei gleichzeitig im Bad war kein Platz. Die Idee mit Badtüre und Duschtüre in einem ist dämlich, da das Wasser vom Duschen dann in den Eingangsbereich tropft. Nachts konnte man das Gluckern von irgendwelchen Wasser oder Abwasserleitungen hören, leider recht laut. Toilette funktionierte nicht und wurde nach 1-2 Stunden gerichtet. Hatten Glück, dass es nicht mitten in der Nacht passiert ist und jemand sein grosses Geschäft bereits gemacht hat. Frühstückssaal war so aufgebaut wie auf einem Bahnhof, wer gemütlich in ruhiger Atmosphäre frühstücken will, ist dort nicht glücklich. Personal war stets bemüht, jedoch reicht das nicht für ein 4-Sterne Hotel. Wir waren in Vietnam schon bei besseren 4-Sterne Hotels zum gleichen Preis. Für eine Nacht ist es völlig ok und den Vorteil 24h nach Check in auch wieder auszuchecken ist der Hauptvorteil dieses Hotels. Da wir jedoch um 12 Uhr weiter mussten, hatte es für uns keinen Vorteil bis um 19 Uhr bleiben zu können. Hotel ist zwar nicht im Zentrum, aber man kommt innerhalb 5-15min mit dem Taxi an viele interessante Standorte.

title: Fantastic Home from Home Hotel
text:
Really enjoyed my time at this hotel.  From check in with check out all very faultless. The bar offers a Happy hour daily between 17.00 - 19.00, cocktails are well made and you most definitely can taste the alcohol!

I went for a lite room which was cozy and comfortable the shower door doubles as the bathroom door, which I thought was very innovative. There is plenty of space for your clothes, shoes etc, a safe and a fridge. The bed is super comfy with plenty of pillows and the TV pretty much has a channel in every language.

The laundry room  on the M floor is also a great idea. Good for me as I am travelling for a month, so I made sure to utilise the facilities washing and drying everything before I left. The machines already have detergent in them so you don't have to worry about that. Dryers are effective but be mindful if you open the door mid session to check your clothes it stops the cycle, something I learned the haed way but staff were happy to sort that out for me.

There is also a vending machine in the laundry with bits and pieces you may have forgotten to pack, all reasonably priced.

I wish Wink hotels were in other counties, because for me that would be my first choice every time. The atmosphere is lovely and the vibe is nice and chilled.

I would definitely stay again 😊

title: A Wink at Dissapointment
text:
My recent stay at the Wink Hotel in Saigon was a major letdown. From the moment we checked in, the experience was plagued with issues.

**Chaotic Check-In and Room Availability**

Despite arriving at 2:30 PM, well past the standard check-in time, our room wasn't ready until 3:15 PM. The small, chaotic lobby did little to alleviate the frustration. This inconsiderate delay set a negative tone for the entire stay.

**Basic Amenities and Lackluster Technology**

The room itself was underwhelming. The absence of complimentary water was a surprising oversight, especially for a hotel of this price range. The lack of a smart TV was another major disappointment, limiting our entertainment options. For a hotel charging $70 per night, it's disheartening to find such basic amenities missing.

**Misleading Location and Confusing Check-In Process**

The hotel's location was also a source of confusion. The property is not actually located at the Saigon Center near Ben Thanh Market, as implied by its name. The check-in process was further complicated by the staff's apparent lack of knowledge about our pre-paid reservation and repeated requests for payment.

**Poor Room Allocation and Inattentive Staff**

The room allocation was another misstep. We had booked two rooms, one with a single bed and the other with two beds, but were initially assigned rooms with only one bed each. Our request for an extra blanket was met with a dismissive response from the staff, who suggested we share a blanket. It took six hours for them to finally deliver the additional blanket.

**Overpriced and Underwhelming**

For the price, the Wink Hotel offers little value. The small room size, basic amenities, and poor customer service do not justify the cost. The hotel's claims of prioritizing customer service are clearly unfounded.

**A Word of Caution**

I strongly advise travelers to avoid the Wink Hotel. There are far better options available in Saigon that offer superior value, comfort, and service. Save yourself the frustration and opt for a hotel that truly cares about its guests.

text:
체크인 체크아웃  시간이 따로 정해지지 않고 체크인 한 시간에 체크아웃을 하게 만들어놓은 시스템이 좋습니다. 
늦게 도착하시는 분들은 나갈때 그만큼 늦게 나갈 수 있어요.
위치는 그렇게 좋지도.. 그렇게 나쁘지도 않아요.
저희는 볼거리 갈때 편도 택시 3만~4만동으로 많이 다녔습니다.

방도 깨끗하고 조식도 종류는 많지 않지만 깔끔하게 나옵니다. 쌀국수, 오믈렛은 매일 나오고, 이틀 묵었는데 조식 두번 종류가 다 달랐어요.

불편한점은 욕실 구조가 이상해서 샤워실 문, 욕실 출입문을 같이 사용하더라구요. 샤워실 문을 닫으면 화장실에 문이 활짝 열려있는 구조. 안쪽은 좁아서 샤워하고 나오면 변기통 옆으로 서서 문을 여닫아야 하는 구조입니다.

가격대비 나쁘지않은 숙소입니다.

title: Exceptional
positives:
This is a fantastic hotel which suited my needs perfectly on my first trip to HCMC. The city was challenging at first, so I really appreciated the Wink Hotel as a calm home base to return to.

The friendliness and helpfulness of the staff was a stand out feature and I really enjoyed chatting with them at the bar and breakfast (the included all you can eat breakfast including both western and Vietnamese foods was tasty). Credit to the wonderful team of Bobby, Quyen, Hana, Vi, Bao, Glenn, Steven and Nhu! They helped and advised me with any issue, were great to talk with, and provided excellent service all round via the bar and restaurant. 

The rooms are clean and modern with nice bathroom facilities. My room wasn't large but had everything needed for my use case of crashing, cleaning up, and doing a little work there (it had a small desk area).

But I preferred to spend any time at the hotel in the common areas, which are comfortable for both lounging and working, and allows for chatting with the staff and the other guests.

The hotel location was good for me, as someone who likes to explore a lot of foot, it was within half an hour of very central areas. I tended to walk in to the centre with some stops along the way for food and coffees. For those who don't like to walk that far (I averaged around 20k steps per day on my trip, which I know isn't everyone) the Grab app can be used easily to pick up a car or motorbike ride.

I had a brilliant stay at the hotel and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a friendly home base when visiting Ho Chi Minh City. I hope I can visit again next time.

title: Wink Hotel Saigon Center - Disappointingly Subpar Experience
text:
Having enjoyed fantastic stays at the Wink hotel in Danang previously, I had high expectations for the Wink Saigon Center. Unfortunately, this property fell well short of the mark. 

Unlike Danang where breakfast was included, here it's an expensive add-on not part of the room rate. The rooms themselves are tiny, with the standard options confined to the bottom 5 floors of the building. To upgrade to higher floors requires paying a steep 50% premium on top of the already hefty room cost.

When I made it to my room, the underwhelming size was compounded by a persistent stale smell emanating from the bathroom. For a brand that promotes itself as boutique and stylish, Wink Saigon feels more like a dated and run-down budget property.

Between the cramped quarters, unpleasant odors, nickel-and-diming for any semblance of an upscale experience, and a complete departure from the consistency I associated with this brand, I couldn't be more disappointed. I certainly won't be returning to Wink Saigon Center, nor can I recommend it compared to the many other upscale options available in this city.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

title: Excellet Hotel
positives: Wink Hotel was a great stay and unique experience. Truly, I wish more hotels were like Wink. I had a few hotel options for Ho Chi Minh City, but decided to go with Wink because they have a laundry room, and I desperately needed that at that point in my trip. I am so glad I chose them because there are multiple reasons to choose Wink over other hotels. The 24-hour check-in was so helpful and appreciated. More hotels should do this as it allows guests to get their money's worth, and it's really helpful to have the option to spend the last morning/half day exploring more of the city, and then come back and shower and eat, and even rest a bit before a late afternoon/evening flight (things you can't do with early checkout, even if hotel keeps your luggage). I always make sure to book a hotel with a restaurant in case I'm too exhausted after a long day out doing tourist stuff, and I can confirm after trying several items on their menu that the food is excellent, including breakfast too. I love their little market options by the restaurant where guests can buy power bars, drinks, and other snacks. I prefer to walk to explore a city, and I was able to walk to a lot of spots like the Opera House, Post Office/book street within 15 to 30 minutes (and so much to see along the way). Also, a very quick ride if you want to use Grab for transportation. The staff was great. Everyone was friendly, professional and ready to answer questions. They also set me up on a day tour to the Mekong Delta. I liked the room's compact layout; the design makes a great use of the space without feeling too small. I've seen some complaints about the shower. The door to the bathroom is also the door to the shower. I put the bath mat down and was fine. I had great views, a cool blackout shade, super comfortable bed, and I could not hear outside noises, even when they had a DJ in the lobby one night.

title: The youngest hotel in Ho Chi Minh City.
text:
On the third day in Ho Chi Minh City, I switched to this hotel. The original plan was to take a trip around Hanoi, but I felt I hadn't had enough coffee or food in Ho Chi Minh City. So I decided to stay and play for three more nights. 

I had set a budget of around 300 for the hotel room. I was attracted to this hotel on Agoda mainly because of its pictures. I thought this hotel was perfect for young people! Stylish and vibrant! 

The hotel's style is somewhat similar to the colors of Marriott W, featuring purple, red, and azure. Many self-service options are implemented in their service. The front desk staff's English proficiency is very good and their attitude is enthusiastic. When I made my reservation in advance, I requested a high floor, and they accommodated me. 

The one who impressed me the most was the staff member named Yen, who always wore a smile and arranged a very quiet room for me. It was very considerate. 

Compared to the overall price, location, service, and decoration, the experience at this 300 price point was fantastic and definitely worth recommending!

title: Best Hotel in Vietnam
text:
We booked this hotel on our last day in Vietnam. It was not in our itinerary, but due to the previous hotel was not good and it seems like there is someone had died in that room. 

Luckily, I have found Wink Hotel. As a tourist, we dont have Idea where to go in Vietnam in case of emergency like this. But we immediately packed our luggage and ride a taxi going to wink. They immediately assist us and in an instant we got our room. This was the highlight of our tour as we Came from dubai and just having vacation in Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam. 

Kudos to Mr. Mako of that night who assisted us on check in. 

The room they gave us was on 11th floor, very near on the elevator and it was City View. 😎 it is very clean room that I took a very long sleep and almost did make it to breakfast. Hehe. But ofcourse, i could not miss it. 

There breakfast is very tasty and that was the real taste of Vietnam.

Another thing that made me this review was, we checked in 7pm of April 8 and they have this 24hours booking. But on april 9, we had to call that we will be extending for 2 hours, and ask the reception how much it will be, and they said it will be free. I am amazed. Really!! Thank you for this Wink.

All in all, this hotel is the best for us. They are good in terms of assisting all guest despite of language barrier.  Cleanliness of the room is superb! They even make up our room and noticed that they had change the bed linens. I could not be more satisfied with that. 

Thank you Wink. When we come back to Vietnam, we will surely book on the same hotel. Kudos to Wink Hotel. We love our stay there!

title: Honeymoon Hotel!
text: My husband and i were looking for hotels in Ho Chi Minh and we kept looping back to Wink even after scrolling through multiple hotel sites. The staff are the best! They are so kind, they are very explanative to all our random questions. We were on our honeymoon and we our request for a high floor with a view was accepted💕 though, i know it is case by case so we really were super lucky! The rooms will be a little warm upon entry if check-in’s at mid day though! Just close the blinds and it’ll cool down in a few minutes! Do note their check-ins are really unique! It’s basically a 24 hour loop, so if you booked for 3 days and you check in at say 12:30, your check-outs gonna be at 12:30 at the end of day 3. It was really helpful as our flight to hcmc arrived at 11:25am and our flight out was at 16:15pm, so we had ample time to get lunch and go around even on our last day! I have no complaints about the room except for the water pressure from the rain shower but honestly i’m short. I’m 150cm tall (~5ft) so the handshower’s height at an angle for me was superb! Especially with the pressure that it has!😍 just a tip - leave the floor towels outside! The shower area’s a slope down towards both drains, so the middle area tends to get wet. If you’re like me and have a need for split wet and dry toilets - make sure you’re the first to shower between you and your partner/family😂 The grab gps keeps looping them to the small road but honestly Wink’s really obvious so when you’re nearby just help the cabbie because the hcmc traffic guys. Honestly, big claps to Wink and their friendly staff! Do give them a look-see if you’re coming by hcmc! We’ definitely be back!🥰

title: Bathroom flaw
text:
We stayed 3 nights, travelling for leisure. 

The bathroom basically flooded each time we showered, which was really frustrating. There is a design flaw with the stall as water will leak out to the toilet area no matter what. Kept having to use towels to clean up the bathroom.

At times, the lifts don’t work efficiently. You press a button and the lift at level one would not open. Instead, the other lift would have to travel all the way down. But both lifts are running, so there’s something wrong with the programming.

Gym is 24h but no aircon after hours. Also, the main door is not glass so it takes a while to find the gym door. Might be a safety hazard too, that passers-by cannot look into the gym.

The room is adequately clean,  but even at a high floor, we could hear traffic and nightlife once we turned out the lights. It’s not noisy but audible enough to affect light sleepers.

Staff is young and energetic; they seem to do it all. Breakfast wasn’t great, so we only had fruit and yoghurt on most mornings. Just head out, since there are so many food options in the neighbourhood. There is a water dispenser at ground floor to refill your bottle, so that’s good.

I think it would be worthwhile paying more to get a better accommodation in this city.

title: Soundproofing and bedding dust
text:
I stayed for two nights.
Pros: The bedding was soft and comfortable, there were no bugs, and the room was relatively clean. Although there is no swimming pool, there is a fitness room.
Cons: 1) The windows cannot be opened, and there was so much dust on the bedding that we had to move it once; however, my friend and I coughed for two days because the dust got into our throats. 2) The soundproofing is very poor. I couldn't sleep because of the noise from the next room in the early morning, so I switched rooms; however, in the new road-view room, I ended up not being able to sleep due to the noise of motorcycle engines and car horns.
3) There is nothing to eat at breakfast except for the omelets. The hotel manager invited us to dinner at the hotel restaurant to apologize for the soundproofing issues, but the food was not tasty at all. The steak was so tough that it was difficult to chew. I recommend eating lunch and dinner out. 4) Although the location is in District 1, it is on the outskirts, so you must take a taxi to leave the hotel. 5) The staff attitude is poor. They appear angry and seem to lack consideration for the guest's perspective. The manager always used vague language regarding compensation for complaints, causing confusion and requiring multiple email exchanges; I requested a face-to-face meeting, but he never showed up. In conclusion, I have no intention of visiting this hotel again.

title: Không xứng đáng theo tiêu chí KS 4*
text:
Có bãi đỗ ô tô, tuy nhiên khu vực bãi đỗ có mùi hôi từ nước thải. Gara không có thang máy đi lên khu vực lễ tân, phải đi thang bộ từ 1-2 tầng và phải đi ngang khu vực ăn uống.
Nhà hàng nằm chung khu vực lễ tân (mùi đồ ăn hòa lẫn chunh khu check in & check out). KS xử lý hút mùi không tốt, buổi sáng khách ăn điểm tâm mà ở tận trước cửa phòng Tầng 12 có mùi đồ ăn bay lên.
Trong phòng chỉ có nước uống (ngoài ra không có trà hay cafê gói, hay ấm đun, muỗng cafe). Tiện nghi không có dao cạo râu dành cho Nam.
Điểm tâm có thể nói là thang điểm thấp nhất trong các KS 4* mình từng ở mặc dù giá cao hơn nơi khác.
author: HỒNG
reply:
Cảm ơn bạn Hồng đã chia sẻ ý kiến về trải nghiệm lưu trú tại Wink Hotel Saigon Centre. Chúng tôi rất tiếc khi biết rằng những tiện nghi và dịch vụ tại khách sạn chưa đáp ứng đúng kỳ vọng của mình.

Về các vấn đề liên quan đến khu vực bãi đỗ xe và nhà hàng, chúng tôi xin ghi nhận và sẽ làm việc chặt chẽ với các bộ phận liên quan để cải thiện hệ thống hút mùi cũng như nâng cao chất lượng dịch vụ. Chúng tôi cũng sẽ xem xét lại các tiện nghi trong phòng để đáp ứng tốt hơn nhu cầu của khách hàng. Về các tiện ích trong phòng, khách sạn chúng tôi hướng tới việc hạn chế sử dụng nhựa một lần, vì vậy những nhu yếu phẩm có thể mua tại khu vực Grab & Go với giá cả phải chăng, đồng thời giúp kéo dài dòng đời sản phẩm. title: Phòng chỉ thích hợp cá nhân đi công tác
text:
Phòng 20m2 bao gồm cả phòng tắm siêu bé, thiết kế tích hợp thông minh rồi mà diện tích thoáng của phòng vẫn cực nhỏ. Tivi thì gắn vào tường, bàn nhỏ cũng gắn vào giường. Đầy đủ tiện nghi nhưng không thoải mái mặc dù mình ở một mình. Nếu đi couple thì chật hơn nữa còn tuyệt đối không phù hợp với gia đình trẻ nhỏ.  Hoặc các bạn tham khảo phòng lớn hơn. Nhớ xem kĩ hình ảnh phòng trước khi đặt kẻo thât vọng như mình. 
Sảnh ksan rộng rãi nhân viên trẻ, phòng k có sẵn mì tôm, trà , cafe, không có nhâm viên mang hành lý.  Nói chung phong cách của ksan trẻ và tự phục vụ nhiều, mng nghiên cứu kĩ style của ksan trước khi đặt. 
Với phòng nhỏ như thế này thì giá khách sạn là khá cao. 
Lần sau mình sẽ không quay lại.
author: Nguyễn
reply:
Cảm ơn bạn Nguyễn đã dành thời gian chia sẻ trải nghiệm của bạn tại Wink Hotel Saigon Centre. Chúng tôi đã nhận được đánh giá và chia sẻ chân thật của bạn tại khách sạn.

Chúng tôi hiểu rằng phòng Deluxe và Premier của Wink có thể không phù hợp cho những ai cần nhiều không gian hơn, và rất tiếc khi phòng không đáp ứng được sự thoải mái mà bạn mong muốn. Ngoài hạng phòng Deluxe và Premier, thì còn một loại phòng Family với diện tích lớn hơn, và thoải mái hơn cho gia đình. Tất cả phòng Family đều nằm trên tầng 12 của khách sạn, đảm bảo view thoáng và đem lại cảm giác thoải mái cho khách lưu trú ở loại phòng này. 

Hy vọng lần tới chúng tôi sẽ có cơ hội đón tiếp bạn với một trải nghiệm tốt hơn. Hãy liên hệ trực tiếp với Wink team, chúng tôi sẽ hỗ trợ và đáp ứng nhu cầu của bạn cùng với gia đình của mình một cách tốt nhất. 

-Từ Đội Ngũ Wink Của Bạn.
